name: Balack's Lantern
description:
This magical lantern, lit with a Dragon Ember is the only light source hot enough to remain lit in the dampness of Balack's Cove.

Obtain this map piece during the Legendary adventure:
Defeat Balack the Banished

name: Ticket to the Burroughs Bazaar
description:
This ticket grants access to the Burroughs Bazaar, and is dropped by a few varieties of mice in the Training Grounds.

Obtain this map piece during the Grandmaster adventure:
Take an Archery Lesson at the Training Grounds

name: Key to the Town of Digby
description: A key used by the scientists in the Laboratory to access their escape transport drill that leads to their secret research facility in Digby.

name: King's Gauntlet Floorplan
description:
Sold in the Bazaar, this floor plan has been commissioned directly by the King of Gnawnia. Below the King's seal is this note: Vend only to those who show remarkable valour in the name of the royal crown, and its jewels. The Cartographer has been working hard to produce a surplus of floor plans!

Obtain this map piece during the Hero adventure:
Capture the Eclipse Mouse

name: Great Gnarled Tree Map Piece
description:
This map piece, which is dropped by Cyclops mice in the Calm Clearing, allows you to travel to the Great Gnarled Tree.

Obtain this map piece during the Journeyman/Journeywoman adventure:
Survey the Calm Clearing

name: Gnawnia Map Piece
description: The King grants access to the lands around the Town of Gnawnia to all hunters who wish to serve in his royal army, giving them access to the Meadow, Town of Gnawnia, the Windmill, the Harbour and the Mountains.

name: S.S. Huntington IV
description:
This boat was built using a variety of nautical supplies and hundreds of thousands of interlocking hull fragments. Its reinforced hull and sturdy rigging allow you to sail the waters of the Rodentia Ocean, and is one of the few vessels capable of breaching the dangerous Iceberg.

Obtain this map piece during the Grandmaster adventure:
Craft the S.S. Huntington IV

name: Keeper's Candle
description:
With the flame of the Keeper mice in your hands, you can see your way to the Forbidden Grove through the darkened tunnels of the Catacombs.

Obtain this map piece during the Legendary adventure:
Capture the Acolyte Mouse

name: Laboratory Map Piece
description:
The Abominable Snow Mouse hoards this map piece for you to find! There's a path to what looks like a Laboratory printed on it.

Obtain this map piece during the Journeyman/Journeywoman adventure:
Find the Hidden Mountain Pass

name: Map of the Lagoon
description:
The Fairy Mice of the Great Gnarled Tree dropped this map piece, which shows the way to the Lagoon. This looks like a dangerous area, and may require special bait.

Obtain this map piece during the Master adventure:
Climb Up the Great Gnarled Tree

name: Ocean Navigation Kit
description:
Crafted from a Telescope, Sextant, and Compass, this kit allows Hunters to sail further out into the ocean than ever before. With this newfound freedom, you'll be able to explore the Tribal Isles.

Obtain this map piece during the Legendary adventure:
Navigate the Rodentia Ocean

name: Repaired Mousoleum Map Piece
description:
Research suggests that mystery lies below the Mousoleum! This patch can be applied to a Tattered Mousoleum Map to reveal new possible hunting grounds. Restoring ancient cloth requires a great deal of skill and does not come cheap.

The Cartographer suspects that a hunter will need the title of Legendary to understand the secrets revealed.

Obtain this map piece during the Legendary adventure:
Capture the Acolyte Mouse

name: Shredded Furoma Map Piece
description:
This tattered piece of map gives access to the Training Grounds in Furoma. Torn from the clutches of Mousevina Von Vermin, the Cartographer at the Bazaar might be able to restore it.

Obtain this map piece during the Master adventure:
Slay Mousevina Von Vermin

name: Stitched Furoma Map Piece
description:
Hunters often find pieces of the Furoma map slightly shredded by the claws of mice. A skilled cartographer is able to restore this shredded map by stitching a patch over the damaged area to reveal additional detail.

Obtain this map piece during the Master adventure:
Capture the Master of the Dojo

name: Tattered Mousoleum Map Piece
description:
The Monster Mouse did quite a number on this old map piece... It shows the way to the Mousoleum, but if you get it repaired, it may reveal an even spookier location!

Obtain this map piece during the Master adventure:
Slay Mousevina Von Vermin

name: Calm Clearing Map Piece
description:
The pirate crews of the Harbour hold onto this map, which depicts a peaceful-looking clearing in the Whisker Woods region.

Obtain this map piece during the Initiate adventure:
Discover the Harbour's Secrets

name: Aqua Base
description: The clear blue water often causes mice to become distracted by their own reflection making an easier target for a trap.

name: Bamboozler Base
description: The Trapsmith's official name for this base is the Bamboozler, but among the populace, it has another, more sinister name: The Bamboozling Bamboo Base of Boo-Boos. Its fresh wood scent is irresistible to clean freaks, and boosts the attraction rate of your cheese, but that's not all. The base is also precision built from only the strongest cuts of bamboo, increasing weapon stability and adding a power bonus.

name: Birthday Cake Base
description:
This huge slab of birthday cake comes from a massive cake served at MouseHunt's very first birthday party. There were so many leftovers, slabs are still being sliced off and distributed to this day!

A flavour first savoured during MouseHunt's 1st birthday!

name: Candy Cane Base
description: Remember how special you felt as a little kid when you found an extra piece of candy on the floor, just for you? Well, now you can replicate that feeling with the Candy Cane Base. Of course, the makers of the base do not recommend it for human consumption. Mice are bound to try licking it, and it gets awfully sticky after a few uses.

name: Chocolate Birthday Cake Base
description:
Three of Gnawnia's finest bakers collaborated to produce this amazing cake, which also doubles as a decorative base. With double chocolate icing, three layers of triple chocolate cake, and an astounding, super rich filling of quadruple chocolate fudge delight, this is one of the most chocolate-y bases ever! This cake is tasty and filling for hunters, but if a mouse takes more than a few bites, it will lapse into a sugary coma.

A flavour first savoured during MouseHunt's 2nd birthday!

name: Dehydration Base
description: A base made out of salt! Besides causing mild irritation to mouse paws, the salt also seems quite excellent at keeping bait fresh.

name: Explosive Base
description: A base made of plastic-explosive, the ultimate back-up plan for any weapon.

name: Firecracker Base
description: Firecrackers have suffered a recent bout of unpopularity lately in Gnawnia, after a rash of accidents convinced many members of the public that fireworks are unsafe. Luckily, the appeal of these high-quality fireworks is rapidly erasing the stigma caused by all the accidents. . . by encouraging people to cause more accidents. Only this time, the accidents will be happening to mice-- hopefully.

name: Gingerbread Base
description: This base has been baked in the oven for just the right amount of time to make it a lightly toasted, chewy wonder. After taking it out of the oven, Santa's elves dusted the base with a sprinkling of powdered sugar and then decorated it with a festive star pattern and multi-colored gumdrops. Unfortunately, they also left it out on the counter where the mice could walk all over it. Now that it's unsuitable to give as a gift, you might as well put a trap on top of it.

name: Magma Base
description:
Carved from the turbulent molten rock at the base of Mt. Dracano, the Magma Base reflects the more dangerous side of the tropics. Scientists haven't quite identified the gas that vents out of this rock yet, but they're sure of one thing: mice love it.
	
Ronza has a hard time carrying a lot of these, because they burn right through boxes and bags.

name: Monolith Base
description: Mice become brutal and vicious in the presence of the Monolith Base, reverting to a feral state. Hunters, too, feel its pull as a sense of overwhelming dread. The ominous feel of this base comes from the fact that this base was found perfectly formed from the lost elemental material Ohnoesium. This extremely rare ore can only be found in small, hard-to-reach deposits deep beneath the earth at Digby, although most hunters who have come into contact with Ohnoesium ore agree that it should probably stay in the ground.

name: Polar Base
description: This base is made from magical glacial ice that seems to absorb and freeze the humidity in the air, mysteriously retaining its shape. This physics-defying ice is imported by Ronza the merchant, perhaps making it the most expensive cube of water you'll ever own!

name: Stone Base
description: The added weight of a stone base increases the stability of your weapon.

name: Tribal Base
description:
The three rival mouse tribes of Elub, Nerg and Derr very seldom come together, but when they finally get around to negotiations after their latest skirmish, they meet on this elaborately carved tribal mask. Only the eldest of the mice from all three tribes are allowed to work on constructing the meeting place, which is hallowed by the tribes-mice due to its origins in the Jungle of Dread. How frustrating for these master crafts-rodents that the trapsmiths co-opt their art for traps!

The tribal paints mesmerize the mice of Elub, Nerg and Derr, giving your trap a +6 Luck Bonus when encountering them on a hunt.

name: Wooden Base
description: A standard wood base to attach to your weapon.

name: Wooden Base with Target
description: A wooden base with a target pad to increase the accuracy of your weapon.

name: 2010 Blastoff Trap
description: It's time to welcome in the new year! Lying in wait behind this colorful pile of fireworks is a diligent little droid, waiting to make the first catch of 2010. When a mouse takes the bait, the droid pushes the plunger, and in a blinding flash of light and color the mouse sails up into the stratosphere, tied to a colossal rocket by the rope around his foot.  The mouse can use the banner as a parachute, if he's smart, but that all depends on whether or not the banner catches fire during launch.

name: 500 Pound Spiked Crusher
description: A 500 pound weight with sharp spikes on the bottom precariously hangs by a thin rope, eagerly awaiting a mouse to wander below.

name: Arcane Capturing Rod Of Never Yielding Mystery
description:
This highly unstable trap setup is held in a constant state of metamorphosis by the unpredictable power of the Onyx stone. This trap almost appears alive, growing metal roots into whatever base to which it is attached.

This trap's methods of capture are infinitely random. It can use its jagged metallic roots to impale mice, expel a thick and dark vapor that turns mice into stone, or bend space and time to erase the mouse from existence.

Scientists of Digby warn hunters that the power of the Onyx stone is incredibly dangerous and fear that using this trap could lead to the end of the world.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Catacombs, Forbidden Grove, Acolyte Realm, or Fort Rox Trapsmith

name: Ambrosial Portal
description: Proof that technology developed in the Burroughs' Laboratory can be used in a more 'gentle' manner, this portal has opened a one-way entrance into a cheesy paradise.

name: Ambush Trap
description: This peaceful setting for tea and a light snack appears to be the perfect spot for war-hardened mice to pause for some peaceful rest and meditation. Yet behind a thin paper wall lies a robot ambush of epic proportions! The loyal droids follow the will of their controlling hunter to either capture and exile mice or use their high speed reflexes for a heavy battle that is sure to erupt into various explosions and montages.

name: Ancient Box Trap
description: The ancient ghost mice which roamed Gnawnia before even the castle existed require an old-fashioned trap strategy, and the Ancient Box Trap is about as old-fashioned as they come. A heavy stone box teeters precariously upon an Ancient Relic Staff, waiting for a mouse to pull the Ethereal Rope and cause the box to slam shut and magically fuse with the base. This may seem like a deceptively simple trap set-up, but ancient mice enjoy the classics.

name: Ancient Spear Gun
description: A launcher rigged to fire an ancient spear of the Elub tribe. The glowing spear possesses magical homing properties that make for an incredibly accurate shot.

name: Bottomless Grave
description:
Although Digby drilling technology has often been regarded as the quickest to dig a grave, ambitious scientists were still tempted to experiment with rocket-propelled drills.



The result of these experiments has now turned into researching where the high speed drills have gone.

name: Christmas Cracker Trap
description: All those gifts from the twelve days of Christmas, and not a single trap among them. . . Santa just doesn't understand Mouse Hunters. Oh well, never fear! Candy canes, reindeer antlers and Christmas lights all make great projectiles! Just stuff them in a giant cannon, pull the string, and voila! Instant present gratification. Now where's all that fruit cake from last year?

name: Chrome DrillBot
description: While drilling through clumpy top soil around Digby, the scientists there became tired of constantly cleaning the drills. Their solution? Coat the drills in slick chrome! Overcharged and super-powered, the Chrome DrillBot obliterates mice in style!

name: Chrome Nannybot
description: No shenanigans will go unpunished while the Chrome Nannybot guards your trap base! With a little ingenuity and the help of the Digby scientists, you've built the deluxe factory model, complete with anti-sass-mouth scanners, advanced gum-in-hair removal matrices, and a stern yet sensible nagging voice available in thirty-eight languages. Now mice who visit can receive a much-needed lesson in table manners before being frozen for your convenience.

name: Clockapult of Time
description: As a golden platform accelerates near 88 miles per hour, the hands of this spooky-looking clock begin to spin with incredible speed. With a faint flash of purple light, the mouse is sent far into the future. To an outside observer, the trap appears to trigger in the blink of an eye, but to a mouse caught within the event, the journey seems much, much longer. The clock begins to blur as the hands spin faster and faster. The clock face glows eerily as everything that was once the present blends to what was once the future.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Cape Clawed, Jungle of Dread, Balack's Cove, King's Gauntlet, or Fort Rox Trapsmith

name: Chrome DeathBot
description:
This limited edition version of the classic DeathBot features shiny chrome-plated panels, with a lot o' bling. The motors have been tweaked a little to bring more power to the chain gun and saw blade, the laser power has been increased by 5 kilowatts, and the missile guidance system has been improved using the newest in mouse-seeking technology.

The King has allowed this weapon to be sold for a limited time only.

"For the MouseHunter who has everything."

name: Digby DrillBot
description:
The scientists of Digby used their knowledge of tunnel digging technology to create the ultimate mouse adversary. Using its two massive high-speed drills, this titan can easily destroy any mouse put in its path.

Catching a Steel Mouse with this trap will produce Scrap Metal!
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Town of Digby Trapsmith

name: Giant Speaker
description: This trap is guaranteed to harsh any rocker's mellow. The minute a mouse comes into the range of the ring of microphones, the slightest noise is amplified a billion times, rocketing them across the room on a wave of sound. Collecting mice is a cinch when they're disoriented and temporarily hard of hearing.

name: Gingerbread House Surprise
description: Warmth and the smell of baking cheese biscuits draw mice into this charming little gumdrop house, where they will find a present, waiting just for them. The mice unwrap the present, to find, in place of the cheese biscuits, a mouse-sized parachute. Once the mouse puts on the parachute, a burst of reverse Santa magic shoots it out the chimney, into the air to a land far away. Being flung into the air isn't what the mouse had on its list, but it's the thought that counts.

name: Gorgon Trap
description: Made from the eye of the Gorgon, a hideous monster with hair made of snakes, this trap will literally scare mice stiff, turning them into living statues. Hunters with visions of figurine collections dancing in their head may be disappointed that the perfect little mouse statues only last for a few hours before they thaw out, but that's certainly long enough to throw them into a sack and send them to a safe location.

name: Harpoon Gun
description: Firing an oversized 200 pound spiked projectile makes for an extremely intimidating trap.

name: High Tension Spring
description: Razor sharp barbs adorn a crushing bar held with over 1000 lbs of tension.

name: HitGrab Horsey
description: Stolen from the depths of the King's closet, this mystical hobby horse works its hunting magic by striking with a swift and unexpected downward head-butt to anything crossing its path.  Unfortunately, the horses poor vision leads to many inaccurate strikes, but his royal luck is seemingly quite high.

name: HitGrab Rainbow Rockin' Horse
description: Unable to pull back its lips to let out a rockin' NAAYY this Horsey compensates by having the loudest hairstyle possible! These hobby horses have often been threatened with exile from the Kingdom after keeping the King up all night to the sound of closet moshing. Rock on... HUNT ON!

name: HitGrab Rockin' Horse
description: Ready to rock the moment it emerges from the King's closet, this rebel hobby horse refuses to play by anyone's hunting rules but its own!

name: Horrific Venus Mouse Trap
description: The effects of radioactive sludge on this Venus Mouse trap appears to have given the plant an aggressive temper! Its sharp vines and thorns now ooze with toxic waste making a menacing opponent for any mouse.

name: Ice Maiden
description: Bound within the pillar of ice on the back of this trap is a rare enchantment. When the dragon breathes fire onto the trap, the ice temporarily melts, releasing a specially-designed dragon collar which snaps down onto the dragon's neck and freezes him in a thick coating of ice.

name: Kraken Chaos
description: This trap offers mice the thrill of the open ocean, with a great piece of cheese and the wind blowing through their fur... of course, they'll also have a giant, grabby squid to keep them company. With eight arms and two tentacles contending for the catch, this trap just has to get the mouse one way or the other. It's also a favorite of humane hunters, as the squid much prefers to eat fish.

name: Mouse DeathBot
description: Although origins of this high-tech robot are unknown, its ability to destroy mice is well known. The DeathBot comes equipped with a high speed chain gun, two rapid fire laser guns, an extending saw blade arm and nine mouse-seeking missiles. Even the quickest, cleverest mouse stands little chance against this adversary.

name: Mouse Mary O'Nette
description: A clever decoy to attract an unsuspecting mouse under a looming steel cage.

name: Mouse Rocketine
description: Off with their heads! This super-charged, rocket-powered version of a guillotine is the perfect way to hold all those criminal mice accountable for stealing your precious cheese.

name: Mouse Trebuchet
description: For those so inclined to not so much harm a mouse, but rather relocate it a few miles away there is the wooden mouse trebuchet. When triggered this trap catapults the mouse at over 500 miles per hour up to a range of 7 miles.

name: Mutated Venus Mouse Trap
description: Radioactive sludge has accelerated the growth of this Venus Mouse Trap and given it what appears to be a healthy appetite for mice.

name: Nannybot
description: Straighten up and mind your manners: the Nannybot is on duty! She has camera 'eyes' in the back of her head, four extra claw arms that allow her to be absolutely everywhere at once, and the Time Out Engine, a device that will catch and hold mice frozen in time until the hunter is ready to deal with them. Some mice 'borrowed' this model from Digby scientists as a prototype, so it lacks all the features of a factory model. Maybe with a few supplies, you could fix it up. . .

name: Net Cannon
description: Using powerful pneumatics this cannon fires a high tension net at an incredible velocity making it capable of catching the quick mice that lurk in and around water. The net cannon is extremely loud, proper ear protection is recommended.

name: NVMRC Forcefield Trap
description: This trap generates a force field tough enough to hold even the strongest mice within. Once trapped, the mouse is harmlessly incapacitated with 100% organic sleeping gas and relocated to a mouse reservation.

name: Obelisk of Incineration Trap
description: This magical obelisk fuses super concentrated carbon material with supernatural heat forces to produce an unmeasurably hot flame. The resulting thermal explosion quickly seeks out the nearest object with somewhat limited accuracy. A nose peg is suggested when using this hunting gear.

name: Obelisk of Slumber Trap
description: This arcane staff is slightly tingly to the touch and stands as a bright beacon designed to mesmerize mice that lurk in darkness. Its mysterious glow and refreshing minty smell gently coax unruly Forgotten mice into a deep sleep.

name: Onyx Mallet
description: The Onyx Mallet Trap represents the latest and greatest achievement in pulverizing technology. Unequaled in the making of such items as puree of mouse, mouse tartar and, the ever popular Mouse Paste, the Onyx Mallet is quickly becoming a favorite among those discerning individuals who insist on receiving their mice flat. Simply place the cheese below the mallet, set the arm to the ready position, and listen for the splat.

name: PartyBot
description: Don't be fooled by this edition of the DeathBot. Although it likes to dress up and party, it still poses a great threat to mousekind.

name: RhinoBot
description: Stale SUPER|brie+ has been found to be a harder substance than that of diamond, a property that the mighty RhinoBot puts to good use. Describing the power of this massive instrument of mouse destruction is simple: whatever it hits, it destroys.

name: Sinister Portal
description: Using technology developed in the Burroughs' Laboratory, this one-way portal into outer space waits at the end of a high-speed conveyor belt for an unsuspecting mouse.

name: Snow Barrage
description:
Looks can be deceiving. Many mice fail to even recognize that a snowman could be a trap! Mice who make this mistake and underestimate the power of this bazooka's 3-snowball-per-second firing rate will very quickly find themselves buried in a pile of their own yellow snow.

The King has allowed this weapon to be sold for a limited time only.

name: Snowglobe Trap
description: It is a little-known fact that mice share humanity's obsession with the weather patterns of vinegar-filled miniature aquariums, which is, in part, why the Snowglobe trap is so successful. When a mouse comes near the snow globe to get a better look at the winter wonderland inside, the moving platform catapults it through the force field at the front of the globe, where it bonks its head on the back wall. Once in the globe, it will freeze, becoming a natural part of the interior scenery.

name: Swiss Army Mouse Trap
description: Three razor sharp knife blades come downwards rapidly while a half dozen high speed drill bits come upwards, leaving little evidence that the mouse ever existed.

name: Tacky Glue Trap
description: If you believe the simplest answer is the best, then white glue and some cheese is the way to go!

name: Thorned Venus Mouse Trap
description: Adorned with razor-sharp thorns grown in the Jungle of Dread, this Venus Mouse Trap uses its vines to trap any mice unfortunate enough to wander near.

name: Venus Mouse Trap
description: The carnivorous plants that grow near the Lagoon of Whisker Woods are often harvested by Trapsmiths and grown to supernatural size by unnatural means. The result is a highly effective and well-camouflaged mouse adversary.

name: Zugzwang's Last Move
description: Throughout the years Wizard Zugzwang's creations have been spread across the Gnawnia Kingdom, being traded between experienced hunters and trapsmith. Zugzwang enchanted the pieces of his chess set to create a trap weapon capable of combating the clever mice in his tower. The pieces of this weapon come to life when a mouse approaches the trap's bait, the battle that follows is quick and decisive.

name: Ancient Cheese
description: These tender morsels spark with electric energy that bind together dust-like particles of stale cheese. Ancient cheese expels a strong stale scent and is extremely volatile.

name: Brie Cheese
description:
Brie offers a very good chance of attracting a variety of mice.

This cheese has an 85% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Cheddar Cheese
description:
Cheddar is rather poor at attracting most mice, however, hunters may find success with this cheese when hunting the more frail breeds.

This cheese has a 70% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Combat Cheese
description: This cheese is specially prepared Swiss mounted on combat dummies and adorned with a target. Masters of the Cheese Fang often use this apparatus to teach students combat techniques as well as help decrease their mental weakness to cheese. Be warned! Should a Master of the Cheese Fang see a hunter using a chunk of this as bait it will surely cause them to challenge the hunter to defend the honor of the school.

name: Creamy Havarti Cheese
description: Made from Creamy Orange Peppers, this incredibly smooth tasting Havarti is the perfect bait for hunting the mighty Jurassic Mouse.

name: Crunchy Cheese
description: Made with delicious stones found in the dunes of Tribal Isle, this cheese looks irresistibly tasty. Who needs teeth anyway?

name: Crunchy Havarti Cheese
description: Filled with chunks of Crunchy Green Peppers, this cheese is a favourite of the Fetid Swamp mouse.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 2
description: The thieving mice on the second floor of the King's Gauntlet can't keep their hands off this tasty treat. If the little pickpockets get away with too much of your cheese, don't be afraid to get physical with them.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 3
description: When you equip this scrumptious cheese, you can expect the sword fighting mice on the third floor of the King's Gauntlet to slash their way through just about anything to try and get it. To counteract their amazing swordsmanship, make sure to use a tactical trap.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 4
description: The music-making mice on the fourth tier of the King's Gauntlet rely on this cheese blend to make their taste buds sing. Bards can be quite wily, so using the right tactic when choosing a trap will help the aspiring hunter stay on-key.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 5
description: Only a truly magical blend of flavors could possibly attract the Mage mice on the fifth floor of the King's Gauntlet, but this wedge possesses just the right mix. In order to take the mages by surprise, be sure to keep your trap in the shadows.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 6
description: This cheese meets the exacting standards of the Holy Warriors on the sixth floor of the King's Gauntlet. If you want to protect your traps from their righteous wrath, try confusing their sense of judgement by using an arcane trap.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 7
description: It takes a seriously special piece of cheese to attract the attention of a mouse that's already dead, but this little wedge fits the bill. Aged for centuries, with just a touch of grave dust mixed in for good measure, This re-animated cheese tends to be a little dry, using a little bit of water might make it go down easier.

name: Gauntlet Cheese Tier 8
description: There is only one type of mouse who can handle the sheer radiance that emanates from this cheese, which is the product of almost fourteen thousand different varieties, blended perfectly into one. The Eclipse Mouse dines only on this epic bait, when it deigns to visit this earthly plane at all. As for what type of trap to use against the Eclipse. . . that knowledge has been forgotten in the folds of time.

name: Gilded Cheese
description:
Gilded Cheese has an ornate outer coating of pure gold which makes it coveted by mice who seek wealth and status alike. Lovelorn mice seek out this cheese in the hopes of finding the right gift for that special someone. Nefarious burglars simply wish to fence something valuable!

Eating Gilded Cheese is a bit of a challenge but most mice don't care much for the taste -- it's the shine they're after.

name: Gingerbread Cheese
description: A soft ball of a sweet cheese that has been liberally infused with the spicy, wholesome flavor of fresh gingerbread.  Garnished with a little gingerbread man, who appears to be screaming as he sinks into the sweet treat.

name: Glutter Cheese
description: This cheese is the result of the careful art of fusing a seemingly infinite quantity of flavours into a single cube of cheese. This decadent bait seems to be the only cheese capable of breaking the will power of the Masters of Cheese Belt.

name: Gnarled Cheese
description: This cheese is the result of a magical petrification process and is a favourite amongst some of the mice in Whisker Woods. It has a crisp scent and gritty taste that yew can't beat!

name: Gouda Cheese
description:
Gouda arrives in crates that float into the Harbour, seemingly from areas off the eastern coast of Gnawnia. It has a very good chance to attract a variety of mice, and its sharp flavour is a special favourite of the mice who inhabit the islands from where it is assumed to originate.

This cheese has a 90% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Gumbo Cheese
description: Almost too soft to keep its shape, this gooey, savoury cheese is a favourite of the Nerg tribe.

name: Inferno Havarti Cheese
description: Made especially to catch dragon mice, the inferno havarti is painstakingly cured using fire salt, a special mineral which emits intense heat all the time. Marbled with veins of delicious molten cheese, inferno havarti tempts the dragon mouse with a fiery jolt of flavor and glowing aftertaste.

name: Limelight Cheese
description: When rare Living Shards are combined with Radioactive Sludge and a dash of Curds and Whey, they form this cheese, which boasts a mineral flavor with a hint of lime. The shards vibrate within the curd, making high-pitched noises difficult for the human ear to hear. This subtle vibration sends tremors through the ground, which attract the mice living under the soil in Digby.

name: Magical Havarti Cheese
description: Made from Magical Blue Peppers, the Stonework Warrior mouse harnesses the magic of this Havarti to remain alive.

name: Maki Cheese
description: Furoma Student mice love the smell of Maki cheese while most other mice find its scent unappealing. Its pungent odour travels further than that of other cheese varieties making it capable of attracting more students to a hunter's trap.

name: Marble Cheese
description:
Marble offers a decent chance of attracting a variety of mice.

This cheese has a 75% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Moon Cheese
description:
One of the inventions the scientists of Digby are most interested in is space probe technology capable of fragmenting a small portion of the moon's surface to harvest small quantities of lunar cheese. Unfortunately, the cost of launching the probes paired with their ability to only harvest a small quantity at a time means collecting this cheese is extremely expensive. Researching this cheese has proved quite dangerous during experiments in the Mousoleum as scientists seem to frequently become victims of Lycan attacks.

In October of 2016, the Sandmouse built a gigantic, spooky sandcastle near the Town of Gnawnia which lit up the night with glowing glyphs of the moon and stars. After he was defeated, we thought we were safe, but the Sandmouse might have had other plans in mind...

In our dreams, the Sandmouse brought visions of the moon crashing down onto Gnawnia. Digby scientists dismissed this as mere illusion, confirming that the moon was still at the same distance as it had ever been.

Then suddenly, an enormous meteor erupted across our sky and slammed into the desert sands south of the Gnawnian Express Station! Was this a mere coincidence or the Sandmouse's doing? Either way, the supply of Meteorite Pieces greatly increased as a result!

Use this lunar cheese at Fort Rox for perfect attraction of mice and to encounter more mice that drop better loot!

name: Onyx Gorgonzola
description: Crafted from Onyx Stones found only on the Master of the Dojo, Onyx Cheese is made from an odd combination of gorgonzola and Onyx stone. Although most mice wouldn't normally care for a slice of gorgonzola intercut with onyx veins, Onyx Cheese is crafted especially to appeal to a very specific set of tastes. But who could desire this strange flavor combo? Someone as old as the rocks themselves, of course, a master of concealment. . . the Dojo Sensei.

name: Pungent Havarti Cheese
description: Dripping with the foul smelling juices of a Pungent Purple Pepper, the Chitinous mouse finds this putrid smelling bait irresistible.

name: Radioactive Blue Cheese
description: An accidental byproduct of an experimental drug, this cheese was created during a chemical spill of a volatile potion. Native to the Laboratory, the experimental mice have found this new type of cheese extremely appealing. Eating it may or may not give you super powers. Use at your own risk.

name: Rockforth Cheese
description:
This electric mellow classic will make any mouse want to gorge themselves on its roque 'n roll goodness. Since it's crafted with all the hard-core awesomeness of a ten-minute drum solo, the flavour beats of up to eleven different kinds of cheese will strum a power chord on the taste buds of even the most reserved mice.

Use this during certain big celebrations to attract tougher rockin' mice, but be warned for they may put forth quite the challenge! Make sure you're ready to use this cheese before equipping it!

name: Rumble Cheese
description: Little is known about the origins of Rumble cheese. Many hunters suspect it is an invention of the Furoma forces designed to somehow destroy Gnawnia. This cheese appears to be incredibly unstable and radiate a mysterious power outwards from its center. The power of Rumble cheese intimidates all mice, scaring them away yet some hunters believe it is the key to attracting powerful, malicious mice. Should you choose to use this bait think long and hard if you are strategically prepared for the adversary it may summon.

name: Runic Cheese
description: Imbued with the darkness that consumes the Catacombs, this magical cheese strikes fear into the hearts of even the most powerful breeds of mice. Runic cheese appears faded, as if only barely lying within this plane of existence.

name: Shell Cheese
description: A favourite amongst members of the Elub tribe this cheese may leave you wondering if Shelder sell seashell shell cheese down by the sea shore.

name: Spicy Havarti Cheese
description: Made from flakes of Spicy Red Peppers, this Havarti is constantly at risk of spontaneous combustion. Its scent resembles that of fresh magma and seems to attract the Magma Carrier mouse.

name: SUPER|brie+
description:
This special, extra fragrant brie is only available as a gift to the supporters of MouseHunt. Due to the magical properties of SUPER|brie+, crafty mice are unable to steal multiple pieces of this precious cheese from hunters who hunt in dangerous environments.

This cheese has a 100% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Susheese Cheese
description: Considered somewhat of an acquired taste, Susheese is the traditional meal of the school of the Cheese Claw. The combination of delicious brie and fish fresh out of the Burroughs River seems to be the only bait that will attract the Masters of the Cheese Claw.

name: Sweet Havarti Cheese
description: Made from the Sweet Yellow Peppers, this Havarti has an intense sweet flavour that Primal mice love.

name: Swiss Cheese
description:
Swiss offers a good chance of attracting a variety of mice.

This cheese has an 80% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Vanilla Stilton Cheese
description: Ghostly mice just love the taste of a good, mould-veined Stilton, but it's the vanilla that compels the spirits of Balack's Cove to leave their eternal strife. Aged to perfection in the cool, damp vaults of a sea cave, this cheese contains vanilla bean harvested at great peril from the Jungle of Dread. The ghosts of Balack's Cave are not the only mice that love this cheese, however. If you happen to get washed up on a jungle shore, hide your Stilton stock in your knapsack.

name: Vengeful Vanilla Stilton Cheese
description: Vengeful Vanilla is a cheese best served cold. With a strong, tangy flavor, extreme vanilla sweetness, and just a hint of bitter mold, it tastes horrible-- and the cheese knows it! The main attractive feature of Vengeful Vanilla is its smell. So strong and delicious that it bypasses the natural wariness of even a hardened character like Balack, it draws its victims in... and then the taste does the rest.

name: White Cheddar Cheese
description:
This cheese is rather poor at attracting mice. However it seems that its unique scent drives away the white, grey and brown breeds of mice.

This cheese has a 70% attraction rate for mice who prefer it.

name: Wicked Gnarly Cheese
description: Formed by a gnarly magical process which transforms it from a relatively normal lump of dairy products into a dried-up ball of roots, this cheese is so twisted and covered with strange wood-grain patterns that it's hard to tell that it's cheese at all. Wicked Gnarly Cheese has got a much sharper scent than its counterpart, Gnarled Cheese, and a flavor that combines the zing of sandalwood and the sweetness of maple, which makes it like candy to some denizens of the Lagoon.

name: Ancient Potion
description: Ancient potion causes instant aging when applied to Brie or SUPER|brie+, transforming it into Ancient Cheese, the preferred bait for hunters in the Forbidden Grove. The conversion rate for Ancient Potion is slightly more expensive than other potions, but it also saves time by eliminating the need to collect stale cheese.

name: Brie Potion
description: One day, while an alchemist was brewing potions designed to turn lead into gold, he stumbled upon the recipe for this ingenious potion, which, in many hunters' estimations, is just as good. Brie Potion, like the alchemists' elixirs of old, turns baser cheeses, such as Cheddar, Marble or Swiss, into Brie.

name: Corrupted Radioactive Blue Potion
description: This potion will convert Brie or SUPER|brie+ into Radioactive Blue cheese, but beware: this potion came from a bad batch, and contains unknown trace elements that lower its conversion rate.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 2
description: This potion converts Marble, Swiss or SUPER|brie+ into an aromatic cheese blend that the rogue mice on Tier 2 of the King's Gauntlet will do anything to steal.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 3
description: Use this potion on your Marble, Swiss, or SUPER|brie+ to make a swashbuckling flavor of cheese that the Swordsmice on Tier 3 of the Kings Gauntlet will want to put on a skewer.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 4
description: One bottle of this potion is enough to turn a quantity of Swiss, Brie or SUPER|brie+ into a sharp cheese that will make the taste buds of the Bardic Mice, who live on Tier 4 of the King's Gauntlet, sing with delight.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 5
description: The powerful aroma of this potion will transfer well to your Swiss, Brie or SUPER|brie+, creating a bold cheese which appeals well to the Black Mage and its minions, the denizens of the King's Gauntlet Tier 5.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 6
description: This potion, when mixed with Brie or SUPER|brie+, will purify the cheese, making it delicious, nutritious, and fit for the noble mice living on Tier 6 of the King's Gauntlet.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 7
description: Mix Brie or SUPER|brie+ with this potion, and it will shrivel up into a dusty old cheese suitable for the deathly mice on the 7th Tier of the King's Gauntlet.

name: Gauntlet Potion Tier 8
description: Pour this potion over your Gouda or SUPER|brie+, and your cheese will transcend the boundaries of time and space, becoming an anomalous blend fit only for consumption by the King's Gauntlet's most deadly warrior: the Eclipse Mouse.

name: Gnarled Potion
description: Water your Brie or SUPER|brie+ with some of this potion, and it will sprout up into a batch of Gnarled Cheese. The more powerful mice in Whisker Woods love Gnarled Cheese's crunchy texture, so be sure to stock up if you're out for big game.

name: Greater Brie Potion
description: Greater Brie Potion allows hunter to convert their Cheddar, Marble or Swiss into Brie... for free. Enough said.

name: Greater Radioactive Blue Potion
description: This giant bottle of Radioactive Blue Potion can convert more Brie or SUPER|brie+ into Radioactive Blue cheese, per batch, than any other potion hunters can find. It's quite useful for Hunters looking to stock up in bulk.

name: Radioactive Blue Potion
description: This potion converts ordinary Brie or SUPER|brie+ into Radioactive Blue cheese, the favorite snack of many of the monstrous mice left roaming the Laboratory.

name: Runic Potion
description: Douse your Gouda or SUPER|brie+ in a batch of Runic Potion, and it will transform, before your very eyes, into pieces of Runic Cheese, the mystical munchies favored by the mice of the Acolyte Realm.

name: Wicked Gnarly Potion
description: This potion converts Brie or SUPER|brie+ into Wicked Gnarly Cheese, which is the only cheese twisted enough to draw the attention of the legendary Silth mouse of the Lagoon.

name: Birthday Gift
description: These gifts were meant for MouseHunt's Birthday, but we'll let you open a few. Happy Birthday MouseHunt!

name: Magical Blue Pepper Plant
description: Grown from seeds coveted by the Elub Tribe, the peppers grown on this plant have an enticing sparkle. It is the belief of the Elub that these peppers increase the intelligence of those who eat them.

name: Champions Chest
description: This old chest was offered to the champions of the original MouseHunting Tournaments hosted by the King!

name: Dragon's Chest
description: A dragon mouse's prized possession is its treasure-- so why not keep it in a fancy, crystal-scaled box? Observers lucky enough to see the dragon mouse in its natural habitat can find it curled up around this chest at night, with its tail jealously wrapped around the lock.

name: Fancy Birthday Gift
description: These extra-special gifts were meant for the MouseHunt Developers, but you're extra-special to us. Happy Birthday MouseHunt!

name: Gift
description: In their mad dash to escape hunters, the thieving elf mice dropped a large quantity of these red gifts across the Gnawnia Mountains. The dropped gifts were quickly picked up by other mice, further spreading them across the Kingdom!

name: Crunchy Green Pepper Plant
description: Grown from a yellow and blue seed, this plant grows oversized, crunchy green peppers.

name: Magically Wrapped Gift
description: These gifts are specially prepared in Santa's workshop and have a magic glow about them. There is sure to be something special inside!

name: Mysterious Box
description: A box made of strange, unrecognizable metal with ornate etchings upon it. A barely audible humming seems to be emanating from the corners as though the metal is vibrating at an immeasurably high frequency.

name: Mysterious Box (old)
description:
A box made of strange, unrecognizable metal with ornate etchings upon it. A barely audible humming seems to be emanating from the corners as though the metal is vibrating at an immeasurably high frequency.

This box looks especially old, from a time the Acolyte mice did not store Frozen Scroll within Mysterious Boxes.

name: Creamy Orange Pepper Plant
description: Grown from a red and yellow seed, this plant has a creamy-sweet aroma. The soft orange peppers it grows are simply irresistible.

name: Pungent Purple Pepper Plant
description: Grown from a blue and red seed, this delicate plant grows pungent-smelling purple peppers.

name: Spicy Red Pepper Plant
description: The red seeds which grow this plant are closely guarded by the Derr Tribe. The peppers which grow on this plant are too hot for human consumption.

name: Red Pocket Envelope
description: A bright red envelope! I wonder what's inside...

name: Ronzas Blue Satchel of Surprise
description: These satchels are prepared by Ronza as supply packages for MouseHunters. The contents of this satchel range wildly. For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special.

name: Ronzas Green Satchel of Surprise
description: These satchels are prepared by Ronza as supply packages for MouseHunters. The contents of this satchel range wildly. For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special.

name: Ronzas Red Satchel of Surprise
description: These satchels are prepared by Ronza as supply packages for MouseHunters. The contents of this satchel range wildly. For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special.

name: Slightly Smaller Gift
description: These strange gifts are often handed out by people who claim that trying to open it has driven them to madness! But... it's just a small, neatly wrapped gift... How could such a pleasant looking item cause madness?

name: Stolen Birthday Gift
description: These gifts were ordered by the King to hand out in celebration of MouseHunt's second birthday. Unfortunately the Terrible Two mice intercepted the delivery and stole all the gifts! Thanks for catching the little pest, inside is a little something to help you in your hunting...

name: Unstable Curd
description: The combination of Ionized Salt, Onyx and Curds and Whey has made this extremely volatile lump of supersaturated curd. The slightest poke will cause the curd to stabilize into a random form of cheese.

name: Inferno Pepper Plant
description: These plants are grown from a red, blue and yellow seed. The difficulty of gathering each seed makes these peppers a rare sight.

name: Sweet Yellow Pepper Plant
description: Grown from yellow seeds collected by the Nerg Tribe, this plant grows deliciously sweet yellow peppers.

name: Plankrun's Journal Back Cover
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.

name: Plankrun's Dojo Notes
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
8:19 pm
I have been surveying the training grounds for some time now. It would appear the mice have overrun this area as well. Many powerful warrior type mice seem to have taken over the Pagoda nearby and turned it into a Dojo. I am now going to attempt to hunt inside…
4:31 pm
I checked my trap and found that I had caught a 7 oz. Master of the Cheese Claw mouse from the Dojo's meditation floor. Additionally this foe dropped a Master Claw shard. Finally I have all of the elements I need to create the cheese required to attract the Master of the Dojo, again. I just hope that this new trap I crafted works out better than the one Zugzwang gave me…
Note:
All of the masters in the Dojo seem to be resilient to the common cheese I could find, so I have had to craft some new cheese that they simply cannot resist. The following is a list of the cheese I have created successfully.
page_text_back:
Susheese:
- curds and whey 3
- nori 1
- salmon 1
- tokens of the claw 3
Combat Cheese
- curds and whey 5
- splintered wood 1
- paint 1
- tokens of the cheese fang 3
Glutter Cheese
- curds and whey 7
- cheesy fluffs 1
- invisi-glu 1
- tokens of the cheese belt 3
Rumble Cheese
- master's seal 1
- ionized salt 1
- curds and whey 20

name: Plankrun's Journal Cover
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.

name: Plankrun's Gnawnia Notes
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
Day 1 - Journal Entry 1:
I've been commissioned by the King of a region called Gnawnia to investigate and record (in this journal) a strange occurrence in his land. He describes an issue with the mice exhibiting strange behaviors... I've yet to encounter one but he assures me that my investigation could shed valuable light into the situation.
In The King's Service,
P.
Day 1 - Journal Entry 2:
Dear King, I'm counting on my drawing skills to help explain how these mice behave. It is strange.
There are obvious differences here in Gnawnia between certain kinds of mice. In the Meadow outside the town gates, I've noticed it's less likely to simply view any specimens... so I've spent my stipend (Thank You) on some cheese to see if I can draw them out.
On the back of this page I will attempt to illustrate my findings.
page_text_back:
Typical Field Mouse:
This is the type of mouse I had expected to encounter out here in the meadow.
Instead I found something much, much different...
Gnawnia Mouse
(Sighted in the Meadow):
It was so strange watching this grey mouse. He acted almost human, walking around on his hind legs.
- Significantly different anatomy!
- Strange human-like posture
I think with these findings then we can be sure that...

name: Ambush Trap Blueprints
description: These blueprints are vital in knowing how to construct the Ambush Trap. These prints show how to set up the required droids as well as how to construct a wall separator using a Furoma Master's Seal.
obtain_hint: Hunt Assassin and Worker mice in the Dojo, or Hapless mice in the Meditation Room and Pinnacle Chamber

name: Ancient Box Trap Blueprints
description: These slightly damaged blueprints diagram the steps in constructing the Ancient Box trap, yielding Forgotten power. The heavy stone box glows with power, making the perfect distraction for a power-hungry mouse.

name: Ancient Frayed Blueprint Piece
description: Sketched onto this torn piece of blueprint is a glowing stick standing up straight on a trap base. The print is too tattered to tell what object it may be propping up.
obtain_hint: Hunt Elub Chieftain mice at the Elub Shore

name: Ancient Mangled Blueprint Piece
description: Amongst various holes and rips is the faint drawing of a hinge. The rest of the print is too discolored and mauled to read.
obtain_hint: Hunt Derr Chieftain mice in the Derr Dunes

name: Ancient Relic Staff
description: An ancient staff from a time long forgotten. This small branch appears insignificant at first glance, however, the longer one gazes directly at it, the stronger its inciting glow becomes.
obtain_hint: Hunt Jurassic mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Ancient Ripped Blueprint Piece
description: An oddly slanted box is drawn in this small scrap of blueprint, as if being held up on one end. The print is torn, omitting what object this may be.
obtain_hint: Hunt Nerg Chieftain mice on the Nerg Plains

name: Ancient Spear
description: This magical spear is carried by the eldest mice of the Elub tribe.
obtain_hint: Hunt Elder mice in Cape Clawed

name: Ancient Spear Launcher Blueprints
description:
These blueprints detail how to properly load an ancient spear into a launcher to create a slightly mystical hydro trap.

This trap requires the rank of Legendary or higher.

name: Ancient Torn Blueprint Piece
description: This slightly damaged scrap of paper appears to be the corner of a blueprint. Etched onto the paper appears to be plans of an ancient trap. Only occasionally found washing up on the eastern shore of Cape Clawed, these scraps of blueprint are rare and valuable. Perhaps finding the rest of the blueprint will unlock its mysteries...

name: Bead of Slumber
description:
The tiring effects of this tiny magical bead can be combined with Obelisk Parts to make the Obelisk of Slumber trap. King's Warning: Staring directly into a bead may cause drowsiness; Do not operate heavy machinery.

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Blue Pepper Seed
description: These small seeds which smell of salt water are slightly moist to the touch. Two seeds placed in a planting pot results in a pepper plant with a magical sparkle.

name: Bolt of Cloth
description: The finest cloth in all of Gnawnia!

name: Bottled-Up Rage
description: This potion contains all of the hatred and loathing generated by the ensorcelled Derr Elders over their long servitude to Balack the Banished. It is so angry, it pounds the cork in its bottle, trying to escape.
obtain_hint: Hunt Derr Lich mice in Balack's Cove

name: Burroughs Salmon
description: The pollution being pumped into the Burroughs River seems to cause the local salmon to grow to massive proportions. Thinly sliced pieces of this tasty fish make for perfect Susheese.

name: Candies
description:
The latest in candy technology! These small sweets can not only be enjoyed as a snack but they also make perfect decorations for gingerbread creations!



Mmmm... crazy delicious!

name: Cheesy Fluffs
description: A generous-sized bag full of oily morsels of cheese in a wide variety of flavours. This yummy treat is hard for both mouse and hunter to resist!

name: Chrome Nanite Coating
description: Your Nannybot is going to need some serious protection if it's going to combat bad manners everywhere-- that regular old steel casing isn't going to protect it from wet willies, rug burns and splatters of mashed cheese, no sir! Luckily, you can combat all these threats using the Chrome Nanite Coating, which not only protects your Nannybot from unsightly stains and dings, but actually uses a fleet of tiny robots to defend the finish and repair previous damage.

name: Coal
description: Several thousand times more dense than your average lump of coal, this carbon borders upon diamond! Its extreme density seems to give it almost... magical properties.
obtain_hint: Hunt Keeper and Scavenger mice in the Catacombs, or Draconic Warden mice in Dracano

name: Coconut Milk
description: Made from giant coconuts found deep in the Jungle of Dread this sweet milk is highly addictive.

name: Compass
description: When all you can see is water, knowing your way north is a good thing! This handy instrument is essential for putting together a navigation kit.

name: Creamy Orange Pepper
description: The scent of these peppers is mildly addictive. Six peppers, ten servings of Coconut Milk, along with some Curds and Whey and salt make some of the creamiest tasting cheese ever.

name: Crunchy Green Pepper
description: A rather noisy snack, these crunchy peppers always taste fresh no matter how long ago they were picked. Six peppers, four servings of Coconut Milk, along with some Curds and Whey and Salt make a cheese with a unique crunchy texture.

name: Curds and Whey
description: Curds and whey are a common ingredient in a variety of cheese flavours. Elaborate flavours often require a greater quantity than more basic flavours.

name: DeathBot Parts
description: These parts make up the many menacing limbs of the DeathBot, along with his head and torso.

name: Dehydration Base Blueprints
description: These blueprints are required to craft the crude, yet effective dehydration base from four splintered wood and over 200 salt. Although the salty base does not have the most power, it is well suited for keeping bait fresh.

name: Delicious Stone
description: These tasty small rocks are collected by members of the Derr tribe within the dunes of Tribal Isle and are used to create Crunchy cheese. 30 of these rocks are combined with 20 servings of coconut milk, 10 curds and whey and 30 dashes of salt to make 15 pieces of tooth-chipping cheese.

name: Digby DrillBot Parts
description: Weighing over 200 pounds these parts are the opposite of portable.

name: Dragon Ember
description:
This nugget of molten rock glows with the Dragon Mouse's enchanted flames. It burns bright enough to pierce any darkness, but in order to use it as a guide, its handler must first find some way to contain its searing heat.

It is rumoured that these glowing embers originate from a place far deeper and darker than the bowels of Dracano.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in Dracano, Burning Replicart™ loot in Draconic Depths

name: Droid Parts
description:
These basic parts are capable of assembling a variety of droids all for different purposes. Popular assembly choices include: high speed rotating droids with swords, droids with powerful clamps for hands on the end of arms that rocket eject, and droids that violently shake before self destructing. The sky's the limit!

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Encrusted Metal of Time
description: Many have long studied this mysterious metal. It possesses a magical property that causes a rust-coloured substance to form on its surface when exposed to water for long periods of time. Although research of this phenomenon is ongoing, many suspect magic to be the root of the cause.
obtain_hint: Hunt Magma Carrier mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Engraved Solid Stone Slab
description: When placed near Timeless Mystic Gems, the engravings begin to emit a light that seems to draw power-hungry mice near.
obtain_hint: Hunt Stonework Warrior mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Ethereal Rope
description: Glowing brightly, this rope magically takes on any length its owner wishes. Very handy for large games of tug-of-war!
obtain_hint: Hunt Primal mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Fire Salt
description: Famous around the Tribal Isles for giving a decent kick to many dishes as well as being used to make very strange and salty glass, this slightly molten sodium chloride is too hot to handle!

name: Frozen Scroll
description: Locked within this scroll is a spell capable of freezing both items and mice instantly. Some Trapsmiths have combined this enchantment with a High Tension Spring and Runes to create a frosty trap. Who knows what other uses the spell may have?
obtain_hint: Hunt Acolyte mice in the Acolyte Realm

name: Gingerbread Base Blueprints
description: A single gingerbread plank, five festive candies and a pack of icing sugar make a base that is sure to bring festive cheer to any trap!

name: Gingerbread House Plans
description:
Every successful architect needs blueprints, even those planning to use gingerbread for construction material! Building a home has never looked so easy!



Two gingerbread planks for the roof, four to make the walls and no gingerbread house would be complete without one more plank for a chimney!



All the planks are carefully glued together with five sugary packs of icing sugar and ten festive candies for decoration!

name: High Tension Spring Parts
description: Various springs and barbs from a disassembled high tension spring.

name: Hinge of Eternity
description: Hunters from past and present agree that this small hinge is clearly the most epic way to attach two objects, allowing limited, yet awesome, rotation around a fixed axis.
obtain_hint: Hunt Fetid Swamp mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Hobby Horse Parts
description: The carefully dismantled components of a HitGrab Horsey. The smell of its stuffing slightly resembles that of hay...

name: Icing Sugar
description: Handy for gluing together gingerbread planks to make a variety of festive items!

name: Inferno Pepper
description: These white-hot peppers begin to radiate heat as they mature, often slightly scorching the plant on which they grow. Six of these peppers combined with 16 servings of Coconut Milk along with some Curds and Whey and Fire Salt make six pieces of highly combustible bait.

name: Intimidating Pincher
description: These less-than razor sharp pinchers are able to carefully, yet securely hold a misbehaving mouse in place.

name: Invisi-glu
description: This successful brand of glue is colourless, odourless, yet surprisingly toxic! Great for combining ingredients, such as Cheesy Fluffs brand cheese morsels.

name: Ionized Salt
description: Imported from the Salt Mines, this salt has a high mineral content and is extremely conductive. Little is known about what possible uses this salt could have. Working with this salt carries a high risk of electrocution, extreme dehydration, and destruction on a universal scale. Handle with extreme care!

name: King's Reserve Bubbleh
description: This exquisite champagne is the King's favourite way to celebrate something special. Although under guard in the Castle's private cellar, a crafty burglar mouse occasionally steals a crate to sell to general stores. Whether ringing in the new year or christening a ship, the King's Bubbleh never disappoints!

name: Launcher Parts
description: The carefully disassembled parts of a launcher gun. Take special caution when dealing with the compressed air tank!
obtain_hint: Use the Hunter's Hammer to smash the Harpoon Gun or the Net Cannon

name: Living Shard
description: Even in a mineral-rich town like Digby, Living Shards are quite rare, and because they take a lot of time and effort to harvest, Digby's General Store places their price at a premium. Digby tradition states that Dr. F. Romage once found a large deposit of the crystals, which he used in his experiments, and some of the crazier stories even claim that he used the living shards to bring the Monster mice to life...

name: Magic Essence
description: This substance is what gives SUPER|brie+ its magical properties. It can be used in a variety of recipes for unique results.
obtain_hint: Use the Hunter's Hammer to smash SUPER|brie+

name: Magical Blue Pepper
description: Believed to grant the gift of intelligence upon any who eat them, these peppers are a highly treasured item amoungst the Elub tribe. Six peppers, 2 servings of Coconut Milk, along with some Curds and Whey and salt make a cheese with a magical sparkle.

name: Master Belt Shard
description: This shard comprises the Cheese Belt portion of a Master's Seal.
obtain_hint: Hunt Masters of the Cheese Belt in the Meditation Room

name: Master Claw Shard
description: This shard comprises the Cheese Claw portion of a Master's Seal.
obtain_hint: Hunt Masters of the Cheese Claw in the Meditation Room

name: Master Fang Shard
description: This shard comprises the Cheese Fang portion of a Master's Seal.
obtain_hint: Hunt Masters of the Cheese Fang in the Meditation Room

name: Master's Seal
description: Representing the combined power, knowledge, and technique of all three Furoma masters, this Master Seal is an almost unstable magical force that can manifest itself into a cheese that far exceeds the power of its creators.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the General Store in the Dojo, Meditation Room, or Pinnacle Chamber

name: Meteorite Piece
description: These small pieces of cheese-like rock are rumoured to be small fragments of the moon.
obtain_hint: Hunt at Fort Rox

name: Mysterious Blueprints
description:
These blueprints outline how to harness the power of the Onyx stone into an arcane obelisk of incredible power. This unstable rod uses magic essence to bring to life a dozen scraps of metal, forming roots that attach itself to any base.



Take caution when choosing to construct this trap. Some fear that the power of the Onyx stone is too great to be meddled with! The scientists of Digby are on a personal mission to burn these blueprints in an effort to protect humanity.

name: Nanny Bolts
description: Bolts infused with parental instinct. These are essential for constructing a Nannybot.

name: Superstar Nanny Glasses
description: Cleverly designed so you think the Nannybot is not watching, these glasses elevate a Nannybot to super-star status.

name: Nannybot Parts
description: Mischievous mice around the Kingdom no doubt feel safer knowing your Nannybot is not assembled.

name: Nori
description: Made from fresh seaweed growing along the shores near the base of the Gnawnia Mountain, Nori is frequently used for preparing Susheese.

name: Obelisk of Incineration Blueprints
description: These blueprints detail how to construct a fiery trap that deals arcane damage. Obelisk parts and 2 scraps of metal form a staff that draws power from a single piece of coal. Splintered wood set alight starts the flow of energy from the coal.

name: Obelisk Parts
description: A mystical staff and its ordinate scraps of metal.
obtain_hint: Use the Hunter's Hammer to smash the Obelisk of Incineration Trap or the Obelisk of Slumber Trap

name: Antique Lantern
description: This strange old lantern must have been sitting in the seawater for too long. No matter what you use, a conventional fire just won't set it alight. Perhaps a more magical flame might bring it to life.

name: Onyx Mallet Blueprints
description: A very crude trap design consisting of an extremely heavy mallet made of 3 Onyx Stones. The tremendous weight is held up by platinum supports.
obtain_hint: Hunt the Master of the Dojo and Dojo Sensei in the Pinnacle Chamber

name: Onyx Stone
description: Argued to be the source of power for the Masters of the Dojo, this magical stone is extremely rare and valuable. The stone seems to not have a clear use. Perhaps with a way to harness its raw energy it could produce a trap most powerful...
obtain_hint: Hunt the Master of the Dojo and Dojo Sensei in the Pinnacle Chamber

name: Paint-brand Paint
description: This strange brand of paint is frequently imported by Ronza and seems to almost be alive, able to take on any colour it wishes.

name: Party Hat
description: When placed onto a DeathBot, this party hat spices things up!

name: Pinch of Annoyance
description: This powder is the distilled essence of the Elub Elders' irritation at being cooped up in Balack's Cove. Don't let it get on your skin-- you'll itch for weeks.
obtain_hint: Hunt Elub Lich mice in Balack's Cove

name: Plank of Gingerbread
description: This plank of gingerbread is carefully baked with love by the King's Royal Chef. Its spicy aroma smells like... happiness. Smash these planks with your Hunter's Hammer to create festive bait!

name: Plant Pot
description: This ornate terracotta pot, crafted by the locals of the Tribal Isles, makes the perfect vessel in which to plant seeds.

name: Tiny Platinum Bar
description: A solid bar of platinum. This looks expensive!

name: Pungent Purple Pepper
description: Cutting into these pungent peppers can quickly clear a room. Six peppers, eight servings of Coconut Milk, along with some Curds and Whey and salt make a cheese with a bitter taste and foul stench.

name: Radioactive Sludge
description: This toxic waste is the result of Radioactive Blue Cheese turning stale.
obtain_hint: Hunt Sludge Scientist mice in the Laboratory, Bog Beast mice in the Toxic Spill, or receive as a daily gift from friends

name: Rainbow Mohawk Wig of Awesomeness
description:
Woah! This bright mohawk guarantees to make any mouse hunting experience more extreme!



If you are the proud owner of the original HitGrab Horsey that does not have a mohawk and want to turn it up to eleven follow these three steps:



1. Carefully dismantle your beloved HitGrab Horsey


2. Glue this totally amazing wig onto its head

3. Play air guitar while hunting to catch mice in true rocker-fashion!



This wig can only be attached to the HitGrab Horsey that was available March, 2009. This wig cannot be attached to the HitGrab Rockin' Horse.

name: Raisins of Wrath
description: These raisins probably started out as Grapes of Wrath, but they've been sitting out for far too long. Grapes that rot before they properly dry out are safely discarded. The drying process has only concentrated the wrath, so use them sparingly in any evil banana breads or nasty oatmeal cookies you may be planning. Raisins of Wrath are best known as an ingredient in Vengeful Vanilla Stilton.
obtain_hint: Hunt Nerg Lich mice in Balack's Cove

name: Red Pepper Seed
description: Nearly indestructible, these seeds are rock-hard and extremely hot to the touch. Two seeds planted in a pot results in a pepper plant radiating heat, on the brink of self-combustion.

name: Rhino Horn
description: Coveted by members of the Derr tribe, this incredibly sharp horn stands as a symbol of intimidation and strength.
obtain_hint: Hunt Aged mice in Cape Clawed

name: RhinoBot Blueprints
description:
These blueprints detail an elaborate method of combining a rhino horn and 24 stale SUPER|brie+ with DrillBot parts to make the mighty RhinoBot.

This trap requires the rank of Legendary or higher.

name: Rice Paper
description:
This delicate paper is perfect for making room dividing walls.

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Rope
description: Made from fibers found within the vines that grow from the Great Gnarled Tree this brand of rope is incredibly strong.

name: Rune
description: These magical stones originate from another plane of existence. Little is known about who or what may have brought them into this world.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Forbidden Grove or Acolyte Realm

name: Salt
description: Gnawnia salt is collected from the seawater around the Harbour where it is known for its magical cleanliness. Salt is a very common ingredient used in a variety of cheese flavours.

name: Savoury Vegetables
description: Farmed on the eastern plains of Tribal Isle by members of the Nerg tribe, these savoury vegetables are the main ingredient in Gumbo cheese. Created in a large stew, 30 veggies are combined with 90 curds and whey, 15 servings of coconut milk and a single dash of salt to create 15 pieces of Gumbo cheese.

name: Scrap Metal
description: These jagged shards of scrap metal resemble the result of a Steel mouse versus a Digby DrillBot.
obtain_hint: Hunt Steel mice throughout Gnawnia, Hydra mice in the Lagoon, Scavenger mice in the Catacombs, or Lich mice in Balack's Cove

name: Seashell
description: These shells are collected from the shores of Tribal Isle by members of the Elub tribe and ground up to make Shell cheese. Made in large batches, 30 of these shells are combined with 10 servings of coconut milk, 60 curds and whey and 40 dashes of salt to produce 15 salty morsels.

name: Sextant
description: Essential for navigating the ocean this sextant is sure to come in handy when searching for new hunting grounds and is an essential part of any navigation kit.

name: Ship Blueprints
description:
Sometimes discovered by hunters after defeating a Hydra mouse in the Lagoon, these rare prints show how to build a ship capable of sailing the open ocean.

The plans call for 900 Splintered Wood, 70 Bolts of Cloth, 100 Ropes and 18 Scrap Metal.

To captain the ship a hunter will need Legendary experience.

name: Spicy Red Pepper
description: Far too hot for human consumption, these peppers smell a bit like magma and appear to slowly roast themselves over time. Six peppers, 12 servings of Coconut Milk, along with some Curds and Whey and Salt make for some extremely spicy cheese!

name: Splintered Wood
description: This wood is harvested from the northern forests of Furoma, where the trees almost seem to fight back against the hatchets. Perfect for building combat apparatus, among other things.

name: Stale Cheese
description: Dried up morsels of cheese are often the result of traps made with harmful chemicals.

name: Stale SUPER|brie+
description:
The sight of this item often draws a tear or two from even the most steadfast MouseHunter. The magic of this item seems to be empowered by its almost paradoxical existence.

This is the result when SUPER|brie+, Runic Cheese, Moon Cheese, Maki Cheese, Maki String Cheese, or Magical String Cheese goes stale.
obtain_hint: Hunt Aged mice in Cape Clawed, or Bog Beast and Spore mice in the Toxic Spill

name: Sweet Yellow Pepper
description: Sweet enough to make cheeks pucker, these bright yellow peppers are a favourite amongst the Nerg tribe. Six peppers, six servings of Coconut Milk, along with some Curds and Whey and Salt make a smooth and sweet cheese.

name: Telescope
description: Every intrepid explorer is sure to have a telescope in their navigation kit to spot far off land.

name: Thorned Mouse Trap Plans
description:
These plans show how to carefully combine thorned vines and the husk of a Venus Mouse Trap to create a deadlier trap hungry for mice.

This trap requires the rank of Legendary or higher.

name: Thorned Venus Mouse Trap Husk
description: The husk of a Thorned Venus Mouse Trap. Although motionless its roots still appear alive.

name: Thorned Vine
description: These vines grow within the Jungle of Dread and are used by members of the Nerg tribe to build defensive structures. The roots seem to still be alive, eager to bond with another plant...
obtain_hint: Hunt Grandfather mice in Cape Clawed

name: Timeless Mystic Gem
description: These gems look as though they are filled with a swirling blue vapour. Their appearance is constantly shifting, giving the illusion of being cut with an infinite number of facets.
obtain_hint: Hunt Chitinous mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Time Out Hour Glass
description: A Nannybot uses this glowing hour glass to measure the length of a time out for ill-behaved mice.

name: Time Out Upgrade
description: This gold-plated clock, when hung around the Nannybot's neck, interacts with the nuclear no-nonsense engine, amplifying the Nannybot's power to thwart shenanigans threefold. The clock also boosts the Nannybot's Time Out engine to a much higher grade of performance, allowing it to make sure that mice stay frozen. With the Time Out clock on your side, the Nannybot will achieve peak performance, punishing naughtiness left and right!

name: Token of the Cheese Belt
description: A Furoma sapphire is regarded as a symbol of tranquil meditation. The School of the Cheese Belt harnesses this magical energy to suppress their once insatiable cravings for cheese. Unleashing the power within the sapphire will materialize all the cravings it has absorbed and is vital in the process of creating Glutter cheese.

name: Token of the Cheese Claw
description: Cheese Claw tokens harness magical jade gems to encapsulate the teachings of the Claw School. The magic essence of these tokens is a vital ingredient in creating the sacred Susheese, a preferred meal of the Masters of the Cheese Claw.

name: Token of the Cheese Fang
description: The glowing ruby in the center of these tokens symbolizes the power of focused aggression that is the core of the teachings of the Cheese Fang. The magical energy of these tokens must be released to create Combat cheese.

name: Veteran Tournament Token
description: These tokens were once awarded to champions of the Original MouseHunt tournaments.

name: Unchristened Ship
description: A mighty ocean vessel awaiting a name. Smash a bottle of the King's Bubbleh over its stern to be ready to sail to ocean!

name: Vanilla Bean
description: This rare bean can be found deep within the Jungle of Dread. Its rind imparts a pleasant, sweet flavor to food. As a result, it is one of Gnawnia's most sought after delicacies.
obtain_hint: Hunt Swarm of Pygmy and Pygmy Wrangler mice in the Jungle of Dread

name: Venus Mouse Trap Husk
description: The husk of a Venus Mouse Trap. Although motionless, its roots still appear alive.
obtain_hint: Use the Hunter's Hammer to smash the Venus Mouse Trap or the Mutated Venus Mouse Trap

name: Yellow Pepper Seed
description: Extremely fertile these seeds vibrate slightly, eager to grow. Two seeds sown in a pot results in a plant bearing a strange yellow pepper that is simultaneously sweet and hot.

name: Attraction Bonus Candy
description: Although this chalky heart candy claims to give you an attraction bonus, the manufacturers got out of it on a loophole by saying that its sweetness (technically) attracts ants.

name: Bow and Arrow
description: This handy bow and arrow, imbued with the Cupid Mouse's magic, is the perfect way to spread the romance this Valentine's day. One hit with these magical arrows and the target falls deeply in love. . . but you weren't thinking of using this for any selfish reasons, were you?

name: Candygram
description: Hey, it looks like someone sent you a tasty treat this Valentine's Day. Hopefully, your admirer is as sweet as this cherry-flavored delight.

name: Chinese Knot
description: This pretty little ornament is knotted by hand, using only one, long piece of red string. Hang it somewhere that you visit frequently, and it's sure to bring you good luck and prosperity in the new year.

name: Christmas Coal
description: Even when you dress it up, this is still just a piece of coal, and a useless one too. You have some good friends.

name: Cinnahearts
description: Wow, a sack of a hundred cinnahearts, all for you! These hearts are the extra-strong variety, imported straight from Dracano for those who really love their cinnamon. By the time you're done with them, your tongue might be on fire, but your breath will smell fabulous!

name: Crown Jewel
description: The Master Burglar Mouse has dropped a flawless gem. When held up to the sun, it sparkles brightly enough to temporarily blind someone. A gem of this quality could only have come from the King's personal vault-- perhaps the King is offering some sort of reward for its return.

name: Crush
description: This fragile heart symbolizes the love and admiration of the person who sends it. Be careful with this treasure... a thoughtless person could crush it, if they wanted to.

name: Crushed
description: What happens when you crush a crush? The sender becomes crushed, of course. Perhaps you could have sugar coated this rejection a little bit more. . .

name: DHU-
description: This chalky heart candy claims to lower your DHU, but it will probably only lower your appetite.

name: DLU+
description: This chalky heart candy claims to raise your DLU, but it only really raises your blood sugar level.

name: Dumplings
description: Mmmm. . . these look like some good dumplings. Beef, barbeque pork, shrimp, rice. . . they're all here, and they're steamed to perfection! Let's get some chopsticks and dig in.

name: Eight Elf Shoes
description:
On the eighth day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Eight Pointy Elf Shoes!

People assume that pointy shoes aren't very comfortable, and most of the time they're right. Elf shoes, however, are the exception to the rule. Soft and cushy, these adorable little belled shoes are the perfect thing to wear on those cozy holiday nights by the fire.

name: Eleven Coloured Lights
description:
