On the eleventh day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Eleven Lights a'twinkling!

Colored red, green and blue, these lights blink in a variety of different patterns. They add instant festivity to a Christmas tree, house, reindeer cutout, animatronic dancing santa with choral elves. . . anything, really. All they need is a little imagination, but electricity helps too.

name: Festive Copyright Claim
description:
At this festive time and season,
I could finally find a reason,
To send a card, and say with glee,
Please stop stealing from my tree!

name: Five Ornaments
description:
On the fifth day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Five OR-NA-MENTS!

Besides comprising the very best part of this holiday song, these colourful ornaments sit nicely on a Christmas tree around the Eleven Coloured Lights. Big ones, little ones, the kind shaped like icicles-- they're all here, and ready to fill your home with holiday glee.

name: Four Festive Stockings
description: On the fourth day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Four Festive Stockings!

name: Gold Brick
description: Wow, somebody really likes you this holiday season. Still, what can you do with a solid gold brick? Well... it can sit in your inventory as a constant reminder of wealth.

name: Gold Tiger Statue
description: This stately replica of the zodiac tiger is the perfect way to commemorate Lunar New Year, 2010. Plus, he's made of gold. Who doesn't like gold?

name: Greeting Card
description: Happy Holiday Hunting!

name: Heart Key
description: This key may not be able to open someone's heart, but it may unlock a chest somewhere around here.

name: Itchy Sweater
description: Well, it is a bit itchy, and garish, and baggy, but grandma knitted it just for you. . . just try it on and smile. It'll make everyone much happier in the long run.

name: Mistletoe
description: Try not to be under this at the same time as a zombie mouse...

name: Mouse Macaroon
description: These painstakingly sculpted mice are painted by hand, then filled with a tangy raspberry jam. Enjoy!

name: Nine Reindeer Antlers
description:
On the ninth day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Nine Reindeer Antlers.

You'll be the life of the party with these stylish reindeer antlers, which are attached to headbands for ease of wear. This model is personally endorsed by the fifth grade class of Gnawnia middle school, who used them to put on the most successful Christmas pageant of the past four years.

name: One Droid Action Figure
description: On the first day of hunting, the good King gave to me... One Droid Action Figure!

name: Ox Mask
description:
Oops... It looks like the mouse that was wearing this mask is a little bit behind the times, but keeping a little souvenir of 2009 isn't such a bad thing.

Holding the Ox Mask, you gain the patience to keep trying for that Acolyte Mouse...

name: Paper Dragon Mask
description: Start your own Lunar New Year parade with this colorful dragon mask! This is the deluxe model: the mouth and eyes really move!

name: Petrified Fruitcake
description: It's a little disturbing, really... The cake in this over-ripe dessert may have gone green and the icing may have flaked off long ago, but the little pieces of pickled fruit are just as bright and cheery as they always were. How many times has this been re-gifted?

name: Posing Mouse Action Figure
description: This amazing toy features karate-chop action! The swift chopping action can shatter wooden planks! Play with at your own risk.

name: Rabbit Mask
description: The mouse that was wearing this mask must be stocking up for next year already. The rabbit mask makes you feel sweet and friendly when you hold it. Maybe it's time to join a hunting party and make some new friends. . .

name: Reindeer Slippers
description: These antler-rific slippers will keep your tootsies toasty this holiday season.

name: Ronzaburger with Cheese
description:
Ronza's favourite snack while flying the open skies! A secret family recipe from a long line of Ronzas. You know what they call a Ronza Burger with cheese in the Tribal Isles? A Rocksa with cheese. Do you know WHY they call it a Rocksa with cheese? Because of the Tribal Isles pebble-counting system, you say? Check out the big brain on you! You're one smart MouseHunter!



What use does this juicy burger have you ask? Well, it's for looking delicious in your inventory, of course!

name: Seven Gingerbread Mice
description:
On the seventh day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Seven Ginger mice!

Nine out of ten cats agree that these little cookies are much tastier than real mice. Hand-shaped with care and topped with adorable little icing designs depicting mice in all sorts of situations, these are the perfect gift for that frustrated hunter on your list.

name: Six Snow Balls
description:
On the sixth day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Six Perfect Snow Balls!

They're snowballs. You go outside and throw them. In fact, why aren't you out there right now? Grandma's not going to ambush herself!

name: Sleigh Bell
description: Ring-ring, ring-ring! Time for a sleigh ride out in the snow. Get your hat and your coat and let's all go!

name: Smashed Teddy Bear
description: Awww... How could you?

name: Soggy Fireworks
description: Oh dear. . . it looks like someone dropped their fireworks in that weird green water that flows through the tunnel of love. Well, waste not, want not. The shopkeeper here has decided to stock them anyway. Maybe they'll still work once they dry out.

name: Ten Candy Canes
description:
On the tenth day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Ten Canes of Candy.

Hand painted in Santa's workshop, these candy canes come in mint, cherry, sour raspberry, black licorice, and soup. Why soup, you ask? Well, Santa knows that not everybody likes candy.

name: Three Santa Hats
description: On the third day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Three Santa Hats!

name: Tiger Heart Chest
description: This chest was crafted especially for the Heart of the Tiger Festival, using materials from both celebrations. It looks like it requires a key from each holiday to open.

name: Tiger Key
description: If there were a chest hidden somewhere in this area, this key might go along way toward bringing you a prosperous new year.

name: Tiger Mask
description: Raaaar! With this mask in your possession, you're ready to take on anything, with all your claws out! Looking at the tiger mask gives you the courage to go anywhere, and catch any mouse that gets in your way! Just remember to use a trap, and not your teeth. Some tiger habits are better left alone.

name: Lump of Spoiled Egg Nog
description:
Oh dear. 

Well, the good news is that the eggnog is open. The bad news is that it seems to have opened on its own... almost as if something clawed its way out from the inside.

name: Two Festive Mitts
description: On the second day of hunting, the good King gave to me... Two Festive Mitts!

name: Valentine from the Devs
description:
On Valentine's Day, we celebrate love,
It's mostly for couples, or so we all think,
But you guys have been there for us all the way,
Playing our game, and sharing our links.

And so, a heartfelt message from us,
The Devs, who work to make the game run,
We love you and thank you this Valentine's Day,
Because without players, the game is no fun.

PS: Happy Lunar New Year! Enjoy the SUPER|brie+

name: Valentine Rejection Letter
description:
I cut you out this festive card,
In pretty colors, pink and blue,
Because I found it much too hard
To say just how much I loathe you.

It took some effort,
as you see,
Just to say,
Stay away from me!

Just kidding... Happy Valentine's Day!

name: Wreath
description: You'll have fun decorating your house with this festive wreath, complete with ornaments and a shiny red ribbon.

name: Yule Log
description: Mmmm, this looks tasty. It's got vanilla cake, and a chocolate swirl, and even a candy cane on top. Time for a holiday sugar rush!

name: Not So Secret Admirer Bunny
description: People tend to feel sorry for this bunny just long enough for him to get attached. He's been rejected by many different owners, perhaps because he loves to an uncomfortable level.
message: You love your Not So Secret Admirer Bunny... and he loves you too!

name: Plush Terrible Twos Mouse
description: This cute little plush toy is much less destructive than actual Terrible Twos mice. Still, you can't help but feel that every time you hug it, something in the Kingdom catches fire...
message: You hug your Terrible Twos Plushie ... and you get a hug back!

name: Plush Tiger
description: Overcoming the adversity becomes easier with a bit of confidence, and this lucky plush tiger. Hold on to his paw, and you're sure to feel more lucky, no matter what you do.
message: You grip your Plush Tiger...and he returns the gesture!

name: Santa Bear
description: Keep the festive feeling alive year-round by hugging this little bear! If one hug does not get you in a happy hunting mood, try another.
message: You hug your Santa Bear ... and feel slightly more festive!

name: Slap Cat
description: When your hunting skills leave a lot to be desired, just come to him and he'll slap some sense into you. Unlike the huggable teddy-bear, Slap Cat does not love you.
message: You slap your Slap Cat but miss ... and quickly receive a slap back!

name: Teddy Bear
description:
This cuddly little friend is the perfect cure for the red box blues. Whenever you're feeling upset, sad or lonely, take comfort that this little bear will always be in your inventory to offer a comforting hug.

When the D.H.U. gets high... just hug this lil' guy!
message: You hug your Teddy Bear... and his hug squeezes you tight!

name: Toy Ronza Ship
description: Crafted by a master toy maker, this miniature ship contains all the same details as Ronza's traveling shop. Just don't expect it to have a trapsmith inside.
message: You look to the sky and wish for Ronza...

name: Acolyte Relic (125,000 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this artifact contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Combat Research (1,250 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Combat Research (750 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (10,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (1,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (250 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (50,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (5,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (500 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (750 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Hunting Research (5,000 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Lab Research (1,000 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Lab Research (500 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Lab Research (750 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Molten Shrapnel Base
description:
Devilishly intelligent hunters have found an incredible use for, and an excellent recycling opportunity by harnessing the power of the dragon embers to melt and fuse the excess pieces of scrap metal.

Gears of platinum churn the massive quantity of compressed molten metal which provides a significant power bonus. Any attempts to record this design upon a blueprint, quickly result in ashes, making this base's design especially secret.

name: Cherry Cheese
description: This soft, sweet cheese is quite a sought-after dessert item in Whisker Woods, both for its extreme rarity and its delightful, fruity flavor. Cherry Mice collect it because it reminds them of their favourite fruit, all year round.

name: SUPER|brie+ Gift Basket
description:
A gift basket perfect for giving to friends! The basket contains 75 SUPER|brie+ for use in the hunt!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Cherry Potion
description: This glowing red potion turns ordinary Brie or SUPER|brie+ into Cherry cheese, a sweet, tasty treat that appeals to the 'berry' discerning sensibilities of the Cherry Mice living in the Calm Clearing.

name: Insta-Horn
description: This single-use air horn in a can from Lucky Larry Industries gives you the power to instantly sound the Hunter's Horn before your timer has reset! The rest of your hunting party may be a bit shaky after you set it off, though-- like most air horns, it's awfully loud.

name: Zugzwang's Scarf
description:
This strange scarf came out of the Dragon's Chest. Apparently, Zugzwang was serious about keeping the moths out of his clothing. The scarf is surprisingly heavy even considering its odd construction.

It doesn't seem to be a very comfortable scarf either, however, Bubbles the giant overprotective octopus seems cowed by its intangible air of power. He should let you travel to the mysterious floating island as long as you have his master's scarf in hand.

Obtain this map piece during either Knight or Lord adventure:
Slay the Dragon Mouse
Hunt for Icewing

name: Zugzwang's Tower Key
description:
In this key, the four seasonal powers combine to overwhelm the seal on Zugzwang's Tower. Unlock the door, but beware: the mice within this tower play a dangerous game, and only the strongest player will achieve a checkmate.

Obtain this map piece during the Lord/Lady adventure:
Capture the Mystic and Technic Kings

name: Fluffy DeathBot
description: To honor the spirit of our loyal hunters, the Deathbot has been given a new paint job to give it some extra frills and flower power! Obliterate mice the cute way... you know you want to.

name: Grungy Deathbot
description: This DeathBot, painted up for our loyal hunters, gives you that gritty, post-apocalyptic feeling while hunting, without leaving the comfort of your own dimension.

name: Power Charm
description: Slightly warm to the touch, this charm is bursting with potential power! The Power Charm provides +500 Power and a 5% Power Bonus to your trap with each hunt.

name: Heat Bath
description: What's the deal with pools, anyway? Mice go in, they splash around, they get *shudder* wet. . . Clearly there's no appeal there. Even water loving mice like to get out of the pool every now and then and get dry-- really, really dry. And the unbearable heat of the torch is a nice touch as well. It gives the whole trap the feel of the tropics. Now, mice won't have to go far from home to get that 'just sat out in the sun for eight hours' feeling!

name: Mystic Pawn Pincher
description: When Mystic Pawns see the glowing energies from this trap, they flock to it, hoping to top up their reserve. The Hunter must then whisper the forbidden words which direct the crane arm, positioning it over the hapless pawn before the allotted time passes. If the spell is said correctly, the runic claw drops down and nabs the Mystic Pawn. Technic Pawn armour is too cumbersome for the Arcane Crane, making them fall out of the claw before it gets a good grip. Not very effective against Technic Mice.

name: Technic Pawn Pincher
description: With all of the gizmos, gadgets, and mechanical gewgaws placed on the field by the Technic Team, one more coal engine isn't going to arouse much notice. In fact, this trap fits in so seamlessly with the Technic defensive line that Technic Pawns try to check it for repairs on a regular basis. When they do, the claw picks them up, and either flings them away, or drops them in the engine for three free hours of running time. Efficiency at its best! Not very effective against Mystic Mice.

name: Zugzwang's First Move
description: The chess pieces of Zugzwang's Last Move have been reborn with the help of a magic feather, becoming a powerful knight who will defend your cheese to the death. Using strategy gleaned from his origins as a chess set, and a stubbornness that can only come from being made of stone, he will fight off any rodent attacker in the name of his King or Queen.

name: Chess Pieces
description: You've smashed Zugzwang's last move, but that didn't extinguish the trap's magic. When you pass your hand over the rubble, the shards move along with you, trying to re-assemble themselves into something new.

name: Fall Key Shard
description: When you pick up this piece of key, you can hear leaves rustling in the distance, and smell woodsmoke on the air. Find the other pieces, and it may unlock something hidden.

name: Heat Bath Blueprints
description: The wise Dragon Mouse has designed a few changes to the Harpoon Gun that hunters sometimes use in Elub Shore. These plans require a couple of Launcher Parts modified with Scrap Metal to form fuel tanks that house a Coal-based combustible fluid.
obtain_hint: Hunt Dragon mice in Dracano

name: Magic Feather
description: Despite being in the Dragon's Chest for a very long time, this feather still looks pristine. You feel energized at its touch, as if it were boosting your life force.
obtain_hint: Hunt Dragon mice in Dracano

name: Spring Key Shard
description: Birdsong and a light spattering of rain greet you when you hold this key shard. After you dry off, you might want to go looking for the other missing pieces.

name: Summer Key Shard
description: When you touch this piece of key, you can smell fresh leaves and the ocean on a hot summer day. By itself, this piece won't open anything, but it looks like it fits into a set.

name: Winter Key Shard
description: Don't lick this key, or your tongue will stick to it for sure! If you combine this shard with a few more pieces, you may find some shelter from the cold.

name: Zugzwang's First Move Blueprints
description:
These blueprints show you how to mould the smashed remnants of Zugzwang's Last Move into a single, powerful knight, brought to life by a magic feather.

This trap requires the rank of Lord/Lady or higher.

name: Spellbook Base
description: The bindings on this spell book glow with runic magic. When you touch it, the pages seem to be moving, ever so slightly. Magic this strong can only be bound by a powerful wizard, and even then, it strives for release. Luckily for you, the spells trapped within this book will try to lure in mice in to break the binding... put a trap on it, and you're in business.

name: Blackstone Pass Trap
description: Between these two pillars lies an anomaly of time and space, a void which emits a siren song that only mice of the Mystic Team can hear. The Mystic King uses pieces of this stone to gather his minions to him in times of crisis, but these monoliths emit enough hypnotic vibrations to draw even the King himself between the pillars. Once the mice pass through this gate, they step into another plane of being, never to return. Not very effective against Technic mice.

name: Obvious Ambush Trap
description: This little robot's not fooling anyone, but with a laser-sighted, explosive-shooting cannon at his side, he doesn't really have to. Because of the Technic King's passion for heavy artillery, Technic Mice have an irresistible compulsion to battle any strange technology and acquire it for the team. Even an obvious ambush brings Technics running in hopes that they can be the one to bring a new weapon home to the King. Not very effective against the Mystic mice.

name: Checkmate Cheese
description: This cheese is the only food which can entice the Chess Master, for its delicate aroma carries the scent... of victory! The Kings of both teams long for a morsel of this cheese, believing it will bring them mastery over the game, but if you can defeat them, the Chess Master himself will challenge you for a piece. Don't leave this cheese out too long, though, or you may find yourself with a stale, mate.

name: Blackstone Pass Trap Blueprints
description:
With these blueprints, and a few extra materials, Hunters can create the ultimate trap temptation for Mystic mice. Although you suspect there may be a Mystic Crystal used in the recipe somewhere, other Hunters will think your trap is really coal.

This trap requires the rank of Lord/Lady or higher.

name: Droid Jetpack
description: Gee, this little jetpack looks like it might propel a tiny robot into the air to shoot mice with a laser cannon. No one's seen a floating-tiny-robot-with-a-mouse-shooting-laser-cannon jetpack in years. The Technic King sure has a taste for the classics.
obtain_hint: Hunt Technic King mice in Zugzwang's Tower

name: Master Bindings
description: This book's cover was designed with the serious master sorcerer in mind, with runic enchantments imprinted on the spine, and a metal seal strong enough to bind even the most persistent of spells. It will hold your collected notes from the Tower Kings without too many incidents.
obtain_hint: Hunt Chess Master mice in Zugzwang's Tower

name: Mystic Crystal
description: You feel the energy of the crystal lulling you into a trance. Could this be how the Mystic King controls his followers? If so, this crystal would make a valuable addition to an anti-Mystic trap.
obtain_hint: Hunt Mystic King mice in Zugzwang's Tower

name: Mystic Curd
description: These special curds and whey have been matured in the stomach of a Crimp-Eared Whifflehorn, the most magical of invisible beasts. The Mystic King was saving them for himself, but he's not the only mouse that may be interested in the vibrations of a magical cheese.

name: Torn Mystic Page
description: The Mystic King dropped these notes scribbled on old parchment. When you read the words aloud, they glow and emit the sound of far off music. These are probably valuable... some binding would help keep them safe.
obtain_hint: Hunt Mystic King mice in Zugzwang's Tower

name: Obvious Ambush Trap Blueprints
description:
These blueprints show you, in detail, how to construct a trap that Technic mice can't help but walk into! Naturally, droids are involved in this ambush, but to pull it off properly this time, they're going to need a little lift.

This trap requires the rank of Lord/Lady or higher.

name: Spellbook Base Blueprints
description:
These blueprints describe how to turn the Chess Master's spell book into a functional base for your trap, but right now, it's got a long way to go. The Master Binding will need some more pages to fill it out before a trap will hold steady, and that aging leather might need some precious metals to protect it from the elements.

This base requires the rank of Lord/Lady or higher.

name: Technic Cheese Mould
description: Although this mould is normally used to form gears for the Technic Army's war machines, it also doubles as a single-use cheese mould. The mysterious Boss Mouse of Zugzwang's Tower loves this shape of this cheese, but the Boss may also require a certain magical zip before it goes in for a nibble.

name: Torn Technic Page
description:
These schematics show all of the Technic King's plans for new and improved mouse weaponry! These blueprints can't get into the wrong paws...

Be sure to should bind them safely into a book that you can carry with you!
obtain_hint: Hunt Technic King mice in Zugzwang's Tower

name: Zugzwang's Left Sock
description: An item covered in this many moons and stars could only have come from a wizard, and Zugzwang's insignia is printed on the heel... but what would that strange mouse want with this gaudy old sock?

name: Hunting Research (10,000 bonus points)
description: The knowledge this research contains instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Larry's Sandwich
description: Larry's favourite snack after a long day of MouseHunting!

name: Mozzarella Cheese
description: This bait has the same attraction rate as Marble Cheese, but it comes with the added warm fuzzy feeling that you get from knowing that somebody out there in Gnawnia cares about you. Sending gifts is free, so why not return the favor? Gifts are a great way to help your friends out without spending any gold.

name: 2010 Pumpkin Treat Basket
description: There's sure to be a Halloween treat in this spooky basket!

name: Evil Pumpkin Seed
description: A seed from the belly of the deadly Gordborg Pumpkin Machine! This seed is sure to grow something spooky.

name: Pumpkin Pummeler Blueprints
description: These blueprints are a diagram of a unique farming process that will grow an Evil Pumpkin Seed into a mouse pummeling sight to behold!

name: Smashed Pumpkin
description: The act of smashing pumpkins can often leave hunters with a melancholy feeling of sadness. Cheer up! These bits of gourd are sure to have some creative use!

name: Empty Candy Wrapper
description: This wrapper is a sweet reminder of candy long ago enjoyed.

name: Rubber Spider
description: Eek! A spider!

name: Spooky Toothbrush
description: After eating so much Halloween candy this spooky brush is sure to come in handy!

name: Lovable Bat Plushie
description: Don't let those little fangs fool you, this adorable bat only wishes to wrap its little wings around you. If you're feeling scared this Halloween, just give this little guy a squeeze and you're sure to feel safe again.
message: You squeeze your Loveable Bat Plushie and it squeeks with excitement!

name: Cackle Lantern Trap
description: Where did all the other pumpkins go? Oh yeah, that's right... the Cackle Lantern smashed them all. But, out of the remains of his old companions springs a new friend who understands the rigors of carnivorous planthood: a sprout of the Venus Mouse Trap. Together, these two are ready to smash, swallow, and snare any mouse that dares set foot on their trap-- just don't ask them to share the proceeds once they're done. The immense heat of the lantern occasionally increases Fire Salt drops when hunting in the Jungle of Dread.

name: Pumpkin Pummeler
description: It takes one seriously evil pumpkin seed to grow a squash so steeped in malevolence, so genuinely nasty that it will sacrifice its brothers and sisters on the vine to smash random passersby... but hey, it makes a great trap mechanism. Mice come in, expecting a festive treat, (and maybe a guy dressed up as a scarecrow jumping out of the bushes), and instead, they come face to face with a real Halloween horror, complete with monster teeth!

name: Candy Corn Cheese
description:
Made by adding sugary syrup and just a hint of marshmallow to ordinary white cheese, Candy Corn cheese is a sweet treat that pleases human and rodent alike. Although Candy Corn is safe for all ages, its sweetness can be overwhelming: mice who overdo it and eat too many kernels will end up with a stomach ache and bad dreams.

This cheese was once used in the Haunted Terrortories during Halloween events of the past. Now it's a suitable replacement for Gouda Cheese!

name: Ghoulgonzola Cheese
description:
Brought to life by placing a pan of pumpkin-infused curd beneath a thunder bolt, Ghoulgonzola has a life of its own-- and a penchant for playing tricks on Halloween revelers. This cheese has been known to pop out of bushes in large flocks, startling passersby, and ring doorbells before flying away. Even after being caught and eaten, Ghoulgonzola will continue to make trouble, fluttering around in your tummy and making rude sounds to embarrass you in company.

This cheese was once used in the Haunted Terrortories during Halloween events of the past. Now it's a suitable replacement for Gouda Cheese!

name: Attraction Charm
description: This strange looking little charm releases a small burst of air every few minutes. When combined with your cheese, it will increase the distance the cheese scent will travel, helping to attract more mice to your trap.

name: Luck Charm
description: Made of rare and precious metals, this charm is believed to bring extra luck with each hunt.

name: Halloween Basket
description:
A Halloween gift basket perfect for giving to someone special.

The basket contains:

• 75 SUPER|brie+
• 25 Candy Corn Cheese
• 25 Ghoulgonzola

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Mystery Gift Box
description: Prepare for edge of your seat excitement! What random gift item could be in this mystery gift box? Tasty Mozzarella? Crumby Stale Cheese? Open it and find out!

name: Beginner's Luck
description: Being in close proximity to Larry the Knight often leaves new hunters with a touch of good fortune. This small vial has encapsulated this talent to be used at your convenience, if you're the superstitious type.

name: Cheese Belt Token Pack
description: Contains 6 Cheese Belt Tokens. The School of the Cheese Belt harnesses the magical energy of these tokens to calm their once insatiable cravings for cheese. Unleashing the power within the token will materialize all the cravings it has absorbed and is vital in the process of creating Glutter cheese.

name: Cheese Claw Token Pack
description: Contains 6 Cheese Claw Tokens. Cheese Claw tokens harness magical jade gems to encapsulate the teachings of the Claw School. The magic essence of these tokens is a vital ingredient in creating the sacred Susheese, a preferred meal of the Masters of the Cheese Claw.

name: Cheese Fang Token Pack
description: Contains 6 Cheese Fang Tokens. The glowing ruby in the center of these tokens symbolizes the power of focused aggression that is the core of the teachings of the Cheese Fang. The magical energy of these tokens must be released to create Combat cheese.

name: Crate of Delicious Stones
description: Contains 10 Delicious Stones. These tasty small rocks are collected by members of the Derr tribe within the dunes of Tribal Isle and are used to create Crunchy cheese.

name: Lucky Coin
description: A Lucky Coin for the superstitious hunter!

name: Lucky Horseshoe
description: A nicely polished horseshoe that shines with a lucky glow! If you're the superstitious, give it a toss; You never know what may break a streak of poor luck.

name: Lucky Underwear
description: Whoa! Check out the stylish print on these shorts! Wearing such a stylish pair of underwear is sure to make lady luck lean your way! Remember: It never hurts to wear more than one pair!

name: Crate of Savoury Vegetables
description: Contains 10 Savoury Vegetables. Savoury Vegetables are farmed on the eastern plains of Tribal Isle by members of the Nerg tribe, and are the main ingredient in Gumbo cheese.

name: SUPER|brie+ Supply Pack
description: A supply package containing 10 SUPER|brie+ and provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 3 days from date of opening.

name: Crate of Seashells
description: Contains 10 Seashells. These shells are collected from the shores of Tribal Isle by members of the Elub tribe and ground up to make Shell cheese.

name: Crate of Vanilla Beans
description: Contains 15 Vanilla Beans. These rare beans are only available deep within the Jungle of Dread, but their rind imparts a pleasant, sweet flavor to food. As a result, it is one of Gnawnia's most expensive delicacies and is used in the creation of both Vanilla and Vengeful Vanilla Stilton.

name: Ambush Trap Parts
description: A carefully dismantled Ambush Trap.

name: Fluffy DeathBot Blueprint
description:
When combined with DeathBot Parts, these blueprints create the Fluffy DeathBot, a trap with with extra frills and flower power! Obliterate mice the cute way... you know you want to.

Once crafted, the Fluffy DeathBot can not be smashed back into parts.

This trap requires the rank of Journeyman/Journeywoman or higher.

name: Grungy DeathBot Blueprint
description:
The Deathbot, painted up for our loyal hunters, gives you that gritty, post-apocalyptic feeling while hunting, without leaving the comfort of your own dimension. Combine these blueprints with DeathBot Parts to show your tough side while hunting mice!

Once crafted, the Grungy DeathBot can not be smashed back into parts.

This trap requires the rank of Journeyman/Journeywoman or higher.

name: Ninja Ambush Blueprint
description:
With a few small tweaks, the droids of the Ambush Trap become the SUPER NINJA GO-GO DEATH SQUAD!!! Smash an Ambush Trap with your hunters' hammer and use it with these blueprints to hunt, ninja

This trap requires the rank of Grandmaster or higher.

name: Super Briefs
description: These collectible, stylish briefs not only keep you warm but also show that you know how to hunt in style! Wear them under your pants, over your pants or even on your head! No matter what your choice, you're sure to turn heads in Super Briefs!
message: You wear your Super Briefs and feel a warm sense of confidence!

name: King's Credit
description:
Congratulations! You've been awarded a King's Credit!

Visit the Prize Shoppe at the King's Arms in the Valour region to claim a prize of your choice, or keep saving up to redeem greater rewards!
obtain_hint: Loot from Daily Loyalty Chests, Relic Hunter Treasure Chests, completing Adventures, or hunting Prize mice

name: Prize Power
description: Prize Power was an ancient magic used to attract certain types of mice. The power of this magic has all but fizzled and it no longer has the same effect as it once did.

name: Ninja Ambush Trap
description: With a few small tweaks, the droids of the Ambush Trap become the SUPER NINJA GO-GO DEATH SQUAD!!! In our next episode, Super Ninja Robot Team must defeat more mice than ever before to prove their worth to their new owner. So be sure to tune in for: SERIOUS NINJA ROBOT AMBUSH! By the powers of Go-Go, they will punish you!

name: Empowered Anchor Charm
description:
This charm is created by bonding Charmbits with Scrap Metal to forge a mighty anchor that increases the stability of a trap's weapon, providing a significant power bonus.

The anchor also prevents being washed out of Balack's Cove when capturing a Riptide Mouse and reduces your movement speed underwater when armed during a dive at the Sunken City.

name: Dragonbane Charm
description:
This charm acts as a hidden surprise for all dragon-like mice bold enough to come near your trap.

When activated, the charm bursts out a jarring cold blast of air, providing a 300% Power Bonus, making these mice easier to catch.
This charm is only consumed when encountering:
  • Dragon Mouse (Dracano)
  • Icewing (Iceberg)
  • Cork Collector, Pressure Builder, and Geyser Hunter mice (Queso Geyser)
  • Storm Dragon mice (Moussu Picchu)
  • Dashing Dragon mice, Empyrean Javelineer Mouse, and the Paragon of Dragons (Floating Islands)
  • Dragons of the Depths (Draconic Depths)

name: Extreme Luck Charm
description: This rare and precious charm contains dangerously concentrated amounts of luck, providing an amazing +8 luck to each hunt!

name: Forgotten Charm
description: Gaze into the mysterious swirl of this charm and you'll feel the lure of Forgotten Power! Equipping this charm changes any trap into a Forgotten one for a single hunt.

name: Freshness Charm
description: This miniature magical ice cube will keep your cheese chilled ensuring that while out on a trap it'll stay fresh as long as possible.

name: Scientist's Charm
description: Powered by small fragments of Living Shard, this technologically advanced charm is scientifically engineered to increase the quantity of Radioactive Blue Potions dropped while hunting in the Burroughs' Laboratory.

name: Super Luck Charm
description: Radiating with sheer lucky awesomeness, this lucky charm provides a +5 luck bonus each hunt.

name: Wishing Well Basket
description: A great gift to celebrate the King's Giveaway! The basket contains 125 SUPER|brie+ and provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: Gold
description: Buy exciting traps and delicious cheese with this!

name: Cornucopia Gift Basket
description: A Thanksgiving Cornucopia full of cheesy goodness! The basket contains 125 SUPER|brie+ and provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: Blue Winter Hunt Gift Box
description: A special gift to hunters of ranks Novice to Grandmaster! For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special. Happy holiday hunting!

name: Festive Gift Basket
description:
This festive gift basket is full of SUPER|brie+ and is great for giving to friends this Great Winter Hunt!

Inside you'll find:

• 125 SUPER|brie+

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Green Winter Hunt Gift Box
description: A special gift to hunters of ranks Legendary through Knight! For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special. Happy holiday hunting!

name: Jumbo Festive Gift Basket
description:
This jumbo gift basket is full of SUPER|brie+ and makes a superb gift this Great Winter Hunt.

Inside you'll find:

• 200 SUPER|brie+

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Red Winter Hunt Gift Box
description: A special gift to hunters of rank Lord or Lady! For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special. Happy holiday hunting!

name: Pair of Tickets
description: It's an oyster with two tickets to that thing you love.

name: Clock Parts
description: The dismantled parts of a Clockapult of Time. Dozens of gears, an hour and second hand as well as a capacitor for something called... flux.

name: Clockapult of Winter Past Blueprint
description:
Combine these blueprints with Clock Parts to create a more festive version of the Clockapult of Time. The Clockapult of Winter Past sends caught mice into the not-so-distant past where they learn a valuable lesson that gives mice a change of heart.

Once crafted, the Clockapult of Winter Past can not be smashed back into parts.

This trap requires the rank of Legendary or higher.

name: Icy RhinoBot Blueprint
description:
These blueprints when combined with RhinoBot Parts make the Icy RhinotBot! Hunt mice with sub-zero flare! Don't let the cute matching hat and scarf fool you, those frozen fists mean business!

Once crafted, the Icy RhinoBot can not be smashed back into parts.

This trap requires the rank of Legendary or higher.

name: RhinoBot Parts
description: Dismantling a RhinoBot takes quite a few swings of the Hunter's Hammer! Oh sure, some hunters have fun playing catch with the RhinoBot head, but it's all fun and games until someone loses an eye!

name: Festive Diamonds
description: The two tickets are now diamonds!

name: Snow Globe
description: A decoration that is both festive and recursive! It seems as though there could be another snow globe within the preserved snow globe, and if that's the case does that mean that you're currently trapped in a snow globe?

name: 2010 Winter Star
description: You saved the Great Winter Hunt! The evil plan of the Squeaker Claws Mouse to ruin the Great Winter Hunt '10 was foiled thanks to your diligent hunting efforts! Happy holiday hunting!

name: Clockapult of Winter Past
description: This more festive version of the Clockapult of Time sends caught mice into the not-so-distant past where they learn a valuable lesson that gives mice a change of heart.

name: Icy RhinoBot
description: This RhinoBot, painted up for our loyal hunters, lets you hunt mice with sub-zero flare! Don't let the cute matching hat and scarf fool you, those frozen fists mean business!

name: Frozen Fromage
description: This small morsel of frozen bait has been magically frozen. The scientists of Digby discovered a morsel of Nutmeg Cheese is frozen inside, a known favourite of the Squeaker Claws Mouse.

name: Winter Star Sunglasses
description: These bad boys are highly suggested to anyone who's anywhere near the Great Winter Tree once it's fully lit up. With a UV rating of 5,000 these should probably do the trick!

name: Larry's Mustache Cookies
description: Soft and chewy, these delightful cookies prepared by our own Royal Knight Larry emit a very... strong... odor while baking.

name: Sylvan Plushie
description: Lumpy and cute, this little stuffed doll smells like freshly cut grass, and also the first snow fall of the year. And... is that a hint of cinnamon? Or maybe it just smells like happiness.
message: Nearby windows fracture to the sounds of its highpitched shrilling purr.

name: Festive Fuse
description:
Set off some holiday cheer with your own festive fuse!
I wonder what this could be for..?

name: Climbing Pitons
description: These pitons seem unusually sharp.

name: Toboggan Ride Parts
description: Full of dynamite submerged in a snowcone, this is one box you'd best move carefully. There's just enough parts in here to rebuild the Explosive Toboggan Ride.

name: Lava Bucket
description: Ah, there's nothing like a bucket of lava on a cold night! Step very carefully when carrying this toasty beverage - you really, really don't want to spill it.

name: Festive Mines
description: You know that excited shriek of surprise often heard when unwrapping a particularly wonderful and unexpected gift? Well, these get a similar reaction.

name: Misplaced Missile Cone
description: You're not sure you want to think about where this came from, or why it's lying here abandoned in the snow bank. Oh well, finders keepers!

name: Ski Sign
description: Expert skiers only! Sudden drops and hidden obstacles!

name: Heart of Ice
description: This little thing is barely bigger than a snowflake; however, it is so cold that it could flash freeze a bucket of water in 7 seconds. Just a word of advice, don't touch your tongue to it.

name: Holiday Explosives
description: Nicely packed explosives to ring in the holidays with a bang!

name: Icicles
description: Pointy!

name: Packed Snow
description: This snow has been specially packed to be incredibly dense.

name: Sled
description: This sled has a super-slick coating and is made to be extremely durable.

name: Double Diamond Adventure
description: Nudging the carefully balanced bait on this toboggan begins an amazing skiing adventure filled with perilous fun! After traversing a slope filled with landmines and sharpened moguls mice can let their aches literally melt away in the magma hot tub.

name: Explosive Toboggan Ride
description: This toboggan provides a unique ride where mice are sent sky high! The airborne journey is exciting, although the landing is a little rough.

name: Seasoned Gouda
description: This seasonal delight is best served chilled, with a light frosting of icing. The hardened curd is far too tough for most common mice, who will pass it by in fear of chipping their teeth! But for truly hardy mice of discriminating taste, no other cheese is so delightful at this time of year.

name: Seasoned Gouda Potion
description: This potion yields a seasoned version of Gouda with a crunchy texture that the stronger mice of the Festive Comet love.

name: Massive Festive Gift Basket
description:
This massive crate of SUPER|brie+ is the ultimate gift this Great Winter Hunt season!

Inside you'll find:

• 1,600 SUPER|brie+

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Nutmeg Cheese
description: This nicely spiced cheese is favoured by the festive mice during the Great Winter Hunt. It also makes the perfect topping for a warm cup of eggnog.

name: 2010 Ronza Voucher
description: Ronza's Traveling Shoppe will be returning to Gnawnia sometime during January, 2011 and will feature new exciting items discovered by Moustachio the Charmer. This voucher can be redeemed for 20 free Luck Charms from her shop when she arrives. Keep watching the skies!

name: Satchel of Gold (2,011 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Crate of Ultimate Luck Charms
description: Containing 20 Ultimate Luck Charms that provide a +20 luck bonus while armed. To open the crate, view the "Special" section of your inventory. One charm is used for each mouse encountered, so use them wisely! In order to arm these Charms, visit Moustachio's Charm Shoppe in the Mountains and purchase a Charm Conduit.

name: Ultimate Luck Charm
description: This charm is rapidly vibrating, near-ready to explode with luck! The Ultimate Luck Charm provides a whopping +20 luck while armed.

name: Tiki Base Blueprints
description: These blueprints describe how to assemble pieces of Tribal Timber into an ornate base capable of mesmerizing the mice of the Elub, Nerg and Derr tribes. The enchanting effect results in a +6 luck bonus when hunting the three tribes. These plans are printed by Ronza herself, and are sometimes available when she visits.  Due to her limited supply, a hunter may only own 5 copies of the blueprints.

name: Tribal Timber
description: This timber was long ago harvested from the Jungle of Dread to construct a Tribal Base. The split wood still fits perfectly together, as though it longs to be together again.

name: Bacon Base
description: This odd little base was granted to Ronza for her help in defeating a Nether Pig plaguing a small village in a far off land. Thankfully it's not actually made of real meat, but rather a cleverly painted polycarbonate slab.

name: Runic Base
description: Forged by "The Forgotten", this ancient tablet was once used as a crafting station to enchant Runes. While in Bristle Woods, the engravings etched on this base begin to glow and dance along the tablet, calling out for what was once born from its surface, attracting mice carrying an abundance of Runes.

name: Seasonal Base
description: This base is carved from the magical soil of Zugzwang's Seasonal Garden. The serene soil brings together all four seasons, providing camouflage inside the garden. The Seasonal Base gains an 18% power bonus when hunting in the Seasonal Garden.

name: Tiki Base
description: Made from precious Tribal Timber collected by smashing a Tribal Base, the Tiki Base features a more ornate design than its tribal counterpart. The serpentine carvings mesmerize the mice of Elub, Nerg and Derr giving your trap a +6 luck bonus when encountering them on a hunt.

name: Arcane Blast Trap
description: This trap uses the conductive properties of onyx to draw magical energy from the world around it. When the trap is activated, the concentrated energy is released in a bright blast, vanquishing mice to another realm.

name: Pneumatic Tube Trap
description: A simple pressure plate below the cheese activates the powerful vacuum tube sucking the mouse to any location you or the vast network of tubes dictates. The highly lucky suction is capable of capturing a mouse that is on the brink of escape, producing a satisfying "FOOOMP" sound.

name: Rewers Riposte
description: These droids have been specially trained by one of the kingdom's most devoted hunters. The droids are quick and agile, allowing them to easily parry an incoming mouse and corral them under a massive net.

name: Shrink Ray Trap
description: Zap! This high-powered Shrink Ray reduces mice to miniature in seconds flat! Makes a great trap for a beginning MouseHunter!

name: First Ever Charm
description: *Sold for a limited time only* To celebrate the introduction of charms to Gnawnia, Moustachio is selling one of his early prototypes. Although more powerful charms have since been discovered, this antiquarian charm remains a special piece of hunting history!

name: Charm Conduit
description: This conduit is added to your trap to gain the ability to use charms. This conduit is carved from the wood of a Mountain Pine Tree.

name: Charmbit
description: Charmbits are a vital ingredient used in crafting Charms. Some say they are impossibly small nanites, while others state that they are condensed magic, experts suggest it is likely a combination of them both. The one thing everyone can agree on is to handle with care and never breathe it in!

name: Epic Orb
description: There are a few charms so powerful, so world-shatteringly incredible that not even the Divine Orb can contain them.  This orb is designed to do just that.  One thousand Charmbits will be required as a base and a Garden Essence will be needed to power it, though eventually more ingredients and abilities may be uncovered.
obtain_hint: Hunt mice throughout the kingdom or purchase from the Labyrinth or Zokor Charm Shoppe

name: Flawed Orb
description: The Flawed Orb is used in crafting rudimentary charms. Its poor workmanship and porous surface make it incapable of being used in crafting more advanced charms.
obtain_hint: Hunt mice throughout the kingdom or purchase from the Labyrinth or Zokor Charm Shoppe

name: Flawless Orb
description: The Flawless Orb balances quality workmanship with quality glass for superior performance. This quality orb makes a perfect vessel for powerful charms.
obtain_hint: Hunt mice throughout the kingdom or purchase from the Labyrinth or Zokor Charm Shoppe

name: Divine Orb
description: Of unknown origins, the Divine Orb defies common understanding. Not made of glass like other orbs, it is made of an unknown crystal that can contain the strongest charms while crafting. This orb should only be used to craft the most powerful of charms and nothing else.
obtain_hint: Hunt mice throughout the kingdom or purchase from the Labyrinth or Zokor Charm Shoppe

name: Simple Orb
description: The Simple Orb is an ideal choice for crafting average powered charms.
obtain_hint: Hunt mice throughout the kingdom or purchase from the Labyrinth or Zokor Charm Shoppe

name: Antiskele Charm
description: This charm is packed with concentrated Radioactive Sludge, which is highly corrosive to bone. Skeleton Mice in the Catacombs fear these charms and will stay clear of your trap while you have one armed.

name: Prospector's Charm
description:
With a center of hard meteorite, this charm provides +200 power and a 10% power bonus to your trap.

When used in the Mountain, this charm's prospecting ability attracts more Gold and Diamond mice. When used alongside SUPER|brie+ in the Mountain, these charms also increase the attraction of Silvertail mice.

When used in Claw Shot City, this charm increases the chance of encountering a Prospector Mouse who may drop some Fool's Gold when caught!

name: Rotten Charm
description: Made from rotten pieces of dried up cheese, this charm's funky odour adds power to your trap by causing a mouse to become slightly queasy right as they attempt to steal your bait. This powerful stench is also known to penetrate bait, increasing the chance of it turning stale.

name: Super Rotten Charm
description: Imbued with rock-hard Stale SUPER|brie+, this charm emits a powerful stench that puts a mouse into a severely disorientated state. The intense odour also increases the chance of your bait turning stale should you fail to attract a mouse.

name: Heart of the Rabbit Gift Basket
description: This jumbo-sized, festive gift basket is full of SUPER|brie+ and makes a great gift during the Heart of the Rabbit Party. The basket contains 200 SUPER|brie+ and provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened. The basket also has 3 Valentine Charms and 3 Lucky Rabbit Charms as a festive bonus!

name: Lucky Rabbit Charm
description: It turns out people have had it wrong this whole time, it's not the entire rabbit foot that is lucky, but rather the fur on the hind legs. These charms are made from 100% naturally shed fur from a rabbit's hind leg. Only a dedicated mouse could have collected the correct furs to make a charm this powerful, though it seems it didn't bring that mouse much luck after all did it?

name: Valentine Charm
description: Bursting with affection, this loving charm adds a 100% attraction bonus. Enjoy the attraction benefit yourself, or share with a friend to let them know they're special!

name: Friend
description: Friends who play MouseHunt.

name: 2011 Birthday Gift
description: A gift wrapped up to celebrate MouseHunt's Third Birthday! I wonder what's inside...

name: Birthday Gift Basket
description: This birthday basket makes a great gift to celebrate MouseHunt's Birthday! The basket contains 200 SUPER|brie+, 100 Cupcake Colby Cheese and provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: Birthday Explosives
description: Festive birthday explosives! Warning: Do not use as candles.

name: Fuse
description: A coil of fuse.

name: Red Wax
description: A glob of multi-purpose red wax.

name: Birthday Bear
description: A cuddly companion and friend to bring to the MouseHunt Birthday Party.

name: Silly Birthday Hat
description: You get the feeling that this silly birthday hat has been around the world. Thankfully it is now nice and safe in your collection; after all, a hat can only handle so much worldly experience.

name: Spring Toy
description: A bright and shiny spring toy! Now to find a hunting spot with a lot of stairs...

name: Cheesecake Base
description:
His Majesty's head chef has created a cake masterpiece from a material known to attract mice, cheese! When used as a base, this rich and decadent cake provides an impressive attraction bonus to your trap setup.

A flavour first savoured during MouseHunt's 3rd birthday!

name: Birthday Candle Kaboom
description: These aren't your normal everyday decorative candles, this becomes apparent as soon as you light one. Candles don't normally spark, hiss and burn up their wick as fast as a mouse eating string cheese. Just a hint: don't put these candles on a friend's cake unless you want them wearing it!

name: Cupcake Colby
description: A special bait to celebrate MouseHunt's Birthday!

name: Nanny Charm
description: The Nanny Charm contains a concentrated amount of scolding and changes any trap's power type to Parental, ensuring that any mice caught are not harmed and instead only told to think long and hard about what they did wrong.

name: Cupcake Colby Potion
description: This magical concoction smells of freshly baked cupcakes combined with a distinctively sharp cheese scent.

name: Warpath Survival Kit
description:
To help those hunting in the Sandtail Desert against the invading Marching Flame, the King has put together this survival kit. Inside this kit you'll find:

• 50 Super Warpath Scout Charms
• 50 Super Warpath Warrior Charms
• 50 Super Warpath Archer Charms
• 100 SUPER|brie+
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Desert Horseshoe
description: Slightly hot to the touch, this horseshoe can be used to transform a Simple Orb into a Warpath Cavalry Charm.

name: Essence of Destruction
description: Sure, it's tiny looking, but we all know looks can be deceiving. It looks like a simple substance of no real quantity, but it's actually an insanely concentrated amount of dark matter. Whatever you do, don't lose or drop this! The results could be... well, destructive.
obtain_hint: Hunt Retired Minotaur mice in Zokor

name: Flameshard
description: The Flameshard is the symbol of the Marching Flame. The army of the Marching Flame draw their powers from these totems, threatening the fall of Gnawnia itself! The more of these you take from them, the better, and perhaps someone can find a way to turn this awesome power against the forces of the Marching Flame.
obtain_hint: Hunt Warmonger, Theurgy Warden, and Gargantuamouse mice in the Fiery Warpath

name: Gold Leaf
description: A very delicate sheet of gold, frequently used in making ornate trim.

name: Heatproof Mage Cloth
description: This flame retardant cloth can be used to create Warpath Mage Charms from a Simple Orb.

name: Oasis Bead
description: This valuable artifact is especially useful in the desert. By concentrating on the small bead, it can locate a source of water anywhere and draw it to you. Some believe that a scheme to flood Gnawnia had been planned where these beads would be used to call the waters of the nearby shores onto the land. Others believe mice just like to have a access to water while travelling the desert.
obtain_hint: Hunt Warmonger mice in the Fiery Warpath

name: Oasis Water Node Trap Blueprints
description: This trap design may appear as a beautiful desert oasis, but below the sand is a masterfully crafted tunnel full of water brought to life by a thousand Living Shards. A splash of coconut milk has been superheated using Flameshards to produce a unique cheese-bearing palm tree that provides a healthy attraction bonus.

name: Sandblasted Metal
description: It looks like this massive pile of metal was going to be used to make more weapons and armour for the Marching Flame force.
obtain_hint: Hunt Warmonger mice in the Fiery Warpath

name: Sandstorm MonstroBot Blueprints
description: In the midst of the Sandtail Desert battle, the most experienced of the local trapsmiths have drafted plans for a massive physical trap of unmatched power. The Sandstorm MonstroBot harnesses the power of Flameshards to fuse heavy pieces of rare Sandblasted Metal to RhinoBot Parts.

name: Sphynx Crystal
description: The spoils of Warmongers are vast and plenty. This particular item is believed to contain the spirit of one of the most feared creatures, thought only to be legend. The Warmonger is probably one of the only mice bold enough to own such a rare trophy.
obtain_hint: Hunt Warmonger mice in the Fiery Warpath

name: Sphynx Wrath Blueprints
description: These blueprints outline how to encase a rare Sphynx Crystal in gold leaf to unleash a fearsome feline mouse adversary. Upon a mouse approaching the mighty sphynx, the power of Flameshards summon her to sentience, unleashing an unrivaled tactical mouse adversary.

name: Warpath Victory
description:
This token is awarded to hunters upon defeating a Warmonger Mouse. It is an honoured symbol of a protector of Gnawnia.

Obtain this item during the Baron adventure:
Push Back The Marching Flame

name: Sandtail Call to Arms
description:
Noble Hunter,

Word of your capture of the Zugzwang's King Mice has reached Gnawnia! I wish to congratulate you, however, we'll have to postpone celebrations.

A powerful army of mice is preparing to invade Gnawnia by route of the Lagoon. Your experience makes you the perfect hunter to help. Please, head West of the Lagoon to the Sandtail Desert before it's too late!

His Royal Majesty,
The King

Obtain this map piece by completing the Lord/Lady adventure:
Capture the Mystic and Technic Kings

name: Enraged RhinoBot
description: Digby scientists were hard at work trying to improve upon the already amazing RhinoBot when a fluke of chance led to the creation of the Enraged RhinoBot!  The pure platinum cogs make it practically indestructible and a machine of pure raging power! It is hard to say whether the scientists think their masterpiece a success or a failure. Since the Enraged Rhinobot has emerged from the labs, no one has been able to discover those scientists' whereabouts!

name: Oasis Water Node Trap
description: Working with some clever trapsmiths and the oasis bead you were able to create a tunnel of water and give it a mind of its own. While on standby the trap simply looks like a still pool of fresh water in a beautiful desert oasis, however any mouse it encounters will be snatched up and rocketed through the water tunnel to whatever destination you've set, be that Davy Jones' Locker or another continent. If this were big enough for a human and much safer, one might consider using it for a more cost effective travel method...
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Fiery Warpath Trapsmith

name: Sandstorm MonstroBot
description: Encased in metal that has stood the test of extreme weathering and time, the Sandstorm MonstroBot is outfitted with the most advanced technologies.  Should a mouse be lucky enough to escape its heat sensor tracking and turbo lasers, they are still left to face its sheer size and hardened fists. One MonstroBot alone could take out three Digby DrillBots at once... easily.  Thankfully, its tastes are of the more furry rodent variety!

name: Sphynx Wrath
description: This trap was intended to pay homage to a mythical creature known only for its unparalleled mouse hunting prowess. Outfitted with a slew of clever traps it came as quite the surprise when the trapsmith who designed this tool of destruction found it utterly destroyed by its own means, the statue untouched. It is believed the simple traps were insult enough to the spirit of this creature that they simply destroyed themselves in its presence.

name: Warpath Archer Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting adversaries armed with bows in the Marching Flame, increasing how often they're encountered. This charm is consumed upon encountering an archery unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Warpath Cavalry Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting mounted adversaries in the Marching Flame, increasing how often they're encountered. This charm is consumed upon encountering a cavalry unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Warpath Commander's Charm
description: This charm assists in attracting Crimson Commanders of the Marching Flame, increasing how often they're encountered. This charm is consumed upon encountering a Crimson Commander Mouse.

name: Warpath Mage Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting magically inclined adversaries in the Marching Flame, increasing how often they're encountered. This charm is consumed upon encountering a mage unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Warpath Scout Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting reconnaissance adversaries in the Marching Flame, increasing how often they're encountered. This charm is consumed upon encountering a scout unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Warpath Warrior Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting warrior adversaries in the Marching Flame, increasing how often they're encountered. This charm is consumed upon encountering a warrior unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Super Warpath Archer Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting archer adversaries in the Marching Flame, significantly increasing how often they're encountered, as well as giving a power bonus against Marching Flame Archers. This charm is consumed upon encountering an archery unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Super Warpath Cavalry Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting mounted adversaries in the Marching Flame, significantly increasing how often they're encountered, as well as giving a power bonus against Marching Flame Cavalry. This charm is consumed upon encountering a cavalry unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Super Warpath Mage Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting magically inclined adversaries in the Marching Flame, significantly increasing how often they're encountered, as well as giving a power bonus against Marching Flame Mages. This charm is consumed upon encountering a mage unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Super Warpath Scout Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting scouting adversaries in the Marching Flame, significantly increasing how often they're encountered, as well as giving a power bonus against Marching Flame Scouts. This charm is consumed upon encountering a scout unit of the Marching Flame

name: Super Warpath Warrior Charm
description: This charm assists in pinpointing and targeting warrior adversaries in the Marching Flame, significantly increasing how often they're encountered, as well as giving a power bonus against Marching Flame Warriors. This charm is consumed upon encountering a warrior unit of the Marching Flame.

name: Ultimate Power Charm
description: Containing highly concentrated energy, this charm is highly unstable. The Ultimate Power Charm provides +2,500 power and a 20% power bonus each hunt.

name: Catacombs Survival Kit
description: To help the fearless hunters who brave the dark and gloomy Catacombs the King has put together this survival kit. Inside you'll find 25 Antiskele Charms, 50 Stale Cheese, 5 Radioactive Blue Cheese Potions and 150 SUPER|brie+. The kit also provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from the date it is opened, making the mice of the Catacombs a little less scary.

name: Antique Green Plaid Egg
description: This egg is one of the most frequently produced eggs, and a known favourite of Moustachio the Charmer.

name: Antique Golden Egg
description: An antiquated golden egg from Spring Hunts of old. This gold plated egg is sure to contain something valuable...

name: Antique Blue Argyle Egg
description: A festively painted egg.

name: Antique Stripy Red Egg
description: A spring egg painted with bright red stripes. You feel slightly luckier while holding this egg.

name: Antique Wavy Purple Egg
description: Water beads off of this painted spring egg.

name: Antique Scalloped Pink Egg
description: This egg is known to occasionally twitch and vibrate in a hunter's inventory.

name: Gift Egg
description: These Spring gift eggs contain one random item from the many possible gifts of the day. I wonder what's inside this one...

name: Antique Sharing Egg
description: Holding this egg has been known to make hunters feel more generous.

name: Antique Friendly Egg
description: A Friendly Spring Egg can turn anyone's mood to sunny-side up!

name: Antique Caring Egg
description: This egg gives a warm and fuzzy feeling while held.

name: Big Bad Burroughs Egg
description: This egg has the dirt of Digby all over it.

name: Black Widow Egg
description: Hmm, this egg smells faintly of SUPER|brie+...

name: Burglar Egg
description: A sneaky egg that probably comes from a sneaky mouse.

name: Cherry Egg
description: A sweet cheese in a calm place could lead you to this egg.

name: Cook Egg
description: This egg rocks back and forth like a ship on the sea.

name: Derr Egg
description: One of the Tribes in the Tribal Isles might carry this egg.

name: Dojo Student Egg
description: Students at the Dojo in Furoma might find this egg familiar.

name: Dragon Egg
description: This egg shakes and rumbles and smells of sulphur.

name: Elub Egg
description: One of the Tribes in the Tribal Isles might carry this egg.

name: Hydra Egg
description: An exceptionally gnarly egg.

name: Jungle of Dread Egg
description: Deep in the jungle, powerful mice protect this egg.

name: Cove Egg
description: The crashing waves on this egg are reminiscent of the ones at Balack's Cove.

name: Magic Egg
description: The magic of SUPER|brie+ could lure out a mouse carrying this egg.

name: Monster Egg
description: This monstrous egg has a monstrous protector.

name: Nerg Egg
description: One of the Tribes in the Tribal Isles might carry this egg.

name: Nibbler Egg
description: Follow the trail of newsprint to find this egg.

name: Pirate Egg
description: Yarr, this egg be carried by a real scurvy dog- er... mouse!

name: Pygmy Swarm Egg
description: This dreadful egg can be found on a whole swarm of mice.

name: Realm Ripper Egg
description: Magic energy threatens to tear this egg apart and send it flying!

name: Seasonal Garden Egg
description: All four seasons shift rapidly across this egg's surface.

name: Silth Egg
description: This egg is wicked gnarly, dude.

name: Gauntlet Bard Egg
description: A pleasant tune emanates from this egg.

name: Warpath Egg
description: This egg is carried by mice on the march!

name: Whisker Woods Egg
description: A woodsy theme is painted on this egg.

name: Zugzwang's Egg
description: Impressive magic was used to forge this egg, and strong protectors guard it.

name: Rocket Rabbit Mallet
description: Smash open eggs in the most spring-time festive way possible! This rocket-powered egg smasher bunny-bashes Spring Egg Hunt eggs like no other instrument can!

name: Chocolate Bunny
description: Delicious milk chocolate that is sure to hop right into your mouth!

name: Umbrella
description: Keeps you nice and dry during rainy days!

name: Scrambles
description: Scrambles the Hunting Seer is full of sage hunting advice that will help you see the sunny side of hunting. When you're questioning your hunting strategy, just ask Scrambles for help. Make sure to consult Scrambles before sounding your horn. You never know what piece of advice you'll get from this cuddly little chicken.
message: Eggs?? Who said anything about eggs?!

name: Marshmallow Monterey
description:
This strange flavour is one of the most bizarre, foul tasting flavours of cheese ever made! Due to its vile peppery-sweet flavour, it used to be tolerable only by the Spring Mice but these days, many mice around the Kingdom have become accustomed to its unique and pungent aroma.

This cheese was once used in the Spring Egg Hunt event. Now it's a suitable replacement for Gouda Cheese!

name: Dark Chocolate Charm
description:
Made of 88% cacao and 12% evil, this sinister piece of confectionery may seem like a regular tasty treat at first glance but when paired with a large enough piece of Chocolatonium, it becomes the bane of any mouse with a sweet tooth!

When armed alongside the Chocolate Bar Base, this charm gains an additional 20% Power Bonus!

name: Spring Gift Basket 2011
description: This bright and colourful basket contains 250 SUPER|brie+ and 50 Dark Chocolate Charms. The basket also provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month upon being opened.

name: Greater Wicked Gnarly Potion
description: This over-sized vial of potion converts Brie or SUPER|brie+ into Wicked Gnarly Cheese. Unlike regular Wicked Gnarly Potion, highly experienced hunters are able to apply each dose to larger quantities of cheese.

name: Undead Emmental
description: This rotten smelling cheese appears slightly animated. Its curse attracts an array of undead mice, including fearsome Zombot Unipire Mice! When placing this bait on your trap, take care to "handle" with caution.

name: Undead Emmental Potion
description: This cursed potion produces a horrifying bait that attracts undead mice including the bone-chilling Zombot Unipire Mice!

name: Zombie Invasion Survival Kit
description: Do you find it hard to rest at your campsite due to constant fear of... ZOMBIE INVASION?! Put your fears to rest with this Zombie Invasion Survival Kit. Inside you'll find 150 SUPER|brie+, 5 Radioactive Blue Potions, 25 Undead Emmental and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield, everything you'll need to hunt your way out of a zombie-filled location!

name: Muridae Gift Basket
description:
This lovely basket is a great way to wish friends good luck while they are helping to rebuild the Muridae Market! The basket contains 15 SUPER|brie+.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Muridae Mega Kit
description:
The King has assembled this mega crate of supplies to help hunters rebuild the Muridae Market! Inside the kit you'll find 5 Limestone Bricks, 10 Coconut Timber, 30 Artisan Charms, and 400 SUPER|brie+.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Muridae Supply Kit
description:
To help hunters rebuilding the Muridae Market the King has put together this supply kit. Inside the kit you'll find 10 Coconut Timber, 5 Shards of Glass, and 200 SUPER|brie+.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Coconut Timber
description: Palm trees are somewhat rare to find in the Sandtail Desert, making this lavish timber a highly sought after building material.
obtain_hint: Hunt Desert Architect and Lumberjack mice in the Muridae Market, or purchase from the Muridae Market General Store

name: Shard of Glass
description: These rough fragments of glass can be melted down at the Muridae Market's General Store to create highly versatile Molten Glass.
obtain_hint: Hunt Glass Blower and Desert Architect mice in the Muridae Market

name: Limestone Brick
description: This limestone is mined from sites located in the harsh terrain of the Sandtail Desert. Mining sites are dangerous locations not only due to the extreme heat, but also by the aggressive Limestone Miner Mice that dwell at them.
obtain_hint: Hunt Limestone Miner and Desert Architect mice in the Muridae Market

name: Molten Glass
description: The General Store of the Muridae Market creates this Molten Glass by using a special melting process that harnesses the intense heat of Flameshards. The result is a remarkably versatile glass that is frequently used to create various vases and platters used by local vendors to display their wares.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Muridae Market General Store

name: Papyrus
description: These delicate sheets are made from the pulp of cacti found in the Sandtail Desert. Papyrus is frequently used by Artisan Mice to sketch designs, as well as by Cartographers to record map and key schematics.
obtain_hint: Hunt Blacksmith and Mage Weaver mice in the Muridae Market

name: Rebuild Cartographer
description:
This represents that you have rebuilt the Muridae Market Cartographer.

Achieve this during the Baron/Baroness adventure:
Rebuild the Muridae Market

name: Rebuild Charm Shoppe
description:
This represents that you have rebuilt the Muridae Market Charm Shoppe.

Achieve this during the Baron/Baroness adventure:
Rebuild the Muridae Market

name: Rebuild Cheese Shoppe
description:
This represents that you have rebuilt the Muridae Market Cheese Shoppe.

Achieve this during the Baron/Baroness adventure:
Rebuild the Muridae Market

name: Rebuild General Store
description:
This represents that you have rebuilt the Muridae Market General Store.

Achieve this during the Baron/Baroness adventure:
Rebuild the Muridae Market

name: Rebuild Trapsmith
description:
This represents that you have rebuilt the Muridae Market Trapsmith.

Achieve this during the Baron/Baroness adventure:
Rebuild the Muridae Market

name: Living Garden Key
description:
This key provides access to the enchanted Living Garden that sits atop the fortified Muridae Market.

Recent Marching Flame attacks have destroyed the magical desert flowers that once grew within the garden. Until these precious flowers have fully regrown, no hunters will be permitted into the area.

Obtain this map piece during the Baron/Baroness adventure:
Obtain a Rift Detector

name: Dimensional Chest Trap
description: This immaculate chest is the last thing from this world that a greedy mouse will see. If an opponent ventures too closely the chest will spring to life and be upon them, opening itself to another dimension and pulling the mouse within.

name: Sandtail Sentinel
description: Although the Muridae Market is heavily fortified, the Marching Flame still poses a significant threat. It was this threat which prompted the local Trapsmith to devise a sentinel powered by Flameshards. Able to sink its body into the sand, the Sandtail Sentinel patiently waits with its eyes just above the surface, waiting for a mouse to approach a baited base.

name: Ninjabread Cheese
description: This mysterious cheese has yet to be seen anywhere in the Kingdom. Perhaps one day the King will discover how it's created...

name: Artisan Charm
description: The ornate design of this magical charm is able to distract industrious mice from their work and make them more interested in your bait. So strong is the effect, that even diligently working Blacksmith and Mage Weaver mice will occasionally visit your trap.

name: Flamebane Charm
description: This charm ignites into a flash of light upon encountering a mouse of the Marching Flame. The blinding flash temporarily disorientates the troops and gives your trap a power bonus, making Marching Flame Mice a little easier to catch. This charm is consumed upon encountering a mouse of the Marching Flame.

name: Lucky Power Charm
description: Made from rare and precious metals, this charm combines the properties of a Luck and a Power Charm.

name: Monger Charm
description: Made of rare scraps of metal found in the Marching Flame's camp, this charm's gleam appeals to the greedy appetite of Warmonger Mice, encouraging them to carry a greater variety of charms and a higher quantity of orbs. Monger Charms are only consumed upon successfully catching a Warmonger Mouse.

name: Super Warpath Commander's Charm
description: Imbued with the power of Flameshards, this magical charm both assists in attracting and capturing Crimson Commanders of the Marching Flame. An extra enchantment has been placed on this charm to have it automatically disarm itself after each hunt. This charm is consumed upon encountering a Crimson Commander Mouse.

name: Super Power Charm
description: Sparks jump along the sharp spiked surface of this charm as it vibrates with power. The Super Power Charm provides +750 power and an 8% power bonus to your trap with each hunt.

name: Challenge Scroll
description: Capture a Monster Mouse in the Laboratory using a Mouse DeathBot and Radioactive Blue Cheese.

name: Papyrus Base
