description: Gathered together in this base is a stack of extremely thin papyrus notes revealing many mouse secrets and weaknesses. Having this knowledge stacked with your trap will surely grant you the upper hand against many foes.

name: Lucky Hunting Kit
description:
Looking for a little extra luck while hunting?

This kit has everything you need to maximize your luck! Inside you'll find:

• 200 SUPER|brie+
• 100 Luck Charms
• 30 Super Luck Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Novice Starter Kit
description: To help new recruits the King has assembled this Novice Starter Kit. Inside the kit you'll find 30 pieces of Swiss Cheese and if you do not already own them, a Wooden Base with Target and 500lbs Spiked Crusher. That equipment is sure to get a new recruit off to a good start!

name: Derr Tribal Kit
description: This kit will give you the upper hand while hunting at Derr Dunes! Inside you'll find 200 SUPER|brie+, 150 Derr Power Charms and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Elub Tribal Kit
description: This kit will give you the upper hand while hunting at Elub Shore! Inside you'll find 200 SUPER|brie+, 150 Elub Power Charms and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Mega Tribal Kit
description: This massive kit will give you the upper hand while hunting at Elub Shore, Nerg Plains and Derr Dunes! Inside you'll find 650 SUPER|brie+, 200 Elub Power Charms, 200 Nerg Power Charms, 200 Derr Power Charms and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Nerg Tribal Kit
description: This kit will give you the upper hand while hunting at the Nerg Plains! Inside you'll find 200 SUPER|brie+, 150 Nerg Power Charms and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Derr Power Charm
description: The Derr Power Charm provides +1000 power and a 10% power bonus while hunting in Derr Dunes. This charm is consumed upon encountering a mouse while hunting in Derr Dunes.

name: Elub Power Charm
description: The Elub Power Charm provides +1000 power and a 10% power bonus while hunting in Elub Shore. This charm is consumed upon encountering a mouse while hunting in Elub Shore.

name: Nerg Power Charm
description: The Nerg Power Charm provides +1000 power and a 10% power bonus while hunting in Nerg Plains. This charm is consumed upon encountering a mouse while hunting in Nerg Plains.

name: Advanced Zugzwang Research
description: This envelope contains one of many assignments that will push your knowledge of the Seasonal Garden and Zugzwang's Tower to absolute maximum! Be warned: You may require advanced equipment to complete this research.

name: Furoma Research
description: This envelope contains one of many assignments that will have you follow in Zugzwang's footsteps and recover the lost knowledge of Furoma. Completing Furoma Research assignments will earn you various supplies to help you better hunt in the Pagoda there. Be warned: Some of these assignments will be a challenge for hunters who have yet to capture all the mice and find all the loot there is to find in Furoma.

name: Library Gift Basket
description: This kit contains helpful hunting equipment to work on research assignments! Inside you'll find 200 SUPER|brie+, 50 Lucky Power Charms, 15 Super Luck Charms, 15 Super Power Charms and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Catalog Library Mice
description: This envelope contains a basic research assignment that will have you capture various library mice in order to catalog them.

name: Library Research
description: This envelope contains one of many assignments that will test your knowledge of hunting within the Crystal Library.

name: Library Supply Kit
description: This kit contains helpful hunting equipment to work on research assignments! Inside you'll find 500 SUPER|brie+, 100 Lucky Power Charms, 30 Super Luck Charms, 30 Super Power Charms and a 1 month Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Blue Tome of Wisdom
description: This magical tome contains hunting knowledge. Opening the tome bestows this wisdom upon the hunter, furthering their hunter's title and giving bonus points.

name: Purple Tome of Wisdom
description: This magical tome contains hunting knowledge. Opening the tome bestows this wisdom upon the hunter, furthering their hunter's title and giving bonus points.

name: Green Tome of Wisdom
description: This magical tome contains hunting knowledge. Opening the tome bestows this wisdom upon the hunter, furthering their hunter's title and giving bonus points.

name: Red Tome of Wisdom
description: This magical tome contains hunting knowledge. Opening the tome bestows this wisdom upon the hunter, furthering their hunter's title and giving bonus points.

name: Yellow Tome of Wisdom
description: This magical tome contains hunting knowledge. Opening the tome bestows this wisdom upon the hunter, furthering their hunter's title and giving bonus points.

name: Zugzwang Research
description: This envelope contains one of many assignments that will take you from the Seasonal Garden to Zugzwang's Tower. These assignments can potentially reward you with Amplifier Charms, Rook Crumble Charms, Spellbook Charms and a few other items to help you better hunt in the tower.

name: Bubbles Bookends
description: Made from the richest chocolate oak, these finely crafted and well polished bookends must have been a part of Zugzwang's personal collection. The design carved into the heavy blocks of wood depict Zugzwang's pet octopus Bubbles. It is said that the wood used to create these bookends came from the first ever ship bubbles sank. Truly, a proud moment for the wrathful Bubbles.

name: Library Points
description: Research recovered by completing assignments from Zugzwang's Library.

name: Nothing
description: Move along, nothing to see here!

name: Points
description: Points measure both the quality and quantity of mice a hunter has caught. Being marked with a high number of points is a sign of a truly experienced hunter!

name: Wisdom
description: Knowledge of hunts past and those yet to come....

name: Crystal Library Card
description:
Jealously guarded by the toughest Zugzwang Tower Mice, this beautiful card is actually a teleporter that will warp you inside Zugzwang's Crystal Library... so long as you are permitted to enter by the owner. Upon Zugzwang's disappearance, ownership of the Crystal Library has been passed down to the King of Gnawnia.

Obtain this map piece during the Lord/Lady adventure:
Capture the Mystic and Technic Kings

name: Amplifier Charm
description: Imbued with knowledge from Zugzwang's Library this magical charm will charge your Tower Amplifier twice as quickly while hunting in the Seasonal Garden. This charm is consumed upon capturing a mouse in the Seasonal Garden.

name: Wealth Charm
description: While this charm is armed all mice will drop extra gold! More valuable mice will drop greater quantities of lovely coins, up to a maximum of 1,800 extra gold.

name: Rook Crumble Charm
description: Rook Crumble Charms are dusted with Onyx powder, which makes them highly unstable. They lie in the conduit, waiting to explode upon contact with a Rook mouse in Zugzwang's Tower. The explosion grants a power bonus when encountering a Rook mouse, consuming the charm in the process.

name: Spellbook Charm
description: Imbued with runic magic, this charm increases the strength of the Spellbook Base. When armed alongside the Spellbook Base, this charm adds +500 power as well as an 8% power bonus. The charm will be consumed upon encountering a mouse.

name: Advanced Amplifier Assignment
description: Charge your Tower Amplifier then head into the tower to seek out the Mystic King, Technic King and Chessmaster!

name: Furoma Assignment
description: Study the studious mice of Furoma.

name: Catalog Library Assignment
description: Catalog the various mice in the Library by capturing them.

name: Library Mice Assignment
description: Research various Library mice.

name: Library Power Type Assignment
description: Research capturing library mice using Physical and Tactical traps.

name: Mystic Amplifier Assignment
description: Charge your Tower Amplifier then head into the tower to seek out the Mystic Pieces!

name: Mystic King Assignment
description: Charge your Tower Amplifier then head into the tower to seek out a Mystic King!

name: Dojo Sensei Assignment
description: Advanced research assignment for those with a greater thirst for knowledge of the mysterious upper levels of the pagoda...

name: Pagoda Assignment
description: Research assignment for the mysterious upper levels of the pagoda...

name: Seasonal Garden Assignment
description: Hunt various mice in the Seasonal Garden.

name: Technic Amplifier Assignment
description: Charge your Tower Amplifier then head into the tower to seek out the Technic Pieces!

name: Technic King Assignment
description: Charge your Tower Amplifier then head into the tower to seek out a Technic King!

name: Metamorphic Rock
description:
These massive slabs are formed within volcanic chasms located thousands of fathoms below the Rodentia Ocean. Extracting this massively heavy material from such depths is an extremely elaborate and expensive process. This rare material is, therefore, in short supply and extremely valuable.

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Zurreal Trap Research
description: This envelope contains an assignment to research a trap capable of capturing Zurreal the Eternal. The trap's concept is simple: Tempt Zurreal close by displaying a collection of rare knowledge then drain all magical and electrical energy from the area to disable his walking throne. Although the design is straight forward, gathering the rare and unique items required will prove itself to be a challenge! Good luck brave hunter, the safety of the Crystal Library relies on your success!

name: Reaper's Perch Blueprints
description: These blueprints describe the careful process of imbuing slabs of metamorphic rock with magical runes and Onyx to create a perch for a deadly Reaper Droid.
obtain_hint: Hunt Zurreal the Eternal in the Crystal Library

name: Draconic Book
description: For individuals seeking a unique, albeit dangerous pet, this lengthy book gives extensive instruction on how to tame your Dragon Mouse.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Ectoplasmic Essence
description: This plasma is the only vaguely tangible matter comprising a ghost mouse. Its radioactive properties can be harnessed as a power conduit.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Luscious Lumber
description: This fine wood is used to construct the enormous bookshelves within Zugzwang's Library.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Encyclopedia Gnawnia
description: This collection of books is a compendium of knowledge, covering a wide variety of both hunting and social subjects. A must have for the bookshelf of a discerning hunting researcher!
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Lich Jewel
description: This strange relic emits high amounts of energy that is neither magical, nor electrical.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Desert Travel Almanac
description: This guide contains in-depth knowledge of the Lagoon and the adjacent desert region. Its origins remain shrouded in mystery.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Mesh Netting
description: Highly conductive metal netting, useful for catching an electrical current, trout or even overly dense ether in the air.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Warp Nail
description: These clippings are from the fingernails of Realm Ripper Mice. Their edges are sharp enough to tear through the fabric of reality, opening portals to other places, realms or even times.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Runestone
description: This stone is capable of absorbing high amounts of magical energy.
obtain_hint: Obtained during Zurreal Trap Research Assignment

name: Reaper's Perch
description: Perched atop Monolith Slabs, the deadly Reaper Droid gazes through smoke awaiting prey. Upon bait being lifted from the stone plate, the runic glyphs begin to glow, mesmerizing the mouse into a state of anhedonia, allowing the droid to descend upon the mouse with little resistance. Where the rodent goes once taken by the droid is up to the will of the hunter.

name: Zurreal's Folly
description:
This trap is the only devised tool suspected of being able to capture Zurreal the Eternal. A harmless looking bookshelf features literature designed to intrigue Zurreal, distracting him from the trap hidden behind the shelf.

The traps's design is complex, but it's utility is simple: Drain all magical and electrical energy in the immediate area. The trap is powered by undead ectoplasm to remain active while using augmented metal netting and runic rocks to open a small hole to another dimension and vacuum all other energy far away. This trap should be enough to knock Zurreal's walking throne out of commission, leaving him mostly helpless.

WARNING: Do not try to operate Droids, heavy machinery or magics anywhere near this trap while activated!

name: Scholar Charm
description: This morsel of Zugzwang's hunting knowledge is the only known artifact able to lure Zurreal the Eternal toward a hunter's trap. Upon successfully capturing Zurreal the Scholar Charm will be consumed as part of the trapping process.

name: Uncharged Scholar Charm
description:
Baiting Zurreal towards a trap will require more than just cheese. This uncharged Scholar Charm is specially designed to hold magical knowledge and if filled with enough pure wizardly knowledge, will undoubtedly be something Zurreal cannot ignore!

Capture a Chess Master Mouse with this charm armed to steal his knowledge and create something capable of luring Zurreal to his folly!

name: Zurreal Trap Research Assignment
description: Travel across the Kingdom in search of supplies to build a trap capable of disabling Zurreal the Eternal's walking throne long enough to capture him. Such a trap will need some very unique materials to draw all magical and electrical energy away from Zurreal while remaining powered itself.

name: Acrostic Research Assignment
description: This envelope contains an assignment to research a secret message. Can you solve the puzzle?

name: Acrostic Research Assignment
description: Test Your Puzzle solving ability! The mice are spreading a message and it is your job to discover it in time to stop their nefarious plans!

name: Mining Charm
description: Loaded with sharp drills, this charm is extremely boring! Its dirt-shattering power packs an extra-strong punch against Digby Dirt Dweller mice, while also loosening soil, helping to coax burrowing mice out of hiding.

name: Extremely Enraged RhinoBot Skin
description: Digby scientists were hard at work trying to improve upon the already amazing RhinoBot when a fluke of chance led to the creation of the Enraged RhinoBot!  The pure platinum cogs make it practically indestructible and a machine of pure raging power! It is hard to say whether the scientists think their masterpiece a success or a failure. Since the Enraged Rhinobot has emerged from the labs, no one has been able to discover those scientists' whereabouts!
marketing_text: With just a few extra spikes, brighter LEDs and some small, controlled explosions, the Enraged RhinoBot takes on a more intimidating-looking persona. Did a pesky mouse just steal some of your precious cheese? Apply this skin to show your appropriate level of rage!

name: Jet-Black ACRONYM Skin
description:
This highly unstable trap setup is held in a constant state of metamorphosis by the unpredictable power of the Onyx stone. This trap almost appears alive, growing metal roots into whatever base to which it is attached.



This trap's methods of capture are infinitely random. It can use its jagged metallic roots to impale mice, expel a thick and dark vapor that turns mice into stone, or bend space and time to erase the mouse from existence.



Scientists of Digby warn hunters that the power of the Onyx stone is incredibly dangerous and fear that using this trap could lead to the end of the world.
skin_weapon_name: Arcane Capturing Rod Of Never Yielding Mystery
marketing_text: Although the Arcane Capturing Rod of Never Yielding Mystery is a very capable Arcane weapon, its tacky purple colour is sometimes said to clash with the dark and dreary Catacombs it is so often used within. Apply this skin to your ACRONYM trap to hunt in gloomy style!

name: Larry's First Move Skin
description: The chess pieces of Zugzwang's Last Move have been reborn with the help of a magic feather, becoming a powerful knight who will defend your cheese to the death. Using strategy gleaned from his origins as a chess set, and a stubbornness that can only come from being made of stone, he will fight off any rodent attacker in the name of his King or Queen.
marketing_text: Zugzwang may be familiar with Technic and Mystic Knights, but what about Friendly Knights? Apply this skin to your trap to put a friendlier face on Zugzwang's First Move.

name: Tournament Token
description: These tokens are awarded to competitors in the King's MouseHunting Tournaments and can be exchanged for a variety of prizes at the Tournament Hall in Valour.

name: 2011 Pumpkin Treat Basket
description: There's sure to be a Halloween treat in this spooky basket!

name: Wooden Crate of Splintered Wood
description: Do you like cinnamon? Well, this crate doesn't have any in it. But what it DOES have is ten delicious pieces of Splintered Wood!

name: Jumbo Halloween Goodie Bag
description:
This massive haul of treats is sure to delight any hunter!

Inside you'll find:

• 400 SUPER|brie+
• 100 Ghoulgonzola
• 100 Candy Corn

As a small treat, inside you'll also find 10 Halloween Candies!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Soulstone
description: This gem has mind-control properties capable of bending the will of a mouse. The Trapsmith at the Spooky Sandcastle has designed a unique trap to harness a Soulstone's power and use it to help catch mice.

name: Soul Catcher Parts
description: The result of carefully dismantling a Soul Catcher Trap.

name: Friendly Knight Mask
description: According to Larry, this mask is the latest and greatest Halloween costume trend! Get yours today!

name: Tiny Cauldron
description: This Tiny Cauldron makes a great tea cup... just make sure you clean out the green goo first.

name: Sock Ghost Plushie
description: Looking for a friendly companion to turn to while hunting in spooky locations? Whenever you're feeling scared, just give this plushie a squeeze!
message: You give this friendly ghost a loving squeeze!

name: Cobweb
description: Looking to make a trap look extra spooky this spooky Halloween season? Trade these Cobwebs at the Trapsmith in the Spooky Sandcastle to receive some spooky trap skins or powerful charms!

name: Halloween Candy
description: These candies have a delicious chewy center and are highly sought-after by the various Shop Keepers in the Spooky Sandcastle. Swing by one of their shops where you can trade for their wares with these tasty morsels of sugar-coated happiness! Oh! Piece of Candy!

name: Soul Harvester
description:
This Soul Catcher has been adorned with platinum-plated metamorphic limbs specially tuned for hunting during the Fall season in Zugzwang's Seasonal Garden. The Soulstone has been amplified through the use of Onyx Stones and Living Shards to further improve the trap's ability to capture mice.

Blowing winds aide the many limbs of this trap to better entangle mice, giving the trap a luck bonus in Fall, along with its bonus at the Gloomy Greenwood.

name: Soul Catcher
description:
Harnessing the power of a Soulstone, this trap pierces the darkness and seeks out weaknesses in Shadow mice.

This shard of Soulstone pulsates slowly, as if longing to be alive. It almost seems to morph and bulge within its platinum setting as it hangs suspended in its web. Perhaps it can be improved if imbued with another powerful stone...

The haunting hum of the Soulstone gives this trap a luck bonus exclusively at the Gloomy Greenwood.

name: Cackle Charm
description: These tiny pumpkin charms contain fragments of Fire Salt charged with Ionized Salt that spark wildly when brought near a mouse carrying Fire Salt. The chemical reaction frequently causes the fragments to fuse and, as a result, increase Fire Salt drops when hunting in the Jungle of Dread.

name: Dreaded Charm
description: These toxic charms contain a poisonous sludge harvested from the bile ducts of carnivorous plants found deep in the Jungle of Dread. The toxic mixture is one of the few compounds capable of weakening mice found in the Jungle of Dread, giving your trap the upper hand while these charms are armed. Encountering a mouse within the Jungle of Dread will cause the charm to be consumed in an explosive release of its contents.

name: Spooky Charm
description:
These spooky-looking charms give your trap a respectable boost of power, plus they look great! Perfect to get you in the mood for Halloween!

All types of Spooky Charms interact with all Halloween traps by giving them a 20% Power Bonus!

When a Spooky Charm is consumed during a hunt, there is a chance that the residual spiritual energy has unfinished business and rematerializes into a stronger Super Spooky Charm!

name: Costumed Ambush Skin
description: These cute little droids are all dressed up for a night of tricking and treating, but don't let their cute exterior appearance fool you! Their disguises only aide in getting the jump on Tactical mice, and they are as ferocious as ever.
marketing_text: These cute little droids are all dressed up for a night of tricking and treating, but don't let their cute exterior appearance fool you! Their disguises only aide in getting the jump on Tactical mice, and they are as ferocious as ever.

name: Count Sentinel Skin
description: Although the Muridae Market is heavily fortified, the Marching Flame still poses a significant threat. It was this threat which prompted the local Trapsmith to devise a sentinel powered by Flameshards. Able to sink its body into the sand, the Sandtail Sentinel patiently waits with its eyes just above the surface, waiting for a mouse to approach a baited base.
marketing_text: Looking to transform the Sandtail Sentinel into a robot with a spooky cloak and a ghoulish walking stick? Well, you have quite specific tastes and this skin does just that! What a coincidence!

name: Zugzwang's Night-Mare Skin
description:
In his darkest dreams, Zugzwang has envisioned this terrible beast...

"A fiery horse, with a headless rider, calls out to me. He lifts his right arm and in it is a burning pumpkin with a face carved into it. Its eyes pierce my very soul, and its smile torments me. This... would be a perfect addition to my first move trap!"
marketing_text: Looking to transform Zugzwang's First Move into something a little spookier? Look no further than this scary-looking trap skin to summon forth the spirit of the headless horseman.

name: 2011 Spooky Supply Kit
description:
This slightly haunted kit will help you hunt the more fearsome mice of the Spooky Sandcastle!

Inside you'll find:

• 100 SUPER|brie+
• 50 Spooky Charms
• 25 Ghoulgonzola Cheese
• 25 Candy Corn Cheese
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Spooky Surprise
description:
The various sweets and goodies in this box are the stolen haul of the mischievous mice that were running amok in the Spooky Sandcastle.

To open this box, visit the special section of your inventory.

name: Apprentice Title
description: Obtain the rank of Apprentice.

name: Baron/Baroness Title
description: Obtain the rank of Baron/Baroness.

name: Count/Countess Title
description: Obtain the rank of Count/Countess.

name: Duke/Duchess Title
description: Obtain the rank of Duke/Duchess.

name: Grand Duke/Duchess Title
description: Obtain the rank of Grand Duke/Duchess.

name: Grandmaster Title
description: Obtain the rank of Grandmaster.

name: Hero Title
description: Obtain the rank of Hero.

name: Initiate Title
description: Obtain the rank of Initiate.

name: Journeyman Title
description: Obtain the rank of Journeyman.

name: Knight Title
description: Obtain the rank of Knight.

name: Legendary Title
description: Obtain the rank of Legendary.

name: Lord/Lady Title
description: Obtain the rank of Lord/Lady.

name: Master Title
description: Obtain the rank of Master.

name: Recruit Title
description: Obtain the rank of Recruit.

name: Bristle Woods Winter Gift
description: A spooky gift is inside this winter gift! Dust off the webs and see what's in side!

name: Burroughs Winter Gift
description: From the spooky setting of the abandoned Laboratory and creepy Mousoleum, to the noisy setting of Digby, to the even more hectic Bazaar the Burroughs region is an entertaining area for a hunter to visit! This small gift is sure to help you in your travels to the region!

name: Feta Gift Basket
description:
A soft velvet hat may not be the best choice for storing briny cheese, but when it comes to holiday gifts, it's really just the thought that counts.

Inside this hat is 50 pieces of Festive Feta with which to hunt during the Great Winter Hunt!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Furoma Winter Gift
description: Amongst the peaceful scenery of Furoma are masters of tactical combat! The contents of this gift will help hunters looking to even the odds.

name: Gnawnia Winter Gift
description: Remember your beginnings as a MouseHunter? When first picking up the Hunter's Horn feels like a distant memory, open the contents of this gift and return to where your MouseHunting all began...

name: Rodentia Winter Gift
description: From the wide open waters of the Rodentia Ocean to Zugzwang's mysterious floating garden and tower the region of Rodentia requires a wide variety of hunting strategies. The contents of this gift is sure to help improve the strategy of any hunter!

name: Sandtail Winter Gift
description: The harsh sun and unforgiving heat in the Sandtail Desert can be the furthest thing from the Great Winter Hunt. Open these gifts to help get back in the Winter Hunt spirit and get an upper hand against the mice that inhabit the desert year round.

name: Tribal Winter Gift
description: Hunting troublesome tribal mice requires a vast amount of loot and resources! Unwrap this gift to find some loot to help your hunting efforts in the Tribal Isles!

name: Valour Winter Gift
description: Valour is where the King hosts his own prestigious hunting grounds aimed at testing a hunter's skill and rewarding the most capable of hunter. The contents of this gift are sure to help a hunter impress the King!

name: Whisker Woods Winter Gift
description: Whisker Woods is a scenic hunting grounds where a hunter can enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the Calm Clearing, or choose to brave the dangerous waters of the Lagoon. The contents of this gift will no doubt prove useful no matter how you choose to spent your time in the woods!

name: Winter Survival Kit
description:
This handy kit is fully stocked with everything needed for the Great Winter Hunt! Inside you'll find 100 Festive Feta and 50 Winter Charms.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Nutcracker Trap Blueprints
description:
These plans outline how to create the festive Nutcracker Nuisance Trap! The plan is rather simple, only requiring six pieces of Splintered Wood and one extremely powerful LED light bulb.

Unfortunately, the only LED bulbs powerful enough for this trap have all been stolen by the Mad Elf Mouse! Be at the ready, hunter: Once enough hunters reach the rank of Master Builder, the King will call upon you to track down the missing LEDs and put an end to the Mad Elf's evil plan!

name: Festive Bow
description: Special gifts call for special bows! This extra-shiny bow makes the perfect addition to gifts and lets friends feel extra special.

name: Shortbread Cookie
description: Buttery and delicious, this festive cookie is sure to please the sweet tooth of any hunter!

name: Glass Mouse Ornament
description: Carefully crafted from the finest molten glass that the Sandtail region has to offer, this ornament instantly makes any tree look opulent.

name: Tournament Competitor Badge
description: For team members that do not place, these badges are a reward for finishing within the top 25% of teams in one of the King's MouseHunting tournaments.

name: Tournament Participant Badge
description: For team members that do not place, these badges are a reward for finishing within the top 50% of teams in one of the King's MouseHunting tournaments.

name: Bronze Tournament Trophy
description: These trophies are a reward for finishing in 3rd place in one of the King's MouseHunting Tournaments.

name: Gold Tournament Trophy
description: These trophies are a reward for finishing in 1st place in one of the King's MouseHunting Tournaments.

name: Silver Tournament Trophy
description: These trophies are a reward for finishing in 2nd place in one of the King's MouseHunting Tournaments.

name: Veteran Champion Trophy
description: Coated in the absolute finest platinum the Kingdom has to offer, this bright and shiny trophy stands as a monument to veteran hunters who proved that they were champions long ago. Should you meet a hunter in possession of such a rare collectible stand in awe, for you are in the presence of a true hunting legend!

name: Festive Toy Receipt
description: This receipt acts as proof of a hunters' skill as a toy builder, granting them access to special hunting equipment in the Festive Comet shoppes. More advanced toys will earn a hunter more Toy Receipts.

name: Toy Cog
description: These tiny toy cogs are required to create clockwork type toys.

name: Ice Coin
description: These coins are the official currency of the Great Winter Hunt! Visit the various shoppes at the Festive Snow Fort where these coins can be redeemed for a variety of hunting equipment and items!

name: Doohickey
description: If you're planning to make an advanced toy this Winter Hunt, you're going to need a doohickey!

name: Fire Bulb
description: It's hard to tell if the extreme heat this bulb radiates is the result of incredible inefficiency or is the result of a magical heat enchantment. Either way, make sure to take care when assembling a toy with this part.

name: Ghostly Cloth
description: Cloth so thin you're not sure if it even exists... The perfect material for making a toy meant to scare!

name: Toy Metal
description: This specially-painted metal is required to make metallic toys.

name: Toy Screw
description: Incredibly strong, these festive screws are used in a wide variety of toys.

name: Toy Spring
description: Springs are incredibly versatile and are used in many festive toys.

name: Toy Wood
description: What can be created from this festive lumber is only limited by imagination and physics!

name: Nutcracker Nuisance Trap
description:
Imbued with ancient magic, this festive trap is in a constant state of charging as it awaits a mouse to enter its blast radius. This festive trap is a sure-fire way to bring a little cheer to the more gloomy areas of the Kingdom!

This trap's innocent toy appearance seems to renew the long lost playful demeanor of Lich mice in Balack's Cove, distracting them enough to occasionally have them surrender twice the loot when captured.

name: Festive Feta
description: When it comes to attracting festive mice, this flavourful festive feast of flawless feta is firmly a fully effective fail-safe form of functional furry festive fascination!

name: Champion Charm
description: Imbued with competitive spirit, this powerful charm provides an impressive bonus to both your trap's power and luck while hunting!

name: Winter Charm
description:
A wintery charm of Great Winter Hunts past...

These charms can be smashed into Pecan Pecorino Cheese which attracts special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga!

name: Festive Box Trap Skin
description: The ancient ghost mice which roamed Gnawnia before even the castle existed require an old-fashioned trap strategy, and the Ancient Box Trap is about as old-fashioned as they come. A heavy stone box teeters precariously upon an Ancient Relic Staff, waiting for a mouse to pull the Ethereal Rope and cause the box to slam shut and magically fuse with the base. This may seem like a deceptively simple trap set-up, but ancient mice enjoy the classics.
marketing_text: Is Acolyte hunting too spooky for you? Does the sight of a Lich Mouse ruin your festive mood? Apply this festive skin to hunt spooky mice with festive style!

name: Digby DecroBot Skin
description: The scientists of Digby used their knowledge of tunnel digging technology to create the ultimate mouse adversary. Using its two massive high-speed drills this titan can easily destroy any mouse put in its path.
marketing_text: Do you need to deck the halls in less than 0.9 seconds? This trap skin adds a useful tinsel cannon and high-velocity light stringing spool to the Digby DrillBot, allowing a hunter to turn any room, location or mouse into an explosion of festive decoration!

name: Winter Oasis Trap Skin
description: Working with some clever trapsmiths and the oasis bead you were able to create a tunnel of water and give it a mind of its own. While on standby the trap simply looks like a still pool of fresh water in a beautiful desert oasis, however any mouse it encounters will be snatched up and rocketed through the water tunnel to whatever destination you've set, be that Davy Jones' Locker or another continent. If this were big enough for a human and much safer, one might consider using it for a more cost effective travel method...
marketing_text: Is the desert heat distracting while hunting? Apply this Festive Skin to your Oasis Water Node Trap to cool down and hunt in festive style!

name: Toy Stockpile
description:
The toys in this stockpile are similar to the toys being built by hunters, but something about them seems off. They have strange modifications, suggesting a sinister undertone. Could a mouse be secretly assembling toys? To what end?

Any stockpiles found will be instantly sent to the castle for immediate disassembly, and any toys salvaged will be contributed toward the community toy drive goal.

name: Winter Screw Charm
description:
A wintery charm of Great Winter Hunts past...

These charms can be smashed into Pecan Pecorino Cheese which attracts special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga!

name: Winter Spring Charm
description:
A wintery charm of Great Winter Hunts past...

These charms can be smashed into Pecan Pecorino Cheese which attracts special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga!

name: Winter Wood Charm
description:
A wintery charm of Great Winter Hunts past...

These charms can be smashed into Pecan Pecorino Cheese which attracts special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga!

name: Irradiated LED shard
description: A glowing LED, however, I don't see a source of electricity causing the unhealthy looking glow. Perhaps it's best you keep your distance.

name: Ronza Voucher
description: Ronza's Traveling Shoppe will be returning to Gnawnia sometime during January, 2012 and will feature exciting new items. This voucher can be redeemed for a mystery prize from her shop when she arrives. Keep watching the skies!

name: Festive Tournament Supply Kit
description:
Looking for a festive competitive edge? This basket is packed with supplies to help you compete in festive tournaments! Inside you'll find 100 Festive Feta and 50 Champion Charms.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: 2012 Big Boom Trap
description: A fine and attractive looking trap for any mouse who likes to have a good time, it is so attractive and dazzling in fact that when the volley of non-lethal BOOM! brand light-works whiz past them, the mouse is rendered immobile for minutes after from sheer awe at the beauty... Except of course when the hunter loads the fireworks volley with BOOM! brand high-incendiary fire-work rounds; in that case you definitely won't be finding a mouse at all.

name: Firecracker Charm
description:
These crackly charms twitch and vibrate in your hands, giving your trap an extra boost of power, while also attracting the Costumed Rabbit, Tiger, Dragon and Snake mice. Handle them with care!

Using these on Calamity Carl's Cruise will give the ship a decent boost in speed!

name: Acolyte Champion Kit
description:
This kit contains materials helpful in tracking down the elusive and powerful Acolyte Mouse!

Inside you'll find:
  • 12 Stale Cheese
  • 1 Runic Potion
  • 3 Runes

name: Balack's Cove Champion Kit
description:
This Champion Kit will help a hunter track down the dangerous Lich Mice in Balack's Cove.

Inside you'll find:
  • 30 Vanilla Beans
  • 3 Lich Loot

name: Pack of Champion Charms
description:
This package contains 12 Champion Charms, renowned around the Kingdom for their impressive power and luck bonuses!

Power: 400
Power Bonus: 5%
Luck: 3

When these charms are armed with a Bronze, Silver, or Gold Tournament Base, the base begins to glow, adding even more luck to your trap!

name: Furoma Champion Kit
description:
This kit contains an ample supply of loot commonly found by hunting Furoma Student Mice, along with a single master shard.

Inside you'll find:
  • 6 Token of the Cheese Claw
  • 6 Token of the Cheese Belt
  • 6 Token of the Cheese Fang
  • 1 Furoma Master Shard

name: Gauntlet Champion Kit
description:
Climbing the King's Gauntlet is a long and arduous journey. This kit will give you a head start!

Inside you'll find:
  • 3 Gauntlet Potion Tier 2
  • 2 Gauntlet Potion Tier 3

name: Jungle Of Dread Champion Kit
description:
Only the bravest and most prepared of hunters dare to enter the Jungle of Dread! This Champion Kit contains both bait and charms to hunt down the most powerful mice of the Dreaded Horde.

Inside you'll find:
  • 9 pieces of assorted Havarti Cheeses
  • 9 Dreaded Charms

name: Mousoleum Champion Kit
description:
Within the Mousoleum lurks spooky and scary mice; this Champion Kit contains bait to help track them down!

Inside you'll find:
  • 1 Radioactive Blue Potion
  • 5 pieces of Moon Cheese

name: Tournament Supply Kit
description: Looking for a competitive edge? This basket is packed with supplies to help you compete in tournaments! Inside you'll find 50 SUPER|brie+, 50 Champion Charms and 1 month of Lucky Golden Shield!

name: Tribal Champion Kit
description:
Hunting in the Tribal Isles is one of the best ways to test a hunter's crafting skill. This Champion Kit contains crafting materials to produce helpful bait to hunt the mice of the three tribes.

Inside you'll find:
  • 10 Seashells
  • 10 Savoury Vegetables
  • 10 Delicious Stones
  • 3 pieces of a Tribe's Chief Bait

name: Whisker Woods Champion Kit
description:
The region of Whisker Woods varies widely from the serene Calm Clearing to the damp and gloomy Lagoon. This Champion Kit will provide help no matter which area you choose to hunt.

Inside you'll find:
  • 3 Gnarled Potions
  • 1 Wicked Gnarly Potion

name: Silver Tournament Base
description:
The Silver Tournament Base is a reward for hunters who have shown not only their ability to compete in hunting tournaments, but their dedication to winning tournaments!

When armed alongside a Champion Charm, in addition to the charm's +3 luck, this base glows with an extra +3 luck, for a total of 13 luck!

name: Golden Tournament Base
description:
The Golden Tournament Base is a reward that is renowned as a symbol of a seasoned tournament competitor. Only the most dedicated of hunters dare set the goal of obtaining this opulent base.

When armed alongside a Champion Charm, in addition to the charm's +3 luck, this base glows with an extra +4 luck, for a total of 15 luck!

name: Bronze Tournament Base
description:
The Bronze Tournament Base is a reward for hunters who have shown they are capable of competing in hunting tournaments.

When armed alongside a Champion Charm, in addition to the charm's +3 luck, this base glows with an extra +2 luck, for a total of 10 luck!

name: Dimensional Chest Champion Trap Skin
description: This immaculate chest is the last thing from this world that a greedy mouse will see. If an opponent ventures too closely the chest will spring to life and be upon them, opening itself to another dimension and pulling the mouse within.
marketing_text: This skin gives the Dimensional Chest Trap a slick silver finish and brands it with the King's official tournament seal, allowing a hunter to show off their tournament skill!

name: MonstroBot Champion Skin
description: Encased in metal that has stood the test of extreme weathering and time, the Sandstorm MonstroBot is outfitted with the most advanced technologies.  Should a mouse be lucky enough to escape its heat sensor tracking and turbo lasers, they are still left to face its sheer size and hardened fists. One MonstroBot alone could take out three Digby DrillBots at once...easily.  Thankfully, its tastes are of the more furry rodent variety!
marketing_text: This skin adds fearsome-looking shoulder spikes and stylish blue accent lighting to the Sandstorm MonstroBot. The bot has been branded with the King's official tournament seal, allowing a hunter to show off their tournament skill!

name: Sandtail Sentinel Champion Skin
description: Although the Muridae Market is heavily fortified, the Marching Flame still poses a significant threat. It was this threat which prompted the local Trapsmith to devise a sentinel powered by Flameshards. Able to sink its body into the sand, the Sandtail Sentinel patiently waits with its eyes just above the surface, waiting for a mouse to approach a baited base.
marketing_text: This skin adds a decorative shield to the Sandtail Sentinel and brands it with the King's official tournament seal, allowing a hunter to show off their tournament skill!

name: Sphynx Wrath Champion Skin
description: This trap was intended to pay homage to a mythical creature known only for its unparalleled mouse hunting prowess. Outfitted with a slew of clever traps it came as quite the surprise when the trapsmith who designed this tool of destruction found it utterly destroyed by its own means, the statue untouched. It is believed the simple traps were insult enough to the spirit of this creature that they simply destroyed themselves in it's presence.
marketing_text: This skin adds an ornate headdress and light, wire wings to the Sphynx Wrath Trap and brands it with the King's official tournament seal, allowing a hunter to show off their tournament skill!

name: Champion's Ring
description: This collectible Champion's Ring symbolizes a hunter's competitive spirit and competence in the King's hunting tournaments!

name: Mouse Statuette
description: This collectible statuette is a status symbol of hunters who have competed with great dedication in the King's hunting tournaments. Displaying this collectible in one's camp is sure to impress visitors!

name: Dragon Festival Celebration Kit
description: This bulging bundle of explosive fun is fully stocked with everything needed to celebrate the Year of the Dragon Festival! Inside you'll find 250 SUPER|brie+, 100 Firecracker Charms, 15 Nitropop Potions, and it provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: Dragon Festival Gift Basket
description: An explosive gift basket perfect for giving to friends this Year of the Dragon Festival. The basket contains 100 SUPER|brie+, 35 Firecracker Charms, and it provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: Dragon Kite
description: Up there in the sky! Is it a bird? Or maybe a slightly larger bird? Wait, is that... Is that a dragon? OH NO RUN FOR YOU LIVES, EVERY- Wait, it's just a kite. Oh. Well then. What a great Year of the Dragon Festival kite!

name: Dragon Seal
description: The mark of a master hunter, anyone bearing this seal shows they have proven themselves at the Year of the Dragon Festival, and have obtained the reputation of Lunar Dragon Hunter!

name: Dragonbreath Charm
description: These charms are professionally-built rockets, a great improvement over the more-volatile Firecracker and Nitropop charms. They are perfectly safe, until ignited. They give off a great dragon's roar and a magnificent display, providing an even greater boost to power, and attracting only the bravest of fireworks-loving festival mice. MUST BE HANDLED BY TRAINED PROFESSIONALS.

name: Nitropop Charm
description:
These charms constantly rumble and clink together in your pack, causing beads of sweat to form on the brows of hunters kingdom-wide. They are hot to the touch, and give a bigger boost to power, while also attracting Costumed Sheep mice. Handle with EXTREME care!

Using these on Calamity Carl's Cruise will give the ship a significant boost in speed!

Create these charms by using Nitropop Potions

name: Dragonbreath Potion
description: Simply place 1 Nitropop Charm into the Dragonbreath Potion, shake vigorously, calmly set it on the ground, then run in the other direction. Return moments later and search the crater for the glowing Dragonbreath Charm. If no crater is discovered, please vacate the area and do not return.

name: Nitropop Potion
description: Take extreme care when pouring this over Firecracker Charms. One stray drip could lead to disaster! Converts 3 Firecracker Charms into 3 Nitropop Charms.

name: Satchel of Gold (2,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Dragonbreath ACRONYM Skin
description:
This highly unstable trap setup is held in a constant state of metamorphosis by the unpredictable power of the Onyx stone. This trap almost appears alive, growing metal roots into whatever base to which it is attached.

This trap's methods of capture are infinitely random. It can use its jagged metallic roots to impale mice, expel a thick and dark vapor that turns mice into stone, or bend space and time to erase the mouse from existence.

Scientists of Digby warn hunters that the power of the Onyx stone is incredibly dangerous and fear that using this trap could lead to the end of the world.
skin_weapon_name: Arcane Capturing Rod Of Never Yielding Mystery
marketing_text: A dragon is nothing to be trifled with and this rare trap skin proves just that! Celebrate the Lunar New Year or simply show off how awesome dragons are with a blazing barrage of exciting explosions! This brilliant skin takes your always-loyal ACRONYM trap and combines it with buckets of fireworks. The arcane powers of the trap magically replenish its internal supply of fireworks, steering them with extreme accuracy, and firing them out at a rate of 15 fireworks a second! This trap skin is a MUST for anyone's collection.

name: Dragon Jade Base
description:
To celebrate the Year of the Dragon Festival, Ronza sought out a Trapsmith capable of carving jade to create the Dragon Jade Base! The ornate carvings carry with them a special enchantment to bring extra luck to your trap!

Only those possessing a Dragon Seal, proving they have braved a victorious encounter with the Costumed Dragon Mouse, may handle the dragon power channeled through this dragon base.

name: Jade Base
description:
This magnificent jade has been mined from far and distant lands and is most often used for ornamental statuettes and other decorations. This particular slab has been specially polished to create a slick surface that's sure to make dodging your trap more difficult for mice.

Jade Base stats have been updated in 2024
Luck: 4 → 10
Power Bonus: 0% → 10%

name: Chrome RhinoBot
description: This RhinoBot sure packs a punch! Its luxurious look and intricate gold detailing is a great way to hunt with style. The shine of its extraordinarily bright chrome is only surpassed by the shiner it leaves on any mice caught in its path!

name: Chrome Tacky Glue Trap
description: Simple and minimalistic, but far from subtle. This modified Tacky Glue Trap features a key ingredient — pure, liquified chrome — to give it a flashy look and a bonus to its luck.

name: Warpath Thrasher
description:
The Warpath Thrasher, often referred to as the "angry flailing croissant", is as dangerous as it is weird looking. Designed to take on the army of the Marching Flame, this trap barrels into the waves, daring to take them all on at once.

This trap is extremely powerful at the beginning of each wave, boasting an impressive 9000 power and 30 luck; however, it begins to rapidly lose power after the initial onslaught.

name: Chrome Charm
description: After revealing the lustrous sheen hiding under the Tarnished Charm's surface, this Chrome Charm shines with a +7 luck bonus.

name: Tarnished Charm
description: Although these dull and stale charms do not look too exciting right now, their tarnish can be polished off by equipping them while hunting to reveal a chrome shine. Each successful hunt will polish a charm, adding a lucky Chrome Charm to your inventory.

name: &lt3 Gift Basket
description:
This lovingly-wrapped gift just oozes with mushy feelings and emotions.

Inside, to your heart's delight, you'll find:

• 70 SUPER|brie+
• 25 Valentine Charms
 • And, just because we love ya, we threw in a DLU+!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

With love,
The Devs

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.

name: S.A.D. Pamphlet
description: This little pamphlet nicely explains how February 14th is Singles Awareness Day. On this day, people who are single are encouraged to celebrate in their own way! Some suggestions include: wearing green (because it's not Valentine's red), staying in bed, treating oneself to popular activities such as eating chocolate, eating ice-cream, or going to the movies alone (or with friends-only friends), volunteering, singles events, and gift giving to oneself. Happy S.A.D. to you!

name: Party Giftbox
description: This party box is filled with fun goodies to celebrate MouseHunt's Birthday! Inside you'll find 100 SUPER|brie+ and 20 Party Charms. It also provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: 2012 Birthday Gift
description: A gift wrapped up to celebrate MouseHunt's Fourth Birthday! I wonder what's inside...

name: Party-in-a-Box
description:
This jumbo party-in-a-box was damaged during shipment and features a rather large dent in one side. As a result, the King demanded a discount on all damaged shipments, and you also get to keep the dent!

Aside from the dent, the contents of this box are intact and fully-functional!

This box is stuffed with the necessary party supplies to really celebrate MouseHunt's Fourth Birthday! Inside you'll find 450 SUPER|brie+, 75 Party Charms, and a keepsake Dent to remember the Birthday Shipping Accident of 2012. It also provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: DLU Gift Box
description: For MouseHunt's Fourth Birthday, the Devs have given me this fancy-shmancy gift! The glowing gold ribbon obviously grants 3 days of the Lucky Golden Shield, but as for what else is inside, I guess I'll have to open it and find out!

name: Cake Polaroid
description: Dinosuit Mouse wuz here. It looks like my patience (and my remote camera skills) were rewarded with this picture of a Dinosuit Mouse absolutely destroying my cake. Guess I'll have to build another cake if I want to catch another Dinosuit Mouse...

name: Confetti
description: Bang! Kapow! Fwsssh! Okay, sure, confetti doesn't actually make that noise, but it's fun to pretend.

name: Dent
description: This strangely tangible dent commemorates the Birthday Shipping Accident of 2012. Hunters obtained it from either the Party-in-a-Box, the Marketplace, or as a drop from some of the mice in the Birthday Party Celebration area.

name: Noisemaker
description: For when you absolutely, positively, have to make more noise than any other hunter, ever.

name: Fancy Confetti
description:
These limited edition gold and silver confetti streamers are your special gift for attending MouseHunt's Fourth Birthday!

From us to you,

The Devs

name: Tiara
description: This beautiful tiara is a highly sought-after accessory for hunters with a discerning taste in class and style. Celebrate MouseHunt's Birthday as a true princess. It's your birthday, too, and you can be a princess if you want to.

name: Blob of Cake Batter
description: A tiny bowl of batter, destined for a delicious birthday cake.  It's smooth, creamy, and... is that carrot I see?  I love carrots!

name: Birthday Cake Candle
description: Nothing completes a birthday cake like a collection of candles, illuminating the room with their warm, cheerful glow!

name: Spark of Candle Flame
description: Only in existence for the briefest of moments, this tiny flash of flame is just enough to light a candle.

name: Dollop of Icing
description: This generous heaping helping of icing would look great on top of any cake, but it'd probably go best on - hmm...  Probably carrot cake.

name: Carrot Birthday Cake Base
description:
This base is actually a slab of cake sneakily sliced from the carrot cake originally concocted specifically to attract the Dinosuit Mouse. In addition to attracting mice, it also attracts the occasional rabbit, whose passing feet have lent this base a +3 luck bonus.

A flavour first savoured during MouseHunt's 4th birthday!

name: Birthday Party Piñata Bonanza
description:
This trap is an amalgamation of celebration for MouseHunt's Fourth Birthday! This fun-filled piñata is sure to cause a big bang at the party! Armed with rainbows, party favours, unicorn horns, and even lasers, this purple animal is stuffed with explosive excitement!

WARNING: Do not HIT, GRAB, SHAKE, TOUCH, LOOK AT, or THINK LOUDLY ABOUT piñata.

name: Party Charm
description:
At this birthday party, even the charms are sporting nifty party hats!

But this is no ordinary party hat this charm is wearing – it also provides some pretty sweet stats!

All types of Party Charms interact with all Birthday traps by giving them a Power Bonus!

When a Party Charm is used during a hunt, there is a chance that it gets out of control and turns into a Super Party Charm!

name: Seven Leaf Clover Cap
description:
As is tradition, once a year the White mice of Gnawnia hold a contest to create these fine hats in hopes of making one great enough to lure a Leprechaun Mouse into their ambush and steal his treasure. Reports state, however, that this plan has never once even come close to working.

This cap is formed out of only the finest grey mosses. Once the shape is formed, the White mice dye it green by swimming with it in buckets of dye. Some of the more 'creative' mice have been reported swimming in the Laboratory's run-off with less favorable results to themselves...

It appears the creator of this specific tiny head-piece adorned it with a very rare seven leaf clover!

name: Tournament Challenger Badge
description: For team members that do not place, these badges are a reward for finishing within the top 10% of teams in one of the King's MouseHunting tournaments.

name: Aether Egg
description: Light and aethereal, this egg is carried by a ghostly mouse.

name: Assassin Egg
description: A stealthy egg, you may find it hiding in the shadows of Furoma!

name: Pocketwatch Egg
description: This egg is made from the same clockworks as the mouse who carries it.

name: Crown Collector Egg
description: This royal egg can only be found by hunters who have an affinity for crowns.

name: Desert Nomad Egg
description: This egg bears the dust of the desert on its surface.

name: Diamond Egg
description: This egg is made from the hardest substance known to mouse!

name: Spring Gift Basket 2012
description: This gift basket is filled with yummy goodies to help you during the Spring Egg Hunt! Inside you'll find 80 Marshmallow Monterey and 20 Dark Chocolate Charms. It also provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month when opened.

name: Egg Hunting Kit
description:
This eggy kit is choco-full with tons of eggy goodness to really help you during the Spring Egg Hunt!

Inside you'll find 200 Marshmallow Monterey, 100 Dark Chocolate Charms, and 5 Eggstra Charms, which give you TWO eggs instead of just one when used with the Eggscavator!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Eclipse Egg
description: Don't shed a tear, eight floors to go before you can get this egg!

name: Fog Egg
description: These eggs rain like hail during Furricanes!

name: Lich Egg
description: Ancient runes tell of the cheese required to attract the mouse carrying this egg.

name: Scavenger Egg
description: The mouse that drops this egg is known for picking up all sorts of things.

name: Spud Egg
description: Potato!

name: Gauntlet Magic Egg
description: Rare and challenging magic swirls around this egg.

name: Eggscavator
description:
The Eggscavator keeps track of all the Spring Hunt Eggs you've found, old and new, smashed or intact. It will also reveal hints regarding the location of other eggs!

Ping the Eggscavator!

name: Golden Paint
description: This paint is used to create Golden Eggs.

name: Green Plaid Paint
description: This paint is used to create Green Plaid Eggs.

name: Blue Argyle Paint
description: This paint is used to create Blue Argyle Eggs.

name: Stripy Red Paint
description: This paint is used to create Stripy Red Eggs.

name: Wavy Purple Paint
description: This paint is used to create Wavy Purple Eggs.

name: Scalloped Pink Paint
description: This paint is used to create Scalloped Pink Eggs.

name: Gift Paint
description: This paint is used to create Gift Eggs.

name: Sharing Paint
description: This paint is used to create Sharing Eggs.

name: Friendly Paint
description: This paint is used to create Friendly Eggs.

name: Caring Paint
description: This paint is used to create Caring Eggs.

name: Eggstra Charm
description:
These charms are a relic from past Spring Egg Hunts. Although most of their magic has faded, a portion of Eggstra Fondue can still be extracted from within!

Smash this charm with your Hunter's Hammer to receive 1 Eggstra Fondue!

name: Marshmallow Gift Basket
description:
This gift basket is filled with squishy goodies to help you during the Spring Egg Hunt!

Inside you'll find 60 Marshmallow Monterey.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: War Scrap
description:
Chunks of metal, scraps of cloth, tiny, mouse-sized bits of fluff... This little bag is full of scraps taken from mice invading the Slushy Shoreline.

Trade this in at the Slushy Shoreline shops for gear to aid in your fight against Icewing!

name: War Supplies
description: These supplies are carried by the less common mice invading the chilly shores of Gnawnia. The mice have raided the King's private hunting supply, including some of his SUPER|brie+ and King's Credits, and are using these supplies against the hunters on the shores.

name: Icebreaker License
description:
This document, sold only in the Harbour and on the S.S. Huntington IV, authorizes the bearer to brave the dangerous and icy shores of Gnawnia. Massive amounts of slush have been hitting the beaches, and floating in amongst it are dangerous mice. Push the invaders back from the castle walls and find out who or what is behind this attack!

An area of danger and adventure for Lord/Lady hunters and above to explore!

Obtain this map piece during the Lord/Lady adventure:
Hunt for Icewing

name: Shoreline Supplies
description:
This crate of icy supplies holds useful hunting items for the Slushy Shoreline and beyond.

Inside you'll find 125 SUPER|brie+, 75 Softserve Charms, 1 Wire Spool, 1 Heating Oil, and 1 Frosty Metal!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Slushy Crafting Kit
description:
This crafting kit holds items useful in the Slushy Shoreline and beyond. Use the crafting items to craft new weapons and bases, or smash them with the Hunter's Hammer to get some War Scraps.

Inside you'll find 1 Wire Spool, 1 Heating Oil, 1 Frosty Metal, as well as 1 random crafting item from these three!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Bottled Cold Fusion
description: The ultimate source of the icy mice's terrible power, this bottle full of cold fusion energy could be very useful in turning the tables, if only we could figure out how to use it!
obtain_hint: Hunt Icewing's Generals in the Iceberg

name: Frosty Metal
description: No ordinary metal could retain its original ductile and tensile properties in the frozen north. Given this, it's hardly surprising that Digby scientists have been completely unable to identify the base metals making up this fascinating alloy.
obtain_hint: Hunt Living Ice and Yeti mice in the Slushy Shoreline

name: Hearthstone Base Blueprints
description:
Warmth and comfort emanate from these blueprints, so much that it makes you wonder just how warm and comforting the base you build with it must be! Certainly enough to dissuade the crazed, distress-loving Zealot mice from visiting your trap.

It requires 14 Wire Spools, 8 chunks of Frosty Metal, 8 pots of Heating Oil, and a huge amount of an intense form of energy to power it.

name: Heating Oil
description: This oil emanates a natural warmth, and can be used to prevent wood and other delicate materials from cracking in the cold air.
obtain_hint: Hunt Living Ice and Saboteur mice in the Slushy Shoreline

name: Magnet Base Blueprints
description:
These blueprints appear to describe the construction steps for a base made from powerful electromagnets, which would be excellent for attracting metal tool-carrying Tunnel Rats.

It requires 5 Wire Spools, 5 chunks of Frosty Metal, 2 pots of Heating Oil, and a fair amount of an intense form of energy to power it.

name: Remote Detonator Base Blueprints
description:
Whoah, this looks dangerous! The device described in these blueprints looks like it could detonate nearly any explosive remotely, which would certainly help with Bomb Squad Mice.

It requires 8 Wire Spools, 2 chunks of Frosty Metal, 1 pot of Heating Oil, and a fair amount of an intense form of energy to power it.

name: Spiked Base Blueprints
description:
Icy Brutes pack a surprising punch, but the base depicted on these blueprints looks like it can neutralize their knockback.

It requires 5 Wire Spools, 5 chunks of Frosty Metal, 10 pots of Heating Oil, at least 50 pieces of Splintered Wood, and a large amount of an intense form of energy to power it.

name: Steam Laser Mk. I Parts
description: These parts can be carefully crafted back into another Steam Laser Mk. I, or perhaps upgraded into a more powerful version!

name: Steam Nine
description:
A metastable polymorph of common steam, this surprising gas is extremely dangerous! Even a small amount released into the surrounding environment can instantly convert even the coldest of ice into ultra-hot steam.

Clearly the source of Icewing's iceberg-forming powers, perhaps it could be combined with Steam Laser technology to create something truly unstoppable!
obtain_hint: Hunt Icewing in the Iceberg

name: Wire Spool
description: A length of wire is rather a handy thing.  It can hold things together, run electricity, or even induce a magnetic field!  It should come as no surprise that the frozen invaders carry plenty with them.
obtain_hint: Hunt Living Ice and Icebreaker mice in the Slushy Shoreline

name: Interlocking Hull Fragment
description: This minuscule fragment is designed to connect with a multitude of other fragments to form an enormous hull-mounted icebreaker for the S.S. Huntington II.

name: Hearthstone Base
description:
Zealot mice find the pleasant warmth of this base to be incredibly repulsive, and avoid it like the plague. Actually, the plague doesn't bother them that much at all. The warm comfort of this base repulses them so greatly that there are simply no words to describe their disgust.

Aside from strongly averting Zealot mice, it makes an excellent hand warmer in the frozen depths!

name: Magnet Base
description: The magnetic power of this base exerts a constant pull on iron tools and equipment, which translates into an increased chance of attracting Tunnel Rats.  Interestingly, this effect is just subtle enough that the mice never consciously notice it.  Besides, even if they did know why they encountered these bases so often, they would never be able to understand how they work.

name: Remote Detonator Base
description:
This base is able to remotely detonate any explosive device, meaning you can properly time Bomb Squad mice explosions to propel you forwards instead of backwards!

Be especially careful placing your cheese on that big red button! The slightest bump could-

name: Spiked Base
description:
Brute mice rely on raw force to keep hunters from progressing. And how do you deal with an unstoppable force? With an immovable object!

When Brute mice try to knock a hunter back with a powerful blow, this spiky, saw-toothed plank drives itself firmly into the ground, preventing any backwards movement.

name: Steam Laser Mk. I
description:
Like a fog machine mixed with a laser lightshow, the Steam Laser Mark I is both effective and awesome. Even mice not directly struck by the Steam Laser Mark I's beam stop in their tracks, engrossed in the incredible lightshow before them.

This combination of hot and hydro works especially well on the Slushy Shoreline and in the Iceberg.

name: Softserve Charm
description:
This tiny charm emanates a sweet vanilla odour that is irresistible to mice who have gotten sick of smelling stale salt air on a long ocean voyage.

When equipped on the Slushy Shoreline, more powerful mice carrying more valuable equipment will be attracted to your trap.

name: Sticky Charm
description:
Made from a mixture of tapioca and long-lasting super glue, this charm is very tricky to handle. Touching it with bare skin adheres immediately, and it cannot be removed short of high-powered solvents.

When equipped, this charm will prevent you from being pushed back when you fail to catch a Bergling mouse, and with 150 extra power, that should happen even less often.

name: Wax Charm
description:
Snowboarders wax up their boards before hitting the slopes. Why? To go fast. And hunters who want to travel faster through the dangerous Iceberg would be well-off if they equipped this charm and waxed up their bases.

Catching Bergling mice with this charm equipped will move you through the Iceberg faster than ever before, and with 150 extra power, it's even easier to catch every mouse!

name: Sticky Charm 5-Pack
description:
Made from a mixture of tapioca and long-lasting super glue, this charm is very tricky to handle. Touching it with bare skin adheres immediately, and it cannot be removed short of high-powered solvents.

When equipped, this charm will prevent you from being pushed back when you fail to catch a Bergling mouse.

This bag contains 5 Sticky Charms, which will be added directly to your Charm collection on purchase.

name: Wax Charm 5-Pack
description:
Snowboarders wax up their boards before hitting the slopes. Why? To go fast. And hunters who want to travel faster through the dangerous Iceberg would be well-off if they equipped this charm and waxed up their bases.

Catching Bergling mice with this charm equipped will move you through the Iceberg faster than ever before!

This bag contains 5 Wax Charms, which will be added directly to your Charm collection on purchase.

name: Drilling Gift Set
description:
This gift set contains items that will speed you through the Iceberg! Use the charms to hold off Bergling mice or speed past them, and use the Drill Charges to power your Ice Drill deep into the Iceberg.

Inside you'll find 60 Wax Charms, 60 Sticky Charms, and 2 Drill Charges.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Iceberg Invasion Kit
description:
This invasion kit contains items that will help you carve through the Iceberg! Use the charms to hold off Bergling mice or speed past them, and use the Drill Charges to power your Ice Drill deep into the Iceberg.

Inside you'll find 120 Wax Charms, 120 Sticky Charms, 5 Drill Charges, and 125 SUPER|brie+!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 months from date of opening.

name: Iceberg Strongbox
description: Built to be strong, re-usable, and attractive, this Strongbox contains many supplies for mice invading the Slushy Shores.  But if you take it for your own, the supplies inside could then be used against them!

name: Iceberg Supply Chest
description: While the outside may not be terribly appealing, this chest contains many supplies desperately needed by the Iceberg mice, and intercepting it will set their war effort back immensely while bolstering your own supplies.

name: Iceberg Treasure Chest
description: This tantalizing chest contains the very best supplies the Iceberg mice have to offer.  Preventing it from reaching the shoreline would be a great idea, and taking the contents for yourself would be an even better idea!

name: Steam Laser Mk. II Parts
description: These parts are no good for rebuilding a Steam Laser Mk. II, but can certainly be used to create a more powerful version!

name: Well-sealed Canister
description:
It's not known what this substance is, but what is known is that it has the unique ability to absorb and channel heat from any substance, making it a truly powerful energy source and likely the explanation for the sudden, huge Iceberg.

If combined with Steam Laser technology, a fairly large amount of an intense source of energy, and equal amounts of Heating Oil, Frosty Metal, and Wire Spools, a truly stupendous trap may be built!
obtain_hint: Hunt Frostwing Commander mice in the Iceberg

name: Diamond Drill Bits
description:
Diamond is the hardest mineral known, and way WAY harder than ice. This makes it the ideal material to bore through the Iceberg faster than ever before thought possible!

Visit the General Store and use this to purchase the most powerful Ice Drill in the land!

name: Drill Charge
description:
Use Drill Charges to quickly carve through 20 feet of ice on the Iceberg! Each capsule is powered by a scalding hot energy cell, which can overheat your Ice Drill if overused, so use them wisely!

Purchase Drill Charges from the General Store with Cold Fusion.

name: Diamond Ice Drill
description:
Diamond is the hardest mineral known, and way WAY harder than ice. This makes it the ideal material to bore through the Iceberg faster than ever before thought possible!

It requires Drill Charges to operate, and can only be used 8 times during each Iceberg invasion before it overheats. It will be reusable after defeating an Iceberg invasion. This upgrade replaces the Ice Drill Mk. III for all drilling operations.

Your first purchase of the Diamond Ice Drill comes with 5 Drill Charges, which can also be purchased from the General Store with Cold Fusion.

Caution: Drilling past Mouse Generals will skip them and their loot.

name: Ice Drill Mk. I
description:
This specialized drill is used to quickly bore through ice, assisting hunters in reaching deeper depths of the Iceberg.

It requires Drill Charges to operate, and can only be used 5 times during each Iceberg invasion before it overheats. It will be reusable after defeating an Iceberg invasion.

Your first purchase of the Ice Drill Mk. I comes with 3 Drill Charges, which can also be purchased from the General Store with Cold Fusion.

Caution: Drilling past Mouse Generals will skip them and their loot.

name: Ice Drill Mk. III
description:
This specialized drill is used to quickly bore through ice, assisting hunters in reaching deeper depths of the Iceberg.

It requires Drill Charges to operate, and can only be used 7 times during each Iceberg invasion before it overheats. It will be reusable after defeating an Iceberg invasion. This upgrade replaces the Ice Drill Mk. II for all drilling operations.

Your first purchase of the Ice Drill Mk. III comes with 4 Drill Charges, which can also be purchased from the General Store with Cold Fusion.

Caution: Drilling past Mouse Generals will skip them and their loot.

name: Ice Drill Mk. II
description:
This specialized drill is used to quickly bore through ice, assisting hunters in reaching deeper depths of the Iceberg.

It requires Drill Charges to operate, and can only be used 6 times during each Iceberg invasion before it overheats. It will be reusable after defeating an Iceberg invasion. This upgrade replaces the Ice Drill Mk. I for all drilling operations.

Your first purchase of the Ice Drill Mk. II comes with 3 Drill Charges, which can also be purchased from the General Store with Cold Fusion.

Caution: Drilling past Mouse Generals will skip them and their loot.

name: Steam Laser Mk. II (Broken!)
description:
Oh no! Just look what Icewing did to this perfectly good trap! Does she even know how long it took to build? The effort and time and gold involved? Does she even care?

Well. You can show her! There's certainly enough parts left here to rebuild this trap, and if you can find an extra-powerful power source somewhere, you can create a trap she'll certainly fear!

name: Steam Laser Mk. II
description:
With more heat, more laser, and more awesome than ever before, the Steam Laser Mk. II truly brings the fight to the Iceberg mice. State-of-the-art targeting chips have also been added, to ensure pin-point laser accuracy and split-second timing, which definitely helps against stronger and faster mice. Even Icewing herself fears and will attack this trap on sight!

This combination of hot and hydro works especially well on the Slushy Shoreline and in the Iceberg.

name: Steam Laser Mk. III
description:
The ultimate in steam laser technology, the Steam Laser Mk. III is truly a marvel of engineering. Able to hyper-heat steam beyond normal (or safe) levels, this trap is truly the pinnacle of anti-Iceberg weaponry. Even Icewing herself fears and will attack this trap on sight!

This combination of hot and hydro works especially well on the Slushy Shoreline and in the Iceberg.

name: Icewing Plushie
description:
This limited edition plushie has been manufactured to help raise awareness about the latest threat to the kingdom.

For a short time the King has requested hunters share these tiny dolls with each other to spread the word to as many hunters as possible. Along with each of these fiercely cute squeezable dolls is a tag outlining the current dangers the kingdom faces, as well as a "wanted" ad for the capture of Icewing herself.

If you squeeze plushie Icewing's hand she'll say a few trademarked catchphrases.
message: PLEASE, LET MY INVASION FORCE DESTROY YOUR CASTLE. (TM)

name: Cold Fusion Bomb
description:
When activated on the Iceberg, this complex creation destabilizes the ice instantly, melting the Iceberg in a flash.

It may be used at any time, but the great flood of water generated swamps the player, sending them to the Slushy Shoreline, and scatters the bonus chests, rendering them uncollectible.

Further, because the mice on the iceberg were not defeated, this does not count as an Iceberg completion so far as the King's record keepers are concerned.

name: Deep Freeze Base Blueprints
description:
Crafted from an exotic collection of rare materials, this base represents an attempt by Icewing to ensure her icebergs could no longer be stopped. In a capable hunter's hands, however, it represents a means to safely explore the depths of the Iceberg before it fully collapses.

In addition to these blueprints, to craft this base you will require:

  • 1 Steam Nine
  • 6 Bottled Cold Fusion
  • 9 Frosty Metal
  • 10 Wire Spools
  • 10 Stale SUPER|brie+
obtain_hint: Hunt Icewing in the Iceberg

name: Deep Freeze Base
description: Sitting at a full -100 degrees Celsius, this base is dangerous to handle and requires protective gear even to arm cheese safely.  Given the extreme cold, it can destabilize most traps, severely impairing their effectiveness.  However, certain traps in a certain area may in fact benefit from the intense cold it emits, even perhaps using it as a stabilizing agent at a critical point.

name: Plankrun's Iceberg Notes
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
Today I must admit was a terrifying ordeal. I had been awoken with a start. I was told it was Sir Reginforth who first spotted them and sounded the horn, his young squire came to make sure I was awake and had all of my gear in order. Larry may be the most awkward, young and clumsy squire, but there is something about his determination and optimism. I can see why Reginforth keeps him around.
When I emerged from my tower, I could hardly believe my eyes, large hunks of ice seemed to have sprouted from the castle's walls, the howling sound of dark magic was bouncing off every stone surface and small eerie unnatural fires were burning everywhere. I knew immediately that this was the work of some very powerful adversaries.
Our battle did not go well, but thankfully it is over now. Our traps were hardly effective and the few hunters who managed to come to the defence of the Kingdom were unable to cover enough ground to even hope to secure against this raid. The castle has taken great damage, our supplies have been plundered and the morale of the Kingdom appears to be at an all-time low.
page_text_back:
A small clan of some of the most dangerous mice Gnawnia has ever known appears to have banded together to terrorize our home. I recognized few of the them, but among them I believe I saw the Master of the Dojo and his students, Balack the dreaded and his tribes, even the Acolyte and his terrifying Master appeared to be a shadow in the mix. I have written about these mice in my journeys before, but I wished I would never have to meet any of them ever again.
One mouse I am probably lucky to never have run into before would be a great gargantuan mouse led by collar and chain who was laying waste to hunter's traps with his impressive jaws. The Dragon mouse who was still out of reach was there as well and I even spotted in the corner of my eye a mouse with horns and a sinister red cape.
One new mouse however remains the topic of interest amongst most of the hunters, a small and fragile winged mouse who was blue from head to toe. To look upon her set in your heart a cold terror and it was clear that even the other mice kept their distance. In the moment it took to blink, it would seem this mouse could create a cold snap so vicious a hunter's traps would freeze and snap under its own pressure. What is worse was that she was freezing entire…

name: Deep Thought (25,000 bonus points)
description: The knowledge these ponderings contain instantly awards the hunter points upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Frozen Sealed Bottle
