description: Knocked loose from the Iceberg's walls during your downward descent, this bottle is frozen solidly shut.  Inside, you can see the corner of a map with the title "To Untold Riches", but try as you might, you cannot get the cork loose.
message: Not even a Monstrobot wielding the Hunter's Hammer could put a crack in this bottle. Looks like its contents will remain a secret forever.

name: Miniature Torch
description: This tiny torch represents the spirit of athleticism and commemorates competitive sporting events.

name: Athlete's Kit
description:
This kit contains professional athletic gear for use in the Great Gnawnian Games "100 Mouse Dash" event!

Inside you'll find 200 Runny Cheese and 50 Athlete Charms.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Training Gift Basket
description:
This gift basket contains training equipment to aid in the Great Gnawnian Games "100 Mouse Dash" event!

Inside you'll find 15 Runny Cheese and 15 Athlete Charms.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: King's Medallion
description: This ceremonial medallion represents excellent performance in the "100 Mouse Dash" during the 2012 Great Gnawnian Games.

name: Runny Cheese
description:
This cheese has been left out in the sun too long, and in this sweltering heat, it's nearly liquid!

Hunters using this cheese will find they can attract some of the more sportier mice in the kingdom. The speed at which this cheese runs off the edge of the trap seems to remind these mice of their own physical prowess.

name: Athlete Charm
description: This charm has been training hard all season for this very moment. Hunters who equip this charm can expect a mighty +10 Luck Bonus while hunting at Runny Stockpiles during the Great Gnawnian Games. After the event, they retain some luck and power, and can be used anywhere!

name: Mobile Charm
description: While most charms sit in their conduit while providing power to a trap, these charms go a step further! Their vibrating ridges allow them to scurry about a trap's base distracting a mouse just long enough for it to fall victim to a trap.

name: Arduous Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

name: Easy Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

name: Elaborate Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

name: Hard Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

name: Medium Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Arduous Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this incredible Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Easy Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a rare treasure map and have discovered this incredible Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Elaborate Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this incredible Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Hard Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this incredible Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Medium Treasure Chest (Season 1)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this incredible Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Treasure Hunting Kit
description:
Hunt down clue-bearing mice and turn regular old treasure maps into Rare Treasure Maps! The Treasure Hunting Kit has everything you need to go treasure hunting, and maybe find an Ancient Amulet of your own!

Inside, you'll find:

• 3 Rare Map Dust
• 125 SUPER|brie+
Rare Map Dust leads to Rare Treasure Chests containing:
  • Two times the points!
  • Two times the gold!
  • Two times the Ancient Charms!
  • More loot!
  • And twice the chance of super-rare loot!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Relic Hunter Scroll Case
description:
This ornate scroll case contains a treasure map that will lead hunters throughout the Kingdom in search of mice. Some say these scroll cases must be enchanted because the size and difficulty of the map that slides out seems to change depending on who opens it.

Sometimes it contains a short, easy map listing only mice in the Gnawnia region whereas other times it contains a much more difficult map that will lead hunters throughout many different regions in search of a long list of challenging and elusive mice. Or sometimes it will contain a map somewhere in between but you won't know which one you've got until you open it!

There are six possible Relic Hunter Treasure Map difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elaborate, Arduous, and Elite. The one you receive upon opening this scroll case is random but it will never contain mice and locations that are above your current rank.

name: Ancient Amulet
description: This must be what the Relic Hunter Mouse was looking for!  However, without being a student of ancient mouse history, it's hard to know exactly why.  Sure, it's a gorgeous golden medallion with ancient mouse tribal markings, just brimming with untold secrets and knowledge...  But that's all.  Huh.  Strange.

name: Ancient Relic
description:
With the dust cleaned off, this jade and gold statue is indescribably beautiful. It represents an ancient period of time in mouse culture, where master sculptors may have spent entire years perfecting a single curve of a single statue, chipping out the tiniest piece of jade and polishing for hours and hours and hours.

It's no surprise that the Relic Hunter Mouse is desperate to catch even a glimpse of these artifacts. They represent an incredible wealth of cultural and artistic knowledge.
obtain_hint: Hunt rare and powerful mice throughout the kingdom, hunt the Relic Hunter Mouse

name: Treasure Map
description: Catching the mice listed on this map will drop clues which when combined will show you where to find an incredible Treasure Chest!

name: Treasure Map Clue
description: Dropped by mice listed on a Treasure Map. Collect all the clues to reveal the location of a fantastic Treasure Chest for your whole hunting team!

name: Rare Map Dust
description:
Scraped carefully from an old, rare map, this dust can instantly transform a Common Treasure Map into a Rare Treasure Map, increasing the rewards gained for everyone working on solving it! The difficulty of the map doesn't increase, only the delicious loot!

Rare Map Dust leads to Rare Treasure Chests containing:
  • Two times the points!
  • Two times the gold!
  • Two times the Ancient Charms!
  • More loot!
  • And twice the chance of super-rare loot!

name: Ancient Gauntlet
description:
This long-forgotten trap can lend much-needed aid to hunters attempting the long climb up the King's Gauntlet. While the statues may look dormant and docile, one of them has been secretly replaced with an incredibly patient hunter droid. Let's see if the mice notice!

Using this trap in the King's Gauntlet will double any Tier 2 Gauntlet Potions that drop.

name: Ancient Charm
description:
This tiny jade and gold charm faintly vibrates with untold reserves of energy. Holding it in your hand makes you feel giddy after only a few moments.

Yes... Yes... The power! The absolute power!!!

name: Ancient Relic Trap Skin
description: The ancient ghost mice which roamed Gnawnia before even the castle existed require an old-fashioned trap strategy, and the Ancient Box Trap is about as old-fashioned as they come. A heavy stone box teeters precariously upon an Ancient Relic Staff, waiting for a mouse to pull the Ethereal Rope and cause the box to slam shut and magically fuse with the base. This may seem like a deceptively simple trap set-up, but ancient mice enjoy the classics.
marketing_text: This beautiful jade and gold version of the Ancient Box Trap is sure to make any mouse trapped inside its solid walls truly appreciative of the skill and artistry that went into its construction!

name: Doobers
description: This loud and beautiful drop seems to hold a special power that could only be described as "not of this world".

name: Mystery Pot of Gold
description:
This gloriously glowing cauldron is enchanted with the luck of the Leprechaun.

It is absolutely FILLED with gold, a handful of Ultimate Luck Charms, some SUPER|brie+, and sometimes a little something extra at the bottom...

It takes a lucky hunter to catch a Leprechaun and find one of these treasures, but an even luckier one might find actual cash lying under all that gold!

name: $25 Cash Prize
description: Rewarded to lucky hunters who catch a prize mouse carrying this special reward.

name: $50 Cash Prize
description: Rewarded to lucky hunters who catch a prize mouse carrying this special reward.

name: 2012 Halloween Scroll Case
description: This dusty scroll case has a heavy feel to it. Who knows what scary riches the scroll inside will lead to?

name: 2012 Halloween Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this Halloween Treasure Chest!

name: 2012 Rare Halloween Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this Halloween Treasure Chest!

name: Halloween Theme Scrap I
description: This tiny scrap of paper has the potential to change your whole life - or at least your whole profile.  Collecting the other two scraps will allow you to select the Halloween Theme customization, but where could they possibly be?

name: Halloween Theme Scrap II
description: This tiny scrap of paper has the potential to change your whole life - or at least your whole profile.  Collecting the other two scraps will allow you to select the Halloween Theme customization, but where could they possibly be?

name: Halloween Theme Scrap III
description: This tiny scrap of paper has the potential to change your whole life - or at least your whole profile.  Collecting the other two scraps will allow you to select the Halloween Theme customization, but where could they possibly be?

name: Candy Apple
description:
Sweet, delicious, and oh-so-tempting... Just be sure to brush your teeth afterwards.

Not recommended for anyone with braces!

This item can be occasionally dropped from mice in the Spooky Sandcastle.

name: Completed Halloween Theme
description: Comprised of three hard-to-find scraps and liberal amounts of clear tape, this theme was put together by a brave hunter who roamed the entire length of the Haunted Terrortories, participated in spectacular teamwork, and knew exactly where to look for a bargain.

name: Mousie Pincushion
description: This is obviously just a pincushion for sewing purposes. Right? Obviously. It couldn't be related to any sort of voodoo, clearly. Just a pincushion. Just for sewing.

name: Spooky Mask
description:
What a sad, scary face! Rumour has it that it was cast from the unhappy face of a hunter opening a treasure chest and being disappointed yet again by not finding the trap they're looking for.

This item can be found rarely on mice in the Spooky Sandcastle.

name: Whisker Woods Wicked Hat
description: This popular fashion item (well, popular among some) has now been mass-produced and can be handed out to your friends to celebrate the spooky season!

name: Halloween Treasure Map
description: Catching the mice listed on this spooky map will drop clues which when combined will show you where to find an incredible Halloween Treasure Chest!

name: Terrifying Spider Trap
description: Dozens, no hundreds of tiny spiders must have created this huge cocoon, but why? Perhaps equipping it in the Spooky Sandcastle or in the Seasonal Garden during Fall will reveal the reason.

name: Candy Corn Ice Maiden Skin
description: Bound within the pillar of ice on the back of this trap is a rare enchantment. When the dragon breathes fire onto the trap, the ice temporarily melts, releasing a specially-designed dragon collar which snaps down onto the dragon's neck and freezes him in a thick coating of ice.
marketing_text: It's not especially well-known, but candy corns are actually secret dragon weaknesses.  When the dragon breaths fire onto the trap, the ice melts, releasing the candy corn - which is absolutely irresistible to them.  Having consumed the sugary treat, they quickly experience a sugar crash, allowing Hunters to collect them safely.

name: Horrific Pumpkin Trap Skin
description: The effects of radioactive sludge on this Venus Mouse trap appears to have given the plant an aggressive temper! Its sharp vines and thorns now ooze with toxic waste making a menacing opponent for any mouse.
marketing_text: What's more horrifying than an incredibly mutated venus fly trap?  An incredibly mutated pumpkin with an unending hunger for tiny mice!

name: Lovecraft Shelf Skin
description:
This trap is the only devised tool suspected of being able to capture Zurreal the Eternal. A harmless looking bookshelf features literature designed to intrigue Zurreal, distracting him from the trap hidden behind the shelf.

The traps's design is complex, but it's utility is simple: Drain all magical and electrical energy in the immediate area. The trap is powered by undead ectoplasm to remain active while using augmented metal netting and runic rocks to open a small hole to another dimension and vacuum all other energy far away. This trap should be enough to knock Zurreal's walking throne out of commission, leaving him mostly helpless.

WARNING: Do not try to operate Droids, heavy machinery or magics anywhere near this trap while activated!
marketing_text: Some books are written about Eldritch Horrors, some books are written by Eldritch Horrors, and some books literally contain Eldritch Horrors. Be very careful when setting up, walking near, or thinking about this trap. As if Zurreal's Folly wasn't already dangerous enough...

name: Springer Skin
description: Razor sharp barbs adorn a crushing bar held with over 1000 lbs of tension.
marketing_text: Cunningly disguised as an old an unused trap, the Springer is actually 100% fully-functioning, and any mouse expecting it to be rusted and safe will shortly be corrected in a very drastic manner!

name: Steam Maw Skin
description:
The ultimate in steam laser technology, the Steam Laser Mk. III is truly a marvel of engineering. Able to hyper-heat steam beyond normal (or safe) levels, this trap is truly the pinnacle of anti-Iceberg weaponry. Even Icewing herself fears and will attack this trap on sight!

This combination of hot and hydro works especially well on the Slushy Shoreline and in the Iceberg.
marketing_text: A combination of flaming-hot Ethereal Charcoal and Eldritch Fog ensure that this version of the Steam Laser Mk. III is no less effective, but far spookier.

name: The Thing That Ate The Bottomless Grave Skin
description:
Although Digby drilling technology has often been regarded as the quickest to dig a grave, ambitious scientists were still tempted to experiment with rocket-propelled drills.



The result of these experiments has now turned into researching where the high speed drills have gone.
marketing_text: When nobody was looking, this... thing crawled out of the Bottomless Grave and nobody has been able to get it to leave. But since it hasn't been any less effective at catching mice, nobody seems to mind very much.

name: Sphynx Wrath Black Cat Skin
description: This trap was intended to pay homage to a mythical creature known only for it's unparalleled mouse hunting prowess. Outfitted with a slew of clever traps it came as quite the surprise when the trapsmith who designed this tool of destruction found it utterly destroyed by its own means, the statue untouched. It is believed the simple traps were insult enough to the spirit of this creature that they simply destroyed themselves in it's presence.
marketing_text: Dark, mysterious, and majestic, this skin may be a little spooky, but definitely makes an impression.  Any hunter displaying this skin can do so proudly, knowing it informs all who see it of their dedication to the hunt, and their incredible tournament accomplishments.

name: Sphynx Wrath Valkyrie Skin
description: This trap was intended to pay homage to a mythical creature known only for it's unparalleled mouse hunting prowess. Outfitted with a slew of clever traps it came as quite the surprise when the trapsmith who designed this tool of destruction found it utterly destroyed by its own means, the statue untouched. It is believed the simple traps were insult enough to the spirit of this creature that they simply destroyed themselves in it's presence.
marketing_text: This trap skin emblazons the power and beauty of the Sphynx Wrath with a rather majestic set of wings. Along with the impressive wingspan upgrade, the skin also tunes the Sphynx Crystal to accommodate for some fancy special effects and pyrotechnics. Truly, this skin is reserved for hard working champions with discerning taste.

name: Witch's Brew Trap Skin
description: Working with some clever trapsmiths and the oasis bead you were able to create a tunnel of water and give it a mind of its own. While on standby the trap simply looks like a still pool of fresh water in a beautiful desert oasis, however any mouse it encounters will be snatched up and rocketed through the water tunnel to whatever destination you've set, be that Davy Jones' Locker or another continent. If this were big enough for a human and much safer, one might consider using it for a more cost effective travel method...
marketing_text: This bubbling cauldron of ancient magic may look silly and fun, but only until a mouse draws near... Then the magic activates and any curious nearby mice are grabbed and drawn deep within!

name: 2012 Pumpkin Treat Basket
description: There's sure to be a Halloween treat in this spooky basket!

name: Fan Base
description:
With its high-speed fans, this base keeps cheese very fresh and is quite "uplifting" for mice who wander onto this trap.

Get yours FREE by becoming part of the fanbase here!

Our thanks to you for being a fan!

name: Cursed City Charm Pack
description:
This package contains 3 Bravery Charms, 3 Clarity Charms, and 3 Shine Charms for use in dispelling curses in the Cursed City.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Dewthief Camembert 4-Pack
description:
Dewthief plants are master moisture-stealers, which means their petals are always soft and delicate, making for an exquisitely smooth cheese.

Mice in the Lost City and Sand Dunes seem to be solely attracted to this cheese.

name: Duskshade Camembert 4-Pack
description:
Duskshade petals can only be harvested in the twilight hours of the evenings, though once harvested, the petals keep for quite some time. Combining these gorgeous petals with a generous amount of Dreamfluff herbs creates a cheese that both looks wonderful and imparts a dreamy sense of peace.

Using this cheese in the Living Garden is sure to attract a rare and mystical mouse.

name: Essence Collector Kit
description:
This package contains 20 Sponge Charms, 20 Searcher Charms, 20 Grubling Chow Charms, and 125 SUPER|brie+ for use in hunting in the Living Garden, Sand Dunes, and Lost City.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Graveblossom Camembert 4-Pack
description:
It takes a brave mouse indeed to take a bite of this cheese, but the payoff is a delicious, creamy-smooth cheese with a slight sharpness to it - delicious!

This cheese cannot be used in the Living Garden, Lost City, or Sand Dunes.

name: Living Chest
description: This chest is actually alive, pulsing and groaning where it sits.  You'll have to be quick and brave to open it, but the rewards are sure to be worthwhile!

name: Living Garden Charm Pack
description:
This package contains 20 Sponge Charms for use in collecting dewdrops in the Living Garden.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Lost City Charm Pack
description:
This package contains 20 Searcher Charms for use in dispelling curses in the Lost City.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Lunaria Camembert 4-Pack
description:
As soft as butter and twice as creamy, Lunaria Camembert is a tiny slice of heaven. In fact, it's pretty hard to justify using such a delicious and fulfilling cheese as bait when you seriously consider just how wonderful it would be to eat it yourself!

This cheese is far too special to use without a really good reason.

name: Sand Crypts Charm Pack
description:
This package contains 10 Grub Salt Charms and 1 Grub Scent Charm for use in hunting the Grub King Mouse in the Living Garden.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Sand Dunes Charm Pack
description:
This package contains 20 Grubling Chow Charms for use in attracting Grubling Mice in the Sand Dunes.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Twisted Essence Collector Kit
description:
This package contains 20 Red Sponge Charms, 20 Yellow Sponge Charms, 6 Bravery Charms, 6 Clarity Charms, 6 Shine Charms, 20 Grub Salt Charms, 2 Grub Scent Charms, and 250 SUPER|brie+ for use in hunting in the Twisted Garden, Sand Crypts, and Cursed City.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 months from date of opening.

name: Twisted Garden Charm Pack
description:
This package contains 10 Red Sponge Charms and 10 Yellow Sponge Charms for use in collecting coloured dewdrops in the Twisted Garden.

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Unstable Gourd
description: This quivering gourd was the result of planting a specific Garden Essence in a Plant Pot and being slightly patient.  When poked, it can reveal a wide variety of delicious loot!

name: A.C.R.O.N.Y.M. Parts
description: The Arcane Capturing Rod Of Never Yielding Mystery has collapsed into a pile of mystic rubble.

name: Arcane Crystal
description:
This pulsating red crystal emanates arcane power and causes your hair to stand on end when you hold it. Surely, if this power were harnessed, it could create the ultimate in arcane traps!

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Clockwork Portal Trap Blueprints
description:
These blueprints detail how to create the Clockwork Portal Trap.

They call for:
  • 1x Clockwork Portal Trap Blueprints
  • 1x Clock Parts
  • 8x Umbral Capacitors

name: Dewthief Petal
description: When you're a plant, moisture is a make-or-break necessity, and the Dewthief flower has a unique solution to ensuring it has a sufficient supply - long, questing vines that coil around the sloping surfaces of nearby plants.  When dew forms on the unfortunate victims, the drops run down the vines and into the upturned face of the Dewthief flower, ensuring its survival at the expense of its neighbors.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Living Garden

name: Dreamfluff Herbs
description: When initially harvested, Dreamfluff looks like a long, brown, withered pod.  However, when placed under the pillow of a softly dreaming mouse, the pod bursts open, revealing the colourful puffs beneath.  While this is a required step to obtain full potency of the herb, it also ensures a wonderfully comfortable and restive night's sleep to the mouse in question.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Lost City

name: Duskshade Petal
description:
Every plant has its ideal growing conditions. Some prefer warmer climates, some prefer direct light, and some prefer torrential downpours. The Duskshade flower, however, can only grow in the light of the setting sun, curling in upon itself for the remaining hours of the day and appearing to the untrained observer as a dead husk.

Educated, observant, and - most importantly - lucky herbologists catching the flower during its exceptionally brief "open" phase will be treated to quite a display from arguably one of the most gorgeous flowers to have ever existed.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Sand Dunes

name: Aleth Essence
description:
This tiny plant holds something mysterious inside - an energy so powerful that it could change the world, if only it were harnessed correctly.

Surely, there must be some way to intensify and combine that energy into something more powerful.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Living Garden, Twisted Garden, Lost City, Cursed City, Sand Dunes, or Sand Crypts

name: Icuri Essence
description:
This tiny plant holds something mysterious inside - an energy so powerful that it could change the world, if only it were harnessed correctly.

This appears to be the most powerful form of this energy possible! Now just what to combine it with to unleash its true power?
obtain_hint: Combine 3 Hix Essences via crafting

name: Essence Prism
description:
Formed from 100% pure plant nutrients, this prism has been condensed tightly enough to form a beautiful crystal.

Place three Garden Essences inside this prism to focus and combine them into a higher-level Garden Essence.

name: Fresh Twisted Garden Soil
description: This special lump of soil was harvested directly from the center of the Twisted Garden and imbued with magic for some sinister purpose.  Having stolen it away, you can now use its immense energies and nutrients for your own, far more heroic purposes!
obtain_hint: Hunt Twisted Carmine in the Twisted Garden

name: Grand Arcanum Trap Blueprints
description:
These blueprints detail how to create the Grand Arcanum Trap.

They call for:
  • 1x Grand Arcanum Trap Blueprints
  • 1x A.C.R.O.N.Y.M. Parts
  • 1x Arcane Crystal
  • 40x Tiny Platinum Bars

This trap requires the rank of Baron/Baroness or higher.

name: Graveblossom Petal
description:
While it may look like something tragic has happened near this flower, that is only a deception that grants the flower the uncanny ability to actually unsettle hungry herbivores enough to scare them away.

Graveblossom flowers don't actually grow solely on graves, though they always seem to look like they mark a fresh one.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Twisted Garden

name: Lunaria Petal
description: Lunaria flowers look rather unassuming during the day, blending in perfectly in fields of boring, white flowers.  But when struck directly by the rays of the moon, they sparkle and become translucent.  The superstitious claim this grants the petals of the flower magic powers, and the superstitious are absolutely right.  Lunaria petals, when properly used, can heal the sick, levitate objects, and be made into an absolutely transcendent cheese.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Sand Crypts

name: Oasis Water Node Trap Parts
description: Some sand, a whole bunch of water, and - somehow - a preserved palm tree.

name: Phantasmic Essence
description:
This vial shimmers and vibrates faintly, containing the distilled essence of phantasmic hauntings collected over the years.

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Phantasmic Oasis Trap Blueprints
description:
These blueprints detail how to create the Phantasmic Oasis Trap.

They call for:
  • 1x Phantasmic Oasis Trap Blueprints
  • 1x Oasis Water Node Trap Parts
  • 3x Phantasmic Essence

name: Plumepearl Herbs
description: An incredibly rare herb, Plumepearls only grow when a tiny grain of sand gets trapped by an uncommon strain of grass.  While growing, the grass "attacks" the sand with a special emulsion that adds layer upon layer of hardened plant matter to the sand until eventually a large pearl-looking bulb remains.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Cursed City

name: Soiled Base Blueprints
description:
These blueprints detail how to create the Soiled Base.

They call for:
  • 1 x Soiled Base Blueprints
  • 3 x Fresh Living Garden Soil
  • 1 x Dewthief Petal
  • 1 x Duskshade Petal
  • 1 x Graveblossom Petal
  • 1 x Lunaria Petal

name: Umbral Capacitor
description:
Able to charge immense amounts of shadow power and release it in an instant, a trap made from these capacitors would be able to unleash fantastic shadow energy!

This is a vintage crafting item which can be smashed with the Hunter's Hammer for a full gold refund.

name: Zugzwang's Leftover Rock
description:
This would be a plain, ordinary rock if only it didn't have Zugzwang's signature insignia proudly stamped on the side. Oh, and if it didn't exude magical residue like crazy!

This is obviously a powerful artifact used by the great Zugzwang, but what was it used for?

name: Dewdrop
description: A tiny drop of water collected from mice in the Living Garden.  When gathered in large enough quantities, it can be used to attract a special mouse!

name: Red Dewdrop
description: A tiny drop of water collected from mice in the Living Garden.  When gathered in large enough quantities, it can be used to attract a special mouse and grants a power bonus!

name: Yellow Dewdrop
description: A tiny drop of water collected from mice in the Living Garden.  When gathered in large enough quantities, it can be used to attract a special mouse and grants a luck bonus!

name: Soiled Base
description: This base is comprised of a full level of soil, carefully lifted from the Living Garden.  It's soft underfoot and relaxing to mice venturing upon it, but contains many living roots that can wrap around tiny mice feet, holding them in place for traps to snap shut!

name: Clockwork Portal Trap
description: Combining magical theorems from previous portal traps with "modern" clockwork technology, the Clockwork Portal Trap represents the pinnacle of Shadow trap development.  Lying dormant until a mouse attempts to steal a piece of cheese, it looks fairly unassuming, if complicated.  But the moment a mouse steps upon it, pre-charged capacitors flood it with energy, instantly creating a super-powered portal that whisks the mouse off to who knows where... or when.

name: Grand Arcanum Trap
description: The pulsing red crystal at the dark heart of this trap glows with an eerie light, attracting mystic mice like moths to a flame.  Any mouse attuned or interested in arcane energies and secrets will find this trap positively irresistible and will pursue it to their doom!

name: Phantasmic Oasis Trap
description: No longer a sanctuary in the midst of a desert, the Phantasmic Oasis Trap entrances and consumes any who dare venture too close.  The psychedelic colours may be enticing, but beware!  The phantasms and spirits that now inhabit this trap are cruel and merciless!

name: Dewthief Camembert
description:
Dewthief plants are master moisture-stealers, which means their petals are always soft and delicate, making for an exquisitely smooth cheese.

Mice in the Lost City and Sand Dunes seem to be solely attracted to this cheese.

name: Duskshade Camembert
description:
Duskshade petals can only be harvested in the twilight hours of the evenings, though once harvested, the petals keep for quite some time. Combining these gorgeous petals with a generous amount of Dreamfluff herbs creates a cheese that both looks wonderful and imparts a dreamy sense of peace.

Using this cheese in the Living Garden is sure to attract a rare and mystical mouse.

name: Graveblossom Camembert
description:
It takes a brave mouse indeed to take a bite of this cheese, but the payoff is a delicious, creamy-smooth cheese with a slight sharpness to it - delicious!

This cheese cannot be used in the Living Garden, Lost City, or Sand Dunes.

name: Lunaria Camembert
description:
As soft as butter and twice as creamy, Lunaria Camembert is a tiny slice of heaven. In fact, it's pretty hard to justify using such a delicious and fulfilling cheese as bait when you seriously consider just how wonderful it would be to eat it yourself!

This cheese is far too special to use without a really good reason.

name: Bravery Charm
description:
When the shadows live in your heart, it can be hard to see. But take heart! Hold this little charm close, and banish that darkness! Be brave, and you'll find that moving towards your goal is easier than ever.

Catching a mouse in the Cursed City will dispel the Fear Curse, getting you one-third of the way closer to attracting rare Essence Guardian mice.

name: Clarity Charm
description:
Sounds in the mists can be deceiving! Is that an owl up in a tree, or something more sinister and far closer? Use the power of this charm to absorb those mists and make it easier to find your way.

Catching a mouse in the Cursed City will dispel the Mist Curse, getting you one-third of the way closer to attracting rare Essence Guardian mice.

name: Growth Charm
description: By itself, this tiny seed of a charm doesn't seem very useful. But when combined with either the Soiled Base or Living Grove Base, it sprouts a tiny amount of growth and slightly increases its effectiveness!

name: Grub Salt Charm
description:
Be careful handling this charm, as it's basically just packed salt. But that's cool though, because every time you use it on your trap, it will leave a thin crust of salt that makes the King Grub Mouse easier to handle.

Once you've got a whole bunch of layers of salt down, perhaps you should start using some Grub Scent Charms to attract him to your well-salted trap?

name: Grub Scent Charm
description:
To say this charm doesn't smell good would be a crazy understatement, so... don't say that. Instead, say that it smells great to the King Grub Mouse, and the moment you use it, the King Grub Mouse will be irresistibly drawn to your trap.

Then again, he is pretty massive. Perhaps you should spread some salt around with the Grub Salt Charm first, to cut him down to size?

name: Grubling Chow Charm
description:
Carefully crafted to look like a Grubling's favourite food, these charms may look tasty, but don't bother trying to eat them - not unless you're as big a fan of the taste of 3-day-old garbage as Grubling Mice are!

Equipping these charms during a Grubling stampede will attract the otherwise elusive Grubling Mouse to your trap!

name: Red Sponge Charm
description: Mice in the Twisted Garden carry tiny amounts of water to sustain themselves.  Equipping these Red Sponge Charms allow you to collect these red drops for yourself, and then use it to attract Dehydrated Mice with a power bonus.

name: Searcher Charm
description:
When wandering around, lost in the mists and the dark, oftentimes all you need is a light, or a sound, or just something familiar to orient yourself by. This charm is often credited by lost explorers to have brought them that tiny spark of good fortune required to get them back on their path home.

Catching a mouse in the Lost City with this charm equipped will dispel the Lost Curse and allow the Essence Collector Mouse to be attracted.

name: Shine Charm
description:
Banish the darkness! Banish all worries and regrets! Let the light from this charm show you the way and lift your heart!

Also useful as a night-light if you're scared of the dark.

Catching a mouse in the Cursed City will dispel the Darkness Curse, getting you one-third of the way closer to attracting rare Essence Guardian mice.

name: Sponge Charm
description: Mice in the Living Garden carry tiny amounts of water to sustain themselves.  Equipping these Sponge Charms allow you to collect this water for yourself, and then use it to attract Thirsty Mice.

name: Wild Growth Charm
description: By itself, this tiny seed of a charm doesn't seem very useful. But when combined with either the Soiled Base or Living Grove Base, it sprouts a wild amount of growth and greatly increases its effectiveness!

name: Yellow Sponge Charm
description: Mice in the Twisted Garden carry tiny amounts of water to sustain themselves.  Equipping these Yellow Sponge Charms allow you to collect these yellow drops for yourself, and then use them to attract Dehydrated Mice with a luck bonus.

name: Crate of Cursed City Charms
description: This crate contains 2 each of Clarity, Bravery, and Shine Charms to help you keep the Corrupt Mouse at bay!

name: Crate of Living Garden Charms
description: With the 10 Sponge Charms contained in this crate, you can half-way fill the beaker in the Living Garden.  That's a lot of Thirsty Mice!

name: Crate of Lost City Charms
description: With the 10 Searcher Charms contained herein, you should be able to keep the Cursed Mouse away for quite some time!

name: Crate of Sand Crypts Charms
description: With 3 Grub Salt Charms and 1 Grub Scent Charm, you won't make too much progress toward catching the King Grub Mouse, but let's be honest: He's huge! You're gonna need all the help you can get!

name: Crate of Sand Dunes Charms
description: Inside this crate is 10 Grubling Chow Charms - the favourite snack of Grubling Mice everywhere!

name: Crate of Twisted Garden Charms
description: Collect red and yellow dewdrops with the 3 Red Sponge Charms and 3 Yellow Sponge Charms in this crate!

name: Purple Winter Hunt Gift Box
description: A special gift to hunters of rank Baron or Baroness! For the most part they contain a few pieces of cheese to help you in your hunting endeavors. Occasionally, they contain something a little more special. Happy holiday hunting!

name: Stack of War Scraps
description: War Scraps are awesome!  You can craft with them, or turn them into charms, or uh, I guess they make an okay pillow, if carefully arranged...  Anyway, they're really useful and this stack contains a full 10 of them!

name: Electric Candle
description:
When the lights go out, you have to look for both a candle and matches, right? But with this handy-dandy device, all you need is the candle! Just plug it in and...

Oh.

Wait.

Right.

name: Holiday Wrapping Paper
description: With hunters so frantic to open their gifts last year, the King was reluctant to use too much wrapping paper this Great Winter Hunt as it wouldn't last long on the packages. He ordered the Royal Wrappers to use JUST enough paper around each Winter Hunt Gift, and now there's several hundred thousand yards leftover in the Royal Wrapping Room.

name: Mini Fighter Jet
description:
Zoooom! Pshaoowwww! Chka-chka-chka-chka-BOOOAAAMMMMM!

Oh man, this is the coolest little jet! It makes real sounds and has little light-up LEDs all over it, and it's got eyes and teeth and it's gonna bite 'cha!

Nyarm nyarm nyarm!

name: Nutcracker
description: The winter holidays are the time of year to put out that festive bowl of nuts with the trusty nutcracker beside it.  Few things are more cheerful than cracking a couple walnuts with a brightly-painted nutcracker!

name: Tree Snowglobe
description: Warm your heart by shaking up this snowglobe and watching the snow fall down around the festive decorated tree!

name: Your Tiny Derpicorn
description:
♫ Your Tiny Derpicooorn, Your Tiny Derpicooorn... ♫

Okay, so it's not a Real Live Pony, but it's certainly a really cool little toy! With her fully-posable head and brushable hair, you can have hours of fun, uh... posing and... brushing... Yeah.

Brush not included. Brushie, brushie.

name: Moon Mobile Parts
description:
All little Albert wanted was the moon. Unfortunately, he couldn't have the moon for obvious reasons, and Moon Cheese is known to have pretty serious side-effects. This Moon Mobile is a safe and pretty alternative that's sure to cheer him up!

Collect 10 Moon Mobile Parts to build this toy!

name: Raygun Parts
description:
Since real laser guns don't actually exist (and if they did, they'd be a massive safety issue), hopefully this Toy Raygun will cheer Albert up and satisfy his long-repressed childhood desires.

Collect 10 Raygun Parts to build this toy!

name: Robot Parts
description:
Every kid wants a real robot. Well, most kids. Okay, some kids. Still, getting one is a tall order, especially since the only robots that exist are the kind that build cars in factories, and that's not usually what kids are looking for.

However, this Toy Robot should be more in line with what little Albert was looking for, and should bring a bright little smile to his face!

Collect 10 Robot Parts to build this toy!

name: Toy Dragon Parts
description:
Who's the coolest mouse?

"Dragon Mouse!"

Who's got real* Fire-Breath Action?

"Dragon Mouse!"

Who's the affordably-priced toy that all the kids want this year?

"Dragon Mouse!"

Kids, this year, ask your parents for...

"Dragon Mouse!"

Because you might not get anything else!

Collect 10 Toy Dragon Parts to build this toy!

name: Ball and Cup Parts
description:
The traditional ball and cup is known world-wide for providing several seconds worth of fun per child, per year. Little Albert never got his when he asked, and while he really wasn't missing out on much, hopefully it'll warm big Al's heart to get one, even all these years later.

Collect 10 Ball and Cup Parts to build this toy!

name: Scarf Parts
description:
When all is said and done, what you need comes above what you want. And staying warm in the cold chill of winter is extra-important. Without it, your tiny little heart could freeze, and that could have long-term repercussions. Why, you might forget about the magic of the season entirely, becoming a greedy and impulsive meanie, placing yourself above all other and...

Wait... Oh no! That poor little mouse. This explains everything!

Hopefully this Toasty Scarf can finally warm his heart and remind him why giving is better than getting this year.

Collect 10 Scarf Parts to build this toy!

name: Wrapped Gift Trap
description: This carefully-prepared pile of gifts can be dangerous as all heck to any mice that happen to tip it over, but that's not its true purpose!  With any luck, you can attract Greedy Al to your trap to receive his gifts, and show him the true spirit of the season!

name: Winter Hunt Theme
description: An icy theme only available to hunters who have shown their dedication during the Great Winter Hunt!

name: New Year's Party Ball
description:
Ring in the New Year with this party-packed party ball!

Contains 200 SUPER|brie+ and 100 Confetti. That stuff gets stuck on EVERYTHING!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Dark Chest
description: An old satchel, torn and stained.  You wouldn't expect much of it, except that its owner protected it so viciously!

name: Scarab Chest
description: Composed of carved gold and hand-selected giant flakes of scarab chitin, this chest protects a royal treasure indeed!

name: Shattered Chest
description:
OPEN WITH CARE.

This box is held together with Rift energy and is exceptionally dangerous if not handled carefully.

name: Aromatic Oil
description: This sweet-smelling oil is produced from an exceptionally rare plant, and thus is typically restricted for royalty or other such important persons.  As such, incredibly powerful mice are irresistibly drawn to it.

name: Living Garden Theme Scrap I
description: This scrap, when combined with two other similar scraps, comprise the Living Garden Theme - a theme that only the fiercest Living Garden hunters will be able to display!

name: Living Garden Theme Scrap II
description: This scrap, when combined with two other similar scraps, comprise the Living Garden Theme - a theme that only the fiercest Living Garden hunters will be able to display!

name: Living Garden Theme Scrap III
description: This scrap, when combined with two other similar scraps, comprise the Living Garden Theme - a theme that only the fiercest Living Garden hunters will be able to display!

name: Rift Base Blueprints
description:
Inscribed on these blueprints with an ink only visible by the light of the fading moon is a detailed description of how to harness Rift energy into a solid base with hidden powers.

Combine these blueprints with three different but powerful forms of Rift energy to craft this base.

This base requires the rank of Baron/Baroness or higher.

name: Rift Crystal
description:
Rift energy changes what it comes in contact with. In the Garden, it empowers small plants and seeds, charging them with powerful energy. Rarely, it can even empower tiny stones, causing them to grow into beautiful and useful crystals.

Correctly harnessing this crystal's energy could lead to incredibly powerful equipment.
obtain_hint: Hunt King Scarab in the Sand Crypts

name: Rift Mist
description:
The Rift between our world and the next is rarely visible, but when dew or droplets form near it, the energy of the Rift can charge it and transform it into a subtly-glowing, powerful mist.

Correctly harnessing this mist's energy could lead to incredibly powerful equipment.
obtain_hint: Hunt Shattered Carmine in the Twisted Garden

name: Rift Stars
description:
Exceptionally observant people will notice tiny spots of light drifting around the places where the Rift mingles with the world. This lantern is powered by those tiny spots of light, but there's far more energy contained within than necessary for just a simple lantern.

Correctly harnessing the energy of these stars could lead to incredibly powerful equipment.
obtain_hint: Hunt Dark Magi in the Cursed City

name: Completed Living Garden Theme
description: This theme was been carefully reassembled from three tattered scraps, themselves recovered from three incredibly powerful and covetous mice.  Hunters displaying this theme can do so proudly, knowing they are some of the fiercest hunters to ever hunt in the Living Garden.

name: Rift Base
description:
Formed from the very stuff of the Rift between this world and the next, nobody is quite certain of the true powers of this base. It seems to augment most traps well enough, but there is definitely something more to be discovered here.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Living Garden, Lost City, or Sand Dunes Trapsmith

name: Shattering Charm
description:
Powerful essences and aromas combine to create this charm, attracting the most powerful beings in the Living Garden and beyond.

In the Twisted Garden, this charm will attract an over-charged mouse with a predilection for Lunaria.

In the Sand Crypts, a monstrous and over-evolved mouse can be seen in the deepest and most violent sandstorms. This mouse is immensely powerful, so great care and preparation should be taken before engaging.

The Cursed City is the domain of a powerful and ancient Magi mouse, rumoured to be the cause of the city's curses. Regardless, he can never be caught with the curses still in effect.

Since you won't be able to augment your trap with another charm when taking on these powerful mice, make sure you have the strongest traps possible available to you before attempting to take them on!

name: Ultimate Charm
description:
Careful... Careful... This charm is humming and vibrating with energy, and the slightest disturbance may - or may not - cause it to pop!

With this charm equipped, you will catch the very next mouse you encounter - guaranteed! What's not guaranteed is if it's consumed or not. Sometimes the vibrations of your trap will set it off and it will dissipate into the ether, and sometimes... not!

Being very hard and expensive to acquire, you'll want to save these charms for a special occasion. But hey, if a mouse ever looks at you funny, you can break out this charm and wipe that grin right off its face!

name: Plankrun's Dark Magi Notes
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
Currently just outside the Lost City. It looks blurry and ethereal. I guess that when Zugzwang cast his spell it affected the entire city and it is staying that way.
I have managed to make it into the city's centre, I think I am in a throne room, it is a garish room that does not befit the rest of the city. I have managed to set up a formidable defense so I should be able to look around for a while without the haunting mice interfering.
I have found something. A journal of the ruler of this city. The journal seems to be the mad ramblings of an insane man but I have pieced together what I believe the history of this city is.
A long time ago this was the city of Longhorn, it was founded by a great builder. She cherished her people and gave everything she had to them. Together they built a beautiful city and for many years it was a wonderful thriving land. The owner of this journal was the brother of this great ruler and was a very petty, jealous man. He coveted wealth and power above all. He felt that the riches of the city rightfully belonged to those who ruled it.
One night the greedy brother went deep into the desert to commune with a Dark Magi who promised him leadership of the city. A dark deed was done and…
page_text_back:
the noble sister fell ill and soon passed away, leaving the city's rule to him. The brother did everything in his power to take the city's wealth for his own. The inhabitants did not stand for this tyranny and shortly after entirely left the city. They travelled to Muridae where they built a huge garden unlike any other to honour the great builder. This sacred garden was said to be blessed by the spirit of the builder, as the plants that grew there were magical and unlike any that had ever been seen.
The evil brother, abandoned, lost everything he had and as he too tried to leave the city he learned what a terrible fate he had set for himself. The dark pact that brought him the throne had also cursed him to forever rule over the city and its inhabitants, never to leave. Shortly after he found himself trapped and alone, his new residents appeared before him. Mice and lots of them. For many years the brother ruled over a city of mice. He went mad, commanding the mice to gather the garden essence in order to use it's power to curse anyone that came near the city and eventually to try and spread it to the world beyond. Though he may have passed, the mice still seem to be attempting to bring about his dark wishes.
A grim history indeed.

name: Plankrun's King Scarab Notes
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
After finding the mad journal in the Lost City, I returned to Muridae to share my findings with Zugzwang and the Muridae council. Knowing now what we do about the world beyond the rift, Zugzwang and I believe that the Dark Magi was a mouse granted immense power directly from an aspect from the world beyond our own.
We discussed the history of this land and some elders pointed me in the direction of the Sand Crypts. The place that their noble builder was laid to rest.
It took me forever to find the entrance to the crypt. This place clearly hasn't been visited by a human in quite a while. The entrance was well hidden, nearly entirely lost to the desert sandstorms, it's almost like this place did not want to be found.
Definitely the most daunting crypt I have ever seen, not that I have been in very many crypts. Still, this is a formidable structure deep under the desert, well protected by the elements and built to last. Unfortunately it seems that not even this hidden place is free from the rodents that plague our world. Mice can be heard scampering all about the place. Time to catch a few and see what they're up to!
page_text_back:
Not what I had expected. There is a strange hierarchy established here. One grub mouse rises to power while it's siblings hatch into scarab mice and help gather food for their ruler. The grub king is fed well to grow big and strong for as long as it can. When it can hold off no more it finally transforms and becomes a great warrior scarab mouse and is quickly replaced by the next grubling.
These mice appear to have legends etched into their walls. One legend is about a grubling who had such an appetite that it consumed the rocks and the sand until the crypt nearly crumbled, it had to be driven off. It supposedly chewed a tunnel far to the north east and was never heard of again. Another legend is about one of the rulers who has yet to come. It is said that he will eat the magic from the garden and grow so large as to fill the entire crypt. On it's hatching day he will wreak havoc upon the whole world and becomes it's new master.
I wonder if there must be a tear in the rift near here that has caused these mice to transform in such a weird way?
Well, I fear I have seen enough. I should go before they find me and try to make me into the next grubling feast!

name: Plankrun's Rift Notes 1
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's Rift Notes.
page_text_front:
We are just leaving a city called Muridae, it is a fortress with a grand holy garden. Zugzwang having investigated the garden did not appear at all convinced that the grounds were actually holy, instead he was more on edge than usual, muttering cryptic thoughts to himself. He mentioned something about an epicenter within the garden but as soon as Zugzwang started tearing plants out by their roots and plucking the holy glowing flowers we were rather forcefully removed from the premises and told we were to leave the city at once.
I am not entirely sure what Zugzwang is looking for so far out into the desert but he claims what we find might reveal secrets as to why the mice have transformed. He believes a great disturbance is hidden here. I expect we will find the worst. For now, we have decided to press deeper into the desert. I can only hope that our armament will be enough to counter what we will find out there. Thankfully there has been no signs of mice yet.
page_text_back:
After a long trek, we have happened upon an abandoned city. Zugzwang warns that there is a powerful evil presence here, a dark magic looming over the entire city.
We have scouted this lost city and have discovered it to be completely overrun with malicious mice and incredibly dark magics. Zugzwang is currently preparing a powerful counter-spell, he says that if he can get through their magics he might be able to see if there is a breach here. I am not sure that I rightly know what he is talking about but from what I understand he seems to believe there are holes in the fabric of our reality that lead to other places, scary places.
I may not have traveled with him long but I trust and will stand by Zugzwang. He has been an incredible help in my fight against the mice and I dare say that without his genius, I would not have made it this far. I must go now to check on my trap and help Zugzwang with the last of his preparations. I do hope this counter-spell works, I must admit the evil here is almost palpable.

name: Plankrun's Rift Notes 2
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's Rift Notes.
page_text_front:
King, we have found it at last! The reason for the mice transformations, it has been under our noses the whole time. Zugzwang and I just survived the craziest journey we've had yet. I am not even clear on how long we were on the other side, but it would seem we made it back and have not been followed, I must write this all down while it is still clear.
Before I share my journey, above all else this must be understood, this is the information that we have been looking for; there is a world just beyond our own. Another dimension touching our own, it bleeds its power into our world and that energy shapes and transforms the mice here.
It was somewhat of an unexpected discovery, Zugzwang had attempted to dispel the magics engulfing the city, however there were actually no spells to counter, instead it was a dark and sinister curse. Zugzwang's powerful counterspell reacted to the curse in a very unpredictable way and everything touched by the curse was banished into a realm between our reality and this other world Zugzwang was looking for.
page_text_back:
Very quickly Zugzwang and I found ourselves marooned in a very uncomfortable place. Thankfully I had the arcane traps that Zugzwang had designed for me as I very quickly realized that my other traps could no longer touch the mice of this 'shifted' plane.
We skirmished through the city, constantly aware that there were dark entities after us. Zugzwang managed to locate a tear in the fabric of this realm and pull us both through it. As we passed through the veil, the ghostly world seemed to melt around us and became a solid world again, solid and very, very sinister. I wanted to tell myself we were back in the lost city but my sense knew better, this was the other side. We had found the veil beyond our world. An alternate dimension!
Cold and unwelcoming, we wasted little time in this area. Zugzwang had confirmed his suspicions and we were off. Traveling through this dimension felt like we were moving through a dense storm but each step took us leaps and bounds.

name: Plankrun's Rift Notes 3
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's Rift Notes.
page_text_front:
Eager to leave this realm before we met anything that lived here, we used one of the garden essence Zugzwang had plucked to lead us back into the Garden, or at least a twisted version of it.
It was so clear now, there was a bright gaping tear right in the center of the garden. A point between our worlds weakened so much that a rip formed in our reality and this universe was spilling into our own.
I will never forget what Zugzwang said to me: "We have discovered it, a potential source of the transformation in the mice across Gnawnia. This isn't the only tear like this Plankrun. I have detected traces of them all over the land. These rifts are where their powers are coming from, the energy of this world bleeds into our own, transforming the mice. There are great entities in here with us working to weaken the veil, I can sense them and they hunger to get out. We can not let this happen Plankrun, these aspects can influence the mice by sending their power through the weakened areas but they cannot get through. They must never get through or they could be the end of our world."
page_text_back:
Zugzwang then pulled out several small stones with strange etchings on them and threw them through the rift. There was a bright flash, a loud screeching noise and once again the world melted and twisted around me. I woke up in a pile of the glowing flowers, we had made it through the breach back to our world.
We were discovered by the garden guards and escorted from the 'Holy' grounds again, this time by spear point. I write this now waiting to be called on trial at the Muridae courts, hopefully our credentials will be enough to convince them that we meant no harm to their precious garden and that they have a much bigger problem on their hands.
Thankfully the councilors at Muridae were willing to listen to reason. For now they have locked down the garden and are having Zugzwang look into if the rift can be sealed. While he is doing that I have decided I will look around, see if I can find out anything more about what happened here.

name: Plankrun's Shattered Carmine Notes 1
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
It would seem I returned at a rather practical time. Zugzwang apparently needs my help with closing the rift in the middle of the Living Garden. By traveling through and closing it from the inside we can keep it sealed so that nothing can get in or out, he doubts that we will be able to seal it fully but this should prevent it from becoming a bigger problem. He also predicts that he knows of an exit point that we might be able to use.
As the garden itself stays intact the seal should hold. Thankfully the people of Muridae are very protective of their land so it will be safe. It would take a massive army with an ensemble of artillery and magic to damage the work Zugzwang has done here.
Zugzwang warns me that what we might encounter in the other world is likely to be more than my Gnawnian traps can handle. He had harnessed the powers leaking through the veil to create a beautiful base for me. He cautions that even with it he doesn't expect we stand a chance against anything on the other side, so we best avoid any situations. We will be spending the next few days with our final preparations and then it will be time to take the journey to the other side once more.
page_text_back:
The preparations have now been completed. Zugzwang and I are ready to travel through the rift in the Living Garden to seal it closed behind us. I hope that we make it out the other side, journal and all. It would be just like me to lose part of my journal in another dimension! Hah.
We have passed through and are now in the alternate world. Zugzwang warns that there might be an Aspect nearby so we are currently hiding to see if we can see anything pass by.
My eyes may have deceived me, but I believe I saw a creature of pure energy harvesting plants, grinding them into each other and creating various potions and poutrices. Zugzwang believed it to be the aspect of the apothecary. It would explain why this being is attracted to this location or perhaps why there are so many twisted plants here. I don't know why but it feels almost like this creature is whispering to me, promising me it can teach me how to heal all illness if only I give into it. Something like this could be a very large threat to anyone weak of will or in need. I doubt it intends to help anyone but itself.

name: Plankrun's Shattered Carmine Notes 2
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
We stayed hidden long enough for the creature to finally wander away and then quickly took care of sealing the tear. We think we closed it up quite well. It shouldn't be a problem now. We're heading off to find our exit plan now, hopefully we don't get lost in here. This place makes my skin crawl, not to mention I feel like this reality is constantly trying to push me out yet we cannot seem to leave so easily.
Sealing off rifts to protect our world is fine by me so long as it means I don't have to hunt these things. I just don't even know if it could be possible!
We've traveled for a while and came upon a strange clearing, in the center is a small robed mouse communing with something entirely unholy. The fact that there is a mouse in this realm is extremely disturbing, it seems they have managed to find a way through the veil but also means that we must be close to our exit. The little mouse who I will call the Acolyte seemed to be taking commands from its master. If I were to describe this 'Master' you could take all of the terror a nightmare gives you, compress that and you would only get this thing's toenail. Having seen enough, we fled before we were noticed.
page_text_back:
I may have had a true wizard at my side but he clearly didn't think it was a good idea to stick around either. Hopefully we find this exit fast!
Success! We've managed to find our exit and travel through. Back in Gnawnia now, or supposedly we are, it's a little hard to tell what with being stuck inside this dense grove. It seems that we will have to return here very soon to see what we can do about this rift. Zugzwang mentioned that due to the properties of the tear he may be able to make it into a portal we could control. For now we've put up some wards and are about to head back to report our findings to you King.
Wait. What is that? It sounds like something is trying to come through the rift...

name: Cozy Cruise Gift Basket
description:
A huggably soft gift basket perfect for giving to friends this Lunar New Year. The wrapping paper is made of cozy blankets!

Inside you'll find:
• 100 SUPER|brie+
• 35 Firecracker Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Cruise Commander Crate
description:
Command your perfect cruise ship experience with this crate of explosive gear, fully stocked with everything needed to celebrate the Lunar New Year!

Inside you'll find:
• 250 SUPER|brie+
• 100 Firecracker Charms
• 15 Nitropop Potions

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Party Cracker
description:
What fun! A crackly, snappy, poppy party cracker! Full of good fun and great toys and prizes, these little party favours will lighten the mood at any party.

Snap it open to collect fancy charms and a dashing party crown!

name: Acolyte Realm Souvenir
description:
This spoon is entirely decorative. It's important to understand and obey this warning, because those who don't are in danger of being hypnotized permanently during use.

In fact? Consider hiding this spoon in the back of a drawer. One you don't use much. Then glue it shut.

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Acolyte Realm section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Captain's Hat
description:
This fancy-shmancy hat proves that the wearer is a true Cruise Captain and has completed a full Cozy Cruise. Also, it just looks swell with pretty much any outfit.

Complete a full cruise on Calamity Carl's Cruise in 2013 to obtain this hat and gain access to all the great items in the ship's Shops!

name: Digby Lab Souvenir
description:
Ever wanted to scare the pants off your friends? Try drinking strange-coloured liquids out of this glass in front of them! Hilarity guaranteed to ensue!

(Bring spare pants.)

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Digby & Lab section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Explosion Earmuffs
description:
These stylish earmuffs go well with any outfit, with the added benefit that they protect your ears from the CONSTANT BARRAGE OF FIRECRACKERS while on Calamity Carl's Cruise!

If guests ever expect to get any shut-eye they might need a pair of these. These earmuffs are so soft you will want to sleep with them on!

Just don't expect to be able to hear the dinner bell in the morning, most people on the cruise seem to miss it...

name: Gnawnian Shoreline Souvenir
description:
Welcome to Gnawnia, where everyone is a closet cheese junkie! Okay, maybe not a closet junkie. Honestly, most everyone's pretty open about it.

Hey, you got any cheese on ya?

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Gnawnian Shoreline section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Harbour Souvenir
description:
Is your keychain missing that certain something? Is that something that it's missing "an unreasonably heavy and surprisingly sharp miniature anchor"? Well, then have we got a souvenir for you!

Remember your trip to Gnawnia's Harbour with every painful step you take!

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Harbour section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Iceberg Souvenir
description:
The only water better-tasting than fresh spring water is fresh iceberg water, collected by melting a chunk of fresh iceberg into a steam-sterilized bottle. (The steam also comes from iceberg water.)

And while double-blind taste tests have shown that most people can't tell the difference between freshly-squozen iceberg water and boring old filtered water, we know that you'll know, and that'll make all the difference.

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Iceberg section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Snake Mask
description:
This Lunar New Year, the Water Snake comes out in full force! And poor Calamity Carl just had no idea they would cause so much trouble!

Celebrate their arrival with this mask! The fangs REALLY WORK*!

*WARNING: EXTREME VENOM HAZARD. DO NOT ACTUALLY WEAR MASK.

name: S. S. Huntington III Souvenir
description:
Calamity Carl would like to apologize for the lack of bottle included in this ship in a bottle. New recycling guidelines and all, you understand.

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the S. S. Huntington III section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Torn Party Crown
description:
Aw man! It's impossible to get these things out of the party cracker without tearing them!

May as well wear it anyway...

name: Tribal Isles Souvenir
description:
Determined hunters can spend months slogging through the Tribal Isles, frantically searching among the foliage for scattered pepper seeds. You can pick up a bag of Tribal Trail Mix and ah, "fondly remember" those times while munching on these brightly-painted sunflower seeds.

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Tribal Isles section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Zugzwang Island Souvenir
description:
These adorable pawn salt'n'pepper shakers are a fantastic addition to any table set. For further hilarity, consider putting salt in the black shaker, and pepper in the white shaker!

Oh, you crazy party animal, you!

This souvenir can be found randomly on mice during the Zugzwang Island section of the cruise, or in the ship's shoppe.

name: Cruise Bux
description: All kinds of fantastic items are for sale in the ship's shoppe, but you'll need to accrue Cruise Bux before you can purchase them.  Collect them as celebration for visiting new areas of Gnawnia on the cruise, or also from mischievous mice who keep running off with the stuff!

name: Snake Jade Base
description:
Calamity Carl commissioned this base to celebrate the Year of the Snake Festival, and by pure coincidence has hired the same Trapsmith from last year. This year's carvings carry similar magic to last year, though the power of the Snake manifests as a love bite for extra attraction!

Only hunters who have helped Carl complete a full cruise in 2013 and saved up sufficient Cruise Bux will be able to have their Jade Base carved into this attractive and fantastic base!

name: S.A.M. F.E.D. DN-5
description:
The S.A.M. F.E.D. DN-5 (Sweets Assaulting Mice Flavour Explosion Device), codenamed "Date Night 5", is a highly-experimental military-grade trap, developed by the scientists of Digby. Comprised mostly of "chocolate", this seemingly-innocent box of sweets will tempt mice with its sugary scent, then bombard them with bonbons when they come into close proximity.

Hunters are warned to NOT eat the chocolate in this trap: It is highly toxic and very little of it is actually edible.

name: Snakebite Charm
description:
Lighting these fireworks produces not just a hiss, but a warning rattle as well. That's your signal to run way, way back!

When they go off, they fly high up in the air in a serpentine motion, before exploding in two sharp, biting pops to form the "head" of the snake.

While using these on Calamity Carl's Cruise, the ship will have its speed boosted to MAXIMUM, moving the cruise along at 25 KM per mouse catch!

name: Snakebite Potion
description:
Please do not look directly into the glowing blue liquid inside of this vial without proper UV protection in a well-ventilated area. Snakebite Potion venom is extremely toxic and leads to complete, permanent, and immediate paralysis upon mere olfactorial, visual, or auditory exposure.

Use on 1 Nitropop Charm to convert it into 1 Snakebite Charm.

name: Chocolate Covered Reaper's Perch Skin
description: Perched atop Monolith Slabs, the deadly Reaper Droid gazes through smoke awaiting prey. Upon bait being lifted from the stone plate, the runic glyphs begin to glow, mesmerizing the mouse into a state of anhedonia, allowing the droid to descend upon the mouse with little resistance. Where the rodent goes once taken by the droid is up to the will of the hunter.
marketing_text: 'Slathered in chocolate.' These were the words given to the chocolateer tasked with decorating the Reaper's Perch. And it looks like a little romance was worked into the new design, as well. How lovely!

name: Birthday Party Pack
description:
This party box is filled with fun goodies to celebrate MouseHunt's 5th Birthday!

Inside you'll find 105 SUPER|brie+ and 25 Party Charms.

Buy one and give it to a friend!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Super MechaParty Box
description:
This robotic box is geared up to really celebrate MouseHunt's 5th Birthday and help hunters SAVE RONZA!

Inside you'll find 455 SUPER|brie+ and 75 Party Charms!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: The Fifth Birthday Gifth
description:
The King hired the finest wordsmiths to come up with the perfect name for a gift to celebrate the very special 5th birthday of MouseHunt. This is the best they could do.

Bad rhymes aside, I wonder what's inside...

name: Isle Idol Box Set
description:
Inside this brightly-coloured box is a novel trap and a collection of extra-special skins. Arm this trap in the Tribal Isles and mice will drop double the Seashells, Delicious Stones, and Savoury Vegetables! But wait, there's more!

When you swap skins on the trap, your trap will magically alter its power type and power to better suit the area you're targeting. With this one trap, you can be the apex hunter in Nerg, Derr, and Elub!

name: Blue Double Dewdrop Powder
description: Sprinkle a little bit of this powder on two Aleth Essences and combine the whole mixture in a Flawless Orb to create a Double Sponge Charm, capable of soaking up two blue dewdrops in the Living Garden at a time!

name: Chrome MonstroBot Upgrade Kit
description:
At the risk of plunging the entire world into a terrible chrome shortage, Ronza has brought this - the absolute ultimate in both physical and chrome traps - to Gnawnia to help fight the good fight. But when she's gone, so too is this upgrade kit, at least until she can scrape together enough chrome to offer it again!

To craft, just take the smashed parts of your Sandstorm Monstrobot and combine (carefully) with this kit. Make sure you follow instructions precisely, as this is a one-way process and you want to make sure you don't have the hyper-chrinolizer on backwards when you're done!

Use this kit with MonstroBot Trap Parts to create:
Chrome MonstroBot
What do you get when you take the incredible ancient technology of the Sandstorm MonstroBot and couple it with the very latest modernizations, then dip the whole thing in a huge vat of molten chrome?

You get this absolutely gorgeous monstrosity...
    Power: 8500
    Power Bonus: 22%
    Attraction Bonus: 10%
    Luck: 30
    Power Type: Physical
    Title Required: Baron/Baroness
    Cheese Effect: No Effect
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Ronza's Traveling Shoppe Trapsmith

name: Extra Coarse Salt
description:
This salt is so coarse, it can't be served for polite company. This salt rocks. It's really rough finding any of this salt. This salt, ah, uh, er, okay, salt jokes are hard to make.

Sprinkle a little bit of this salt on two Ber Essences and combine the whole mixture in a Divine Orb to create a Super Salt Charm, which counts for double the hunts against the King Grub Mouse in the Sand Crypts.

The humour sure dissolved there, huh?

Ahem.

name: Red Double Dewdrop Powder
description: Sprinkle a little bit of this powder on two Ber Essences and combine the whole mixture in a Divine Orb to create a Red Double Sponge Charm, capable of soaking up two red dewdrops in the Living Garden at a time!

name: Sandstorm MonstroBot Parts
description: The MontroBot is now a monstrous pile of parts.

name: Yellow Double Dewdrop Powder
description: Sprinkle a little bit of this powder on two Ber Essences and combine the whole mixture in a Divine Orb to create a Yellow Double Dewdrop Charm, capable of soaking up two yellow dewdrops in the Living Garden at a time!

name: Force Fighter Blue Action Figure
description:
Oh wow, these... These aren't particularly well-made action figures, are they? The paint's not quite the right colour, the male bodies and the female bodies are exactly the same, they're missing critical costume features, and - ow! That's a splinter!

I guess the reason the Mouse Force Five have so many of these on-hand is that nobody will buy them.
