name: Burroughs Rift Theme Scrap I
description: Collect and wire up all three scraps of the Burroughs Rift Theme to cybernetically enhance your journal!

name: Burroughs Rift Theme Scrap II
description: Collect and wire up all three scraps of the Burroughs Rift Theme to cybernetically enhance your journal!

name: Burroughs Rift Theme Scrap III
description: Collect and wire up all three scraps of the Burroughs Rift Theme to cybernetically enhance your journal!

name: Calcified Rift Mist
description:
The mists of the Rift permeate deep within all Rift mice. Catching a Rift mouse with a Rift Vacuum Charm coaxes out a small amount of that mist and calcifies it into a solid form, which can then be safely collected.

This crunchy, crusty, crackly calcification can then be used to craft powerful Rift items to turn the tables on those malicious mice!

name: Erupting Rift Core
description:
An explosive, swirling, singularity of energy contained within a particle barrier. A major ingredient for crafting powerful rift charms.

CAUTION: This material may violently react with matter from our dimension, including with hunter hands! In order to safely handle this material, a hunter must first obtain the protection of a Null Gauntlet.

name: Shattered Rift Crystal
description:
A smashed, refined rift focus crystal. Due to the strange physics laws surrounding the rift, it is easily able to be reassembled.

An essential component needed to craft powerful Rift traps.

name: Burroughs Rift Journal Theme
description: Show off your dedication to rift hunting with this cybernetic journal theme!

name: Contaminated Crumb Cake
description: A crumbly slice of toxically topped cheese cake.  Petrified by pollution!

name: Crystallized Fossil
description: A faded crystallized amber containing a strange, unknown mouse fossil.  Could this be one of the first mice that ever existed?

name: Optic Receiver
description: A replacement part for cyborgs with damaged eyesight.  Never leave home without a few spares!

name: The Red Button
description: Under lock and double key, this remote Red Button looks very important and ominous.  Try as you might, you can't find a way to unlock it so you can press it.

name: Null Gauntlet
description:
This metallic glove fairly hums with power, though it doesn't seem to exude power so much as consume it. Lights dim when brought near, electronics flicker, fires gutter and die.

This item is the only known method of safely handling Rift Charms without being consumed by their strange and terrible powers.
obtain_hint: Hunt Menace of the Rift mice in the Burroughs Rift

name: Rift Circuitry
description: Alternate reality circuitry from the Rift. This circuit board is almost alien in comparison to known technology found in Gnawnia. It is essential in Rift-based machinery!
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Burroughs Rift or the Furoma Rift

name: Focused Crystal Laser
description:
By combining the altered high technology scavenged from the most powerful Burroughs Rift mice and the remains of a smashed Crystal Tower, Digby scientists have learned how to focus Rift Power into a terrible laser beam capable of bringing the fight to the Rift mice like never before!

By focusing all the Crystal Laser technology into a single beam, the most power possible can be directed at a single target. This trap's high power combines exceptionally well with the Rift Power Charm's power bonus, and makes this trap fantastic for catching tougher Rift mice, though it suffers slightly against the remainder of the weaker, sneakier Rift mice.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Multi-Crystal Laser
description:
Take a smashed Crystal Tower, add a healthy collection of high technology scavenged from the most powerful Burroughs Rift mice, sprinkle with a dollop of Digby ingenuity, and what do you get? Terrifying Crystal Laser technology that brings Rift Power traps to the next level!
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Polluted Parmesan Cheese
description: Pulsating with green radioactive goo, the soft glow is surprisingly soothing.  Pungently sweet with the most toxic of aromas, the toxic mice of the Burroughs Rift find it intoxicating.

name: Terre Ricotta Cheese
description: Rough and robust.  Tough in texture with an added accent of tasty topsoil.  Demanded by the Digby-like mice of the Burroughs Rift.

name: Rift Power Charm
description:
Equip this charm and you'll experience real, rifty power. Witness the swirling energies barely contained within and marvel! Also, handle carefully! You don't want to drop it - who knows what would happen if it were to shatter while not carefully armed on a trap?
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Rift Vacuum Charm
description:
If it weren't for the fact that it actually, physically exists, nobody would believe such a charm possible. It appears to be composed of some form of rift antimatter and is constantly drawing energy from any rift source it comes near. When catching a Rift mouse with this charm armed, a tiny piece of Calcified Rift Mist may be created, which can be useful for crafting ever more powerful rift charms!

CAUTION: This charm may violently react with matter from our dimension, including with hunter hands! In order to safely handle this charm, a hunter must first obtain the protection of a Null Gauntlet.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Polluted Parmesan Potion
description: A soft, warm, radioactive glow emanates from this stagnant solution.  Pour this over your String cheese and be repulsed with the foul results of some Polluted Parmesan cheese!

name: Terre Ricotta Potion
description: Pouring this viscous concoction over your String cheese will erupt in a violent quake revealing some dirty and delicious Terre Ricotta Cheese.

name: 2014 Pumpkin Treat Basket
description: There's sure to be a Halloween treat in this spooky basket!

name: Charming Study Research Assignment
description: This envelope contains a study to be completed concerning the charms found in the Spooky Sandcastle and the mice they belong to.

name: Extra Spooky Research Assignment
description: This envelope contains a an Extra Spooky research assignment! The spookiest mice of the Spooky Sandcastle.  Be Warned:  The power of the Skello-ton Base is required to finish this assignment.

description:
A creepy bag of haunting charms! For those looking to make quicker work of the Spooky Sandcastle!

name: Two Oxygen Canisters
description: Two canisters of purified oxygen. These allow hunters to safely explore the depths of the ocean surrounding the Sunken City.

name: Spooky Halloween Theme Scrap I
description: Collect and combine all three scraps of this Spooky Halloween theme to secure your journal from scary spirits!

name: Spooky Halloween Theme Scrap II
description: Collect and combine all three scraps of this Spooky Halloween theme to secure your journal from scary spirits!

description: Collect and combine all three scraps of this Spooky Halloween theme to secure your journal from scary spirits!

name: Completed Spooky Halloween Theme
description: Sanctified gates upon consecrated hallowed ground makes the perfect resting place for your journal entries.  Great at keeping those pesky spirits out too!  Collect all three Spooky Halloween scraps to complete this theme!

name: Spooky Shuffle Ticket
description:
This admission ticket allows a hunter to make a card pair selection in the Spooky Shuffle. Flip two cards and see if they match!

Play the Spooky Shuffle now!

name: Mousataur Skull
description:
The skull of a fabled Mousataur! It even still has the horns on it! Sought after by hunters and trapsmiths alike for their incredible magical properties.

It is said that the longer the horns, the stronger the magic stored inside.

Take this to the local Trapsmith for appraisal and advice.

Once you've taken advantage of any deals from the Trapsmith, you can always smash this skull and recover a Cobweb!

name: Rift Candy
description:
Rock hard candy shell with an oh-so-sweet trans-nougat centre! The swirling vortex of taste takes your tongue on a trans-dimensional trip to another dimension of taste! Literally!

This new candy is this year's hottest item of the season! The Shop Traders in the Spooky Sandcastle would most definitely be seeking this succulent treat for trade!

name: Skello-ton Base
description:
Yes, it's true that zombies possess an insatiable hunger for brains. Brains this, brains that, it's brains, brains, brains all the time! But after several huge meals of brains, a zombie's tastes begin to turn to dessert, and the discerning zombie longs for nothing more than that classic treat: Skell-O!

The Skello-ton Base is composed entirely of Skello, which will leave zombies' mouths watering. It's so jaw-droppingly good that the zombies will even forget to chew the brains in their mouths, letting them tumble to the ground instead. While definitely gross, this allows you to collect a portion of those Brain Bits for use in crafting Brain Charms.

Even more effective when paired with the Brain Extractor or Maniacal Brain Extractor weapons!

name: Candy Charm
description: This sweet candy treat is the top treat on every mouse's trick-or-treat wish list.

name: Super Spooky Charm
description:
These charms are super spooky and give your trap a nice little boost of power! Goes well with a Halloween trap skin and journal theme!

All types of Spooky Charms interact with all Halloween traps by giving them a 20% Power Bonus!

When a Super Spooky Charm is consumed during a hunt, there is a chance that the residual spiritual energy has unfinished business and rematerializes into a stronger Extreme Spooky Charm!

name: Shortcut Charm
description:
These specialty charms are highly sought after during the Halloween season. This year these charms help you to quickly navigate through the nightmarish Spooky Sandcastle.

Using a Shortcut Charm used to advance you an extra space forward while hunting at the Spooky Sandcastle.

name: Super Brain Charm
description:
Jam-packed full of more delicious brains than previously possible, this charm greatly increases the chance to encounter a zombie while hunting in some of the more spooky locations across the kingdom, plus it offers handy Power, Attraction, and Luck bonuses!

Mmm, such brains!

name: Charming Study Research Assignment
description: Collect data on the new charms and charm carriers that have ventured into the Spooky Sandcastle.

name: Extra Spooky Research Assignment
description: Collect data on the new charms and charm carriers that have ventured into the Spooky Sandcastle.  Be warned: Only hunters with the rank Count/Countess and up alongside the power of the Skello-ton Base can finish this assignment.

name: All Seeing Eye Skin
description: By combining the altered high technology scavenged from the most powerful Burroughs Rift mice and the remains of a smashed Crystal Tower, Digby scientists have learned how to focus Rift Power into a terrible laser beam capable of bringing the fight to the Rift mice like never before!
marketing_text: The all seeing eye with its burning gaze rests atop its twisted throne.  This spire draws its powers from the evil parts of the Rift where many do not dare to tread.  Some believe it is where the souls of the dead rest.  The rift crystal orbs act as a gateway providing some strange creature the ability to glimpse through them and allow it to reach out from wherever it resides with its fantastic powers.

name: Haunted Spires Skin
description: Take a smashed Crystal Tower, add a healthy collection of high technology scavenged from the most powerful Burroughs Rift mice, sprinkle with a dollop of Digby ingenuity, and what do you get?  Terrifying Crystal Laser technology that brings Rift Power traps to the next level!
marketing_text: Sitting atop the graves of fallen heroes, these pumpkins act as focusing devices that allow the souls buried underneath to channel their powers outwards.  Burning with anger? desire for revenge? or a sense of justice whose light changes those it touches to good?  Perhaps it is determined by the spirit of the hunter who wields it?

name: Molten Oasis Trap Skin
description:
Like a dragon protecting its massive hoard of treasure, the phantasm in this Chrome version of the Phantasmic Oasis Trap is obsessed with guarding its new-found wealth. The Chrome has blinded it with greed and its anger toward intruders knows no bounds. Even hunters fear placing this trap down as the phantasm will often snap its steely jaws at them, thinking the hunter is after the gold strewn around it.

Hunters can at least consider themselves lucky: The true target of this trap are the mice, and the phantasm will stop at nothing when it comes to safeguarding its treasure from unworthy opponents
marketing_text: Rage!  Boiling hot rage!  The phantasm within this trap has grown so angry at all of the mice that have slipped from its grasp, that it has quite literally boiled over, causing its chrome to melt.  A furious, fiery version of its former self, it vows to allow no further such trespasses!

name: Skeletal Rune Shark Trap Skin
description: The Sunken City's best line of defense now becomes one of your best weapons of offense!  Hidden behind a cleverly disguised rocky outcropping is a shark powered by re-oxygenating oxygen tanks! Triple the fins for triple the speed, racks on racks of razor sharp teeth coupled with a frickin' laser beam attached to its head!  Equipped with hover fins for equally effective use on land!
marketing_text:
Reanimated and ready to rumble! The Rune Shark weapon was modelled specifically after these ancient kings of the sea. Nothing beats the original, even in skeletal form!

Hydro mice beware, you're in for a scare!

name: The Spirit of Halloween Skin
description:
This highly unstable trap setup is held in a constant state of metamorphosis by the unpredictable power of the Onyx stone. This trap almost appears alive, growing metal roots into whatever base to which it is attached.



This trap's methods of capture are infinitely random. It can use its jagged metallic roots to impale mice, expel a thick and dark vapor that turns mice into stone, or bend space and time to erase the mouse from existence.



Scientists of Digby warn hunters that the power of the Onyx stone is incredibly dangerous and fear that using this trap could lead to the end of the world.
skin_weapon_name: Arcane Capturing Rod Of Never Yielding Mystery
marketing_text: Looks like a couple of Acronyms were left in the Pumpkin Patch over the years.  The result looks to have turned it into quite the spooky antenna.  Now channeling the spirits of the undead and halloween exclusively, it makes for quite the interesting sight to behold!

name: Gold Foil Mouse Statue
description:
A small mouse figurine wrapped in a solid gold foil. Much too valuable to open!

Wonder what mouse is inside...

name: Two Front Teeth
description: All that most hunters want for winter hunt are their two front teeth...  Well, how 'bout this pair of someone else's?  Only slightly used, too! Eww.

name: White Chocolate Snowman
description: This scrumptious little snowman is as delicious as it looks!  Consisting of creamy white chocolate with dark chocolate accents, this confection looks too good to eat!

name: Arctic Asiago Cheese
description:
Fermented in the frigid air of the arctic and frozen under a natural river of pure spring water, this cheese keeps fresh and cool under a hardened protective layer of ice.

The cheese has a slightly sweet and tangy taste to its crisp outer shell, giving off an irresistible aroma that can melt the tongue of even the coldest mice.

name: Winter Builder Charm
description:
A wintery charm of Great Winter Hunts past...

These charms can be smashed into Pecan Pecorino Cheese which attracts special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga!

name: Winter Hoarder Charm
description:
A wintery charm of Great Winter Hunts past...

These charms can be smashed into Pecan Pecorino Cheese which attracts special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga!

description:

Collect these bricks from the mice at the Festive Ice Fortress by equipping Arctic Asiago to capture the mice. Then, use them to build and upgrade an epic Ice Fortress!

name: Crystal Ice Tower Skin
description: By utilizing raw Rift crystals and advanced technology, intrepid hunters have attempted to create a trap capable of harnessing the indomitable powers of the Rift. Being such a foreign power, the trap is barely able to hold itself together, but thankfully it retains enough control to not immediately destroy itself and instead allows the hunter to focus its power to retain a hunting edge within this dangerous alien landscape.
marketing_text:
Clever Gnawnian Trap smiths have gotten their hands on some Ice and Tower bricks to create a new, Ice powered Crystal Tower Trap!

Powered by a specially frozen and repurposed Rift Crystal to harness some of the holiday spirit! Celebrate the Great Winter Hunt all year round in the rift with this must have holiday trap skin!

name: Winter Helper's Perch
description: Perched atop Monolith Slabs, the deadly Reaper Droid gazes through smoke awaiting prey. Upon bait being lifted from the stone plate, the runic glyphs begin to glow, mesmerizing the mouse into a state of anhedonia, allowing the droid to descend upon the mouse with little resistance. Where the rodent goes once taken by the droid is up to the will of the hunter.
marketing_text:
A winter helper all dressed up for the holiday season with what looks like a big bag of gifts... Or maybe its coal?
Well, the weary mouse who wakes up great winter morning and comes to this tree will know what's inside pretty quickly!

name: Sinister Winter Wreath Portal
description: Using technology developed in the Burroughs' Laboratory, this one-way portal into outer space waits at the end of a high-speed conveyor belt for an unsuspecting mouse.
marketing_text:
Commonly mistaken for the entrance to a Great Winter Hunt party, the music and finely decorated wreath trick even the sharpest of mice by preying on their holiday spirit!

A devious design by some crafty trapsmith!

name: Ice Fortress Pro Pack

description: A list of the nicest mice this winter that have warmed at least one other heart this season.  Tracking down all the mice on the list shouldn't be too tough.  Make sure you give each one a special pat on the back!

name: Iceball Brawl Theme Scrap I
description: Collect and pack these three scraps of the Iceball Brawl Theme together to freeze your journal!

name: Iceball Brawl Theme Scrap II
description: Collect and pack these three scraps of the Iceball Brawl Theme together to freeze your journal!

name: Iceball Brawl Theme Scrap III
description: Collect and pack these three scraps of the Iceball Brawl Theme together to freeze your journal!

name: Bigger, Golder Brick
description:
The plain, old gold brick is so last season! If your friend was really your friend, they would put their money where their mouth is and cough up the cash for this extravagant gift!

Made only from pre-processed Gnawnian gold coins and Magic Essence from the Kings private stores! Extremely valuable indeed!

name: Raw Diamond
description: A naturally formed, almost perfect raw diamond protruding from a lump of coal.  A real diamond in the rough!

name: Sooty Stocking
description: An old winter hunt stocking packed full of soot and coal.  Someone must have been very naughty!

name: Iceball Brawl Theme
description: A icy cold theme only available to hunters who have fully constructed their entire Ice Fortress with all expansions and upgrades!

name: Throwable Snowball
description:
This perfectly-packed, beautifully-rounded snowball is perfect for throwing and allows a hunter to make a guess in the Snowball Showdown. Toss one at the playing field and see what sticks!

Play the Snowball Showdown now!

name: Borean Commander Caught
description: In order to purchase certain items from the shop, you will need to catch the Borean Commander - the final icy leader of the 2014 Great Winter Hunt.

name: Ice Fortress Completed
description: In order to purchase certain items from the shop, you will need to complete the full Ice Fortress during the 2014 Great Winter Hunt.

name: Tower Slab
description:
Special slabs of ice doubly frozen and fortified. Able to withstand fierce wind gales with incredible compressive strength, great for stacking!

Collect these slabs from the mice at the Ice Fortress by capturing mice every week. Then, use them to build a terrifyingly tall Ice Tower!

name: Hothouse Base
description:
A lovely flowerbed of poinsettias. Kept fresh inside a fully sealed and functional hothouse! Perfect for keeping these flowers growing even out of season. Perfect for celebrating the Great Winter Hunt all year round!

Don't you wish you could just smell them?

The Hothouse Base will increase petal and herb drops from mice in the Living Garden, Lost City, Sand Dunes, and their twisted counterparts!

name: Festive Gauntlet Crusher
description:
A giant spiked snow boulder sits atop a steep ice slope. Below sits a piece of cheese precisely counterbalanced upon a release trigger. Waiting patiently for some unsuspecting mouse to pick up his last meal!

The perfect trap to tempt even the most will hardened of thieves! What good is being sneaky when you're being run down by a giant, spiked snow boulder?

Using this trap in the King's Gauntlet will double any Tier 3 Gauntlet Potions that drop.

name: Satchel of Gold (1,500 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (3,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: Satchel of Gold (4,000 gold)
description: The gold contained in this satchel is instantly awarded to the hunter upon being collected. This item does not appear in a hunter's inventory.

name: 2015 Party Pack
description:

name: New Year's Party Portal Trap Skin

But the moment a mouse steps upon it, pre-charged capacitors flood it with energy, instantly creating a super-powered portal that whisks the mouse off to who knows where... or when.

name: Plankrun's Whisker Woods Rift Notes
description: A torn page out of Plankrun's journal.
page_text_front:
I fear that I may be spending too much time in this alternate world. It is as if every time I return from the Rift, our world ages a little more in relation. But I cannot stop my quest, I am so close, I can feel it!
Much time has passed since we started work to keep our world safe from the dimension that constantly threatens to spill into our own. The time shift can be jarring as time can travel at different rates when you're in the Rift for too long. Small pushes of mice within Gnawnia have popped up here and there, however the hunters we had trained have been more than capable of holding them off with Zugzwang's support. It is lonely work without his company but his pupils need guidance or they're likely to crash his floating tower.
On my latest trip back into town I ran into Larry, he has grown so much and recently been promoted to a full fledged knight, an honour fitting such a noble and determined young man. We all suggested to Sir Reginforth that since his apprentice has earned his title that maybe he should retire to a quaint cottage out in the mountains. He loudly protested to the thought of retirement and instead proclaimed we call him "Lord Reginforth". If this title sticks I expect he will be demanding the title of Baron before the year is out.
page_text_back:
I have found it! I have found how I will track him down, the Master of Mice!
Inside the emptiness of the Rift I stumbled upon strange sigils etched into a wall that looks older than time itself. I must show this to Zugzwang at once.
They stood out to me like a blazing beacon, I don't know how but when I looked at that strange script I could feel The Master of Mice's sinister presence trying to hide itself deep in the rift. I no longer fear this Aspect of pure evil. I will return to Gnawnia, gather a capable force of hunters and using this marker we will track down The Master, defeat it and surely before you even get a chance to read this journal page oh King, Gnawnia will finally be free of this aggressive mouse invasion!

name: Chocolate Box Trap Skin
description: The ancient ghost mice which roamed Gnawnia before even the castle existed require an old-fashioned trap strategy, and the Ancient Box Trap is about as old-fashioned as they come. A heavy stone box teeters precariously upon an Ancient Relic Staff, waiting for a mouse to pull the Ethereal Rope and cause the box to slam shut and magically fuse with the base. name: The Heart Stopper Skin
description:
Powered by a secret pyrite mixture (known as "Nitrogen Lawcide") passed down from law-man Marshall Lawson to the young aspiring lawful hunters. This pneumatic icon of the law is the perfect way to deter any and all lawbreakers!

Once triggered, the ramp locks release, causing the Lawcide-powered, law-abiding, law-legs to lawnch forward (known as the "Law Lawnch Effect"), providing the thrust required to slam the shield into the mice, propelling them backwards and away from the train.

"I fought the law, and the law fought back." --Unknown incarcerated raider

This trap is very effective while the Gnawnian Express is passing through Raider River.
marketing_text:
Having trouble sharing your true feelings and emotions? Saddened by having to reject yet another unsuitable suitor? Then this is the trap skin for you!

Perfect for fending off unwanted admirers (and mice) that may come calling. Trust me, your feelings will be quite clear after they open your door and come face to face with one of these.

Using these powerful firework charms on Calamity Carl's Cruise will boost the speed of the ship to MAXIMUM, moving the cruise along at 25 KM per mouse catch!

name: Cupcake Birthday Base
description:
Specially selected cupcakes, hand-picked by the Kingdom's best pastry chefs to ensure they are the most flavourful and fragrant. These cupcakes are then individually installed by the King's personal Trapsmith! A couple dozen of these delectable desserts are decorated and perfectly arranged on a titanium baking sheet for stability. Once baked, they come out deliciously dangerous!
On top of that, this base contains a special surprise secretly added by the Head Trapsmith Chef: Cupcakes that happen to pop off the base during any scuffles turn into Cupcake Charms! Also, with the included lifetime warranty, all damaged cupcakes are covered under an immediate replacement plan, so your base is never missing one of its colourful cupcakes!

A flavour first savoured during MouseHunt's 7th birthday!

This base has a rare chance to drop a Cupcake Charm when a mouse is caught!

It sits innocently enough, completely stationary looking deliciously ordinary until something comes across its googly-eyes. At this moment it transforms into a hulking golem prepared to fend off any mousy invader without an invitation!

Keeping parties safe since... We don't even know!

name: Candle Chrome MonstroBot Skin
description:
What do you get when you take the incredible ancient technology of the Sandstorm MonstroBot and couple it with the very latest modernizations, then dip the whole thing in a huge vat of molten chrome?

You get this absolutely gorgeous monstrosity, the absolute pinnacle of physical damage traps. No mere mouse can withstand it's pounding paws for long, but be sure not to deploy it lightly - you want to make sure it's pointed at the mice before you turn it on, not towards you!
marketing_text:
Air-brushed to give it a soft, waxy exterior finish, the Candle Chrome MonstroBot looks completely harmless and actually quite welcoming! The promise of warmth and birthday celebration lures the unsuspecting mice close, unleashing a torrent of wax upon them!

Happy Birthday!

name: Chesla's Flame 'n' Fire Birthday Skin
description:
Anna Chesla was a world-renowned inventor and chess master, best known for her patented "Advanced Chess" method. Her final invention, Chesla's Revenge, was named by her followers after her mysterious disappearance who saw it as one last attempt to best her bitter arch-rival, Zugzwang.

Ancient rival of Zugzwang, Chesla was never able to defeat the chess master and would frustratingly return time and time again to the Seasonal Garden, biding her time until she was charged up for another attempt. With near perfect mastery of the technological advances of the time, she refused to admit her lack of mastery for chess.

With the focus on charging her Amplifier to enter the tower, she couldn't spare much time for focus on improving her chess tactics. Out of her frustration, she had an epiphany! Using her great technological prowess, she quickly built an extremely powerful coil to gather and focus the magic energies of the Seasonal Garden, greatly accelerating her amplification rate!

Finally being able to focus her energies elsewhere, she had turned up the power too high in anticipation and overloaded the coils. When the bright glow from the coil finally dimmed, she was never seen again.

The power from the coil was not enough to destroy her, and many conflicting theories about her disappearance surfaced over the years, but no one truly knows what became of Anna...

Scrawled upon the underside of the tower, one can make out the word "Checkmate".

Hunting with the Chesla's Revenge in the Seasonal Garden has the chance to overload it and increase the amount of amplification gained per catch. Just... keep your distance...
marketing_text: A throwback to the days before electricity, Chesla's Revenge features "old school" technology, harnessing the power of heat and fire to vanquish its foes! This skin harnesses the fiery power of the infinite burning birthday candles designed by Chesla just before her foray into the more-advanced Chesla Coils. By the time the mouse realizes it can't blow out the candles it's too late!

It seems that the Chocolatonium has awakened some powerful abilities that were previously lying dormant in the charm's energetic core. This charm possesses power, luck, and attraction bonuses as well as the ability to contribute to the Riftwalker and Riftstalker trap set bonuses!

name: Egg Basket Box Trap Skin
description: The ancient ghost mice which roamed Gnawnia before even the castle existed require an old-fashioned trap strategy, and the Ancient Box Trap is about as old-fashioned as they come. A heavy stone box teeters precariously upon an Ancient Relic Staff, waiting for a mouse to pull the Ethereal Rope and cause the box to slam shut and magically fuse with the base. This may seem like a deceptively simple trap set-up, but ancient mice enjoy the classics.
marketing_text:
Ah, a finely woven wicker egg basket inlaid with a satin, soft-coloured plaid pattern. Decorated to look like the most innocent-looking Spring Egg Hunt collection basket there is. Upon closer inspection, the mice realize all too late that the magical ancient peeps coaxing them into the box aren't all too friendly!

Once underneath, the peeps come to life and pin the mouse down inside. As the box closes, the soft-coloured plaid turns into the many swirling neon hues of the void, reality collapsing around the hapless prisoner, caging them inside forever as the peeps dance... Dance... DANCE!!!

Probably the happiest and scariest way to go!

Happy Spring Egg Hunt!

name: Spring Hunt Shark Trap Skin
description: The Sunken City's best line of defense now becomes one of your best weapons of offense!  Hidden behind a cleverly disguised rocky outcropping is a shark powered by re-oxygenating oxygen tanks! Triple the fins for triple the speed, racks on racks of razor sharp teeth coupled with a frickin' laser beam attached to its head!  Equipped with hover fins for equally effective use on land!
marketing_text: Cybernetic spring hunt ceramic put to the test with this new, deep sea alternative to conventional metals.  Lightweight and very aquadynamic, it will be much too late before a mouse realizes this isn't just a big Spring Hunt egg floating towards them!

name: Glowing Gruyere Kit
description:
Looking to go spelunking within the Fungal Cavern? Look no further than this Glowing Gruyere Kit! Includes a generous stipend of SUPER|brie+, some Glowing Gruyere to get you started, and some valuable Gemstone Boost Charms!

Inside you'll find:

• 750 SUPER|brie+
• 75 Glowing Gruyere Cheese
• 5 Gemstone Boost Charms
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 months from date of opening.

name: Nightshade Basket
description:
A bustling basket of SUPER|brie+ with a generous garnish of Nightshade. Nightshade is used to craft Glowing Gruyere for use within the Fungal Cavern!

Inside you'll find:

• 30 Nightshade
• 225 SUPER|brie+
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Nightshade Kit
description:
A kit carefully-packed with some SUPER|brie+ decorated with a pinch of Nightshade. Nightshade is used to craft Glowing Gruyere for use within the Fungal Cavern!

Inside you'll find:

• 15 Nightshade
• 75 SUPER|brie+
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

name: Underground Exploration Kit
description:
Alright, you're here. This means you're serious about spelunking and you look to traverse the perilous depths of Fungal Cavern and return to tell the tale to your fellow hunters. This is why we have this kit just for you!

Inside you'll find:

• 2,250 SUPER|brie+
• 200 Glowing Gruyere Cheese
• 5 Gemstone Boost Charms
• 5 Diamond Boost Charms
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 4 months from date of opening.

name: Nightshade
description: Lily plants that sometimes bud within the Fungal Cavern and are often farmed by the Citizens of Zokor.  A pleasant, sweet and aromatic fragrance emanates from the petals.
obtain_hint: Hunt Fungal Fodder in the Fungal Cavern, or Fungus Farmers in Labyrinth and Zokor

name: Cavern Fungus
description: A bioluminescent fungus grown in the Fungal Caverns and often farmed by the Citizens of Zokor.
obtain_hint: Hunt Fungal Fodder in the Fungal Cavern, or Fungus Farmers in Labyrinth and Zokor

name: Crystal Crucible
description:
A rare crystal bloom surging with unknown energies. This cluster of crystal collects and focuses energy throughout its core.

This incredibly powerful accumulation of crystal energy is used to craft one of the most powerful Forgotten traps, along with allowing a hunter to access some of the best charms the Charm Shoppe Guild has to offer!
obtain_hint: Hunt Diamondhide, Huntereater, and Crystal Behemoth mice in the Fungal Cavern

name: Diamond
description:
A rare, valuable stone of colourless carbon. An extremely hard substance that shines bright... like a diamond!

This precious stone is used to create the coveted Diamond Cheese, which is used to track down the Huntereater, Diamondhide, and Crystal Behemoth mice.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Fungal Cavern

name: Gemstone
description:
Precious and valuable stones found deep within the Fungal Cavern. The shine of these Gemstones is truly outrageous. Truly, truly, truly outrageous!

This precious stone is used to create Gemstone Cheese, used to track down the powerful mice that drop Diamonds as loot!
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Fungal Cavern

name: Mineral
description:
A cluster of valuable Minerals found deep within the Fungal Cavern.

This underground resource is used to create Mineral Cheese, which aids in tracking down mice that drop Gemstones as loot, and is used to create or purchase other craftables and helpful equipment in the various Shoppes.
obtain_hint: Hunt Gruyere Grazers in the Fungal Cavern, Storm Dragons in Moussu Picchu, or purchase from Queso Canyon General Stores

name: Fungal Cavern Journal Theme
description:
Encrusted with Minerals, Gemstones, Diamonds and of course, a generous infection of fungus! A combination of efforts put forth to conquer the Fungal Cavern.

Anyone who owns this journal theme has seen the depths of the Fungal Cavern and returned to tell about it.

name: Fungal Cavern Map Piece
description:
A recent settling of sand near the southern edge of the desert has revealed a hidden passageway into an underground cavern.

The Fungal Cavern is the site of an underground aquifer, a damp place full of mushrooms and poisonous plants. The walls are rich with Minerals and sparkling Gemstones that reflect and scatter what little light enters the cave.

An area of danger and adventure for Duke/Duchess hunters and above to explore!

Obtain this map piece during the Duke/Duchess adventure:
Explore the Fungal Cavern

name: Labyrinth Key
description:
This is some kind of strange and intricate device made entirely of stone. It seems to depict a large maze carved into a miniaturized mountain range. As you examine the small device, minuscule floors of the complex maze slowly shift and move around creating an infinitely more incomprehensible maze. Some hunters have discovered a relief in the deepest depths of the Fungal Cavern that when deposited, causes the walls to shift, open up and reveal an entrance to the Labyrinth.

A dangerous design that can be deciphered by hunters ranked no less than that of Duke/Duchess. Those of lesser rank seem not to make it back...

Obtain this map piece during the Duke/Duchess adventure:
Track Down the Retired Minotaur

name: Crystal Crucible Trap
description:
A perfectly arranged set of specifically sized and energized crystals. Once struck with a tuning fork, the resonating waves activate their energy causing a reaction between the crystals. Once fully awoken, the main grounding crystals hone and confine the smaller crystals into a powerful, circular orbit.

The crystals hum together producing a low-toned sound, attracting mice in the general area, luring them to its center ring. Once a mouse gets close enough the crystals spin and speed up into a blur and release an awesome flash of light. Too blinding to even see what has happened to the now missing mouse...

name: Diamond Cheese
description:
The hardest cheese known to hunter and mouse alike. Using advanced cheese crafting techniques and combining that with modern mining practices, this piece of cheese is chiseled down into bite-sized teeth-shattering portions. The shaving and shaping of the cheese removes the harder outer layer and exposes the fresh Diamond in the core, releasing a most potent odour capable of attracting a few particular mice with a sweet tooth for these rare rocks.

The Diamond Devourers that nest in the deepest part of the Fungal Cavern crave this cheese more than anything else. Beware when you equip it and don't get bitten!

name: Gemstone Cheese
description:
Liquified Gemstones are poured into moulds to make this marvellous cheese, which is surprisingly soft... by the mice standards. The amalgamation of the different Gemstones make quite a medley of textures and flavours that the more refined mice within the caverns find irresistible.

An absolute delicacy for the Gemstone Gorgers that dwell near the center of the Fungal Cavern.

name: Glowing Gruyere Cheese
description:
Full of fluorescent flavour! Once the fungus growing within the cheese begins to glow, the cheese is ripe and ready to eat! The brighter the glow, the bolder the scent and taste.

A favourite of the breeds found throughout Hollow Heights.

name: Mineral Cheese
description:
Crispity, crunchity and rich in minerality. Mineral Cheese might be totally lacking in vitamins but it more than makes up for it in Minerals! You will need teeth of steel to chew up these solid morsels.

A must have meal for the Mineral Muncher mice that live in the deeper, harder regions of the Fungal Cavern.

name: Diamond Boost Charm
description:
A marvel of modern geological science! A self-cutting replica diamond encased inside of a divine orb that creates a perfectly-cut duplicate of a freshly dropped Diamond.

Provides a boost to Diamond loot drops. If a mouse drops Diamonds while this charm is equipped, an extra Diamond will appear as if out of thin air!

name: Gemstone Boost Charm
description:
A specialized charm that reacts in the presence of other Gemstones causing tiny vibrations in the cavern walls, shaking mice and forcing them to drop extra Gemstones.
Provides a boost to Gemstone loot drops. If a mouse drops Gemstones while this charm is equipped, an additional extra Gemstone will be shaken loose from their tiny paws.

name: Nightshade Farming Charm
description:
A specialized charm designed to create a fully grown clone of a Nightshade plant. Using freshly picked Cavern Fungus and a dusting of Minerals, this charm instantly grows an additional Nightshade plant when one is found.

Provides a boost to Nightshade loot drops. If a mouse drops Nightshade while this charm is equipped, an extra Nightshade plant will instantly grow nearby, ready to be plucked.

name: Spore Charm
description: A small colony of genetically-engineered spores. Designed, grown, and cultivated by analyzing the spores used within the Fungal Cavern. Don't breathe this!

name: Super Spore Charm
description: Building upon the conventional Spore Charm, the Super Spore Charm further infuses its deadly fungal mixture with... more deadly fungus!  Super-concentrated, super-saturated super spores!

name: Ultimate Spore Charm
description:
The awesome power of a Crystal Crucible courses through this charm, enhancing the potency of the Cavern Fungus and maximizing the seductive aroma of the Nightshade.

This charm packs a wallop and will be a great addition to any MouseHunter's hunting equipment!

name: Fungal Gemstone Crucible Trap Skin
description:
A perfectly arranged set of specifically sized and energized crystals. Once struck with a tuning fork, the resonating waves activate their energy causing a reaction between the crystals. Once fully awoken, the main grounding crystals hone and confine the smaller crystals into a powerful, circular orbit.

The crystals hum together producing a low-toned sound, attracting mice in the general area, luring them to its center ring. Once a mouse gets close enough the crystals spin and speed up into a blur and release an awesome flash of light. Too blinding to even see what has happened to the now missing mouse...
marketing_text:
Moulded over with fungus, this is the result of leaving your Gemstone Trap unattended inside the Fungal Cavern for long periods of time. Providing a strange synergy with the crystals, the fungus growing along the gems on the trap spreads wildly. This surge of fungal energy is aimed at mice causing them to demolecularize into nothing more than fungus-enriched fertilizer.

What a way to grow!

name: Gemstone Shark Skin
description: The second revision of the Runeshark, codename: The Great Rune Shark, is improved in every way over the original design. Enhanced lasers, stronger fins, sharper teeth and increased size to take on the toughest of prey. The biggest advantage: Strength in numbers! A whole school of sharks ready to be unleashed!
marketing_text:
A hardened-gloss revision of the School of sharks built with an abundance of new raw materials harvested from the Fungal Cavern. A mighty Mineral body, infused with Gemstones and diamondine teeth. A shark-shaped machine built to maul the toughest of mice!

The inclusion of infra-red, gem-based spotlights for eyes makes it even tougher to hide once the trap is sprung!

name: Nightshade Farming Kit
description:
A specialty kit full of SUPER|brie+ and Nightshade Farming Charms!

Inside you'll find:

• 100 Nightshade Farming Charms
• 100 SUPER|brie+
Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 month from date of opening.

description:
A treasure chest for treasure hunters! Coated in Rare Map Dust, these chests contain everything a hardcore Treasure Hunter needs to take their loot to the next level!

Inside you'll find:

• 500 SUPER|brie+
Rare Map Dust leads to Rare Treasure Chests containing:
  • Two times the points!
  • Two times the gold!
  • Two times the Ancient Charms!
  • More loot!
  • And twice the chance of super-rare loot!

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Give to Friends page to gift this item to a friend.
