name: Admiral's Ship Theme Scrap I
description: Collect all three Admiral's Ship Journal Theme Scraps and combine them to instil fear into those that dare sail the spooky skies!

name: Admiral's Ship Theme Scrap II
description: Collect all three Admiral's Ship Journal Theme Scraps and combine them to instil fear into those that dare sail the spooky skies!

name: Admiral's Ship Theme Scrap III
description: Collect all three Admiral's Ship Journal Theme Scraps and combine them to instil fear into those that dare sail the spooky skies!

name: Crimson Curd
description: A dark red curd of cheese. These curds turn red when kept for long periods of time beneath the soil. Absorbing a lot of "iron" and "nutrients" from the ground.
obtain_hint: Loot drop from mice in the Mousoleum with the Barricade built

name: Admiral's Ship Journal Theme
description: This journal theme commemorates the commandeering of the Admiral's Ship, earned during the 2018 Halloween event!

name: Ghostfire Cannonball
description:
An Ethereal Cannonball with just a little more lift! Every ball is cast around an Ethereal Bat that gives the cannonball's flight that extra oomph to bust through targets with extra spooky force!

These cannonballs will knock loose an extra ship part when used against the Grand Ghostship!

name: Assembled Cemetery Slat
description: This slat has been assembled with others like it to form a protective barricade in the Mousoleum.

name: Cemetery Slat
description:
Scrap pieces of wood from old coffins, crypts and other sites from around the Mousoleum burial grounds.

These can be repurposed into a protective barrier to keep out zombies at the Mousoleum.

name: Spooky Shuffle Dust
description:
Upgrades the Spooky Shuffle cards and begins an upgraded version of the game with better rewards!

Play the Spooky Shuffle now!

name: Deadwood Plank Base
description: A base made of poisonous Deadwood, a type of lumber gathered from the aged coffins and housings of truly horrific and evil individuals. The residual spiritual energy caught within the wood make it a powerful material to unleash on the unsuspecting.

name: Admiral's Galleon Trap
description:
A massive haunted galleon once commanded by Admiral Arrrgh himself. It strikes fear in the souls of all nether-nautical ghostship captains and mice alike. Sitting idly by, hovering between this world and the next, it waits, invisibly, for an unsuspecting mouse to step aboard the base. Once awoken, it materializes and begins to lift into the sky with its new member of the crew.

Of course they always have the option to jump...

The Admiral's Galleon Trap has the spooktacular ability to randomly raid mice for up to 5,000 bonus Cursed Gold!

name: Creepy Coffin Trap
description:
A bed for the dead! Undead mice see this as one big bed and breakfast. Armed with a delicious bait, mood enhancing fog, old musty wooden scent and topped with a beautiful display of gnarled trees, who could resist!?

Unbeknownst to potential visitors, this coffin has a permanent resident confined within its 6 walls and it doesn't take kindly to house guests...

As an added bonus, it produces an extra Cemetery Slat when one is dropped within the Mousoleum.

name: Crimson Cheese
description: A dark and delicious delicacy. A musty, oozing piece of cheese made from delicately aged and evil curds. Very rich in "iron" and topped with what looks to be a sweet... ketchup sauce?

name: Extreme Spooky Charm
description:
Ghoulishly glowing with a burning desire to enact revenge on the one who captured this powerful soul and stored it in this sticky confection, this charm explodes with an extreme amount of power when departing from your trap.

All types of Spooky Charms interact with all Halloween traps by giving them a 20% Power Bonus!

When an Extreme Spooky Charm is consumed during a hunt, there is a chance that the residual spiritual energy has unfinished business and rematerializes into a stronger Ultimate Spooky Charm!

name: Pointy Charm
description: A rather "pointy" charm that increases the value of a caught mouse, adding 10% bonus points to your quarry, up to a maximum of 10,000 extra points.

name: Goody Galleon Trap Skin
description:
A massive haunted galleon once commanded by the Ghostship Admiral. It strikes fear in the souls of all nether-nautical Ghostship Captains and mice. Sitting idly by while it waits, invisibliy, hovering between this world and the next, waiting for an unsuspecting mouse to step aboard the base. Once awoken, it materializes and begins to lift into the sky with a new member of the crew.

Of course they always have the option jump...
marketing_text: A flying galleon made out of delicious candies and other assorted goodies and treats. If the cheese fails to attract the mice, the sickly sweet scent of this sugary ship will certainly steal their attention.

name: Soul Searching Turbine Trap Skin
description:
Desolate and disheartening, this trap paints a picture of a bleak and meaningless existence, even when observed in its resting state. When a mouse approaches, the Temporal Turbine begins to hum, spinning violently and churning impossibly dark clouds, forming a direct link with the depths of a void in space beyond our plane of existence.

Once the mouse begins to gaze into the contraption, the turbine links with the mind of the mouse, implanting the image of a mouse utopia, convincing it to surrender itself as it astrally-projects the soul of the mouse into space, leaving behind a dormant husk, never to return.
marketing_text: Someone or something has been peeking through the proverbial "Looking Glass" to examine each and every mouse that steps up to the turbine. We're not sure what exactly they are looking for because they have yet to let a mouse go...

name: Spooky Chrome Temporal Turbine Trap Skin
description:
Cast in chrome, this more expensive version of the Temporal Turbine has been tuned to aim directly at the sun! The chrome coating allows it to withstand the heat every time the portal is open and exposed to the impossibly hot flames.

Mice triggering this trap get instantly cooked to a crisp! Youch!
marketing_text: All that Trick-or-Treating has finally paid off with this chrome-dipped Temporal Turbine Trap skin, decorated in the spirit of Halloween. Wonder where they got those gold-plated skulls...

name: Capture Admiral Arrrgh of the Ghostship Armada
description: Collect Ethereal Cannonballs to shoot down the ghostships that have risen from the ocean. Collect and use Lockbox Limburger Cheese to track down and defeat Admiral Arrrgh!

name: Great Winter Hunt 2018 Gift Basket
description:
A great way to put a smile on a friend's face this holiday season!

Inside you'll find:

• 30 Glazed Pecan Pecorino Cheese
• 20 Let It Snow Charms
• 1 Magical Holiday Hat

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Great Winter Hunt 2018 Large Supply Kit
description:
A large supply kit of assorted festive goodies to help you send out Snow Golems this holiday season!

Inside you'll find:

• 500 Glazed Pecan Pecorino Cheese
• 300 Let It Snow Charms
• 12 Magical Holiday Hats
• 3 Festive Summoning Bells
• 50 Throwable Snowballs
• 1 Snowball Showdown Dust

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 4 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Winter Hunt Supply Kit
description:
A beautiful kit bound to bolster your performance this Great Winter Hunt. One of these will get you off to a great start this season!

Inside you'll find:

• 100 Glazed Pecan Pecorino Cheese
• 50 Let It Snow Charms
• 3 Magical Holiday Hats

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Great Winter Hunt Treasure Hunting Kit
description:
Perfect for checking off all of those naughty and nice lists this Great Winter Hunt!

Inside you'll find:

• 200 Glazed Pecan Pecorino Cheese
• 100 Let It Snow Charms
• 3 Rare Map Dust

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: 2018 Naughty Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a Naughty Treasure List and have discovered this Naughty Treasure Chest!

name: 2018 Nice Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a Nice Treasure List and have discovered this Nice Treasure Chest!

name: 2018 Rare Naughty Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a Naughty Treasure List and have discovered this Naughty Treasure Chest!

name: 2018 Rare Nice Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a Nice Treasure List and have discovered this Nice Treasure Chest!

name: Festive Decoration Theme
description: This theme was cut from one of the massive icebergs sent to destroy Gnawnia and sprinkled with a bunch of lovely decorations from the Great Winter Hunt of 2018!

name: 2019 Lucky Codex
description: A sparkling, celebratory codex that provides hunters with +1 Luck to their traps for the entire year of 2019!

name: Iceberg Sculptor's Pick
description:
An exceptionally exquisite piece of ice-breaking equipment made from the Festive Comet. It seems as if the ice itself begins to melt at even the slightest touch from this pick.

This ice pick can be used to break frozen holiday decorations free from their icy tombs at the shop during the 2018 Great Winter Hunt.

name: Firework Sugar Cookie
description:
A fantastic depiction of a firework about to blast off and ring in the New Year!

This delicious cookie can be traded in during the Great Winter Hunt for fabulous rewards and prizes.

name: Festive Fireworks Decoration
description:
This decoration dresses up your Festive Comet Camp with a Festive Fireworks theme!

Use this decoration to attract special mice that have a chance to drop Firework Sugar Cookies when caught in the festive location.

name: New Year's Voucher
description:
A extra-celebratory voucher obtained during the New Year's Celebration that can be turned in for a new decoration in the Festive Comet General Store, among other rewards!

You can use this to purchase special rewards from the festive shoppes during the 2018 Great Winter Hunt.

name: Ornament Sugar Cookie
description:
This shiny ornament cookie could be easily mistaken for a real one! Be careful which one you bite into!

This delicious cookie can be traded in during the Great Winter Hunt for fabulous rewards and prizes.

name: Festive Ornaments Decoration
description:
This decoration dresses up your Festive Comet Camp with a Festive Ornaments theme!

Use this decoration to attract special mice that have a chance to drop Ornament Sugar Cookies when caught in the festive location.

name: Festive Snow Decoration
description:
This decoration dresses up your Festive Comet Camp with a Festive Snow theme!

Use this decoration to attract special mice that have a chance to drop Snowflake Sugar Cookies when caught in the festive location.

name: Snowball Showdown Dust
description:
Upgrades the Snowball Showdown board and begins an upgraded version of the game with better rewards!

Play the Snowball Showdown now!

name: Snowflake Sugar Cookie
description:
A delectable, premium choice cookie that perfectly reflects the Great Winter Hunt holiday spirit.

This delicious cookie can be traded in during the Great Winter Hunt for fabulous rewards and prizes.

name: Toboggan Sugar Cookie
description:
A hard and crunchy confection. Sturdy enough to actually toboggan on!

This delicious cookie can be traded in during the Great Winter Hunt for fabulous rewards and prizes.

name: Nutcracker Sugar Cookie
description:
Neat, tidy and well-dressed. This deliciously decorated sugar cookie stands at attention awaiting deployment to fulfill its duty as a tasty snack!

This delicious cookie can be traded in during the Great Winter Hunt for fabulous rewards and prizes.

name: Festive Toys Decoration
description:
This decoration dresses up your Festive Comet Camp with a Festive Toys theme!

Use this decoration to attract special mice that have a chance to drop Nutcracker Sugar Cookies when caught in the festive location.

name: Festive Winter Sports Decoration
description:
This decoration dresses up your Festive Comet Camp with a Festive Winter Sports theme!

Use this decoration to attract special mice that have a chance to drop Toboggan Sugar Cookies when caught in the festive location.

name: 2019 New Year's Base
description:
Happy New Year! This party-powered base celebrates 2019 all year long!

During all of 2019, while this base is equipped, mice have a chance to drop 2019 Charms when caught. The charm-generating powers of this base will cease to work on January 1, 2020.

name: Glowing Golem Guardian Base
description:
A magical sheet of ice sheared from the iceberg formed between the collision of the Festive Comet and the poor, poor S.S. Huntington III. While flying through the air, it captured some glowing festive spirit that entwined with the Gnawnian Aurora Borealis. Also makes a great base for a Christmas Tree!

Provides a bonus of +6 Luck when armed with the Golem Guardian Trap.

name: Golem Guardian Trap
description:
A specially modified Golem Generator designed to create a Golem Guardian for your cheese. This golem does not leave the generator, this is their generator and they have to defend it!

Since the golem is generated, it takes some time before the trap can fully power up. Every hunt you take will slowly generate specialized, weapons grade, animated snow to create your Golem Guardian. Once fully powered, your Golem will pop out and appear!

The Golem Guardian Trap supports special modules that change the configuration of the golem generated, changing its power type to match that of the module.

WARNING: If you change your Golem Guardian Trap Module, it will take time to re-assimilate the previously generated golems, slowly disassembling them to build a new one from the newly selected module.

name: Glazed Pecan Pecorino Cheese
description:
Glazed pecans adorn this extra-sweet version of Pecan Pecorino Cheese.

Just as cute, just as crunchy, but a bit more delectable with that extra glaze! It's sure to bring about some special mice this festive season...

Use this cheese to attract special event mice in the Great Winter Taiga that drop even more Snow Golem parts!

name: 2019 Charm
description:
Celebrate each catch with the enthusiasm of a New Year's Eve party! These Limited Edition charms have 2,019 Power to commemorate the New Year!

These charms were rewarded to hunters during the New Year's Celebration of the 2018 Great Winter Hunt.

name: Golem Guardian Charm
description:
A small Golem Guardian booster module is contained within this tiny charm. Equipping this while your Golem Guardian Trap is armed will boost the rate of power growth gained per hunt to get your Golem Guardian up to full power faster!

Charges your Golem Guardian Trap 10 times faster.

name: Kris Chromo Trap Skin
description:
What do you get when you take the incredible ancient technology of the Sandstorm MonstroBot and couple it with the very latest modernizations, then dip the whole thing in a huge vat of molten chrome?

You get this absolutely gorgeous monstrosity, the absolute pinnacle of physical damage traps. No mere mouse can withstand it's pounding paws for long, but be sure not to deploy it lightly - you want to make sure it's pointed at the mice before you turn it on, not towards you!
marketing_text:
'Twas the night before Christmas, when all through the land, the mice were busy stealing all the cheese with their hands.

When all of a sudden, a mouse came too near, to the wrong monstrobot chromed in Santa's gear.

With a whirr and a whistle, it stirred right to life, and came down on that mouse, with the fury of its might.

The mouse was now gone, the cheese still there. It powered back down, for another mouse to appear!

name: Eternal Frost Ember Prison Core Trap Skin
description:
By studying the design of the Meteor Prison Core, the clever Trapsmiths of Queso Canyon were able to create their own version of this fantastical device.

Redesigned, reinforced and really, really hot! If you thought prison couldn't get any worse, just turn the temperature up... a couple hundred degrees!

This Prison Core takes things to a whole new level. Using Unstable Ember Gadgets to cycle heat, it makes working with hot temperatures a cool breeze! Works just like an air conditioner to remove just enough heat, keeping the temperature in the safe spot between incarceration and incineration.

On the bright side, any mice who end up in here end up with one heck of a tan!
marketing_text: The geniuses behind the Ember Prison Core have done it again! By throwing one into reverse they have created a prison of eternal frost. Now that's how you put a criminal on ice.

name: Festive Chrome Winter Wreath Trap Skin
description:
Cast in chrome, this more expensive version of the Temporal Turbine has been tuned to aim directly at the sun! The chrome coating allows it to withstand the heat every time the portal is open and exposed to the impossibly hot flames.

Mice triggering this trap get instantly cooked to a crisp! Youch!
marketing_text:
Decorated in chrome baubles with lovely blue accent pieces. This beautiful wreath unleashes winter's wrath upon mice that happen to wander in its way.

Also looks great as a decoration on your own tree!

name: Festive Judge Trap Skin
description:
With the scales of justice forever tipped in their favour, this self-appointed court of droids enforces their own laws within the courtroom. Among them you will find: falsified evidence, fake witnesses, a biased judge, and a stenographer that only writes down incriminating words and ignores the defense. This trap finds all mice guilty until proven guiltier. Once judged, the bailiff brings all offenders to the King's Stockade to rot.

The mice are real, the cases are real, the rulings are final. This is Judge Droid.
marketing_text:
A Santa droid with his elf droids have setup their courtroom into a workshop in preparation for the holiday season. Those that get submitted to the court get judged on a whole different set of criteria to determine if they would make a nice or naughty gift for the good girls and boys.

Nice gifts get wrapped up and added to the pile, naughty gifts... well, they get wrapped up too but go somewhere a bit... warmer. And get turned into coal.

Interestingly enough, we have never seen Judge Christmas actually deliver any of his gifts.

name: Point-settia Ballista Trap Skin
description: A vortex of thunderous bolts fire endlessly from this Storm Wrought Ballista Trap. Enhanced by dark dragon magic drawn from Ful'Mina's powerful tooth, its powerful storm vortex can rip an additional Dragon Scale from the clutches of its victims.
marketing_text: This trap puts the "point" in poinsettia. A beautiful holiday plant turned into a powerful ice throwing ballista. The best way to send "Seasons Greetings!" to all those dragons in the sky.

name: Golem Guardian Arcane Skin Module
description:
A specially-modified Golem Generator designed to create a Golem Guardian that guards your very cheese. Although the golem behaves like others who come from generators, this one does not leave to hunt for loot. This is their generator and they have to defend it!

Since the golem is generated for a different purpose, it takes some time before the trap can fully power up. Every hunt you take will slowly formulate specialized weapons-grade animated snow to create your Golem Guardian. Once fully powered, your customized Guardian Golem will pop out of the generator and make its appearance!

The Golem Guardian Trap supports special trap skin modules that change the configuration of the golem generated, changing its Power Type and stats to match that of the module.

WARNING: If you change your Golem Guardian Trap Skin Module, it will take time to re-assimilate the previously generated golems, slowly disassembling them to build a new one from the newly selected module.
marketing_text:
An Arcane power module for the Golem Guardian Trap. This unit generates a Golem Guardian imbued with academic arcana from every Great Winter Hunt past, present, and future.

When fully charged, this trap will have:

  • Power: 6000
  • Power Bonus: 15%
  • Attraction Bonus: 20%
  • Luck: 28

name: Defeat the Iceberg Sculptor Mouse
description: The remnants of the Festive Comet floating in Rodentia are being carved into festive icebergs and are heading straight for Gnawnia! Blast your way through 10 icebergs to find the source and put an end to the Iceberg Sculptor Mouse's attack!

name: New Year's Chrome Sphynx Wrath Trap Skin
description:
Coated in blinding chrome, this trap is a sight to behold! Light sparkles, shines, and reflects from the Sphynx's opulent wings scattering light throughout any Camp site.

It's a small wonder the small, moving dots of reflected light don't distract the kitty from its job at hand!
marketing_text:
In a constant state of celebration, this sleek sphynx shimmers beneath a sky blazing full of fireworks. The commotion of combustion creates colourful confusion that the sphynx can clandestinely creep to capture those tiny creatures it has been confusing!

Happy New Year!

name: Scarlet Sparkling Bubbleh Trap Skin
description: Thought to be lost long ago, this fully-grown Ember Root is an extremely powerful tree that protected the Queso Canyon from intruders long ago. Its attractive vines of golden leaves would lure those seeking valuables to their untimely demise.
marketing_text:
Though it looks oddly familiar to run-of-the-mill King's Reserve Bubbleh, this flute glass of violently bubbling liquid is actually a caustic and combustible chemical! Exploding (almost literally) with a bouquet of delicious smells, hunters must be careful when handling this not-so-normal cocktail. Definitely keep this one off the serving platter!

Excited mice, looking to celebrate, caught standing too close will end up with quite the singed fur.

name: Year of the Pig Gift Basket
description:
A decadent gift basket celebrating the Year of the Pig! Great to give to friends to get them into the generous spirit of the pig!

Inside you'll find:

• 50 Nian Gao'da Cheese
• 5 Red Lunar Lantern Candles

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Year of the Pig Large Supply Kit
description:
A porcine supply kit that will launch your Lunar Lantern straight into space! You will see everything in triplet all event long!

Inside you'll find:

• 400 Nian Gao'da Cheese
• 120 Red Lunar Lantern Candles

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 4 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Year of the Pig Supply Kit
description:
Nothing to snort at! A portly supply kit that will keep your Lunar Lantern lit for quite a long time!

Inside you'll find:

• 200 Nian Gao'da Cheese
• 40 Red Lunar Lantern Candles

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Year of the Pig Journal Theme
description:
A beautifully handcrafted journal theme to celebrate the Year of the Pig!

Rewarded to those who climbed their lantern to great heights during the Lunar New Year 2019 Celebration.

name: Pig Mask
description:
Celebrate the Year of the Pig with this replica Pig Mask!

Release your inner piglet by putting on this mask and jumping in some muddy puddles!

"Oink! Oink!"

name: Pig Lunar Lantern
description: A lantern used to celebrate the Year of the Pig this Lunar New Year. This can be lit with Lunar Lantern Candles during the 2019 Lunar New Year event to provide bonus loot drops and bonus luck for your trap!

name: Pig Jade Base
description:
The kind, hardworking and resourceful earth pig is represented in this Jade Base.

Those who complete the 2019 Lunar New Year adventure are awarded with this carefully carved Pig Jade Base!

name: Chrome Truffle Finder 500™ Trap Skin
description:
Cast in chrome, this more expensive version of the Temporal Turbine has been tuned to aim directly at the sun! The chrome coating allows it to withstand the heat every time the portal is open and exposed to the impossibly hot flames.

Mice triggering this trap get instantly cooked to a crisp! Youch!
marketing_text: A Truffle Finder 500™! It has the ability to snort out a truffle from up to 500 feet below the surface! Reprogrammed to sniff out mice and dipped in a rose chrome for aesthetics, no mouse can escape these notorious nostrils!

name: Floating Pig Fortress Trap Skin
description: Assembled here is a monstrous trap of arcing electrical surges, pumping straight from the quantum quartz in the center. When a mouse triggers this trap, it is subjected to an infinite timeline of catch attempts to find one where it is caught. Unfortunately, sometimes the timeline it finds is not your own, giving an alternative reality version of yourself credit for the catch. Hey, at least it's nice to know one of the many versions of you is always catching a mouse!
marketing_text:
Clever hunters have utilized these pigs' aggressive defence tactics by placing cheese around their home. When the curious mice go to investigate, they alert their hog friends who then immediately "spring" into to action to defend their home sty.

Lunar lanterns have been affixed to their home to make transport easier without disturbing the piggies too much!

name: Couple of Orcas Trap Skin
description: The second revision of the Runeshark, codename: The Great Rune Shark, is improved in every way over the original design. Enhanced lasers, stronger fins, sharper teeth and increased size to take on the toughest of prey. The biggest advantage: Strength in numbers! A whole school of sharks ready to be unleashed!
marketing_text: A couple of orcas swimming in tandem, full of the power of love! They don't need money or fame and they love each other just the same. All mice stop in awe as they majestically swim by, just long enough for you to pick them up and safely relocate them.

name: Celebrate Lunar New Year 2019
description: Celebrate the 2019 Lunar New Year by lighting your Pig Lunar Lantern and earning the Pig Jade Base!

name: 2019 Birthday Gift Basket
description:
A small grab bag of goodies for gearing up in the SUPER|brie+ factory! Inside you'll find:

• 30 Coggy Colby Cheese
• 15 Factory Repair Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: 2019 Birthday Supply Kit
description:
A factory sized supply kit for those looking to restore full functionality to the SUPER|brie+ Factory! Inside you'll find:

• 600 Coggy Colby Cheese
• 200 Factory Repair Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Gilded Birthday Scroll Case
description:
An exquisitely decorated scroll case prepared by wealthy aristocrats for other wealthy aristocrats for their birthday!

Upon completing the map inside of this scroll case, you will receive a treasure chest containing:

• 50,000 Gold
• 50,000 Points
• 10 Speedy Coggy Colby
• 25 Gilded Charms
• 16 Gilded Coins
• 100 Ancient Charms
• An assortment of random Party Charms
• 1 SUPER|token+ (Guaranteed 4 SUPER|tokens+ if you use Rare Map Dust)

• 2 weeks of the Anniversary Aura
• 1 month of the Lucky Golden Shield

There is also a chance to obtain the Slayer Scroll Case which offers a tough challenge!

An elegantly wrapped birthday scroll case celebrating MouseHunt's Birthday!

Contains a treasure map that consists of all the birthday mice within the SUPER|brie+ Factory.

name: 2019 Birthday Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting treasure chest!

name: Birthday Crate of Ultimate Luck Charms
description: Containing 20 Ultimate Luck Charms that provide a +20 luck bonus while armed. To open the crate, view the "Special" section of your inventory. One charm is used for each mouse encountered, so use them wisely! In order to arm these Charms, visit Moustachio's Charm Shoppe in the Mountains and purchase a Charm Conduit.

name: Birthday Crate of Ultimate Lucky Power Charms
description: Containing 20 Ultimate Lucky Power Charms! Sharpened shards of power and glorious, shimmering wings of luck, the Ultimate Lucky Power Charm provides the best of both. A staggering 2,500 Power and a 20% Power Bonus on top of 20 Luck!! In order to arm these Charms, visit Moustachio's Charm Shoppe in the Mountains and purchase a Charm Conduit.

name: Birthday Crate of Ultimate Power Charms
description: Containing 20 Ultimate Power Charms made of highly concentrated energy, these charms are highly unstable. The Ultimate Power Charm provides +2,500 power and a 20% power bonus each hunt! In order to arm these Charms, visit Moustachio's Charm Shoppe in the Mountains and purchase a Charm Conduit.

name: 2019 Gilded Birthday Treasure Chest

You and your friends have completed an exquisite Gilded Birthday Treasure Map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

You will receive:

name: SUPER|brie+ Factory Journal Theme
description:
Adorn your journal with the powerful style of the SUPER|brie+ Factory's pipework!

Originally designed to commemorate MouseHunt's 11th birthday!

name: Circuit Breaker Fuse
description:
A "bumping" breaker that fuses the power of dance directly into the factory components. Adds the bumping and grinding to the buzzing and whirring. Easy to install: Just pop it and lock it!

This item is found within the Break Room at the SUPER|brie+ Factory!

name: Golden Punch Ticket
description:
A SUPER|brie+ Factory worker's special punch ticket. This card's punch marks indicate the worker has worked a shift in every room of the factory!

These tickets can be turned in at the SUPER|brie+ Factory for special bonus rewards for all your hard work!

name: Mixing Rod
description:
A special rod made from "hyper carbon", shaped specially for mixing cheese at rapidly changing viscosity.

This item is found within the Mixing Room at the SUPER|brie+ Factory!

name: Pressurized Pump Pipe
description:
A pipe specially manufactured to withstand high pressures being pumped through it.

This item is found within the Pumping Room at the SUPER|brie+ Factory!

name: Quality Cog
description:
Sugar, spice and everything nice has been infused in these integral cogs. The sweet magical energy stored in these cogs slowly seep out onto the production line.

This item is found within the QA (Quality Assurance) Room at the SUPER|brie+ Factory!

name: Birthday Banana Cake Base
description:
A blissful slab of exquisitely decorated banana cake with a flavour so unique it can never be recreated!

Baked up fresh for Hunters who joined MouseHunt's 11th birthday celebration!

name: Surprise Party Trap
description:
A birthday surprise party where the mice bring themselves right to the law enforcement! No need to serve fancy warrants or send elaborate SWAT (Special Weapons and Traps) teams! Just let the criminals walk right in!

Inside you will find a lovely Birthday Cake, a squad of droids who sing you your rights, a fun game of "put the cuffs on the criminal", surprise boxes of evidence, and some lucky mice even get to leave with a cool orange party jumpsuit!

This trap has a rare chance to drop a Party Charm when a mouse is caught!

name: Wacky Inflatable Party People Trap
description:
A seemingly lifeless pair of balloons lay dormant until an unsuspecting party person triggers this stellar celebration! Once a mouse gets too close, the music starts, confetti fills the air and the balloons begin to inflate with powerful Rift Mist to bring some out-of-this-world party people to life!

Armed with their unpredictable dance moves, this trap is incredibly hard to dodge when limbs come firing out of the thick and billowing coloured mist!
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Coggy Colby Cheese
description:
A cog-shaped birthday confection! A double layer of Colby cheese with cream in between, smothered in custard and topped with some fruit, crème fraîche and a candle.

A favourite of factory workers everywhere!

Equip this cheese at the SUPER|brie+ Factory to advance cheese through the pipeline and attract mice that drop factory parts.

name: Factory Repair Charm
description:
A special charm that only works in the SUPER|brie+ Factory. Equip this for a chance to encounter the Factory Technician Mouse who will drop bonus parts for the current room you are in and possibly some for other rooms as well!

This charm also cranks up cheese production in the SUPER|brie+ Factory, adding an additional +10 litres pumped with each capture of a mouse, even if you're not using Coggy Colby Cheese! This bonus is applied on top of whatever the Pumping Room is currently producing.

name: Infinite Birthday Party Trap Skin
description:
Expanding upon the previous principles of the Endless Labyrinth trap, this infinite beauty is quite a marvel indeed! The central core transports mice into a maze of infinite possibility. Each plate contains a miniverse of endless mazes that is in constant orbit around the central maze command core. As each plate passes through the core, they are reassembled with new passageways, completely reconfiguring the endless combinations.

The result is an infinite series of endless mazes with infinitely-changing configurations. If a mouse somehow impossibly manages to escape from one of the mazes, they simply pass into another section of a recently reconfigured maze plate. Truly maddening.
marketing_text:
An infinitely swirling vortex of confetti and party balloons to lure, confuse and excite mice!

Once captured, the newly invited party attendee is submitted to a party that never ends. It just goes on and on my friends! Some people started partying not knowing what it was and they'll continue partying forever just because...

The promise of an infinite party sounds great on paper, doesn't do so well in reality though...

name: Cake Pop Core Trap Skin
description:
A structure emulating the protective husk of the meteor that crashed into Fort Rox, except now it is being used to imprison mice instead of protect them!

With a loud crack, the sphere quickly shatters and surrounds the unsuspecting cheese thief, locking them away within their own prison dimension.

The warm glow seems so inviting until a mouse gets too close...
marketing_text: This giant pendulum of a cake pop swings into action when any unlawful varmint crosses its path. Colourfully exploding upon impact, tiny particles of adhesive sugar coat its perpetrator, sticking them at the centre of this colourful confection.

name: Protect the SUPER|brie+ Factory
description: Vincent, The Magnificent, thinks himself to be the owner and operator of the King's SUPER|brie+ Factory, running tours for mice so that they can wreak havoc on the machinery and hold cheese crate shipments hostage. Upgrade machinery, get cheese flowing through pipes and into crates again, and put an end to Vincent's grasp on the factory!

description: An egg infused with a small electrical charge from thunderstormy weather.

name: Eggsweeper Shovel
description:
This specially designed mini-shovel is used to carefully dig and extract eggs from the soil in the Eggsweeper mini-game during the Spring Egg Hunt!

They are extremely delicate so as to avoid breaking the eggs they find, making them good for one-time use only!

Play the Eggsweeper now!

name: Magical Eggsweeper Fertilizer
description:
Sprinkle a packet of this Grade A fertilizer on your Eggsweeper field to increase the size of all the eggs on the playing field AND turn one of them into a Magical Eggsweeper Egg!

These large eggs have more and better rewards and the Magical Eggsweeper Egg always contains SUPER|brie+!

Play the Eggsweeper now!

name: Spring Chrome Eggtastic Ballista Trap Skin
description:
A chrome coated Storm Module with some other minor modifications has created this powerful and beautiful trap that even the great Ful'Mina herself can't scoff at.

Firing overcharged harpoons, this upgraded model is magnetic and doesn't require a tether to reel the dragons in. After being speared, the harpoon releases its stored electricity into the target to incapacitate it. The trap then uses its vast power to create a focused electromagnetic field that brings the spear back with everything attached to it.


Enhanced by dark dragon magic drawn from Ful'Mina's powerful tooth, its powerful storm vortex can rip an additional Dragon Scale from the clutches of its victims.
marketing_text: A rose chrome-coated, egg-shaped storm module has been installed in this Chrome Storm Wrought Ballista to give it some flair for the Spring Hunt season! This module also channels a bit of the seasonal magic causing some beautiful wild growth to occur around it.

name: Spring M.Y.N.O.R.C.A. Trap Skin
description: In the furthest depths of the swirling Rift, in the heart of that howling storm, there is a pocket of deep calm. In the silence of that alien oasis, the air itself whispers unknowable mysteries that devour the mind. This trap contains the recording of an echo of a question, and mice are irresistibly drawn by the unyielding mystery.
skin_weapon_name: Mysteriously unYielding Null-Onyx Rampart of Cascading Amperes
marketing_text: A wonderful M.Y.N.O.R.C.A. decorated for spring! The soft coloured flowers really accent the colourful pastels covering this trap.

name: Cottontail Sentinel Trap Skin
description: Although the Muridae Market is heavily fortified, the Marching Flame still poses a significant threat. It was this threat which prompted the local Trapsmith to devise a sentinel powered by Flameshards. Able to sink its body into the sand, the Sandtail Sentinel patiently waits with its eyes just above the surface, waiting for a mouse to approach a baited base.
marketing_text: Wrapped in a cotton cloak and proudly donning bunny slippers. This giant carrot wielding sentinel will make sure you eat your vegetables!

name: Dragonshard Egg
description:
Slightly hot to the touch, each one of these eggs contains some modest Queso Canyon supplies along with a Dragonshard.

Occasionally, the various shopkeepers throughout the Kingdom will accept Dragonshards for supplies to help your hunting efforts in Queso Canyon.

name: Sparkling Dragonshard Nest
description: These sparkling nests have been carefully collected by the King's Royal Ornithologists. They are long-abandoned and contain valuable Queso Canyon supplies!

name: Dragonshard
description: A small shard from the shell of a Dragonshard Egg. Once accepted by Gnawnian shopkeepers, is now sought after by the King and he is willing to trade! Dragonshards can be spent at the King's Arms in exchange for special supplies, which are useful in the Queso Canyon or for dragon hunting in general.

name: Fully-Functional Queso Geyser Replica Clay Model
description:
Covered in delicious queso, it's a small wonder the clay and papier-mâché structure of this Queso Geyser replica hasn't completely fallen apart!

This life-like recreation details the start of what appears to be a safe route to ascend the queso waterfall just east of the Cantera Quarry to the location of a mighty geyser known to blast delicious liquid cheese into the sky.

The model also features a real-life working geyser! Though it makes a bit of a mess and the queso used in the reaction is synthetic and smells a bit funny.

The King is a bit confused as to why the Royal Cartographers have chosen to re-create a working model of the area out of clay and craft materials and is not quite sure how hunters will incorporate this into their personal maps...

Obtain this map piece during the Count/Countess adventure:
Slay The Geyser Dragon

name: Extreme Dragonbane Charm
description:
This extreme charm acts as an extreme hidden surprise for all dragon-like mice bold enough to come near your trap.

When activated, this extreme charm bursts out a jarring triple cold blast of air, providing a 900% Power Bonus, making these mice a breeze to catch.
This charm is only consumed when encountering:
  • Dragon Mouse (Dracano)
  • Icewing (Iceberg)
  • Cork Collector, Pressure Builder, and Geyser Hunter mice (Queso Geyser)
  • Storm Dragon mice (Moussu Picchu)
  • Dashing Dragon mice, Empyrean Javelineer Mouse, and the Paragon of Dragons (Floating Islands)
  • Dragons of the Depths (Draconic Depths)

name: Cork Egg
description: This egg is kept safe and sound with an impermeable layer of cork which protects it from being submerged molten queso.

name: Queso Geyser Scroll Case
description:
Burst this open to hunt down clues from the volatile mice that reside in the Queso Geyser.

CAUTION: This scroll case is under extreme pressure!

name: Queso Geyser Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

name: Geyser Egg
description: This egg is surrounded by a circling cloud of fresh queso powder, formed from nestling deeply within the Queso Geyser.

name: Pressurized Egg
description: A incredibly well-formed egg that can withstand the intense heat and stress of the geyser without cracking under pressure.

name: Queso Canyon Grand Tour Scroll Case
description:
The map inside of this scroll case will lead you on an epic tour of the entire Queso Canyon!

Be warned: This map includes 40 mice from the Queso River, Queso Plains, Queso Quarry, and Queso Geyser.

Prepare yourself for a challenge!

description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this incredible Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Queso Canyon Grand Tour Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Rare Treasure Chest!

name: Chrome Storm Wrought Ballista Parts
description: A carefully and delicately disassembled Chrome Storm Wrought Ballista trap rests inside this cardboard box. Disassembling the trap revealed an area where lightning had eroded the chrome revealing part of a cryptic message: "hunted offer unfired".

name: Cork Bark
description:
Cork Bark is a lightweight, porous wood coveted by the mice of the Queso Geyser. It is grown and harvested from the large cork trees found in this area and some mice have been known to grow this material right under their fur. The mice of this area use it to shield themselves from the frequent queso showers, provide camouflage and a rudimentary armour.

Enough of this gathered together should be able to create a cork big enough to plug up the Queso Geyser, increasing its pressure and causing an eruption which will attract new airborne Draconic mice to the area.
obtain_hint: Hunt in Queso Geyser

name: Dragon Slayer Cannon Chassis
description: An extremely heat-resistant chassis capable of containing extreme temperatures beyond what scientists can even measure before their tools melt. Looks like the beginnings of something extremely powerful...

name: Imbued Dragon Slayer Cannon Chassis
description: With a burning outer layer of glowing ore grafted onto the chassis and an impossibly sharp and bright blade inserted directly into the priming chamber, this frame is ready to channel and store massive amounts of heat into its core.

name: Kalor'ignis Rib
description: A burning collagen husk from the chest of Kalor'ignis, the molten marrow at the center will normally consume the rib once exposed to air, crumbling it to dust. It is extremely rare to find one that has had minimal oxygen exposure and is still fully intact.
obtain_hint: Hunt Kalor'ignis of the Geyser in Queso Geyser

name: Geyserite
description: Geyserite is a mineral composite created in the unique environment of a geyser. Formed under extreme pressures, loose chunks of this mineral get ejected out when strong eruptions occur. Its opaline structure makes it quite attractive to the resident dragons of the geyser.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest after a Medium Eruption in Queso Geyser

name: Congealed Rubber
description: The sticky fluid that seeps out of the various flora that live in and around the Queso Geyser slowly congeals into this thick rubber under the extreme heat of the geyser. This naturally-forming rubber can help form an air-tight seal when applied to a cork structure.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest after a Small Eruption in Queso Geyser

name: Tungsten
description: A rare metal found within Queso Canyon. It has a high melting point and is extremely dense, making it a valuable resource for producing stronger, heavier corks.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest after a Large Eruption in Queso Geyser

name: Solidified Amber Queso
description: A hunk of amber that is the result of millions of years of fossilizing queso. A faint vibration can be felt resonating from this stone.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest in Queso Geyser

name: Queso Thermal Spring
description: A self-contained thermal pocket located in a miniature volcanic spring filled with molten queso.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest in Queso Geyser or purchase from the Queso Geyser General Store

name: Magic Nest Dust
description:
A special dust that is directly applied to Queso Geyser Dragon Nests. When sprinkled onto a nest that has cooled down, the dust tumbles through the spaces in the woven straw, magically filling empty sections of the nest with additional rewards.

Magic Nest Dust adds 5 special reward items to the Dragon Nests at Queso Geyser.

name: Geyser Smolder Stone
description: A rare clump of smoldering rock. These clods get stuck and survive multiple eruptions before finally shaking loose. The extended time spent below strengthens the outer layers of this rock keeping all the molten energies of the queso center contained.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest in Queso Geyser or purchase from the Queso Geyser General Store

name: Thermal Chisel
description: A chisel forged from exposure to extreme heat from the Queso Geyser. One of the few tools that can withstand the extreme thermal heat of the geyser.
obtain_hint: Loot from a Dragon Nest in Queso Geyser or purchase from the Queso Geyser General Store

name: Dragon Slayer Cannon
description:
A devastating machine created with an incredibly rare rib of a terrifying dragon, housed in a heat-resistant shell. It draws power from the Kalor'ignis Rib stored within, focusing it in its centre, building a giant bubble of Draconic energy that expands outwards. Once it has expanded beyond critical mass, the outer blades begin to spin at an incredible velocity, shaping the energy from spherical to cylindrical and finally to a sharpened point. Once the formed mass of energy comes into contact with the point of the firing pin, it explodes forwards in an awesome beam of Draconic energy.


Enhanced by dark dragon magic drawn from Ful'Mina's powerful tooth, its powerful energy can blast an additional Dragon Scale from the clutches of its victims.

name: Queso Fount Trap
description: A bubbling fount of molten queso which is superheated faster than it can vaporize. The surface tension is so high that even the slightest vibration can trigger an explosion! The specially crafted spouts focus the eruption towards the placement of the cheese on the trap hoping to cover any mice that wander too close.

name: Smoldering Stone Sentinel Trap
description: A lumbering elemental built from powerful Geyser Smolder Stones, this massive weapon sits still until the thermal signature of a nearby mouse comes near. Driven by its craving for heat, the trap snatches up mice and consumes them to keep its core hot.

name: Gouging Geyserite Trap
description:
A devious canopy of Amber Queso stalactites and stalagmites await any hungry mice that approach this trap. Once a mouse takes a sip of cheese, the resonating sound from the slurp bounces off of the back of the cave wall and begins to vibrate the stalactites overhead, causing them to dislodge and trap the mouse in a cage of fallen queso.

The fallen shards melt back into the reservoir beneath and get pulled back up into the canopy to slowly drip and form new stalactites. A completely self-renewable trap system!

name: Slay The Geyser Dragon
description: Lure Kalor'ignis by building a reinforced cork to pressurize the geyser and cause an EPIC eruption of cheesey vapour!

name: Rare Medium Chrome Slayer Treasure Chest
description:
You and your friends have completed a difficult Rare Chrome Slayer Treasure Map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

This chest extends the Slayer Aura by 3 days and the Chrome Aura by 5 days when opened.

name: Living Grove Mould
description:
A clump of extraordinary mould extracted from the Living Garden and seeded with Nightshade.

Combine this with Soiled Base parts to create the Living Grove Base.

name: Soiled Base Parts
description: A musky box of Soiled Base parts. The Soiled Base can be reassembled from these parts.

name: Chrome Bit
description:
An amorphous blob of extremely high quality chrome. A material highly sought after by Ronza.

You can spend Chrome Bits at Ronza's Traveling Shoppe for great rewards!

After she leaves, these will be removed from your inventory.

name: Chrome Kit Voucher
description:
This voucher can be exchanged along with gold to purchase one Chrome Upgrade Kit of your choice during Ronza's visit. With the right amount of gold, this voucher can be exchanged at Ronza's Travelling Shop before she's gone!

These can be turned in at Ronza's Traveling Shop with gold for your choice of any Chrome Upgrade Kit.

After she leaves, these will be removed from your inventory.

name: Aurora Base
description:
AURORA BOREALIS?! At this time of year? At this time of day? In this part of the Kingdom? Localized entirely within your base!? Yes!

This captured phenomenon from the Living Garden is a swirling vortex of light and energy which is where Living Garden essences grow from.

The Aurora Base has a chance to generate a random essence when hunting in the Living Garden, Lost City, Sand Dunes, and their twisted counterparts!

name: Living Grove Base
description:
A Soiled Base with a special topical fungal agent seeded with Nightshade. This base absorbs moisture from its environment and once it has absorbed enough, it will produce a Cavern Fungus or a Nightshade.

When armed, it has a chance to produce Cavern Fungus or Nightshade when catching mice anywhere in the Kingdom.

When armed in the Fungal Cavern, its localized ecosystem stimulates the growth of the flora causing it to produce Cavern Fungus or Nightshade on every successful catch!

The Living Grove Base also benefits from arming Growth and Wild Growth Charms. Equipping a Growth or Wild Growth charm increases the base's Luck, Power, Power Bonus and Attraction rate!

name: Moonbeam Barrier Trap
description:
A mystical trap that peers into the souls of the mice that approach it through its ruby lense. When detecting one whose spirit aligns with shadow energies, it opens up its trap door and seals them away in its trap dimension.

Since it closely resembles a segment of a fort wall at Fort Rox, this trap immediately opens up when it detects a Battering Ram Mouse coming at it. Too many lenses have been destroyed during initial testing so it no longer takes any risks.

This trap has a 100% catch rate against the Battering Ram Mouse.

name: Extreme Queso Pump Charm
description:
This design improves upon the Super Queso Pump Charm by harnessing an extra dose of Wild Tonic. Like their namesake charm, they will allow you to operate your Queso Pump from nearly anywhere in the Kingdom. However, the Extreme Queso Pump Charm will pump QUADRUPLE the quantity of Bland Queso over that of the original!

Maximize your Bland Queso pumping efforts by using this charm at the Queso River.

This charm seems to have no effect when used in otherwordly areas, such as the Acolyte Realm and from within The Rift.

name: Stalemate Charm
description:
One of the most powerful charms hidden away by Zugzwang himself. This charm forces the perpetual game of chess to remain in an unwinnable state.

Using this charm in Zugzwang's Tower prevents you from finishing your game of chess and being kicked out when capturing a Technic King, Mystic King or even the Chessmaster himself!

name: Super Wax Charm
description:
Get your base waxed up! Hunters who want to travel even faster through the treacherous Iceberg should equip this Super Wax Charm! It gives double the move speed bonus that a regular Wax Charm does!

Catching Bergling mice with this charm equipped will move you through the Iceberg even faster than ever before, and with 250 extra power, it's even easier to catch mice!

name: Glittering Geyserite Trap Skin
description:
A devious canopy of Amber Queso stalactites and stalagmites await any hungry mice that approach this trap. Once a mouse takes a sip of cheese, the resonating sound from the slurp bounces off of the back of the cave wall and begins to vibrate the stalactites overheard, causing them to dislodge and trap the mouse in a cage of fallen queso.

The fallen shards melt back into the reservoir beneath and get pulled back up into the canopy to slowly drip and form new stalactites. A completely self-renewable trap system!
marketing_text: A peaceful looking grove that masks the overhanging deadly yet colorful stalactites. The beautiful and serene waters lend an inviting sense of comfort to approaching mice that end up make easy targets as they relax in the clear spring waters.

name: Royal Chrome Storm Wrought Ballista Trap Skin
description:
A chrome coated Storm Module with some other minor modifications has created this powerful and beautiful trap that even the great Ful'Mina herself can't scoff at.

Firing overcharged harpoons, this upgraded model is magnetic and doesn't require a tether to reel the dragons in. After being speared, the harpoon releases its stored electricity into the target to incapacitate it. The trap then uses its vast power to create a focused electromagnetic field that brings the spear back with everything attached to it.


Enhanced by dark dragon magic drawn from Ful'Mina's powerful tooth, its powerful storm vortex can rip an additional Dragon Scale from the clutches of its victims.
marketing_text: Detailed with a Royal Blue finish and trimmed in gold, this Chrome version of the Storm Wrought Ballista Skin is used by the highest ranking royalty and only the wealthiest of hunters.

name: 100 Pack of SUPER|brie+ Cheese
description:
A pack of 100 SUPER|brie+ Cheese.

This special, extra fragrant brie is only available as a gift to the supporters of MouseHunt. Due to the magical properties of SUPER|brie+, crafty mice are unable to steal multiple pieces of this precious cheese from hunters who hunt in dangerous environments. This cheese offers a 100% attraction rate for many of the mice in the game!

name: Large Blooming Spice Plant
description:
A large bloom of assorted spices. When harvested, you are guaranteed to find Mild, Medium, and Hot Spice Leaves.

This blooming spice plant also contains a handful of Flamin' Spice Leaves or, more rarely, Ember Roots or Ember Stones.

name: Medium Blooming Spice Plant
description:
A medium bloom of assorted spices. When harvested, you are guaranteed to find Mild and Medium Spice Leaves.

This blooming spice plant also contains a handful of either Hot or Flamin' Spice Leaves.

name: Small Blooming Spice Plant
description:
A small bloom of assorted spices. When harvested, you are guaranteed to find Mild Spice Leaves.

This blooming spice plant also contains a handful of either Medium or Hot Spice Leaves.

name: Large Queso Keg
description:
A large-sized keg filled with Bland Queso and then corked shut.

Inside you'll find:

• 1,500 Bland Queso


Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Medium Queso Keg
description:
A medium-sized keg filled with Bland Queso and then corked shut.

Inside you'll find:

• 500 Bland Queso


Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Small Queso Keg
description:
A small-sized keg filled with Bland Queso and then corked shut.

Inside you'll find:

• 250 Bland Queso


Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Rift Chronometer
description:
A device able to accurately measure the passage of time within the Rift Plane despite the disingenuous influence of the Absolute Acolyte Mouse.

Use this device to measure Rift Distortions within the Rift Plane in search of clues to find a more deeply hidden structure. The Rift Chronometer will allow you to discover distortions by hunting any Riftwalker or Riftstalker mice. Higher point value mice will provide the greatest number of distortions.

The Cartographer at the Bristle Woods Rift is interested in analyzing these distortions to further chart the Rift Plane. Once you've collected 2000 distortions, make sure to visit the Bristle Woods Rift Cartographer to reveal the Valour Rift within the Rift Plane!

Good luck, brave hunter!
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Bristle Woods Rift Cartographer

name: Rift Distortion
description:
A distortion of time and space detected by your handy Rift Chronometer. Capturing Rift Walker or Rift Stalker mice with high point values reveal the greatest quantity of these distortions.

Collect 2000 distortions and visit the Bristle Woods Rift Cartographer to unlock a map of the Valour Rift!
obtain_hint: Hunt mice in the Rift Plane while in possession of a Rift Chronometer

name: Valour Rift Map Piece
description:
This map piece depicts an area of the Rift Plane within the Valour Region. The Bristle Woods Rift Cartographer requires information that can be gathered by collecting 2000 Rift Distortions from Rift Plane mice.

Purchase a Rift Chronometer from the Bristle Woods Rift to begin your adventure and discover the Valour Rift.

This area of the Rift Plane can only be explored by hunters ranked Archduke/Archduchess or above.

Obtain this map piece during the Archduke/Archduchess adventure:
End the Total Eclipse

name: 2-Pack of Gauntlet String Cheese
description: String cheese combined with the extracted essence from a Gauntlet Elixir. This powerful, swirling stringed cheese contains raw power at its core which Gauntlet Rift mice find intoxicatingly alluring.

name: Valour Rift Gift Basket
description:
A perfect gift to help a friend start their climb up the Rift Gauntlet Tower.

Inside you'll find:

• 30 Gauntlet String Cheese
• 20 Champion's Fire

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Valour Rift Large Supply Kit
description:
A large Valour Rift Supply Kit to overstay your welcome in the tower.

Inside you'll find:

• 1,000 Gauntlet String Cheese
• 1,000 Champion's Fire
• 500 Rift Super Power Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 4 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Valour Rift Supply Kit
description:
Get a head start up the Rift Gauntlet Tower with this kit!

Inside you'll find:

• 250 Gauntlet String Cheese
• 250 Champion's Fire

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: The Gilded Steps
description: Plated in gold, this enchanted item depicts the never-ending steps that wind throughout the Valour Rift Tower. As you gaze upon it, the stairs float up from the bottom and back to the top in an endless spiraling pattern.

name: Codex of Valour: Bard Page
description:
An archaic musical score with an unrecognizable set of lines and notes. Although you can not decipher what is written on the page, holding it invokes a jovial yet calming melody in your mind.

Adds +1 Luck while a Tactical trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Dusty Page
description:
A worn and tattered page that looks like it is about to crumble to dust. When you hold it, it begins to slowly restore itself, although you feel drained followed by a sense of dread while doing so.

Adds +5% Power Bonus while a Hydro trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Eclipse Page
description:
Crackling with power and energy, the runes and glyphs that cleave into the page move and shift as you try to focus. Without any ability to understand what lies before you, you still feel a source of magical energy coursing through the page and into your being.

Adds +5% Power Bonus while a Forgotten trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Magic Page
description:
A seemingly blank page. While holding it, your mind succumbs to visions of grandeur allowing you to see the once hidden mystical runes and understand their power.

Adds +5% Power Bonus while a Shadow trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Melee Page
description:
A sense of pride and honour overcomes you as you hold this page. The glorious battles of warriors long passed flood your mind as you learn from their experiences.

Adds +5% Power Bonus while a Tactical trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Noble Page
description:
Scrolling text floats up from the bottom of the page in gold. Entitlement and nobility flood your thoughts as you experience the royal lineage of the ancestors of kings.

Adds +5% Power Bonus while an Arcane trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Puppetry Page
description:
This page is full of bright images depicting a story. The images come to life and perform a play in front of your very eyes. Without the use of words, you are able to understand their story.

Adds +5% Power Bonus while a Physical trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour: Thievery Page
description:
Unknown scribbles, symbols and markings fill the page nonsensically. Looks to be a unique language used by thieves and rogues. Even though you can't understand it, you feel that luck is in your favour while holding it.

Adds +1 Luck while a Physical trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Valour Rift General Store

name: Codex of Valour
description:
This book once housed a collection of pages with sections ascribed to the factions of the Valour Rift that have since been lost to the tower. Every page was written and imbued by the members of each floor within the tower, lending their power to the pages...

With this codex in your possession, your trap will be enhanced with a 5% Power Bonus while a Rift trap is armed.

Additionally, every page that is recovered will further enhance your trap. It has been quite some time since the Codex of Valour was whole...
obtain_hint: Complete the adventure: "End the Total Eclipse"

name: Gauntlet Elixir
description:
A potent potable derived from the ambient energy surrounding the Valour Rift Tower. Extracted and filtered into a soft and aerated substance that infuses its energy into that which it is applied.

These elixirs can be traded in at the Valour Rift Cheese Shoppe for Gauntlet String Cheese.
obtain_hint: Hunt at the tower entrance within the Valour Rift

name: Tower Sigil
description: A glyph containing magic rune words of power that can be used to increase your abilities in the Rift Gauntlet Tower.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Valour Rift

name: Tower Secrets
description: An esoteric parchment that has integral plans and details behind the architectural design of the enigmatic Valour Rift Gauntlet Tower.
obtain_hint: Hunt in the Valour Rift on Floors 8 and above

name: Champion's Fire
description: The fighting spirit of a fallen champion that had previously attempted to scale the Rift Gauntlet Tower stored in a tiny bauble that can be expended to bolster your abilities inside the Valour Rift.

name: Fragment of the Eclipse
description: A small fragment of an eclipsed core. The power coursing through this small fragment is impressive considering it is only a fraction of what it once was.

name: Tattered Celestial Skin Pattern
description:
These patterns were derived from the stars and constellations themselves. The height of the Rift Gauntlet Tower ascends beyond the Rift mist and allows a clear view of the endless nighttime sky.

Turn these in at the Valour Rift Trapsmith for various trap skins.
obtain_hint: Hunt Possessed Armaments, Prestigious Adventurer, Soldier of the Shade, and Terrified Adventurer mice in the Valour Rift

name: Core of the Eclipse
description: The corona from this eclipsed core is so strong that it causes the air to combust around it. This blazing energy represents only a small fraction of the powerful magic the Total Eclipse Mouse itself commands.
obtain_hint: Hunt The Total Eclipse Mouse in the Valour Rift

name: Prestige Base
description:
A slab of the foundation from the Valour Rift Gauntlet Tower. It shares a bond with the original structure and grows stronger the further you progress into the tower. The bond is so strong that it persists through and outside of the Rift Plane, in all other areas of the Kingdom.

This base will grow in power as the hunter reaches new heights:

+20 Power Boost per floor reached during Ultimate Umbra

+2 Luck Boost per Total Eclipse floor reached during Ultimate Umbra

These boosts are based on highest floor reached and are applied permanently as you reach greater heights during Ultimate Umbra.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Celestial Dissonance Trap
description:
A powerful model replica of the Valour Rift Tower derived from its original blueprints. This replica tower uses the power of the Eclipse Core to recombine itself around the mouse, sending it into its own version of an infinite tower in another dimension.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Gauntlet String Cheese
description: String cheese combined with the extracted essence from a Gauntlet Elixir. This powerful, swirling stringed cheese contains raw power at its core which Valour Rift mice find intoxicatingly alluring.

name: Rift Extreme Power Charm
description:
The casing of this charm can barely contain the twisted Rift power within. The charm's energy sparks violently in its unrelenting desire to unleash its power into the Rift Plane.

Handle with care!
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Rift Super Power Charm
description:
Infused with even more Rift power, this upgraded version of a Rift Power Charm packs a little more punch!
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Lunar Celestial Dissonance Skin
description: A powerful model replica of the Valour Rift Tower derived from its original blueprints. This replica tower uses the power of the Eclipse Core to recombine itself around the mouse, sending it into its own version of an infinite tower in another dimension.
marketing_text: Written in the stars was the design for this skin. A modified core that projects the heavenly glory that exists beyond the Rift mist. Very few mice have seen it with their own eyes which captivates them in wonder when they gaze upon it.

name: Solar Celestial Dissonance Skin
description: A powerful model replica of the Valour Rift Tower derived from its original blueprints. This replica tower uses the power of the Eclipse Core to recombine itself around the mouse, sending it into its own version of an infinite tower in another dimension.
marketing_text: Written in the stars was the design for this skin. A modified core that projects a day of fun in the sun. With very few Rift mice ever able to leave the Rift Plane, this depiction provides a powerful distraction from the endless night of the Valour Rift.

name: End the Total Eclipse
description: Within the Valour Rift stands an endlessly tall tower slightly out of sync with our timeline. Using knowledge learned from your Rift Chronometer, you must synchronize yourself with the tower's timeline for as long as you can to recover valuable loot and artifacts from within the Rift Gauntlet. Will you be able to manifest an Ultimate Umbra and summon the Total Eclipse?

name: Spooky Reward Box
description:
A special spooky box of rewards!

Inside you'll find:

• 25 Ultimate Spooky Charms
• 10 Spooky Shuffle Tickets
• 250 SUPER|brie+
• 500 King's Credits

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 3 Days from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Happy Halloween Journal Theme
description: A Happy Halloween theme earned by gathering enough Spooky Ship Parts during the 2019 Halloween Event!

name: Spooky Ship Parts
description:
A stack of ship parts that have been blasted clean off of the Grand Ghostship.

Collect these to earn great rewards during the Grand Ghostship Halloween event.

name: Hallowed Ground Base
description: An unearthed section of hallowed ground formed into a dark yet peaceful base.

name: Cemetery Gate Grappler
description: A section of a cemetery gate repurposed with magical Draconic bindings and pure iron harpoons. Dragons captured with this trap get sealed within the gates. The magical bindings prevent the dragon from being able to escape.

name: Rift Spooky Charm
description:
Too spooky for the mortal realm, this powerful charm harrows the Rift!

All types of Spooky Charms interact with all Halloween traps by giving them a 20% Power Bonus!
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Pearly Gate Grappler Trap Skin
description: A section of a cemetery gate repurposed with magical Draconic bindings and pure iron harpoons. Dragons captured with this trap get sealed within the gates. The magical bindings prevent the dragon from being able to escape.
marketing_text: Golden celestial gates decorate the Gate Grappler to help ease your mind when capturing dragons letting you pretend you are sending them to a better place!

name: Terrifying Terrorsplit Squash Trap Skin
description: Assembled here is a monstrous trap of arcing electrical surges, pumping straight from the quantum quartz in the center. When a mouse triggers this trap, it is subjected to an infinite timeline of catch attempts to find one where it is caught. Unfortunately, sometimes the timeline it finds is not your own, giving an alternative reality version of yourself credit for the catch. Hey, at least it's nice to know one of the many versions of you is always catching a mouse!
marketing_text: A terror-inducing squash decorated in harrowing, haunting Halloween fashion! Mice caught with this dressed up version of the Timesplit Dissonance Trap experience an infinite timeline of Halloween celebration!

name: Bring Down the Grand Ghostship
description: Foil the dastardly plans of Captain Cannonball and Admiral Arrrgh by preventing the assembly of the Grand Ghostship. Fire cannonballs to dislodge Spooky Ship Parts, disrupting their construction efforts, and putting an end to the terror in the sky!

name: Unstable Rift Core
description:
Careful study of the entire Codex of Valour has revealed the true nature of a Core of the Eclipse.

Bringing three Cores of the Eclipse within close proximity to one another results in a cascade reaction producing this unstable version of the core. The immense gravitational forces are in perfect balance, manifesting an ornate crystal field, frozen in time.

Don't let its balanced beauty fool you: This Rift Core is incredibly unstable! A gentle poke, or even the slightest breeze, will collapse the core and, in a flash of light, pull items from the Rift Gauntlet Tower's timeline into phase with our own, destroying the Unstable Rift Core in the process.

Once in your inventory, carefully poke these Unstable Rift Cores to find Champion's Fire, various Rift Power Charms, Essences, as well as gold!

name: Arduous Treasure Chest (Season 7)
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!

description:
You and your friends have completed an exquisite Gilded Treasure Map and have discovered this tempting Treasure Chest!
You will receive:

• 50,000 Gold
• 50,000 Points
• 25 Gilded Charms
• 10 Gilded Coins
• 100 Ancient Charms
• 10 Ultimate Luck, Power, or Lucky Power Charms
• 10 Super, Extreme, or Ultimate Ancient Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

There is also a chance to obtain the Slayer Scroll Case which offers a tough challenge!
