The powerful Dragon Slayer Cannon upgraded with a new and shiny chrome plated shell. The upgrade of the chrome coating offers exceptional heat resistance which insulates the inner core, preventing power lost through heat dissipation by an additional 25%! Increasing the overall power and efficacy of the Cannon and maintains its ability to blast an additional Dragon Scale from the clutches of mice it captures.

A masterpiece of Dragon hunting equipment!
marketing_text: Chrome petals float around the cannon just as an egg has been launched from it at near mach speed. Eggs can be seen flying over the horizon from Queso Canyon all the way to the Mountains of Gnawnia.

name: Eggstravagant KingBot Trap Skin
description:
Using the new and improved Chivalric Code++ (CC++) programming language in combination with the latest advancements in A.I. (Aristocratic Intelligence), comes the cutting edge in Physical mouse trap technology: the Legendary KingBot!

This model improves upon the statistics of its predecessor, the Charming PrinceBot, in every way by employing the most sophisticated nobility algorithms ever conceived. It was designed with a Worthiness Factor so high that when confronted with the industry standard Sword-in-the-Stone unit test, it not only removed the sword with ease but completely obliterated the stone in the process!
marketing_text: The Eggstravagant KingBot, devout searcher of eggs gallops around the Kingdom looking for hidden marvels... and eggs. With his findGnawniaEggs algorithm, he will leave no stone unturned searching for his prize.

name: Fount Of Fluff Trap Skin
description: A bubbling fount of molten queso which is superheated faster than it can vaporize. The surface tension is so high that even the slightest vibration can trigger an explosion! The specially crafted spouts focus the eruption towards the placement of the cheese on the trap hoping to cover any mice that wander too close.
marketing_text: The ground shakes below unknowing what's to show. Hundreds of rabbits run about, causing a fluffy white-out!

name: Slumbering Bunny Trap Skin
description:
This formidable, fully-powered contraption has the ability to resonate subharmonic frequencies that only mice can hear. It uses this melodious stonesong to lure its prey hypnotically into a secluded location deep within a rock formation. Once the mesmerized mouse is within reach, the trap snatches it with its mighty stone pincers and encases it into a nearby boulder. It then uses its ultra-high powered laser tail to carve a slab out of the boulder so that it can carry the encased mouse and deliver it to the hunter on a stone platter.

It is said that the trap resonates a unique stonesong depending on the mouse but all the hunter ever hears is rock. Over time, some hunters have grown quite fond of this strange but compelling "rock music".
marketing_text: Snoozing in a meadow, the giant fluff ball's snores can be heard from miles away. Don't get too close to pet the beast because you might wake it up, although its fur does look soft...

name: Chrome Regal Thinking Tree Trap Skin
description: A mystical stone structure soaked in thought wave magnifying chrome. The resonance of the chrome amplifies the thought projections of the encased jewels, allowing them to grasp the minds of mice from further away. The mind erasure process is even faster as everything the mice experience is chrome! The jewels work their magic until the victim's mind is as spotless and shiny as the chrome itself.
marketing_text:
Sometimes when you have a lot on your mind and are feeling overwhelmed, taking a moment to sit under the lush canopy of a breathtakingly beautiful tree can really help you put it all in perspective. The Chrome Regal Thinking Tree takes things to another level by granting mice a whole new perspective to appreciate.

Granting them a peaceful moment to meditate, mice often rest against the trunk and reflect upon their invasion plans while they nibble the trap's cheese. Its elegance, beauty, and mind piercing crystal are sure to further dissuade any invasion plans.

After all, if the mice were to succeed and destroy the kingdom, where else would they get to encounter such immaculate beauty while enjoying the perfect morsel of cheese?

name: Regal Princebot of the Golden Glade Trap Skin
description: This state-of-the-art machine was designed using Gnawnia's most sophisticated droid technology and programmed using the latest version of Chivalric Code to ensure the most accurate honour and nobility algorithms. It comes equipped with 24-karat luscious golden locks as well as a glistening, stainless steel longsword that is nearly as sharp as the PrinceBot's charming wit. Every model comes complete with a Trusty SteedBot to improve height, speed, and dramatic flair.
marketing_text:
Immaculate. Resplendent. Splendiferous.

Whatever words dare attempt to describe being overwhelmed by true sublime beauty, they always seem to fall short in the presence of this refulgent idol.

This hoofed avatar of peace and prosperity stun all who gaze upon it. Mice who dare to approach the cheese end up dumbstruck in the princes' glowing presence. A graceful flash of its golden mane and a swift flurry of its staff are generally the last thing mice remember, at least if they haven't immediately pledged themselves to love, beauty and obscene opulence.

name: Regal Stalwart Guardian Trap Skin
description:
This formidable, fully-powered contraption has the ability to resonate subharmonic frequencies that only mice can hear. It uses this melodious stonesong to lure its prey hypnotically into a secluded location deep within a rock formation. Once the mesmerized mouse is within reach, the trap snatches it with its mighty stone pincers and encases it into a nearby boulder. It then uses its ultra-high powered laser tail to carve a slab out of the boulder so that it can carry the encased mouse and deliver it to the hunter on a stone platter.

It is said that the trap resonates a unique stonesong depending on the mouse but all the hunter ever hears is rock. Over time, some hunters have grown quite fond of this strange but compelling "rock music".
marketing_text:
It is said that these elite guardians were first commissioned by the King in order to guard the Prize Vault. Thankfully hunters had become so good at protecting the castle from mouse invasion, that these specialized units never saw even a single mouse. Rather than letting these works of high-tech art and culture collect dust, the King decided to make this model available to all hunters.

This Regal Stalwart Guardian will remain on high-alert at all times, ever ready to protect your most valuable items and resources from menacing mouse marauders.

name: Regal Vault Procession Trap Skin
description:
The Surprise Transport Incarceration Nuisance Grabber Enhanced Retrofit takes the art of criminal capture to the next level. The increased power allows it to actively seek out suspects rather than simply waiting for them to turn up of their own volition. The bright lights make the fake gold and gems sparkle and glisten irresistibly which can fool even the more discerning criminals, making this model a far more thorough and efficient convict catcher.

The slogan for this model is "Clean up the skies!" which is generally considered to be a bit ironic given the excessive extra pollution that it produces over its predecessor.
marketing_text:
Nothing entices master criminal mice more than a chance to steal a piece of cheese AND a healthy chunk of the Royal Treasury.

Mice who dive through this regal door hoping to pluck some treasure quickly find themselves securely locked up and being transported to face royal justice.

At least during the ride, they'll have an accompaniment of trumpets as they are half buried by looming piles of gold. Once they tire of attempting to swim through dense, sloshing waves of gold, they can always rest against the "criminally soft", velvet-lined, ultra-heavy-duty vault door.

If you're going to get caught during a heist, it might as well be a fantastic spectacle!

name: Draconic Depths Multi Cheese Mega Pack
description:
An overflowing bundle of cheeses from the Draconic Depths!

Includes:
  • 100 Fiery Fontina Cheese
  • 100 Icy Isabirra Cheese
  • 100 Poisonous Provolone Cheese

name: Large Steel Barrel
description:
This is the largest version of Lil Jill's Steel Barrels. It's packed with a hefty amount of extremely volatile material that should only be handled by well-trained professionals!

Handle with Extreme Care!

Inside you'll find:

• 60 Dragon Embers
• 60 Dragon Ashes


Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Large Unstable Geode
description:
These massive, miraculous minerals form naturally in the Draconic Depths but can only be retrieved by a skilled geologist who knows how to spot them. On the outside, they look like any other rock but on the inside, they are loaded with extremely valuable resources!

Crack open this breathtakingly beautiful geode to find a random assortment of 100 cheeses including Elemental Emmental, Fiery Fontina, Icy Isabirra, and Poisonous Provolone.

In addition, you'll find 600 Dragon Embers, a random assortment of 25 Dragonbane charms, and very rarely, you might even find a Dragon's Skull!

name: Medium Steel Barrel
description:
This is the mid-sized version of Lil Jill's Steel Barrels. It's packed with a moderate amount of highly flammable and extremely dangerous material!

Handle with Extreme Care!

Inside you'll find:

• 20 Dragon Embers
• 20 Dragon Ashes


Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Small Steel Barrel
description:
This is the pint-sized version of Lil Jill's Steel Barrels. Don't let its size fool you, it's just as flammable and dangerous as the bigger ones!

Handle with Extreme Care!

Inside you'll find:

• 10 Dragon Embers
• 10 Dragon Ashes


Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.

name: Small Unstable Geode
description:
These rare and beautiful minerals form naturally in the Draconic Depths but can only be retrieved by a skilled geologist who knows how to spot them. On the outside, they look like any other rock but on the inside, they contain an assortment of valuable goodies.

Crack open this geode to find a random assortment of 25 cheeses including Fiery Fontina, Icy Isabirra, and Poisonous Provolone.

name: Dragon Ashes
description:
This brilliant blue ball of superheated plasma is the result of using mind-bogglingly high temperatures to incinerate nearly any item down into a form of protomatter known as Dragon Ashes. These Dragon Ashes are so pure in draconic essence that when enough of them are recombined they can be used to form the extraordinarily powerful Mythical Dragon Heart. Some geologists speculate that the first dragons may have obtained their powerful, magical hearts by collecting these ashes from the planet's core.

The temperatures required to create Dragon Ashes are so extreme that they can only be incinerated from loot that originated from an Elemental Dragons' Den.
obtain_hint: Incinerating Replicart™ loot from the Elemental Dragons' Den in Draconic Depths

name: Dragonhide Sliver Forge Base
description:
By harnessing the intense heat of compressed Dragon Ashes, this miraculous base has the extraordinary ability to forge additional Dragonhide Slivers whenever a mouse drops them as loot.

This base will double Dragonhide Sliver loot drops (Draconic Depths: Replicart™ compatible).

name: Ronza's Draconic Depths Supply Ship
description:
A fearsome looking dirigible loaded with supplies to raid the Draconic Depths!

Inside you'll find:

• 300 Condensed Creativity
• 300 Magic Essence
• 400 Airship Charms
• 100 Ultimate Dragonbane Charms
• 7,500 Dragon Embers

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Chrome Slumbering Boulder Upgrade Kit
description:
Take tactical hunting to all new chrome heights by upgrading the Slumbering Boulder Trap into a magnificent chrome version. The resulting trap is shinier, more aerodynamic, and capable of producing an even more intense subharmonic frequency.

Use this kit with Slumbering Boulder Trap Parts to create:
Chrome Slumbering Boulder Trap
A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!
    Power: 15000
    Power Bonus: 30%
    Attraction Bonus: 18%
    Luck: 42
    Power Type: Tactical
    Title Required: Archduke/Archduchess
    Cheese Effect: Insanely Stale
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Ronza's Traveling Shoppe Trapsmith

name: Slumbering Boulder Trap Parts
description: A disassembled Slumbering Boulder Trap. Somehow the parts themselves still appear to be able to camouflage into their surroundings. Careful not to lose a piece!

name: Chrome Slumbering Boulder Trap
description: A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!

name: Arcane Storm Summoner Lightning Rod Trap
description: Ronza has faced her fair share of storms and inclement weather during her many years spent navigating the skies. This unique design leverages the arcane powers of lightning, wind, rain, and more into a formidable trap. This ornate rod appears completely dormant... until a mouse approaches. Fog and wind remove a mouse's sense of direction, rain and frost incapacitate it, and finally an arcane lightning strike all but ensures a capture.

name: Chrome Black Knight Boulder Skin
description: A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!
marketing_text: Favoured by hunters from distant lands, this trap stalks silently through any environment despite its heavily armoured metal chassis. Its dark, intimidating presence evokes memories of a bygone age of both chivalry and brutality.

name: Chrome Jungle Cannon Trap Skin
description:
The powerful Dragon Slayer Cannon upgraded with a new and shiny chrome plated shell. The upgrade of the chrome coating offers exceptional heat resistance which insulates the inner core, preventing power lost through heat dissipation by an additional 25%! Increasing the overall power and efficacy of the Cannon and maintains its ability to blast an additional Dragon Scale from the clutches of mice it captures.

A masterpiece of Dragon hunting equipment!
marketing_text: Found deep in distant jungles, this trap was possibly left behind by an ancient civilization. Though it left the jungle, the jungle never truly left it. As a result, it occasionally fires out huge clumps of foliage that cover the entire surrounding area. Thankfully this doesn't seem to interfere with its mouse-catching ability. Rusted and filthy as it may be, this thing still packs a punch!

name: Forged Alloy Devastator Dragon Cannon Trap Skin
description: After many years of exhaustive research, the new pinnacle of dragon hunting technology has finally been created: the Dragon Devastator Multi-cannon! By harnessing the extraordinarily destructive power of the Mythical Dragon Heart and focussing it through a myriad of Dragon's Breath Opals, this masterful machine capitalizes on all the unrealized potential of its predecessors and has become something truly more than the sum of its parts. It is capable of utilizing the same power that fuels the very essence of the world's mightiest dragons and redirects it into multiple, ultra-concentrated energy beams of cataclysmic strength and intensity. Never before has there been such a momentous and monumental leap forward in dragon catching innovation as this illustrious invention!
marketing_text: Give the Dragon Devastator Multi-Cannon that rustic chic style that only imported forged alloy metal can provide. Looks great in any environment. The alloy is guaranteed not to rust or tarnish even when exposed to the most vile forms of dragonfire including devastating flame, deep-freezing cold, noxious slime, and more!

name: Chrome Polygon School of Sharks Trap Skin
description: The ultimate upgrade for the ultimate aquatic predator! This fearsome trap is the perfect fusion of cutting edge technology with prehistoric predatory instincts. It takes all the ferocity of its predecessor and enhances it with chrome armour plating, ultra high-powered multi-wavelength laser emitters, and solid chrome teeth so sharp that they could slice through the hull of a battleship like it was a tin can... just imagine what they could do to a mouse!
marketing_text: The Chrome Polygon School of Sharks Skin takes hydro-based MouseHunting to new, high-definition places! Mice who stumble into this trap's sphere of influence can't help but lose track of reality and find themselves somewhere where they don't know where they are.

name: Unstable Rainbow Inkwell
description:
The mysterious, colourful liquid contained within is no ordinary ink. It is believed to be made from pure, liquefied rainbow essence. This appears to be the Mythweaver's secret ink that he has been using to rewrite the Book of Lore as well as the many other ancient tales throughout the Folklore Forest such as the Tale of the Bountiful Beanstalk, the School of Sorcery, the Draconic Depths, and more. It seems this mystical ink has the power to transform thought and imagination into real, tangible items!

Once uncorked, this fantastical fluid will instantly coalesce into a random assortment of items from the Foreword Farm, Prologue Pond, Table of Contents, Bountiful Beanstalk, School of Sorcery, and Draconic Depths. There is even a chance that it might spawn something from beyond those tales.

name: Metaphor Morsel
description:
This minuscule morsel contains a wealth of useful analogies that when combined together make for a profoundly delicious snack.

Use these morsels to craft Metaphor Manchego Cheese.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Afterword Acres and Epilogue Falls

name: Rainbow Nib
description:
If the pen is mightier than the sword then the nib must be mightiest of all! This extremely powerful pen nib was forged by the Mythweaver himself using calcified rainbow dust. When affixed to a Golden Quill, it transforms it into a Rainbow Quill which is capable of writing more words than ever thought possible!

The only way to obtain these rare nibs is to loot them from the Mythweaver after the Silver and Golden Quill upgrades have been unlocked in the Table of Contents. The higher the Encyclopedia Volume when the Mythweaver is caught, the more likely he will be to drop one of these.
obtain_hint: Loot drops from the Mythweaver after the Silver and Golden Quills have been unlocked

name: Mythweaver's Guide to World Domination
description:
This complete how-to guide contains detailed, step-by-step instructions for any mouse looking to achieve their goals of total world domination. There is no listed author or publisher so the origin of this extremely powerful and oddly specific book is a mystery.

This appears to be the playbook that the Mythweaver has been using all this time to enact his nefarious plans in the Folklore Forest.

The first chapter describes rewriting folklore at the Table of Contents, the second chapter details how to write oneself into the Bountiful Beanstalk, and so on. It's all here! Everything the Mythweaver has done so far is laid out in clearly written instructions accompanied by detailed diagrams, full colour illustrations, and even a few pie charts.

Each chapter appears to have been checked off... except for the last one. The final chapter in this book is titled "How to Write the Ultimate Conclusion to the Kingdom of Gnawnia in 3 Easy Steps!". Skimming through this chapter, you're able to determine the final stages of the Mythweaver's plan:

  • Step 1: Corrupt the Infinitree at the Afterword Acres
  • Step 2: Discover the hidden wisdom of the Epilogue Falls
  • Step 3: Write the end of the story at the Conclusion Cliffs

This is it! You have what you need to stop the Mythweaver before he finishes his ultimate plan. It's not going to be easy but with this book, you've got a fighting chance!

Only hunters ranked Viceroy and above can read from these enchanted pages...

Obtain this map piece during the Viceroy adventure:
Fight the Blight and Save the Infinitree

name: 2-Pack of Allegory Anari Cheese
description: Two pieces of Allegory Anari Cheese.

name: Folklore Finale Gift Basket
description:
Give the gift of a satisfying conclusion! Inside you'll find:

• 15 Condensed Creativity
• 15 Metaphor Manchego Cheese

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Folklore Finale Large Supply Kit
description:
An overflowing kit of extremely useful supplies for any hunter preparing to write their conclusion! Inside you'll find:

• 500 Condensed Creativity
• 300 Magic Essence
• 500 Metaphor Manchego Cheese
• 300 Rainbow Spore Charms

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 4 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Folklore Finale Supply Kit
description:
A kit full of inspirational supplies for any hunter prepping to write their conclusion! Inside you'll find:

• 100 Condensed Creativity
• 100 Magic Essence
• 100 Metaphor Manchego Cheese

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: 2-Pack of Metaphor Manchego Cheese
description: Two pieces of Metaphor Manchego Cheese.

name: 2-Pack of Plotting Paneer Cheese
description: Two pieces of Plotting Paneer Cheese.

name: 2-Pack of Symbolic Sirene Cheese
description: Two pieces of Symbolic Sirene Cheese.

name: Allegory Algae
description:
These astonishing aquatic plants exist as generalizations for thoughtful comparison amongst the marine life in the Epilogue Falls. Fortunately, they're also delicious and make for wonderful cheese ingredients!

Use this algae to craft Allegory Anari Cheese.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Epilogue Falls

name: Conceptual Coral
description:
These colonial marine invertebrates tend to form around a few core concepts in the Epilogue Falls. The concepts themselves are very abstract and not entirely known to non-marine life but the general gist of it seems to be: strength good, mice bad. Using these highly sophisticated but purely theoretical notions, the King's best marine biologists have determined that these coral are willing and ready to offer their unimaginable durability to aid hunters in their efforts to clear the unwanted mice that are damaging their ecosystem.

Use Conceptual Coral to build the most durable barrels in the Epilogue Falls.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Epilogue Falls

name: Folklore Motif-Index: Hydro Luck
description:
This long-lost collection of volumes contains powerful and detailed secrets about the strengths and weaknesses of Gnawnia's most influential characters. Any hunter who arms themselves with this information is bound to achieve great things!

This volume describes techniques derived from Hydro folktales for improving your luck. Adds +5 Luck while a Hydro trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Epilogue Falls General Store

name: Folklore Motif-Index: Hydro Power
description:
This long-lost collection of volumes contains powerful and detailed secrets about the strengths and weaknesses of Gnawnia's most influential characters. Any hunter who arms themselves with this information is bound to achieve great things!

This volume describes techniques derived from Hydro folktales for increasing your power. Adds 20% Power Bonus while a Hydro trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Epilogue Falls General Store

name: Folklore Motif-Index: Tactical Luck
description:
This long-lost collection of volumes contains powerful and detailed secrets about the strengths and weaknesses of Gnawnia's most influential characters. Any hunter who arms themselves with this information is bound to achieve great things!

This volume describes techniques derived from Tactical folktales for improving your luck. Adds +5 Luck while a Tactical trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Afterword Acres General Store

name: Folklore Motif-Index: Tactical Power
description:
This long-lost collection of volumes contains powerful and detailed secrets about the strengths and weaknesses of Gnawnia's most influential characters. Any hunter who arms themselves with this information is bound to achieve great things!

This volume describes techniques derived from Tactical folktales for increasing your power. Adds 20% Power Bonus while a Tactical trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Afterword Acres General Store

name: Hypothetical Halophyte
description:
These strong, saltwater plants are so unbelievably durable that their very existence is still theoretical. There is a lot of conjecture amongst the King's best marine botanists whether these plants are even real at all or whether they are merely abstractions of a suggested idea... despite the fact that they've held them in their hands.

Use Hypothetical Halophyte to build more durable barrels in the Epilogue Falls.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Epilogue Falls

name: Idea Germ
description:
This extremely complex and highly advanced microorganism has evolved with the express purpose of spreading infectious ideas at a rapid pace. The nature of these ideas can be benevolent or malevolent depending on their source. Unfortunately, in the Afterword Acres, the Blight Bringers are using these powerful pathogens to spread their vile virus throughout the area's vegetation including to the mighty Infinitree!

If these germs could be recovered from the Blight Bringers then perhaps they could be used to create more positive, useful ideas.
obtain_hint: Loot drops from the Blight Bringers in the Afterword Acres

name: Literary Log
description:
These extraordinary logs are willingly gifted to honest, hard-working droids by the Infinitree in the Afterword Acres. It is said that every grain in the wood tells a unique story and that no two logs are quite the same. Unfortunately, no one knows how to read the strange cuneiform markings on them so they all look pretty much the same to most people.

Use your droids in the Afterword Acres to carve these into Poetic Planks.
obtain_hint: Extracted from the Infinitree by droids in the Afterword Acres

name: Pearl of Wisdom
description: These small but mesmerizing pearls are formed by unfathomable quantities of wisdom coalescing within extremely salty water into a single, swirling mass that contains all the knowledge of the Folklore Forest. If this tremendous wisdom could be released and harnessed, it could surely be used to create powerful and wondrous things.
obtain_hint: Loot drops from Torrential Tyrants in the Epilogue Falls

name: Plot Hook
description:
These ornate, glistening hooks can be found bobbing around in the river rapids nearest to the Epilogue Falls where the current is the strongest. Rather than catching fish, these hooks are designed to catch a hunter's attention. Each one is imbued with an original circumstance capable of beginning or ending a story all on its own. It is believed that if you combine enough of these Plot Hooks together you might be able to formulate the conclusion to an epic tale.

Use these Plot Hooks to craft Plotting Paneer Cheese to be used in the Conclusion Cliffs.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Epilogue Falls

name: Poetic Plank
description:
All the art and beauty of the Afterword Acres culminates into this exquisite slab of finely carved wood. The limitless stories told by the Infinitree are abbreviated into short stanzas and etched onto these planks making them capable of withstanding not only the great test of time but also the harsh, salty rapids in the Epilogue Falls.

Use these Poetic Planks to build barrels for travelling up the rapids in the Epilogue Falls.
obtain_hint: Carved from Literary Logs by the droids in the Afterword Acres

name: Symbolic Seashell
description:
This is not merely a seashell. It is a comparative representation of what it means to be a seashell in the modern world. It also has a scrumptious salty flavour and a delightful crunch which makes it a marvelous ingredient for cheese!

Use these seashells to craft Symbolic Sirene Cheese.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Epilogue Falls

name: Bionic Sea Turtle Trap
description: This serene, sophisticated, sea turtle is the latest advancement in aquatic automaton technology. It swims through the seas with unprecedented speed and grace and is able to effortlessly outmaneuver even the most agile of marine mice. Due to the Pearls of Wisdom used in its construction, it is not only swift and powerful but also extremely intelligent and programmed with an unlimited supply of clever idioms, poignant metaphors, and even helpful life advice. Some mice who encounter this miraculous contraption give themselves up willingly to it because they're so mystified by its insightful guidance to do so.

name: Lumberdroid Sawmill Trap
description: This fully-functional, fully-automated, sustainable sawmill is the epitome of efficiency! The custom-built Lumberdroids that operate the mill are second-to-none at sawing, chopping, and replanting. The engineers that built these Lumberdroids were determined to program them to work with three primary objectives: diligence, efficiency, and safety. However, due to time and budget constraints, they were only able to program two objectives.

name: Massive Mecha Snapping Turtle Trap
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!

name: Allegory Anari Cheese
description: This soft, creamy cheese has a mild flavour with strong undertones of fictional circumstances that are remarkably familiar and relatable. Mice who eat this tend to question why they started down their nefarious path in the first place.

name: Metaphor Manchego Cheese
description: This strong, flavourful cheese expresses itself in uniquely vague yet profound ways. Mice who eat it tend to see themselves from a new perspective and often give up on a life of malfeasance afterwards.

name: Plotting Paneer Cheese
description:
This soft, scheming cheese has the ability to weave a satisfying conclusion for mice of any genre at the Conclusion Cliffs.

Plotting Paneer Cheese provides 25 Pages / Notoriety per catch in the Conclusion Cliffs.

name: Symbolic Sirene Cheese
description: This salty, brined cheese has a pungent flavour that evokes thoughts of comparison with objects in the surrounding environment. Mice who eat it tend to reflect on themselves and their relationship with the world around them and often find peace and harmony afterwards.

name: Super Rainbow Spore Charm
description: This breathtakingly beautiful charm is bursting at the seams with power, luck, and colour! It garners its immense mouse catching power by focusing the magic of a double rainbow (so intense) through Crystal Crucibles and into its dangerously potent Nightshade.

name: Benevolent Frog Prince Trap Skin
description: This serene, sophisticated, sea turtle is the latest advancement in aquatic automaton technology. It swims through the seas with unprecedented speed and grace and is able to effortlessly outmaneuver even the most agile of marine mice. Due to the Pearls of Wisdom used in its construction, it is not only swift and powerful but also extremely intelligent and programmed with an unlimited supply of clever idioms, poignant metaphors, and even helpful life advice. Some mice who encounter this miraculous contraption give themselves up willingly to it because they're so mystified by its insightful guidance to do so.
marketing_text: This is no ordinary frog who speaks and performs helpful tasks, this one is also a prince! Apparently, it was once a human who was cursed by a wicked witch and all it needs is a kind princess to turn it back. Unfortunately, all the princesses in the region have been reluctant to help because this new form has been so useful for retrieving items that have been lost in a body of water which is a surprisingly common occurrence for princesses.

name: Big Bad Slumbering Wolfbot Trap Skin
description: A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!
marketing_text: The Big Bad Slumbering Wolfbot and Little Red Riding Droid have teamed up at long last to create the ultimate mouse-catching strategy! The Wolfbot, being a master of disguise, has flawlessly hidden itself within the costume of a sick grandmother who mistakenly left some cheese at the side of her bed before lying down for a nap. Little Red Riding Droid then hides itself behind the bed, ready to pounce on any mouse who comes near and bonk them on the head with a baguette. With this dynamic duo working together, the mice in this forest don't stand a chance!

name: Delicious Decoy House Trap Skin
description: This fully-functional, fully-automated, sustainable sawmill is the epitome of efficiency! The custom-built Lumberdroids that operate the mill are second-to-none at sawing, chopping, and replanting. The engineers that built these Lumberdroids were determined to program them to work with three primary objectives: diligence, efficiency, and safety. However, due to time and budget constraints, they were only able to program two objectives.
marketing_text: This confectionary cabin fills the surrounding forest with a sugary aroma that attracts mice with a sweet tooth from miles around. It is designed to lure the mice in with treats so that the droids who lie in wait can shut the door behind them. However, the droids built this trap a little too well because some of them can't seem to resist eating their own creation, much to the dismay of the patient witchbot who is in charge of the operation.

name: Ferocious Solitary Beast Trap Skin
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!
marketing_text: Legend has it that this reckless recluse was once a handsome, haughty noble who was transformed into this fuming, ferocious beast by a powerful witch as punishment for his rude behaviour. Now this massive creature lives in solitude, guarding a single precious rose for some unknown reason, as though he is waiting for redemption from some kind-hearted beauty. It's a tale as old as time...

name: Fight the Blight and Save the Infinitree
description: There is a terrible blight spreading throughout the Afterword Acres and the mighty Infinitree is at risk of being infected! Fight the blight, protect the tree, and carve up some beautiful Poetic Planks for use in the Epilogue Falls.

name: Ride the Rapids and Defeat the Falls Guardian
description: Build a barrel and send your brave droids up these dangerous river rapids towards the Epilogue Falls to loot the many valuable resources floating here. Beware the mighty Falls Guardian at the end of your journey and discover what mysteries it is protecting!

name: Eerie Lane Journal Theme
description:
Crisp fog, heavy with a silence so tense it could snap, fills Eerie Lane.

This dead end street is crowded with houses that are somehow able to watch. Truly a journal theme which is sure to make each entry be a little extra alert and on edge.

Rewarded for brewing a large supply of evil extract during the 2025 Halloween event.

name: Rift Super Rainbow Spore Charm
description:
This breathtakingly beautiful charm is bursting at the seams with power, luck, and colour! It garners its immense mouse catching power by focusing the magic of a Riftified double rainbow (so intense) through Crystal Crucibles and onto its dangerously potent Nightshade.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Brewer's Boon Potion
description: The secrets of this strange potion are granted to only the most skilled apothecaries who have proven themselves. It would seem this potion can interact with a very strange mix of items, duplicating their very powerful effects.
obtain_hint: Dropped as bonus loot while Baba Gaga's Boon is active.

name: Denouement Duplicator Potion
description: This colourful, iridescent liquid bubbles and foams excitedly whenever it's placed in a lush forest or near a rushing waterfall. By pouring it onto some of the natural byproducts of these locations, it exhibits an extraordinary ability to duplicate those useful resources!

name: Dragon Ash Potion
description: Often compared to the Dragon Ember Potion, this concoction goes much further than its predecessor. Super heating significantly larger quantities of resources to much greater temperatures, this potion conveniently converts those items directly into pure Dragon Ashes.

name: Rare Map Dust Potion
description: Have too many ancient relics collecting common dust? Pour the contents of this bottle over a pile of relics and watch them instantly dissolve, leaving only the most rare and precious of dust particles behind!
obtain_hint: Purchase from Gloomy Greenwood General Store

name: Totally Safe Gold Duplication Potion
description:
Pouring this completely safe potion over a pile of gold will duplicate the pile of gold with no negative side effects whatsoever. You may need to smash a nasty crust off the coins using your Hunter's Hammer once they've finished forming, but after that it's perfectly valid currency wherever gold is accepted.

This potion converts larger quantities of gold the higher rank you are.
obtain_hint: Chance to drop from Boiling Cauldron Trap or Baba Gaga's Boon

name: Bionic Bat Cave Trap Skin
description: This serene, sophisticated, sea turtle is the latest advancement in aquatic automaton technology. It swims through the seas with unprecedented speed and grace and is able to effortlessly outmaneuver even the most agile of marine mice. Due to the Pearls of Wisdom used in its construction, it is not only swift and powerful but also extremely intelligent and programmed with an unlimited supply of clever idioms, poignant metaphors, and even helpful life advice. Some mice who encounter this miraculous contraption give themselves up willingly to it because they're so mystified by its insightful guidance to do so.
marketing_text: These flying technological terrors are as swift as they are shrill. They swoop down on any mouse foolish enough to enter their lair and stun them with supersonic blasts from their high fidelity, onboard stereo speakers before scooping them up and bringing them back to their cauldron.

name: Costumed Cauldron Adventure Trap Skin
description:
Baba Gaga created this ornate cauldron by harnessing the arcane energies that grow naturally in the enchanted vines of the Gloomy Greenwood. She built it for the purpose of brewing magical potions powerful enough to defeat all the hunters of Gnawnia so it was poetic justice that those same hunters learned how to turn her creation against her!

This cauldron has been repurposed into a devastating mouse trap that lures in mice who seek to absorb some of its arcane energy but instead find themselves engulfed in a very mysterious and very unpleasant boiling liquid. Most of the time this liquid causes the mouse to vanish into thin air but every once in a while, it actually transforms the unfortunate creature into a useful potion!

This trap has a rare chance to produce a random potion after catching a mouse.

When armed with the Alchemist's Cookbook Base, the base is guaranteed to duplicate any potion that this trap produces.
marketing_text:
Dressing up as fun characters to go seeking spooky adventure with your friends may sound like a good idea at the time, until you actually stumble into a real adventure. Specifically, the dangerous kind with large teeth lurking in dark forests. If you're still around after, it generally makes for quite a fun story to share, especially if escaping said adventure involves only having lost the most silly pieces of your cobbled together costumes.

These droids have perfected this form of perilous adventure by setting out in an enchanted hovering hot tub (actually a cauldron stolen from a witch who had her own definition of the term "Cottage Core" decoration). Not only do these droids get to travel in style, but the worst has truly already happened: Spending the entire evening in a dreadfully soggy costume.

This of course means that everything else on their adventure is bound to look up from that point on. Perhaps even on a high note, any scary monsters chasing them around, might just be seeking to get a good soak and join in on the fun!

name: Boneyard Blaster Multi-cannon Trap Skin
description: After many years of exhaustive research, the new pinnacle of dragon hunting technology has finally been created: the Dragon Devastator Multi-cannon! By harnessing the extraordinarily destructive power of the Mythical Dragon Heart and focussing it through a myriad of Dragon's Breath Opals, this masterful machine capitalizes on all the unrealized potential of its predecessors and has become something truly more than the sum of its parts. It is capable of utilizing the same power that fuels the very essence of the world's mightiest dragons and redirects it into multiple, ultra-concentrated energy beams of cataclysmic strength and intensity. Never before has there been such a momentous and monumental leap forward in dragon catching innovation as this illustrious invention!
marketing_text: This trap skin gives "show a little backbone" new meaning. Not only does it face down the fiercest of dragons but is also known to put on a bone-chilling show. Dancing skeletons playing a rib xylophone can distract even the fiercest of foes, giving the cannon a perfect opportunity to line up a show stopping finish the dragon won't soon forget.

name: Chrome Slumbering Plague Doctor Trap Skin
description: A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!
marketing_text:
Silently watching from behind its mask, this patient practitioner of puncturing and pungent poultices provides services for any who need it, but mostly to those who seem to not want it.

You are most likely to spot it gliding through crisp autumn leaves anytime there just so happens to be violin notes hanging in the air. Traveling from patient to patient administering its cures, one can't help but begin to question the adage of "Doctor knows best".

name: Haunted Carriage Ride Trap Skin
description:
The Surprise Transport Incarceration Nuisance Grabber Enhanced Retrofit takes the art of criminal capture to the next level. The increased power allows it to actively seek out suspects rather than simply waiting for them to turn up of their own volition. The bright lights make the fake gold and gems sparkle and glisten irresistibly which can fool even the more discerning criminals, making this model a far more thorough and efficient convict catcher.

The slogan for this model is "Clean up the skies!" which is generally considered to be a bit ironic given the excessive extra pollution that it produces over its predecessor.
marketing_text: Legends of this mysterious, haunted carriage have circulated for ages. The story goes that a mouse walking alone in the forest at night under a full moon may find this suspicious carriage waiting for them along their path. The stoic, expressionless driver droid helpfully offers them a ride to their destination but once they enter and the door closes behind them, that mouse is whisked away and never seen again.

name: Massive Mecha Snapping Pumpkin Trap Skin
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!
marketing_text:
No one suspects the humble underwater Jack-O'-Lantern costume. Sitting silently, this sunken squash gourds its territory. Mice who wander too close, assuming it to merely be a submerged pumpkin, quickly discover they were mistaken!

Some claim that the guardian's basket of candy grows after each mouse it catches, but mysteriously, it seems to go down shortly after. No one knows what happens to all the confectionery.

name: Flying Broomsticks and Potion Boons
description: Gather your courage and head deep into the Gloomy Greenwoods to face the monstrous, yet gorgeous, Baba Gaga! Learn her sinister recipes and use them to brew up some bubbling batches of bloodcurdling bait! Master the alchemical arts and bring down Baba Gaga with her own boiling cauldrons!

name: Festive Tree Journal Theme
description: Celebrate the festive season by decorating a tree with friends and family!

name: 2026 Lucky Codex
description: A sparkling, celebratory codex that provides hunters with +1 Luck to their traps for the entire year of 2026!
obtain_hint: Purchase from any Great Winter Taiga General Store

name: Rift Hailstone Singularity Base
description:
The mysterious festive magic contained within the Hailstones at the Great Winter Taiga have been known to exhibit some strange, fantastical properties under certain extraordinary conditions. This base demonstrates what happens when a massive number of Hailstones are combined and compressed into one another. The result is a Hailstone singularity of infinite density and infinite holiday cheer. The overwhelming gravitational force unleashed by this base is so strong that it can bend the very fabric of spacetime in the Valour Rift, allowing MouseHunters to slingshot themselves up the tower at unprecedented speeds. However, this inescapable gravitational force has the side effect of pulling all the tower's loot past its event horizon and into the singularity where it is lost forever.

This base adds +1 step per catch in the Valour Rift but it consumes all loot drops while climbing the tower.

In addition, this base has the same properties as the Prestige Base which causes it to grow in power as the hunter reaches new heights:

+20 Power Boost per floor reached during Ultimate Umbra

+2 Luck Boost per Total Eclipse floor reached during Ultimate Umbra

These boosts are based on highest floor reached and are applied permanently as you reach greater heights during Ultimate Umbra.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: 2026 New Year's Base
description:
Happy New Year! This party-powered base celebrates 2026 all year long!

During all of 2026, while this base is equipped, mice have a chance to drop 2026 Charms when caught. The charm-generating powers of this base will cease to work on January 1, 2027.

name: Polar Vortex Trap
description:
This severe swirling snowstorm is a large-scale extratropical cyclone that occurs when the raging forces contained within Cyclone Stones are released into an atmospheric zone that has a high concentration of holiday magic. These festive forces produce an inescapable vortex that pull mice into its centre and trap them forever. Once inside, most mice are quite content to be trapped because the eye of this storm is actually a calm and cheerful place where the snow is always ideal for packing and the surrounding rushing winds sound like merry melodies.

This trap adds +1 to area-specific loot drops and consumes 1 Cyclone Stone per catch when used in the Floating Islands.

name: 2026 Charm
description:
Celebrate each catch with the enthusiasm of a New Year's Eve party! These Limited Edition charms have 2,026 Power to commemorate the New Year!

These charms were rewarded to hunters during the New Year's Celebration of the 2025 Great Winter Hunt and from the Limited Edition 2026 New Year's Base.

name: Rift 2026 Charm
description:
A Rift version of the 2026 Charm!

Celebrate each catch with the enthusiasm of a New Year's Eve party! These Limited Edition charms have 2,026 Power to commemorate the New Year!

These charms were rewarded to hunters during the New Year's Celebration of the 2025 Great Winter Hunt and from the Limited Edition 2026 New Year's Base.
Riftwalker Set
Required: Rift Base, Weapon, and Charm
Set Bonus (2 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
Set Bonus (3 pieces):
  • +20% Power Bonus
  • +5 Luck

name: Chrome Mantlepiece of Obliteration Trap Skin
description: A mystical stone structure soaked in thought wave magnifying chrome. The resonance of the chrome amplifies the thought projections of the encased jewels, allowing them to grasp the minds of mice from further away. The mind erasure process is even faster as everything the mice experience is chrome! The jewels work their magic until the victim's mind is as spotless and shiny as the chrome itself.
marketing_text: This deceptively tranquil holiday scene lures mice in from the cold to get warm by its festive fireplace. Once they've cozied up to it for their long winter's nap, the mantlepiece activates and enters their slumbering minds in order to deposit painfully catchy festive jingles that loop forever.

name: Cocktail Crasher Snapping Turtle Trap Skin
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!
marketing_text: This well-dressed but ill-mannered guest slowly makes it way from party to party that it wasn't invited to. The Cocktail Crasher’s social skills leave much to be desired as it only comes out of its shell when snapping at the host to demand another helping of snacks and drinks.

name: Deep Freeze Chrome Slumbering Boulder Trap Skin
description: A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!
marketing_text: While the stonesong genre became popular among many hunters, some wanted a more festive rendition. One such hunter left their Chrome Slumbering Boulder out in the snow and lo and behold, the ice covering the trap changed its tune! Now hunters can enjoy merry melodies with the backtrack of.. are those sleigh bells?

name: Dragon Devastator Firework Cannon Trap Skin
description: After many years of exhaustive research, the new pinnacle of dragon hunting technology has finally been created: the Dragon Devastator Multi-cannon! By harnessing the extraordinarily destructive power of the Mythical Dragon Heart and focussing it through a myriad of Dragon's Breath Opals, this masterful machine capitalizes on all the unrealized potential of its predecessors and has become something truly more than the sum of its parts. It is capable of utilizing the same power that fuels the very essence of the world's mightiest dragons and redirects it into multiple, ultra-concentrated energy beams of cataclysmic strength and intensity. Never before has there been such a momentous and monumental leap forward in dragon catching innovation as this illustrious invention!
marketing_text: To celebrate the New Year, Trapsmiths from all around Gnawnia got together to orchestrate the most elaborate and most spectacular fireworks display in the Kingdom's history. Remarkably, this celebratory event is just as practical as it is beautiful because the light show is even capable of catching mice! The only downside is that it only lasts for a matter of seconds before dissipating after catching a mouse and the process to set it back up is quite laborious, taking a full fifteen minutes before it's ready again.

name: G.I.F.T. Sled Trap Skin
description:
The Surprise Transport Incarceration Nuisance Grabber Enhanced Retrofit takes the art of criminal capture to the next level. The increased power allows it to actively seek out suspects rather than simply waiting for them to turn up of their own volition. The bright lights make the fake gold and gems sparkle and glisten irresistibly which can fool even the more discerning criminals, making this model a far more thorough and efficient convict catcher.

The slogan for this model is "Clean up the skies!" which is generally considered to be a bit ironic given the excessive extra pollution that it produces over its predecessor.
marketing_text: The Great Incarcerating Fire-powered Transporter Sled is truly a fearsome weapon. Though it may not seem all that intimidating, it relies on its harmless appearance to scoop up unsuspecting mice that stop to ogle at the oodles of presents it carries.

name: Peppermint Aurora Sea Turtle Trap Skin
description: This serene, sophisticated, sea turtle is the latest advancement in aquatic automaton technology. It swims through the seas with unprecedented speed and grace and is able to effortlessly outmaneuver even the most agile of marine mice. Due to the Pearls of Wisdom used in its construction, it is not only swift and powerful but also extremely intelligent and programmed with an unlimited supply of clever idioms, poignant metaphors, and even helpful life advice. Some mice who encounter this miraculous contraption give themselves up willingly to it because they're so mystified by its insightful guidance to do so.
marketing_text: While sea turtles are typically known for their insights and intelligence, these sea turtles don't need to rely on those attributes to capture the attention of mice. Using the power of the aurora, the turtles glide through the night sky in search of a cozy resting place. These delicious looking contraptions need only rest on a hunter's base and mice will flock to their tempting peppermint stripes hoping for a nibble.

name: Defeat the Frost King
description: The Frost King has constructed a large and terrifying fortress of ice in the Great Winter Taiga and must be stopped!

name: Conclusion Cliffs Gift Basket
description:
Share these writing supplies with any hunter aiming to conclude the Mythweaver's story! Inside you'll find:

• 20 Condensed Creativity
• 15 Magic Essence
• 3 Motivation Mallets

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 1 Month from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Conclusion Cliffs Large Supply Kit
description:
A massive kit of supplies for writing an epic conclusion to the Mythweaver's story. Inside you'll find:

• 650 Condensed Creativity
• 650 Magic Essence
• 300 Rainbow Spore Charms
• 100 Motivation Mallets

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 4 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: Conclusion Cliffs Supply Kit
description:
A kit full of the right writing supplies for a just conclusion. Inside you'll find:

• 200 Condensed Creativity
• 200 Magic Essence
• 15 Motivation Mallets

Provides the Lucky Golden Shield for 2 Months from date of opening.

Visit the Special section of your inventory to open this item.
Visit the Send Supplies page to gift this item to a friend.

name: 2-Pack of Deus Ex Maconnais Cheese
description: Two Pieces of Deus Ex Maconnais Cheese.

name: Mythical Rainbow Diamond
description:
This gorgeous gemstone is brimming with mystical, otherworldly powers that are beyond the comprehension of non-fictional characters. It is believed to be the true source of the Mythweaver's extraordinary, reality-bending magic and can therefore only be found by catching his purest and most powerful form.

If these phenomenal jewels were to be wrested from the Ultimate Mythweaver's relentless grasp then perhaps they could be used to craft wondrous and unimaginably powerful creations. It is also rumoured that there may be treasures contained within the diamonds themselves.
obtain_hint: Loot drop from the Ultimate Mythweaver

name: 2-Pack of Storied Saga Cheese
description: Two Pieces of Storied Saga Cheese.

name: Deus Ex Machinery
description:
This miraculous machine has been a staple of Gnawnian folklore since time immemorial. For countless eons, it has been regarded as the all-powerful solution to any seemingly unsolvable problem so any hunter who can harness its limitless power will surely be capable of righting any wrong and altering the outcome of their own destiny.

Use these Deus Ex Machinery to craft Deus Ex Maconnais Cheese in the Conclusion Cliffs.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Conclusion Cliffs

name: Folklore Motif-Index: Law Luck
description:
This long-lost collection of volumes contains powerful and detailed secrets about the strengths and weaknesses of Gnawnia's most influential characters. Any hunter who arms themselves with this information is bound to achieve great things!

This volume describes techniques derived from Law folktales for improving your luck. Adds +5 Luck while a Law trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Conclusion Cliffs General Store

name: Folklore Motif-Index: Law Power
description:
This long-lost collection of volumes contains powerful and detailed secrets about the strengths and weaknesses of Gnawnia's most influential characters. Any hunter who arms themselves with this information is bound to achieve great things!

This volume describes techniques derived from Law folktales for increasing your power. Adds 20% Power Bonus while a Law trap is armed.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Conclusion Cliffs General Store

name: Motivation Mallet
description:
When inspiration won't strike, it's time to strike back with the Motivation Mallet! This mystical mallet is one of the most important tools in any writer's toolbox. With enough of these, any stumped writer can smash their Writer's Block to smithereens, give themselves new choices for their upcoming chapters, or really indulge themselves by extending their Postscript.

Use Motivation Mallets in the Conclusion Cliffs to do any of the following:
  • Break the Writer's Block to choose the length and genre of your starting chapter
  • Reroll your Next Chapter choices
  • Add 3 more hunts to your Postscript
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Conclusion Cliffs

name: Story Thread
description:
These colourful threads are woven with great care into the many tapestries of Gnawnia's lore. Each one tells a multitude of stories with limitless meanings and interpretations. By harnessing the narrative power of these threads, one may be able to influence the outcome of events in the Conclusion Cliffs.

Use these Story Threads to craft Storied Saga Cheese in the Conclusion Cliffs.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Conclusion Cliffs

name: Rainbow Diamond Refractor Base
description:
This awe-inspiring, breathtakingly beautiful base represents the pinnacle of energy refraction technology in Gnawnia. After rigorously studying all the previous refractor base iterations, the Trapsmith at the Conclusion Cliffs has finally perfected this extraordinary technology by incorporating the incomparably powerful Mythical Rainbow Diamonds into its design. These miraculous minerals are able to bend, split, and concentrate trap energy in profoundly powerful ways and when combined in large quantities, they become more than the sum of their parts. All of the transformative power that has fueled the Mythweaver's nefarious efforts throughout the Folklore Forest has finally been captured, harnessed, and given a noble purpose with this monumental piece of mouse-catching equipment.

In addition to its extraordinary mouse-catching power, this miracle of modern science has the following special effects:

  • Floating Islands: Chance to add +1 to area-specific loot drops
  • Bountiful Beanstalk: Doubles Fabled Fertilizer loot drops
  • School of Sorcery: Adds +1 Spell Force
  • Draconic Depths: Doubles Dragonhide Sliver loot drops (Replicart™ compatible!)
  • Afterword Acres: Provides a chance to prevent the Blight from regrowing (stacks with the Rainbow Quill)
  • Epilogue Falls: Provides a chance to prevent getting pushed back by the current after failing to catch (stacks with the Rainbow Quill)
  • Conclusion Cliffs: Provides a chance to not lose a Postscript hunt after failing to catch (stacks with the Rainbow Quill)
  • Everywhere: Provides a chance to roll up armed Ultimate Ancient Charms into Rainbow Charms
  • Everywhere: Provides a chance for any tier of armed Rainbow Charm to roll up into their next, more powerful version

name: Rainbow Diamond Ball and Chain Trap
description: Despite its inexplicable ability to hover, this gigantic rainbow diamond is believed to have infinite density therefore making it the perfect trap for keeping a criminal mouse from scurrying away. By compressing a large amount of Mythical Rainbow Diamonds together into one massive ball and then attaching a shiny metal clamp and chain to it, the Trapsmith at the Conclusion Cliffs has managed to build a remarkably simple yet remarkably effective means of enforcing the law in Gnawnia.

name: Deus Ex Maconnais Cheese
description:
This firm yet creamy cheese is a divine delicacy that has the ability to weave an epic and climactic conclusion for mice of any genre at the Conclusion Cliffs.

The omniscient power of Deus Ex Maconnais Cheese provides an astonishing 125 Pages / Notoriety per catch in the Conclusion Cliffs.

name: Storied Saga Cheese
description:
This mild but exceptionally well-aged cheese has the ability to weave a just and definitive conclusion for mice of any genre at the Conclusion Cliffs.

Storied Saga Cheese provides 50 Pages / Notoriety per catch in the Conclusion Cliffs.

name: Ball of Bridled Literature Trap Skin
description: Despite its inexplicable ability to hover, this gigantic rainbow diamond is believed to have infinite density therefore making it the perfect trap for keeping a criminal mouse from scurrying away. By compressing a large amount of Mythical Rainbow Diamonds together into one massive ball and then attaching a shiny metal clamp and chain to it, the Trapsmith at the Conclusion Cliffs has managed to build a remarkably simple yet remarkably affective means of enforcing the law in Gnawnia.
skin_weapon_name: Rainbow Diamond Ball and Chain Trap
marketing_text: Bound within these heavy chains is the entirety of Gnawnian literature. It contains every novel, every poem, every character, and in fact every single word ever put to the page throughout the Kingdom. Any mouse that gets snagged by this big bundle of books will be eternally trapped by the desire to devour every page which, unfortunately for them, is quite impossible.

name: Chrome Scribbling Letter Trap Skin
description: A layer of chrome enhances the bandwidth of the subharmonic frequency that the Slumbering Boulder Trap uses to disarm approaching mice. What appears as a shining deposit of precious materials quickly materializes into a highly aerodynamic flying mouse predator!
marketing_text: At first glance, this appears to be merely a folded note surrounded by stationary supplies but as soon as a mouse approaches (perhaps with the intent of penning a strongly-worded letter slandering humanity), this clever trap springs into action. The note unfolds into a fearsome trap with razor-sharp pen nibs at the ready to scribble that disgruntled, unsuspecting mouse completely out of existence.

name: Discarded Draft Dungeon Trap Skin
description:
The Surprise Transport Incarceration Nuisance Grabber Enhanced Retrofit takes the art of criminal capture to the next level. The increased power allows it to actively seek out suspects rather than simply waiting for them to turn up of their own volition. The bright lights make the fake gold and gems sparkle and glisten irresistibly which can fool even the more discerning criminals, making this model a far more thorough and efficient convict catcher.

The slogan for this model is "Clean up the skies!" which is generally considered to be a bit ironic given the excessive extra pollution that it produces over its predecessor.
marketing_text:
This unique prison was created using all the bad ideas that have ever been discarded by a writer during the creative process.

Each of these hastily scribbled notes was crumpled and tossed away at some point during a moment of pure exasperation and that frustrated energy remains stained onto every page alongside the ink.

Any mouse that gets trapped inside this dungeon is doomed to experience every contrived plot point, every forced meet-cute, and every deus ex machina ending that has ever been put to the page.

name: Massive Mechanical Typing Turtle Trap Skin
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!
marketing_text: This gigantic, automatic typewriter is working on a masterpiece of its very own but it is constantly getting interrupted by pesky mice which causes it to make mistakes. name: Conclude the Mythweaver's Story
description: It has been a long and arduous battle against this worthy foe but here at this great precipice, the Mythweaver's story must be given a righteous and epic conclusion. Use your trusty, experienced, and well-read droids to type up genre-spanning conclusions that will transform this cliffhanger into a climactic finale by relegating the Mythweaver to little more than a footnote in the Gnawnian history books.

description: Carry the horse's blessing with you as you navigate the Kingdom. Display this ingot to welcome growth and prosperity into your adventures.

name: Horse Lunar Lantern
description: A lantern used to celebrate the Year of the Horse. This can be lit with Lunar Lantern Candles during the 2026 Lunar New Year event to provide bonus loot drops and bonus luck for your trap!

name: G.I.F.T. Horse Trap Skin
description:
The Surprise Transport Incarceration Nuisance Grabber Enhanced Retrofit takes the art of criminal capture to the next level. The increased power allows it to actively seek out suspects rather than simply waiting for them to turn up of their own volition. The bright lights make the fake gold and gems sparkle and glisten irresistibly which can fool even the more discerning criminals, making this model a far more thorough and efficient convict catcher.

The slogan for this model is "Clean up the skies!" which is generally considered to be a bit ironic given the excessive extra pollution that it produces over its predecessor.
marketing_text: This Golden Inviting Fabulous Trove Horse tempts even the most stubborn of enemies into its gilded jaws! The allure of wealth is too great to ignore and the mice climb right in without hesitation. Shared only in hushed tones of legend, few mice live to tell the tale of what lies beyond the mouth of this exquisite cage, and those that do can never unlearn the horror of what it truly means to look a G.I.F.T. Horse in the mouth...

name: Legendary HorseBot Trap Skin
description:
Using the new and improved Chivalric Code++ (CC++) programming language in combination with the latest advancements in A.I. (Aristocratic Intelligence), comes the cutting edge in Physical mouse trap technology: the Legendary KingBot!

This model improves upon the statistics of its predecessor, the Charming PrinceBot, in every way by employing the most sophisticated nobility algorithms ever conceived. It was designed with a Worthiness Factor so high that when confronted with the industry standard Sword-in-the-Stone unit test, it not only removed the sword with ease but completely obliterated the stone in the process!
marketing_text: Every twelve years, the Legendary KingBot's noble stead takes its own reins and gallops gallantly into the new year with confidence and determination. The KingBot is content to just sit back, hand out red envelopes, and enjoy the ride as the Legendary HorseBot charges forward into health and prosperity.

name: Massive Mystic Dragon Turtle Trap Skin
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!
marketing_text: This dragon turtle was found under a mountain, studying a chess table in front of it. The hunter who found it tells the tale of being invited to play a game. The turtle spoke of learning the game recently but having no opponents so the hunter obliged, curious to learn more about the aged statue. The hunter was swiftly defeated, prompting a warm, rumbling chuckle from the statue. As a reward for winning, it asked to be taken from its resting place under the mountain and promised enduring wealth, protection, and a friendly chess tutor. Only later did the hunter learn that "recently" meant 350 years ago for this ancient dragon turtle.

name: Celebrate Lunar New Year 2026
description: Celebrate the 2026 Lunar New Year by lighting your Horse Lunar Lantern!

name: 18th Anniversary Pipe Party Journal Theme
description: Becoming the Cheesy Pipe Party Master might sound like a pipe dream to some, but it's actually as simple as equipping the 18th Birthday Journal Theme for all to see!

name: Chocolate Pistachio Cake Base
description:
This sinisterly good slice features a dangerously delicious pistachio butter pastry mixture encased in melted chocolate.

A flavour first savoured during MouseHunt's 18th birthday!

Though the Chrome Slumbering Boulder is typically known for being impressively hard to spot until it pounces, this squeaky chrome version manages to be just as effective at catching mice while being obnoxiously on display.

The translucent, colourful form noisily twists and squeaks into exciting and sometimes statically charged forms, leaving captivated audiences wondering what it could possibly transform into next.

Even as it gently descends in the form of an inescapable balloon cage, mice are often too entertained by their fur standing on end to notice they will soon be caught!

unparalleled at what it does. Any unruly mice who have a bit of a sweet tooth can't help but let themselves get scooped up thinking they will enjoy eating their way out of this sugary challenge. Though delightful at first, after only a few bites it becomes increasingly obvious that this might have been a very poor decision. The more a mouse tries to nibble it's way out, the harder the sugar crash hits them in the end.

description: Despite its inexplicable ability to hover, this gigantic rainbow diamond is believed to have infinite density therefore making it the perfect trap for keeping a criminal mouse from scurrying away. By compressing a large amount of Mythical Rainbow Diamonds together into one massive ball and then attaching a shiny metal clamp and chain to it, the Trapsmith at the Conclusion Cliffs has managed to build a remarkably simple yet remarkably effective means of enforcing the law in Gnawnia.

name: Cerulean Armillary Sphere
description:
This extraordinary and expertly crafted device is as complex and useful as it is breathtaking to behold. It was designed and built by Ronza herself as a means of reliably navigating to the elusive and lucrative trade settlement in the sky known as the Cerulean Skyport.

However, while en route to share the prototype with the MouseHunters of Gnawnia, her airship was attacked by a fleet of villainous Sky Raiders who also sought the location of the Skyport. During the attack, the device was shattered and its valuable fragments were spread throughout the Kingdom. The intrepid hunters were then tasked by Ronza to scour the continent in search of these fragments before the Sky Raiders arrived at the shores of Gnawnia. Once fully recovered, Ronza was able to reassemble the device and lead the hunters to their next destination in the sky before she needed to flee from her approaching archnemesis: Captain Crook.

The broken fragments were eventually collected by the Sky Raiders' closest allies, the Sky Pirates of the Floating Islands, in a vain attempt to reassemble the device themselves so that they could join the Raiders up at the Skyport. However, they lacked the knowledge of how the pieces fit together and therefore were left with just a collection of useless, broken fragments. Fortunately for the MouseHunters, Ronza shared her knowledge of the Armillary Sphere's design with the Cartographer at the Floating Islands before she left and that Cartographer has since kept that knowledge safe from the malevolent machinations of the Sky Pirates.

Only hunters ranked Archduke/Archduchess and above can comprehend how to use this complex tool...

Obtain this map piece during the Archduke/Archduchess adventure:
Liberate the Cerulean Skyport from Captain Crook

description:
This sturdy, makeshift scroll case was carefully built by bolting together whatever could be found lying around on the Skydocks.

Opening this scroll case will take you on a treasure hunt through the Cerulean Skyport and leads to a treasure chest containing a cache of RaidBuster™ Cannonballs and other other useful supplies!
