name: Chrome Skull
description:
This intimidating Chrome skull was forged from melted Cerulean Chrome Ingots and imbued with the extraordinary power of the Chrome Aura!

Crushing this Chrome Skull will reward you with 5 Days of the Chrome Aura.

Chrome Aura: Provides +5 Luck to your trap as well as a chance to find Chrome Charms.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Cerulean Skyport General Store

name: Corsair Chaser Scroll Case
description:
This elaborate scroll case was constructed using the robust, durable properties of Sky Ore and Sky Glass to ensure a safe, reliable seal.

Opening this scroll case will take you on a treasure hunt throughout the Floating Islands and the Cerulean Skyport where you will face off against pirates, raiders, and other lawless mice. The journey will lead you to a treasure chest containing useful cheese and supplies for chasing corsairs, namely the deplorable delicacy Sky Pirate Swiss Cheese.

name: Cerulean Skyport Journal Theme
description: Master the aeronautic trade routes and defeat the villainous Sky Raiders with the Cerulean Skyport Journal Theme!

name: Atmospherium Gas
description: Compressed within this canister is an artisanal blend of the finest free-range atmospheric gases, hand-harvested from certified organic air farms. This highly valuable and desperately sought-after resource has a wide range of practical uses amongst the empyrean elite such as: breathing.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: Aurora Spice
description:
Some people believe that the beautiful auroras that fill the night sky in certain parts of the world are a visual phenomenon caused by charged particles from the sun colliding with oxygen and nitrogen atoms in the atmosphere, exciting them, and causing them to emit light in colourful, dynamic patterns.

Those people are grossly misinformed. Auroras are actually vast fields of colourful, magical spice floating gracefully through the sky. What few ground dwellers know is that the Aurora Spice is just as flavourful as it is beautiful so there is an entire airborne industry that revolves around harvesting this magical spice for a variety of culinary uses.

The most famous, or perhaps infamous, use for Aurora Spice is in the production of Aurora Bocconcini Cheese which is a delicacy for the Sky Commander mice who frequent the Cerulean Skyport.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: Cerulean Chrome Ingot
description:
This extraordinarily valuable, mesmerizingly shiny, and inexplicably buoyant metal ingot is the single most sought-after resource across all layers of the Gnawnian atmosphere. Its tantalizing shimmer and exceptionally powerful magical properties are enough to make even the most honest mice turn to a life of crime and greed.

The Sky Raiders have been stealing these ingots for ages and delivering them to their leader, Captain Crook. As the supreme commander of all airborne villainy, Captain Crook hoards these ingots to herself and so far the only person that has ever managed to steal some back is the fearless and intrepid Ronza.

If honest and noble MouseHunters were able to retrieve these valuable, stolen goods from the Captain then, in the right hands, they could possibly be used to create unimaginable new technologies for the purposes of good.
obtain_hint: Loot drop from Captain Crook

name: Cerulean Skyport Journal Theme Scrap I
description: Collect all five Cerulean Skyport Journal Theme Scraps and use them to purchase the journal theme from the Cerulean Skyport General Store!
obtain_hint: Loot drop from Slipstream the Virtuoso of Vapours

description:
This ragged, torn piece of paper is covered with scribbled formulas and hastily sketched diagrams for building a unique mouse-catching device of some kind. It appears to be merely one section of a much larger blueprint.

Collect all 20 of these Blueprint Scraps and bring them to the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport in order to build the Chrome Queso Cannonstorm Base.
obtain_hint: Loot drop from Captain Crook in a Queso Geyser Raid

name: Dirigible Debris
description:
This may look like a worthless hunk of wood and cloth nailed together but despite appearances, this is a valuable and highly sought-after resource at the Cerulean Skyport due to its wide range of industrial uses. These are made from the bits and pieces of dirigibles that came in a little too quickly when attempting to dock.

The scavenging scoundrels known as the Debris Raiders scour the Skydocks to collect this covetous commodity before it can be traded legally.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: Fiery Warpath Raid Intel
description:
This is a collection of expertly gathered, top secret intelligence detailing Captain Crook's plans to raid the Fiery Warpath.

Use this intel to find and intercept Captain Crook's raid of the Fiery Warpath from the Cerulean Skyport.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: RaidBuster™ Cannonball
description:
Are your shipments constantly being threatened by airborne pirates? Is your Kingdom being bombarded by a relentless fleet of mobile marauders? Have Sky Raiders got you down?! If you answered yes to any of these questions then you're in need of this exciting new product: RaidBuster™ Cannonballs (patent pending)!

Simply load these sleek, shiny, and meticulously handcrafted cannonballs into your cannon and fire away as you hunt! Each RaidBuster™ Cannonball is made from a little bit of every known metal ore in existence which makes them impervious to any and all Sky Raider defences. Every time you hit a Sky Raider with one of these state-of-the-art cannonballs, they are guaranteed to drop a little bit more of whatever they were trying to steal!

Take back the skies today with RaidBuster™ Cannonballs!

Fire RaidBuster™ Cannonballs while hunting in the Cerulean Skyport to add +1 to loot drops of Corsair's Curds, Dirigible Debris, Atmospherium Gas, Unrefined Cloudstone, Aurora Spice, Raid Intel, and Cerulean Chrome Ingots.

name: Table of Contents Raid Intel
description:
This is a collection of expertly gathered, top secret intelligence detailing Captain Crook's plans to raid the Table of Contents.

Use this intel to find and intercept Captain Crook's raid of the Table of Contents from the Cerulean Skyport.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

description:
This is a collection of expertly gathered, top secret intelligence detailing Captain Crook's plans to raid the Tribal Isles.

Use this intel to find and intercept Captain Crook's raid of the Tribal Isles from the Cerulean Skyport.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: Unrefined Cloudstone
description: This aerial ore is an extremely valuable commodity to the citizens of the sky, even in its unrefined state. It has a wide range of practical uses and an even wider range of impractical, purely aesthetic uses. One of its most common uses is for popular jewelry such as the Cloudstone Bangles that the Sky Paragons of the Floating Islands are known to be fond of.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: Zokor Raid Intel
description:
This is a collection of expertly gathered, top secret intelligence detailing Captain Crook's plans to raid Zokor.

Use this intel to find and intercept Captain Crook's raid of Zokor from the Cerulean Skyport.
obtain_hint: Loot drops in the Cerulean Skyport

name: Chrome Base
description:
This shining slab of solid Cerulean Chrome has been expertly engraved with a design so intricate and exquisite that it transcends mere beauty and actually imbues this base with extraordinary powers! Its many swirling crevices have the ability to harness and absorb some of the power from each mouse that it encounters. Hunt by hunt, this base charges itself on that power until it reaches a critical point where it coalesces into a physical manifestation of that power in the form of a Chrome Skull!

The Chrome Base has the following special effects while using it:

• Spawns a Chrome Skull every 300 hunts
• Provides a 100% chance to roll up any armed Chrome Charm into its next, more powerful version

name: Chrome Queso Cannonstorm Base
description:
This base was originally a repurposed Hailstone Cannon that had been permanently set in a bed of hardened amber queso making it portable and allowing it to be used outside of the Great Winter Taiga. When used in the Queso Canyon region, this augmented cannon fired Solidified Amber Queso at any mouse that approached its trap and each successful hit exploded into bonus Queso Canyon loot!

However, the original design blueprints that contained the secrets to this base's extraordinary effects was lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of the Queso Geyser so that she could make her own pirated version. Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

While armed within the Queso Canyon Region:
• This base will destroy 5 Solidified Amber Queso on every hunt
• Bonus Queso Canyon loot will be found in the rubble after catching a mouse

name: Aurora Bocconcini Cheese
description:
This soft and remarkably light cheese is made using the magical and extremely flavourful Aurora Spice that is harvested from the highest and most prestigious layers of the atmosphere. The Aurora Spice adds a powerful, almost meddlesome flavour that, while off-putting to most mice, has become the only cheese that most of the villainous Sky Commanders of the Cerulean Skyport will eat. They find its potent flavour and airy texture utterly irresistible and it's enough to lure them away from even the most lucrative heist or raid.

Arm this spicy, buoyant cheese in the Cerulean Skyport to attract Sky Commander mice.

name: Sky Raider Romano Cheese
description:
This deviously delectable alternative to Sky Pirate Swiss is irresistible to the Sky Raiders that frequent the Cerulean Skyport. It replaces the briny sea air aroma of its predecessor with the smoky scent of sky smog that bellows from the engines of the Sky Raiders' airships. More important than its scent or even its flavour, is its outrageously ostentatious tricorne hat and eye patch made from royal purple velour and trimmed with pure, uncursed, 24 karat gold. It is unclear whether the Sky Raider mice actually eat the cheese or just horde it but either way, they will go to great lengths to get their greedy paws on it.

Arm this criminally flavourful cheese in the Cerulean Skyport to attract the greediest Sky Raider mice!

name: Atmospherium Debris Ball and Chain Trap Skin
description: Despite its inexplicable ability to hover, this gigantic rainbow diamond is believed to have infinite density therefore making it the perfect trap for keeping a criminal mouse from scurrying away. By compressing a large amount of Mythical Rainbow Diamonds together into one massive ball and then attaching a shiny metal clamp and chain to it, the Trapsmith at the Conclusion Cliffs has managed to build a remarkably simple yet remarkably effective means of enforcing the law in Gnawnia.
skin_weapon_name: Rainbow Diamond Ball and Chain Trap
marketing_text: After witnessing the success of their hastily assembled Dirigible Debris Dungeon, the Skydock workers at the Cerulean Skyport decided to take it up a notch with a more elaborate and even more hastily bolted together contraption based on the Rainbow Diamond Ball and Chain Trap. Behold their creation, a gigantic and ridiculously heavy ball and chain made from enormous amounts of Dirigible Debris and filled with Atmospherium Gas allowing it to stay aloft indefinitely. Its thick debris chain was fastened directly to the Skydock itself so that this metal balloon isn't going anywhere!

name: Chrome Legendary AstronautBot Trap Skin
description:
Using the most advanced (and most dangerous) programming language ever designed, Chivalric Code Sharp (CC#), in combination with the absolute cutting edge in Aristocratic Intelligence (AI) via Legendary Leader Models (LLM), the King's best and brightest engineers have created the pinnacle of Physical mouse-catching technology: the Chrome Legendary KingBot!

This revolutionary new design features enhanced Worthiness Factor optimization and the new, state-of-the-art Generative Glory and Prestige Training (GGPT) which makes this the most sophisticated nobility bot in the entire Kingdom!
marketing_text: This brave robotic leader is boldly going to the final frontier on a rocket made from Dirigible Debris and fuelled by the extremely flammable Atmospherium Gas. This makeshift rocket was so hastily bolted together at the Skydocks that the engineers forgot to include a seat, controls, or any safety equipment whatsoever. Fortunately, this AstronautBot wasn't programmed to feel fear or recognize bad decisions!

name: Dirigible Debris Dungeon Trap Skin
description:
The Surprise Transport Incarceration Nuisance Grabber Enhanced Retrofit takes the art of criminal capture to the next level. The increased power allows it to actively seek out suspects rather than simply waiting for them to turn up of their own volition. The bright lights make the fake gold and gems sparkle and glisten irresistibly which can fool even the more discerning criminals, making this model a far more thorough and efficient convict catcher.

The slogan for this model is "Clean up the skies!" which is generally considered to be a bit ironic given the excessive extra pollution that it produces over its predecessor.
marketing_text: This makeshift dungeon was bolted together as quickly as possible before the Sky Raiders arrived at the Cerulean Skyport using whatever Dirigible Debris was lying around on the Skydocks. It turns out that it doesn't really matter how dodgy the trap looks because as long as it is filled with that delicious Aurora Spice as bait, the raiders simply can't resist it!

name: Floating City of Stone and Chrome Trap Skin
description: A mystical stone structure soaked in thought wave magnifying chrome. The resonance of the chrome amplifies the thought projections of the encased jewels, allowing them to grasp the minds of mice from further away. The mind erasure process is even faster as everything the mice experience is chrome! The jewels work their magic until the victim's mind is as spotless and shiny as the chrome itself.
marketing_text: This miraculous, glistening structure was originally built as a scale model of the Cerulean Skyport and is held aloft by the mysterious properties of Unrefined Cloudstone. Its creators took such great care in duplicating the confusing layout and labyrinthian paths of the real thing that upon completing it, they immediately realized that it would make a marvellous mouse trap because any mouse that wandered in would surely forget the way back out.

name: Liberate the Cerulean Skyport from Captain Crook
description: The corrupt Captain Crook and her vile Sky Raiders have invaded the Cerulean Skyport! They are mercilessly plundering all the incoming airships full of valuable trade goods and have begun using the Skyport as a base of operations for launching raids on various locations all over Gnawnia. Put a stop to these heinous criminals, retrieve their stolen loot, gather intel on their devious plans, and capture their unscrupulous leader before she raids the entire kingdom!

name: Cerulean Skyport Airship Balloon
description: This uniquely designed airship was constructed using all of the most popular trade goods at the Cerulean Skyport. The balloon is made from an oversized Atmospherium Gas canister, the sails are trimmed with Unrefined Cloudstone, the hull is loaded with precious Aurora Spice, and the whole thing is bolted together with Dirigible Debris.
obtain_hint: Purchase from the Cerulean Skyport General Store

name: Cerulean Skyport Airship Hull
description: This uniquely designed airship was constructed using all of the most popular trade goods at the Cerulean Skyport. The balloon is made from an oversized Atmospherium Gas canister, the sails are trimmed with Unrefined Cloudstone, the hull is loaded with precious Aurora Spice, and the whole thing is bolted together with Dirigible Debris.

obtain_hint: Loot drop from Captain Crook in a Fiery Warpath Raid

description:

obtain_hint: Loot drop from Captain Crook in a Tribal Isles Raid

name: Chrome Desert Heater Base
description:
This base was originally a repurposed holiday heater redesigned to turn up the heat on mice! Fueled by Flameshards, using this base in the Sandtail Desert will turn the heat up so high that mice will drop more loot in an attempt to quickly shed layers and escape!

However, the original design blueprints that contained the secrets to this base's extraordinary effects was lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of the Fiery Warpath so that she could make her own pirated version. Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

While armed within the Sandtail Desert:
• This base will consume a Flameshard on every hunt
• Mice will drop bonus loot when caught

name: Chrome Thief Base
description:
This remarkable base was originally designed by a group of clever yet morally-dubious hunters who pooled their knowledge and resources to create a base that could properly pillage the city of Zokor.

Some of them preferred a slow and quiet approach whereas others just wanted to smash and grab. After a lengthy debate, they finally decided: "Why not both?" And thus, the first truly switchable base was created.

However, the original design blueprints that contained the secrets to this base's extraordinary effects was lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of Zokor so that she could make her own pirated version. Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

Upon entering Zokor, hunters will be able to switch this base to one of the following modes:

Stealth Mode:
Provides a 50% chance to not lose Stealth.

Heist Mode:
Doubles Stealth lost but also doubles Fealty, Tech, and Scholar district loot gained.

This base does not affect loot drops in the Minotaur's Lair.

name: Chrome Tribal Vegetation Kaboom Base
description:
Long ago in the exotic Tribal Isles there existed two different magical bases whose designs were both lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of the Tribal Isles so that she could make her own pirated versions. However, she got the blueprints for each all mixed up and couldn't tell them apart so she combined them into something new that has the effects of both!

Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

This base has the special effects of both the Tribal Kaboom Base and the Vegetation Base when hunting in the Tribal Isles:

• Increases quantity range for drops of Seashells, Savoury Vegetables, Delicious Stones, and all Seeds
• Spawns a pepper that matches whatever seed a mouse drops

description:
Using the most advanced (and most dangerous) programming language ever designed, Chivalric Code Sharp (CC#), in combination with the absolute cutting edge in Aristocratic Intelligence (AI) via Legendary Leader Models (LLM), the King's best and brightest engineers have created the pinnacle of Physical mouse-catching technology: the Chrome Legendary KingBot!

This revolutionary new design features enhanced Worthiness Factor optimization and the new, state-of-the-art Generative Glory and Prestige Training (GGPT) which makes this the most sophisticated nobility bot in the entire Kingdom!
marketing_text: This fearless, fiery commander was designed to be the ultimate opposing force to fend off the tyranny of the Marching Flame in the Fiery Warpath. Its searing, red-hot laser blade was forged for the sole purpose of duelling with the flaming sword of the mighty Warmonger.

name: Chrome Mind Labyrinth Trap Skin
description: A mystical stone structure soaked in thought wave magnifying chrome. The resonance of the chrome amplifies the thought projections of the encased jewels, allowing them to grasp the minds of mice from further away. The mind erasure process is even faster as everything the mice experience is chrome! The jewels work their magic until the victim's mind is as spotless and shiny as the chrome itself.
marketing_text: This shining mind maze has the ability to lure unsuspecting mice into a mental construct of the infinite Labyrinth of Zokor. Mice believe themselves to be wandering endlessly through these cold, chrome corridors searching for an exit that doesn't exist whereas in reality they are trapped merely within the confines of their own minds.

name: Colossal Rainbow Treasure Chest
description: You and your friends have completed a treasure map and have discovered this colourful Treasure Chest!

name: Rare Colossal Rainbow Treasure Chest

description: Despite its inexplicable ability to hover, this gigantic rainbow diamond is believed to have infinite density therefore making it the perfect trap for keeping a criminal mouse from scurrying away. By compressing a large amount of Mythical Rainbow Diamonds together into one massive ball and then attaching a shiny metal clamp and chain to it, the Trapsmith at the Conclusion Cliffs has managed to build a remarkably simple yet remarkably affective means of enforcing the law in Gnawnia.
skin_weapon_name: Rainbow Diamond Ball and Chain Trap
marketing_text: Gnawnian astronomers theorize that this skin may be one of the brightest objects in the Kingdom! Forged from pure gold and pristine diamonds, it boasts a magnetic personality, quite literally, by pulling mice in with its inescapable gravity. As they drift helplessly toward its glittering surface, amethyst inlays are the absolute last luxury they’ll ever look upon before being consumed by its radiant glory!

name: Regal Chrome ValkyrieBot Trap Skin
description:
Using the most advanced programming language ever designed (Chivalric Code Sharp) in combination with the absolute cutting edge in Aristocratic Intelligence (AI) via Legendary Leader Models (LLM), the King's best and brightest engineers have created the pinnacle of Physical mouse-catching technology: the Chrome Legendary KingBot!

This revolutionary new design features enhanced Worthiness Factor optimization and the new, state-of-the-art Generative Glory and Prestige Training (GGPT) which makes this the most sophisticated nobility bot in the entire Kingdom!
marketing_text: The latest and greatest in bot tech! Featuring a sleek winged steed, a shiny helm, and an extra-long spear for ultimate reach. Get ready to watch mice tremble with every dramatic crack of thunder and lightning.

name: Regal B.E.A.K Machine Trap Skin
description:
This creative contraption is Ronza's greatest contribution to the field of anti-pirate tech: the Confiscation and Legal Apprehension of Wrongdoers (C.L.A.W.) Machine! This highly sophisticated mechanical grappling device is specifically calibrated to locate and extract hidden stolen and prohibited items from Sky Pirates, Sky Raiders, and any other lawless mice who may be carrying corsair contraband.

This marvellous machine DOUBLES loot drops of Corsair's Curds and Sky Pirate Seals.
marketing_text: Created by the Royal Aviary Force to aide the astute Hunter. This Bejeweled Embellished Avian Kite (B.E.A.K) features a blue sapphire tipped beak which makes easy work of even the more hardiest mice.

name: Chrome Electromagnetic Meteorite Base
description:
This base was originally composed of a solar panel, battery pack, and strange, almost alien technology that had the ability to attract chunks of meteorite after charging up enough energy. It only seemed to activate when the sun went down and the charging cycle had completed, which caused the glyphs etched into its surface to glow, and something from deep within to hum...

However, the original design blueprints that contained the secrets to this base's extraordinary effects was lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of Fort Rox so that she could make her own pirated version. Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

Use this base during the night in Fort Rox for a chance to find Meteorite Pieces.

name: Chrome Essential Living Garden Base
description:
Over the years, many important bases were designed to aid hunters who were looking to tame and cultivate the Living and Twisted Gardens, break the curses of the Lost and Cursed Cities, and survive the harsh climates of the Sand Dunes and Crypts.

One contained the power of an aurora at any time of the year, at any time of the day, and localized entirely within the base. Another contained a lovely flowerbed of poinsettias kept fresh inside a fully sealed and functional hothouse. Another was made from a highly unstable metallic alloy that produced a bizarre chemical reaction when exposed to massive amounts of sodium chloride. And another harnessed mystical energies that warded against heinous curses.

Each of these miraculous bases had their own unique effects and unfortunately, the designs for each of them have long been lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of the Living Garden so that she could make her own pirated versions. However, she got the blueprints for each all mixed up and couldn't tell them apart so she combined them into something new that has the effects of all four!

Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

While hunting in the Living/Twisted Garden, Lost/Cursed City, or Sand Dunes/Crypts, this base has the following effects:

• Chance to generate a random essence
• Increases petal and herb drops
• Adds +1 to the salt level in the Sand Crypts upon catching a mouse with any salt charm
• Automatically attracts the King Grub Mouse in the Sand Crypts when the salt level reaches 50
• 50% chance to break any curse in the Lost/Cursed City upon catching a mouse

name: Chrome Stormcaster Base
description:
Two different important bases were once built specifically for use at Moussu Picchu. The first, known as the Forecaster Base, was originally a sophisticated weather forecasting device that had the "unexpected feature" of actually intensifying the weather instead of merely predicting it. The second, known as the Storm Condenser Base, was a device constructed from repurposed hailstone that had a powerful coil and fan capable of capturing and neutralizing stormy weather.

Both of these miraculous base designs were lost to the Trapsmiths of Gnawnia... until now! It turns out that the villainous Captain Crook discovered and then stole these lost blueprints during her raid of Moussu Picchu so that she could make her own pirated versions. However, she got the blueprints for each all mixed up and couldn't tell them apart so she combined them into something new that has the effects of both!

Now that the design secrets have been recovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport is able to forge this new, stronger, and shinier version using the miraculous combination of Cerulean Chrome that has been charged with the energy from Adorned Empyrean Jewels!

While hunting in Moussu Picchu, hunters will be able to switch this base to one of the following modes:

Forecasting Mode:
Doubles the weather intensity gained on every successful catch based on the type of cheese that is armed

Condensing Mode:
Prevents the weather intensity from increasing

name: Ultimate Chrome Base
description:
By combining the remarkable powers of all the many Chrome bases that have been discovered, the Trapsmith at the Cerulean Skyport has finally created one Chrome base to rule them all... the Ultimate Chrome Base!

This incredible base infuses massive quantities of Cerulean Chrome with an enormous amount of energy harnessed from Adorned Empyrean Jewels in order to power its long list of special effects.

The Ultimate Chrome Base has the following special effects while using it:

• Anywhere: Spawns a Chrome Skull every 300 hunts
• Anywhere: Provides a 100% chance to roll up any armed Chrome Charm into its next, more powerful version
• In the Tribal Isles: Increases quantity range for drops of Seashells, Savoury Vegetables, Delicious Stones, and all Seeds
• In the Tribal Isles: Spawns a pepper that matches whatever seed a mouse drops
• In the Sandtail Desert: Consumes a Flameshard every hunt, mice drop bonus loot when caught
• In all Living Garden related areas: Chance to generate a random essence
• In all Living Garden related areas: Increases petal and herb drops
• In the Sand Crypts: Adds +1 to the salt level upon catching a mouse with any salt charm
• In the Sand Crypts: Automatically attracts the King Grub Mouse when the salt level reaches 50
• In the Lost/Cursed City: 50% chance to break any curse upon catching a mouse
• In Fort Rox (Night/Dawn Phase): Chance to find Meteorite Pieces
• In the Queso Canyon: Consumes 5 Solidified Amber Queso every hunt, mice drop bonus loot when caught
• In Zokor: Activate Stealth Mode to provide a 50% chance to not lose Stealth
• In Zokor: Activate Heist Mode to double Stealth lost but also double Fealty, Tech, and Scholar district loot gained
• In Moussu Picchu: Activate Forecasting Mode to double weather intensity gained on every catch based on cheese armed
• In Moussu Picchu: Activate Condensing Mode to prevent the weather intensity from increasing

name: Chrome Circlet of Picchu Trap Skin
description: Recasting the enchanted metal of the Circlet of Pursuing trap in chrome has amplified both its reach and its power! This extraordinary supernatural oddity can now open a portal directly to the target's location to snatch it up immediately and consume its essence with increased efficiency!
marketing_text: This shining arcane marvel hovers above the peaks of Moussu Picchu drawing upon the natural magic of the mountain to enhance its own mystical mouse-catching energies.

name: Titanic Twisted Garden Turtle Trap Skin
description:
This massive mechanical marvel takes all the sophistication and grace of its predecessor and replaces it with monstrous marine stopping power! The sheer size of this aquatic automaton is enough to terrify most mice but those who aren't intimidated by its size will surely second guess themselves when they witness how impossibly swift it is despite its gargantuan physique. However, its impressive size and speed pale in comparison to the mighty power of its ferocious, titanium jaws. The bite force of their snap currently remains unmeasured because they have destroyed every measuring device that has attempted to quantify their strength.

Few hunters realize that this gigantic marine machine is actually much more than just a big, dumb brute. The vast number of Pearls of Wisdom used in the construction of its complex circuitry actually make it a terrific conversationalist, a gifted and reliable advisor, and even a world class chess player!
marketing_text: This massive, moss-laden, bark-backed garden turtle is as fiercely stubborn as it is dangerous. It has spent so much time in the Living and Twisted Gardens that the strange and exotic plant life there has grown into and around it, turning this large amphibious machine into an eternal fixture in the soil.
